*Gabriel Manalu,Minh Son Hoang,Hyeontaek Hwang,Jaesung Lee,Hyojin Choi,Tran Tuan Phong,Seon Kwon Kim,Saad Wazir,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DashBench 基准，用 1,709 段行车视频（含碰撞与非碰撞的罕见"长尾场景"）评测 25 个视频大模型，发现全部模型在安全关键场景下远低于可用门槛，常误判、漏判并产生幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对自动驾驶场景的视频大模型评测基准主要基于常规交通条件和一般理解任务，无法评估模型在最罕见、最安全关键的"corner case"（边角场景）上的表现，而这些恰是自动驾驶落地的核心风险点。

Method: 构建 DashBench 基准：精心筛选 1,709 段行车视频，覆盖碰撞相关与罕见的非碰撞边角场景；设计多样化提示与开放式问答任务，对 25 个视频大模型进行系统评测，并结合严格评测工具包做诊断分析。

Result: 所有被评测模型的表现均显著低于安全关键驾驶应用所需的门槛；模型频繁误判或漏检前方危险事件，并在解释中幻觉出并不存在的交通参与者或动作，暴露出关键能力缺口。

Conclusion: DashBench 以大规模数据集、严格评测工具和对现有模型缺陷的细致诊断，推动更安全、更可解释的自动驾驶系统研究；代码与数据将公开于 cornercase-dashbench.github.io。

Abstract: Natural language explanations promised by modern Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) offer autonomous driving systems a path toward detailed scene description and interpretable decision making on the road. While recent benchmarks have begun assessing these models on driving scenes, they mainly target routine traffic conditions and general comprehension tasks based on existing driving datasets and therefore fail to evaluate model performance on the rarest and most safety-critical driving events, also known as "corner cases". To provide a comprehensive evaluation of Video LLMs on precisely these scenarios, we introduce DashBench, a benchmark testing 25 Video LLMs on 1,709 carefully curated driving videos spanning not only collision-related corner cases but also rare non-collision ones. Through extensive prompts and open-ended question answering, we expose a critical capability gap: all evaluated models perform substantially below the threshold required for safety-critical driving applications, frequently misjudging or missing dangerous events on the road ahead and hallucinating non-existent agents or actions in their explanations. We believe DashBench, combining an extensive dataset with a rigorous evaluation toolkit and a detailed diagnosis of current model limitations, drives progress toward safer, more explainable autonomous driving systems. The code and data will be shared at: cornercase-dashbench.github.io

</details>


### [140] [EG360: Efficient and Generalizable $360^\circ$ Depth Estimation via Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation and Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16793)
*Laiyan Ding,Chongxi Meng,Rui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EG360：基于自适应全景-透视蒸馏与球面跨层特征融合的轻量可泛化全景深度估计模型，6.593M参数、Jetson Orin NX上35 FPS并具强零样本性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用全景深度估计依赖大预训练模型，零样本泛化好但计算开销大，难以在嵌入式平台实时推理；而已有轻量全景模型多为单域训练，受域偏移影响泛化差。本文旨在弥合二者差距，兼顾轻量与泛化。

Method: 以轻量深度模型为基础，提出由场景几何引导的自适应全景-透视蒸馏（APPD）策略，并设计球面跨层特征融合（SCFF）模块以增强全局语义感知；重参数化后仅6.593M参数。

Result: 在真实世界基准上取得强零样本性能；Jetson Orin NX 16GB（MAXN模式）上达35 FPS，而此前ViT-small模型不足2 FPS。

Conclusion: 通过蒸馏与特征融合设计，EG360在极低参数量下实现了兼具泛化性与实时性的全景深度估计，为嵌入式部署提供可行方案，代码将公开。

Abstract: Generalized panorama depth estimation has witnessed great advances in recent years. These methods typically achieve robust zero-shot generalization performance using large pretrained models, but their high computational cost makes real-time inference on embedded platforms challenging. In contrast, previous lightweight panorama models have mostly been developed for single-domain evaluations and cannot generalize well due to domain shifts. To reduce the gap between these two types of models, we introduce EG360, an efficient and generalizable panorama depth estimation model. Specifically, building on a lightweight depth model, we design an Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation (APPD) strategy guided by scene geometry, along with a Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF) module for global semantic perception. As a result, with only 6.593M parameters after reparameterization, EG360 achieves strong zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks and runs at 35 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode, whereas a previous ViT-small model runs at less than 2 FPS. Our code will also be made public for future research.

</details>


### [141] [Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16840)
*Sheng Tang,Shengzhe Wei,Tiancheng Chen,Wenhua Jin,Xinyang Lu,Tinghao Jiang,Shuoxuan Feng,Yupeng Liu,Yu Zhang,Xingshuo Chang,Keren Zhou,Yuhan Xiong,Jiahao Li,Haoming Liu,Jituo Tian,Hui Liang,Chaoqun Tang,Feng Tian,Wentao Ouyang,Kaojin Zhu,Xiaolin Chai,Peihuang Fu,Miao Zheng,Yunbo Hu,Feixue Cai,Zizhen Zou,Weigang Wang,Yexuan Yang,Haoyu Feng,Weiqi Zhang,Juntong Fang,Zesong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Kosmo-GFM 将几何基础模型、位姿优化引擎与重建衍生监督结合，实现高效的场景级重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建一个能在场景级别鲁棒恢复相机位姿与几何的重建系统，并为下游 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 提供支持，同时利用重建场景反哺几何基础模型。

Method: GFM 从图像/视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视角对应和动态 3D 点；PoseEngine 结合这些预测与几何优化恢复场景级位姿与几何；KosmoWorld 从重建的真实场景生成图像与几何监督以改进 GFM。此外提供 PoseEngine Flash 混合精度版本。

Result: SpatialBench 上深度相对误差最低、5° 相对位姿 AUC 最高；五个数据集上动态点与场景流平均终点误差最低；34 个场景中 PoseEngine 在 1°/3°/5° 阈值下位姿 AUC 最高，累计耗时 14.07 小时（约 GLUEMAP 69.67 小时的 20%），Flash 版 2.62 小时（约 4%）；数据、算力、训练预算扩展实验趋势良好。

Conclusion: 结果表明在场景级重建流程中使用学习到的几何先验是可行且有效的，兼具精度与效率优势。

Abstract: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.

</details>


### [142] [Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16861)
*Deyao Hong,Jiayi Jiang,Yuchun Chen,Yixuan Shi,Wenyi Li,Zheng Jiang,Chengxing Xie,Mingyu Su,Qingle Liu,Mingju Gao,Yizhe Chi,Youjie Zheng,Calvin Xiao,Kaisen Yang,Huan-ang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Visual Cipher Bench（40 道原创视觉谜题，覆盖空间操作、逻辑规划、规则归纳与知识解码四类），仅给出 1–3 幅黑白线稿和极简提交指令，要求模型完全从图像中发现解题机制。8 个前沿模型共 29 种推理配置下最强仅 26.7%，5 个模型低于 1%；给出非剧透机制提示后准确率从 7.8% 升至 55.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体在长程编程与终端任务上的成功依赖两个条件：明确的文本规格与即时执行反馈。然而真实问题中关键信息只存在于图像里，规则与线索难以转写为文字，也缺少测试用例反馈，因此"长程能力是否可从文本迁移到视觉推理"尚不明确。现有评测无法捕捉这一能力：视觉推理基准多为单轮短链问答，智能体基准则集中于文本环境或可试错的交互状态。

Method: 构建 Visual Cipher Bench：40 道原创视觉谜题，分四类（空间操作与模拟、逻辑约束与规划、规则归纳、知识类解码）。每题仅提供 1–3 幅黑白线稿与最小化提交指令，迫使智能体反复检查图像、模拟空间变换、自主交叉验证线索，完全从视觉证据中发现解题机制。评测 8 个前沿模型的 29 种推理努力程度配置，并在 10 题子集上做提示消融实验。

Result: 最强模型 GPT-6 Astra（max）仅达 26.7% 准确率，8 个模型中 5 个低于 1%；在 10 题子集上加入一条不含解法剧透的机制提示，准确率从 7.8% 跃升至 55.6%。

Conclusion: 当前智能体的主要瓶颈不在执行多步计划，而在自主从视觉证据中发现规则；一旦规则被给出，执行能力即显著释放。Visual Cipher Bench 为衡量智能体的长程视觉推理提供了严格基准。

Abstract: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

</details>


### [143] [Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16869)
*Xiaoyang Li,Xinghao Yan,Yuan Chai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Raysemble从单张X射线重建腰椎与骨盆共八块骨骼，通过将形状与位置解耦实现高精度3D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单张X射线重建多块骨骼的3D结构具有挑战性，需同时处理形状与空间布局，现有方法精度不足。

Method: 每个3D查询点在图像投影处采样局部与全局特征，共享解码器预测归一化骨骼形状；利用预测深度与相机几何确定3D中心与尺度，将形状重采样至统一的毫米网格。

Result: 在23名留出患者43个CT生成的模拟正位X射线上，无需刚性对齐即在15种对比方法中领先，三随机种子平均Dice 65.24%、HD95 9.09mm、ASSD 3.32mm，较VolumeNeRF的Dice提升5.86个百分点。

Conclusion: 形状-位置解耦的范式有效提升了单视图多骨骼重建精度，优于现有方法。

Abstract: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.

</details>


### [144] [TokenStream: Multi-Subject Personalized Video Generation with Token-wise LoRA and Guided Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16897)
*Hung Nguyen,Quang Qui-Vinh Nguyen,Khoi Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TokenStream 提出一种基于优化的框架，可在文本到视频生成中组合多个独立学习的主体身份，并通过 ToRA、T2V 引导流与新基准 Multi-DB 提升身份保持与文本对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多主体视频生成中，单张参考图学习难以将主体外观与静态图像偏置分离；直接合并独立训练的适配器又会导致身份混淆。同时缺乏无需参考视频、无需对每个新组合联合优化的方法及相应评测基准。

Method: 1) Token-wise LoRA（ToRA）：将低秩更新限定在主体相关文本 token 的交叉注意力 value 投影上，为每个主体提供独立适配路径；2) T2V 引导流：早期去噪阶段从冻结基模型复制 query 和 key，以复用其布局与运动先验，同时保留个性化 value；3) 构建 Multi-DB 基准：30 个主体、122 个提示，提示中不含外观描述并涵盖多样交互。

Result: 在 1.3B 模型上的 Multi-DB 基准中，身份保持指标由 DreamBooth 的 0.422 提升至 0.467，文本对齐由 0.652 提升至 0.688。

Conclusion: TokenStream 无需参考视频训练数据集或逐组合联合优化即可组合独立学习的主体身份，验证了 token 级适配与基模型先验复用的有效性，并提供了 Multi-DB 这一多主体视频生成评测基准。

Abstract: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination. Learning from a single reference image makes subject appearance difficult to separate from static-image bias, while merging independently trained adapters can mix identities. Token-wise LoRA (ToRA) restricts low-rank updates to the cross-attention value projections of subject-associated text tokens, providing a separate adaptation path for each subject. A T2V-guided stream copies queries and keys from the frozen base model during early denoising to reuse its layout and motion priors while retaining personalized values. We also introduce Multi-DB, a 30-subject, 122-prompt benchmark with appearance-free prompts and varied interactions. On Multi-DB at 1.3B, TokenStream improves identity preservation from 0.422 for DreamBooth to 0.467 and textual alignment from 0.652 to 0.688.

</details>


### [145] [Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16907)
*Kesi Xu,Ayesha Azam,Tanvier Kaur,Monika Kondratowicz,Kinza Asim,Brinder Chohan,Paapa Appiah-Odame,Zhao Chen,David Snead,Nasir Rajpoot*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段PD-L1 TPS评估框架，其中D2Count-Net计数阳性/阴性肿瘤细胞计算TPS，TPS-Guard以模型间分歧估计不确定性，转诊最不确定切片并标记接近1%/50%阈值的病例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PD-L1 TPS决定NSCLC免疫治疗选择，1%和50%阈值附近尤其需要更仔细的复核，但自动评分系统缺少可靠的"何时需人工复审"的提示机制。

Method: 三阶段流程：阶段1定位肿瘤区域并排除巨噬细胞富集斑块；阶段2双分支计数网络D2Count-Net分别计数PD-L1阳性与阴性肿瘤细胞得出TPS；阶段3不确定性引导的分诊机制TPS-Guard，以独立训练模型间的分歧作为不确定性，转诊最不确定切片，并在估计跨越阈值不一致时标记1%或50%附近的分数。回顾性单中心研究，154张WSI、三位病理学家互相比对。

Result: 114张训练未见切片上模型MAE为6.96个百分点，落在三位病理学家区间（4.24–8.29）内；模型不确定性与绝对TPS误差相关（rho=0.77）、与病理学家间分歧相关（rho=0.71）；转诊最不确定的15%切片后，模型与病理学家MAE均下降。未经再训练应用于外部公开数据集仍能将复核引向高误差病例，转诊更多不确定病例可提升50%阈值处敏感性。

Conclusion: TPS-Guard为单个自动评分提供复审理由，并能识别病理学家之间分歧更大的切片；其对TPS报告的实际影响仍需前瞻性阅片研究验证。

Abstract: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.

</details>


### [146] [Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16925)
*Chang Liu,Henghui Ding,Tong Yang,Dayoung Kil,Seong-heum Kim,Qilin Xiang,Ronghao Zheng,Ziyang Zhang,Shanlin Jiang,Ruohan Shi,Qilin Fan,Chengfeng Qiu,Kaifeng Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ECCV 2026 LSVOS挑战赛MUMU赛道总结：要求单一模型（≤0.5B参数、≤8GB峰值显存）同时完成多概念图像打标、开放词汇检测与简短描述；三支领先队伍均基于Florence-2-base做不同扩展，检测新类别仍是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动端场景需要统一的紧凑多模态模型，同时覆盖打标、检测与描述三类任务，并在严格的参数与显存预算下高效运行，因此设立MUMU赛道以推动该方向研究。

Method: 赛道定义三项联合任务（质量/场景/事件词表的多概念图像打标、开放词汇目标检测、简短图像描述），预算0.5B参数与8GB峰值推理显存，按加权任务得分乘效率因子排名。前三方案均以Florence-2-base为基础：①轻量打标头+跨任务推理精修；②在多源覆盖感知数据上训练的共享低秩适配器+任务相关解码；③免训练流水线，将描述映射为标签并对检测做测试时增强。

Result: 三支队伍均成功在预算内用单一Florence-2-base扩展实现三类输出；其中新类别开放词汇检测性能明显落后，成为主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 紧凑的提示式视觉-语言模型可为三类任务共用，前提是针对各任务设计监督方式、解码策略与跨任务线索；未来重点在于提升新类别开放词汇检测能力。

Abstract: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.

</details>


### [147] [A Disease-specific Retinal Aging Biomarker for Predicting Progression to Late Age-related Macular Degeneration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16955)
*Hexin Dong,Benjamin Hou,Puzhen Wu,Mingquan Lin,Emily Y. Chew,Zhiyong Lu,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出并验证"眼底AMD年龄"(FAA)指标，用于量化AMD特异性视网膜衰老，在AREDS/AREDS2数据上显示优于实际年龄的预后分层能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际年龄虽是AMD主要风险因素，但无法反映个体视网膜衰老差异，限制了AMD风险分层与及时干预的效果。

Method: 基于AREDS数据（2,192名参与者、36,782张眼底图像）训练FAA模型，并在AREDS与AREDS2队列中验证；将FAA纳入Cox比例风险模型，与基于实际年龄的方法比较，并在不同表型定义（读片中心判定 vs 专家判定）下评估。

Result: AREDS中C-index由0.836提升至0.888，5年Brier分数由0.050降至0.046；AREDS2中C-index由0.715提升至0.756，2年Brier由0.078降至0.076，且在多种表型定义下结果一致。

Conclusion: FAA能捕捉AMD相关的加速视网膜衰老，提升AMD风险预测与分层精度，值得进一步评估其临床应用价值。

Abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults. While chronological age is a primary risk factor, it inadequately reflects individual variations in retinal aging, limiting effective AMD risk stratification and timely intervention. Here, we propose and validate fundus-based AMD age (FAA), which quantifies disease-specific retinal aging in AMD and captures accelerated AMD-related retinal aging, thereby improving prognostic precision over chronological age. Trained on 36,782 images from 2,192 participants in the Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) dataset and validated across AREDS and AREDS2 cohorts, our model demonstrates significant improvements over traditional chronological age-based approaches. Specifically, integrating the proposed FAA into Cox proportional-hazards models significantly enhances prediction performance. FAA improved the C-index from 0.836 to 0.888 and reduced the 5-year Brier score from 0.050 to 0.046 in AREDS, with consistent gains observed in AREDS2 (C-index 0.715 to 0.756; 2-year Brier 0.078 to 0.076). FAA showed improved prognostic performance across the two datasets and under different phenotype definitions (reading center-defined vs. specialist-defined grading), supporting its potential utility for AMD risk stratification. These findings highlight the advantage of incorporating FAA into AMD risk prediction frameworks, supporting further evaluation of FAA for AMD risk stratification.

</details>


### [148] [ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16984)
*Ulysse Mizrahi,Sean Zaretzky,Dov Danon,Amit H. Bermano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ElasticDino，一个轻量适适器，通过对齐并消除跨通道一致的空间伪影，高效生成像素对齐的高分辨率特征图，用于 ViT 密集预测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 自注意力二次复杂度限制了特征分辨率并引入空间伪影，而分割、深度估计等密集任务需要高分辨率且细节保真的特征。

Method: 观察到伪影跨通道一致，用基于空间形变（deformation）的轻量架构同时校正伪影并与输入图像结构对齐；因缺乏真值，用线性头的像素级语义分割与深度估计等下游密集任务引导形变过程，避免任务特定语义泄漏进模型。

Result: 在多个主流密集任务基准上精度优于现有方法，且计算性能更优。

Conclusion: ElasticDino 以轻量形变式适器高效产出像素对齐高分辨率特征，保留锐利语义、避免平滑偏差，是提升 ViT 密集预测的通用有效方案。

Abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts. In this work, we introduce ElasticDino, a lightweight adapter which produces high-resolution feature maps, adhering to the fine details of the input image. As a key insight, we observe the consistency of artifacts across channels, and simultaneously resolve them to match the input image structure. Using a slim architecture based on spatial deformations, ElasticDino produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps efficiently. Leveraging deformations allows strictly preserving sharp semantics, and thereby avoiding the smoothness biases inherent to alternative approaches. Due to the absence of ground truth, we employ pixel-level semantic segmentation and depth estimation with linear heads to predict a set of downstream dense tasks, guiding the deformation process without leaking task-specific semantics into the model. We demonstrate superior accuracy over current methods on a range of popular dense task benchmarks, with better computational performance.

</details>


### [149] [AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17048)
*Shuhan Li,Huankang Guan,Xintong Guo,Yang Bo,Yuyang He,Dunyuan Xu,Jingyan Chen,Fang Liu,Tsz Kin Wan,Jinpeng Chen,Zhenqi He,Yuxuan Hu,Wenbo Li,Han Gao,Qijun Li,Long Chen,Hongsheng Li,Rui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AURA 2.0 是一个流式视频大语言模型，核心是让模型能主动发起对话（MIC），并支持流式工具调用、交互式视觉定位与长程交互记忆，在开源流式模型中性能领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 助手只在被提示时响应，即使视频流中出现值得讨论的事件也保持沉默，交互完全是用户驱动的。作者希望突破这种纯用户驱动模式，让模型能主动识别话题并发起对话。

Method: 在 AURA 基础上做三项升级：模型主动对话（MIC）、流式感知工具调用（SATC，利用当前视觉与对话上下文调用外部工具并融合返回信息）、交互式视觉定位（IVG，识别用户标注物体并输出帧对齐边界框）。此外构造专门的流式交互数据集，采用三阶段训练整合新行为与原有流式交互能力，并加入长程交互记忆（LHIM）维持长视频流中的上下文连贯性。

Result: 在公开流式基准上，AURA 2.0 在开源流式模型中取得领先性能；针对性评测进一步验证了其新增交互能力。模型权重与推理代码已开源。

Conclusion: AURA 2.0 将流式视频 LLM 从被动响应推进到主动交互，结合工具调用、视觉定位与长程记忆，展现了主动式多模态交互的可行方向。

Abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.

</details>


### [150] [Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17060)
*Hao Li,Fangzhou Hong,Zhaoxi Chen,Hui En Pang,Kairui Hu,Mingze Sun,Runmao Yao,Xinhao Ji,Xiyuan Zheng,Xuanli Chen,Yalun Dai,Yap Kim Hui,Dingwen Zhang,Yuanyuan Gao,Ziang Cao,Cheng Huang Yean,Jackson Peng,Rui Duan,Yaobo Liu,Zetong Wang,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Ropedia Xperience 2 数据集，包含 1,589 个度量尺度 3D 场景扫描与 4,230 段第一人称人类演示（74 任务、131 小时），并展示将每次采集复用为机器人学习资源（场景转仿真环境、人体动作重定向、虚拟遥操作与自动长程轨迹生成），为研究物理 AI 在环境与行为上的扩展律奠定数据基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型基础模型虽能直接从视觉观测控制机器人，但在真实世界的长程、接触密集任务上仍脆弱。物理 AI 的进步依赖两类资源：监督"任务如何执行"的人类演示数据，以及可闭环 rollout、评估与改进的交互环境。语言模型已有明确的扩展律，而物理 AI 的关键问题——能力如何随环境与行为规模扩展——尚未被刻画，其前提是确定该扩展哪些数据、如何持续生产与复用这些数据。

Method: 构建 Ropedia Xperience 2 数据集：1,589 个已发布的度量尺度 3D 扫描，以及覆盖 74 个任务的 4,230 段第一人称录制（131 小时）。进一步将每次采集复用为机器人学习资源：(1) 将场景转换为物理可交互仿真环境；(2) 将人体运动重定向为全身机器人轨迹；(3) 通过虚拟遥操作与自动化长程轨迹生成获得额外机器人行为。作者将此"环境与行为联合采集"定位为物理 AI 数据采集的黄金标准。

Result: 发布 1,589 个度量尺度 3D 扫描与 4,230 段第一人称演示（74 任务、131 小时）；验证采集可被转化为仿真环境、全身机器人轨迹及额外生成行为，证明同一份采集可多重复用于机器人学习。

Conclusion: 环境与行为的联合采集可作为物理 AI 数据采集的黄金标准，为建立"环境规模—行为规模"上的扩展律提供数据基础。

Abstract: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.

</details>


### [151] [SALT: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer for Single-Temporal Cross-Dataset Structural Localization in Remote Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17077)
*Aggelos Psiris,Georgios Angelidis,Giorgos Sfikas,Maria Vakalopoulou,Thomas Lagkas,Panagiotis Sarigiannidis,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SALT：冻结DINOv3主干，学习正/负结构状态并与低秩适配对齐，实现仅用单时相影像的跨数据集变化检测迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感变化检测通常依赖双时相空间对齐影像，实际中常不可得。单时相方法依赖源数据集的结构证据迁移，但特征适配易过拟合源域、损害跨数据集泛化；作者认为当适配参数与预测所用状态独立参数化时，该风险更高。

Method: 提出State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer（SALT）框架：冻结DINOv3主干，学习负/正结构状态用于为每个patch打分，并通过State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation（SALA）张成rank-2子空间以校正patch特征；采用Directional State Alignment监督校正方向（提升正patch证据、压低负patch证据），并用Geometry Preservation限制预训练patch特征间成对关系的变化。

Result: 在LEVIR-CD与WHU航拍建筑数据集上，像素级及双向迁移均优于四种统一source-only协议复现的基线：像素级AP提升9.45和5.79点，IoU提升27.69和14.25点（LEVIR-CD→WHU、WHU→LEVIR-CD）；仅0.068M可训练参数，每张图40.2 ms。

Conclusion: 将特征适配参数与预测状态对齐，可在极小参数与计算开销下显著提升单时相变化检测的跨数据集泛化能力；代码已开源。

Abstract: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios. Recent single-temporal approaches address this limitation by learning structural evidence, such as building regions, from a labeled source dataset and transferring it to unseen target imagery using only the current image. However, adaptation to the source dataset can over-specialize pretrained features and reduce their cross-dataset generalization, a risk that this paper argues is higher when the feature adaptation is parameterized independently of the states used for prediction. To address this issue, the current study introduces SALT, a State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer framework. SALT keeps a DINOv3 backbone frozen and learns negative and positive structural states that both score each patch and, through State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA), span the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected. Directional State Alignment supervises these corrections to raise the evidence of positive patches and lower that of negative ones, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. Experiments on LEVIR-CD and the WHU aerial building dataset show that, at the pixel level and in both transfer directions, SALT outperforms four baselines reproduced under a common source-only protocol, improving over the strongest reproduced baselines by 9.45 and 5.79 points in pixel-level AP and by 27.69 and 14.25 points in IoU (LEVIR-CD to WHU and WHU to LEVIR-CD, respectively), with only 0.068M trainable parameters and 40.2 ms per image. In order to facilitate reproducibility and further research, the source code of SALT is available at https://github.com/gthpapadopoulos/SALT

</details>


### [152] [Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17103)
*Tian Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JNSP：将模型合并重构为子空间干扰问题，通过对每个任务的权重增量取前-r右奇异子空间并投影去除其他任务子空间分量，实现无数据、闭式、顺序无关的CLIP多任务合并，平均准确率89.45%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练合并方法（平均、幅度剪枝、符号选举）均逐元素操作，忽略了每个delta在其作用的隐特征上仅诱导低维更新的结构特性，导致任务向量相互干扰。

Method: 对每个二维权重张量，取各任务delta的前-r右奇异子空间（该任务对表示影响最大的输入方向），从每个任务向量中移除位于其他任务子空间并集内的分量，得到闭式、顺序无关、无需前向传播的联合零空间投影（JNSP）。

Result: 在8个CLIP分类任务上ViT-B/16平均89.45%，超TIES 11.88点、Task Arithmetic 14.22点、WUDI 0.98点；TALL数据集三种骨干均提升(+10.8/+12.6/+9.1)，复现89.20%。消融：共享单一子空间降2.9点，顺序变体跌至69.6%。RoBERTa-large上劣于普通task arithmetic。

Conclusion: 子空间级投影是有效的免训练合并思路，在CLIP视觉任务上显著领先；但方法并非通用，在NLP模型上失效，作者如实报告了该局限。

Abstract: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps. In practice the task vectors of different tasks interfere, and the standard remedies--averaging, magnitude pruning, sign election--operate entry by entry, ignoring that each delta induces a low-dimensional update on the hidden features it acts upon. We recast merging as a subspace interference problem. For every two-dimensional weight tensor we take the top-r right-singular subspace of each task's delta--the input directions along which that task moves the representation most--and remove from each task vector the component lying in the union of the other tasks' subspaces. The resulting Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP) is closed-form and order-independent, needs no forward pass, and is defined entirely by the checkpoint set. On eight CLIP image-classification tasks JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy without using a single image, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline (TIES-Merging, 77.57%), 14.22 above Task Arithmetic, and 0.98 above WUDI's data-free consensus merge (88.47%). The gain holds across three backbones on the independently trained TALL release (+10.8, +12.6, +9.1 over TIES for ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14) and replicates there at 89.20%; controls confirm the source--a single shared subspace instead of per-task ones loses 2.9 points, and a sequential variant collapses to 69.6%. On RoBERTa-large the same projection underperforms plain task arithmetic, which we report rather than hide. Code is available at https://github.com.

</details>


### [153] [TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17104)
*Ruijie Wu,Yuechen Yang,Yanfan Zhu,Yu Wang,Shilin Zhao,Ming-Tsun Tsai,Szu-Yuan Li,Shuo-Ming Ou,Tz-Heng Chen,Haichun Yang,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TuMAP是一种病理组学流程，通过双视图基础模型表征、形态型标注与组成/形态型内分析，从35.8万个肾小管中识别出8种形态型，并揭示不同肾病在形态型组成及形态型内部表型上的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肾小管形态高度异质，使得与疾病相关的肾小管重塑难以量化，现有方法无法区分"形态型组成的改变"与"同一形态型内部的表型差异"。

Method: TuMAP流程包含三部分：(1) 双视图基础模型表征与临时形态型标注；(2) 组成性病理组学及形态型内部病理组学分析；(3) 患者层面的统计推断。数据为358张PAS染色肾活检切片中的456,158个肾小管。

Result: 识别出8种基于图像的形态型，其中7种在子采样中分配稳定。在6个诊断组的219名患者中，糖尿病肾病(DN)和肾小管间质性肾炎/急性肾小管损伤(TIN/ATI)各有7种形态型比例与微小病变不同，IgA肾病有6种不同。DN在所有8种形态型中均表现为核实度降低、偏心度增加；面积归一化核密度进一步揭示了形态型内部差异。

Conclusion: TuMAP提供了一个框架，可将肾小管形态型组成的改变与形态型内部的表型差异分离，实现更精细的疾病相关肾小管重塑量化。

Abstract: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.

</details>


### [154] [Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17105)
*Amirmohammad Mohammadi,Rupak Khadka,Kathleen A. Grant,Mary Lauren Benton,Joshua Peeples*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究将视觉语言模型（VLM）与参数高效微调（PEFT）结合，用于非人灵长类肝脏组织学的少样本全切片图像分类（预测乙醇饮用状态），所有PEFT配置均优于非PEFT基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算病理中的少样本全切片图像（WSI）分类具有挑战性，而VLM结合PEFT被认为是一种有前景的方案，但需要在真实组织学任务（如从肝脏切片预测饮酒状态）中验证其有效性。

Method: 在猴子酒精组织研究资源（MATRR）子集上，将适配器（adapter）与多种非PEFT配置进行对比评估；采用注意力机制的多实例学习（ABMIL）作为框架，并对文本通路与视觉通路的适配进行定性注意力热图分析及病理学家复核。

Result: 所有PEFT配置的平均平衡准确率均高于非PEFT基线；如在四样本（four-shot）设置下，仅用ABMIL为43.5%，加入适配器后提升至78.1%。注意力分析显示文本通路适配产生更局部化的热图，视觉通路适配则更弥散，而病理学家认为各适配方案识别出的组织学特征相似。

Conclusion: VLM+PEFT在少样本WSI分类中显著优于非PEFT方法，且不同通路适配在注意力模式上存在差异但组织学依据一致，显示该方案在计算病理少样本任务中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.

</details>


### [155] [STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17126)
*Tingfeng Li,Ming-Fang Huang,Shaobo Han,Yue Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STeP-C神经压缩框架，在实时DAS流式采集系统上实现端到端部署，以98.85%压缩率、31.04dB PSNR和535MB/s吞吐完成实时压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DFOS/DAS产生数百MB/s的高分辨率时空数据，实时存储与传输困难。已有神经压缩方法要么需逐段重训练无法流式，要么仅离线验证，缺乏大规模流式端到端部署。

Method: STeP-C解耦空间编码、时间预测与熵优化残差编码，以条件熵削减为动机的率失真目标端到端训练；指出熵编码为流式瓶颈，采用GPU端符号计算、缓存概率表、无GIL并行算术编码、FP16推理与批量熵编码，并围绕GPU环形缓冲构建实时流水线。

Result: 在实时DAS测试床上实现98.85%文件体积缩减、31.04dB全频带PSNR、平均535MB/s吞吐（超过1kHz/81km DAS所需的324MB/s）；显著优于传统编解码器；可免训练迁移到未见信道范围；保持下游检测一致性（96.62%高置信类别一致、事件类型100% Jaccard相似度）。

Conclusion: STeP-C首次在真实流式DAS系统上端到端验证神经压缩的实时可行性，证明熵编码工程优化是流式部署关键，且在压缩效率、泛化性与下游任务一致性上均表现优异。

Abstract: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.

</details>


### [156] [HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17146)
*Robbie Hamilton,Fan Zhang,David Bull*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiVE-VQA用单个冻结的V-JEPA 2.1视频基础模型，从多深度提取token网格并堆叠成层级时空体，由紧凑3D卷积头融合，仅训练5.2M参数即在多个NR-VQA基准上超越17个SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户生成视频激增使NR-VQA至关重要，但现有方法依赖复杂的多分支架构或对单分支骨干的高成本微调，效率与效果难以兼顾。作者想验证：单个冻结视频基础模型能否作为有效的NR-VQA骨干。

Method: 冻结预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器，从中多个深度提取token网格并堆叠为层级时空体积；用一个紧凑3D卷积头沿层、空间、时间三轴融合，结合浅层失真线索与深层语义/时序上下文。只训练头部（5.2M参数，占总量5.7%），无辅助多模态模型，推理成本与分辨率无关。

Result: 仅在LSVQ训练、不微调，在SROCC和PLCC上于域内（LSVQ-test、LSVQ-1080p）和跨域（KoNViD-1k、LIVE-VQC）基准超越17个SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 对单一冻结视频基础模型做层级化的逐深度特征融合，比任务特定的多网络融合更有效、更高效，可作为NR-VQA的强基线。

Abstract: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA.

</details>


### [157] [SpotDiff: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Zero-Shot Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17172)
*Anit Upadhyaya,Ata Akbari Asanjan,Chaitanya Jalluri,Subash Yeggina,Jeremy Kravitz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpotDiff是一个免训练、即插即用的零样本变化检测框架，通过组合DINOv3、AnyUp和SAM 3三个视觉基础模型，无需任何变化标签即可实现高精度遥感变化检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统遥感变化检测依赖大量时间对齐的像素级标注，难以跨区域、跨成像平台和跨领域扩展；现有零样本方法虽减少监督需求，但因特征粗糙或跨时相不一致，细粒度变化定位效果差。

Method: 组合互补的视觉基础模型：用DINOv3提取语义稳健特征，用AnyUp将其重建到像素分辨率，用SAM 3生成文本引导的感兴趣区域候选，并通过推理时多尺度策略（SWIMS）使小目标检测更可靠；随后在候选区域内比较两期重建特征来度量变化，全程无可学习组件、无微调、无变化标签。

Result: 首次将通用特征上采样器用于变化检测，仅此一项即比双线性上采样提升13.8 F1；LEVIR-CD上达到82.46 F1，比最强先前免训练方法高2.06分；多类SECOND基准上建筑变化检测提升10.3 IoU，六类平均提升2.2 IoU；在PlanetScope(3m)和Sentinel-2(10m)影像上无需修改即可跨分辨率迁移。

Conclusion: 组合现代基础模型是实现可扩展、无标签变化检测的有效途径。

Abstract: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains. Recent zero-shot approaches reduce the need for supervision, but they often localize fine-grained changes poorly because their features are coarse or inconsistent across time. We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot change detection built by composing complementary vision foundation models. SpotDiff uses DINOv3 for semantically robust features, AnyUp to reconstruct them at pixel resolution, and SAM 3 for text-guided region-of-interest proposals, which an inference-time multi-scale strategy (SWIMS) makes reliable on small objects. Change is then measured by comparing the reconstructed features of the two dates inside the proposed regions, with no learnable components, fine-tuning or change labels. To our knowledge, SpotDiff is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, which alone adds 13.8 F1 over bilinear upsampling of the same features. On LEVIR-CD, SpotDiff reaches 82.46 F1, 2.06 points above the strongest prior training-free method, and on the multi-class SECOND benchmark it improves building change detection by 10.3 IoU and the six-class average by 2.2 IoU. Qualitative results on PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery show that the same pipeline transfers across resolutions without modification. Our results indicate that composing modern foundation models is an effective route to scalable, label-free change detection.

</details>


### [158] [Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17176)
*Raghavendra Ramachandra,Hailin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究探索用验证数据做提示词选择（而非微调）来提升冻结参数视觉语言模型在差分变脸攻击检测（D-MAD）中的性能，Version 1 提示词选择显著降低 MACER，但递归修订未能进一步提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在冻结参数的 VLM 评估器中，能否通过基于有标签验证数据的提示词选择来改善 D-MAD 性能，而无需微调模型。

Method: Version 1 生成 50 个候选提示词，用安全导向损失（优先漏检变脸攻击 MACER，兼顾真实样本误分类 BSCER、响应/解析失败与决策不一致）选最优；Version 2 基于验证集聚合反馈递归修订提示词。

Result: 在 160 对主体不相交测试集（LMA、MIPGAN-2、PIPE）上，Version 1 提示词 MACER 为 19.17%、BSCER 为 0.00%，而人工控制提示词 MACER 为 70.00%（差 50.83 个百分点，95% bootstrap 区间 [43.33,58.33]）。递归修订未超过 Generation 0 最优验证损失，其修订后代测试 MACER 为 31.67%。Version 1 漏检的 23 个攻击全部为关键点类（LMA）变脸。

Conclusion: 提示词构建能显著影响冻结参数 VLM 的 D-MAD 性能，但也揭示了仅用 10 名受试者的小规模验证集下递归提示词优化仍具挑战。

Abstract: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

</details>


### [159] [Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17190)
*Robert Fonod,Nikolas Geroliminis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对悬停无人机视频参考帧稳定中"共识捕获"（consensus capture）问题，构建静态与动态两部分基准，在4K航拍帧上评测十种配准管线，并量化目标掩膜的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有配准管线都是在"仅相机运动"的特征匹配基准上选型的，但在繁忙路口，同向运动的车辆会提供互相一致的对应点，把鲁棒的单应矩阵估计拉向自身运动，即"共识捕获"。这种失效无法通过内点统计（inlier 数量/比例）发现，因此需要专门的对准评测方法。

Method: 提出两部分基准：静态协议在精确已知单应下评测10种管线，按站点不重叠划分并与分辨率、特征预算匹配后调参；动态协议在离线与实时两种预算下评测，悬停片段仅依据视频本身选取以覆盖不同运动前景的数量与一致性，并设静止对照。指标包括背景对齐、目标位置误差、估计跟随运动群位移的比例，采用经人工标注地面控制点审计的伪真值参考，同时评估掩膜方案。

Result: 静态场景中调参后的 AKAZE、RootSIFT、SIFT、BRISK 领先；重调匹配器阈值使 mAA 最多提升 0.0062，掩膜代价小于 0.005。未加掩膜的 ORB 在 304 对实时动态样本中有 28 对被捕获，离线有 6 对；其实时被捕获估计的中位角点误差为 18.8 px，但内点数与内点比仍属典型。掩膜可消除所有管线的捕获，且不改变领先管线排序。

Conclusion: 共识捕获是现有特征配准管线在动态航拍场景中真实存在且内点统计无法察觉的失效模式；目标掩膜是有效且代价低的防护手段。作者公开了代码、数据与结果，为该问题提供可复现的评测基础。

Abstract: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.

</details>


### [160] [eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17194)
*Tong Zhao,Xianfang Zeng,Yucheng Han,Ruoyu Wang,Mingkun Lei,Gang Yu,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出端点分布匹配蒸馏(eDMD)，仅在学生最终输出上训练共享fake模型并用于校正每一步去噪，理论上保证匹配项当且仅当最终输出分布匹配教师时为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多步DMD蒸馏在学生中间状态或所有去噪步上训练fake模型，使学生更新信号与中间分布纠缠，扭曲匹配方向，甚至在最终输出已匹配教师时匹配项仍非零。

Method: 单一共享fake模型仅在学生最终输出上训练，作为端点参考校正每个去噪步；理论分析证明该参考使分布匹配项仅依最终输出分布归零。另引入精确教师(PT)，在最终噪声区间用短多步轨迹替代单步引导预测，并为中间步配校准查询密度。

Result: 在SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein(4B、9B)和Qwen-Image-2.1上，4步生成中eDMD持续优于现有分布匹配方法。

Conclusion: 以端点分布为统一参考可消除中间分布干扰，获得理论上无偏、实践中更强的少步蒸馏效果。

Abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.

</details>


### [161] [MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17199)
*Soumi Sarkar,Subhadip Boral,Sarbani Palit,Ashish Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MALNISI邻域光谱相似度指标构建图结构，结合改进的图注意力网络与加权对比损失进行高光谱图像无监督表示学习，在6个基准数据集上优于14种先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱图像具有高维光谱信息，蕴含与土地利用相关的判别性特征。近期图神经网络的无监督表示学习揭示了这些复杂的土地利用相关光谱关系，但如何更好地刻画像素间邻域相似性、构造有效图结构并学习保持细粒度光谱细节的紧凑表示仍待改进。

Method: 三项贡献：1）提出MALNISI指标（Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index），基于邻域信息衡量两像素相似度，用于构建加权邻接矩阵，赋予HSI图结构；2）提出升级版图注意力网络，采用增强的多头注意力机制，将MALNISI权重作为辅助特征以强化邻域像素间注意力，并集成残差连接、跳跃投影和特征归一化以缓解过平滑、保留光谱细节、稳定训练并加速收敛；3）提出加权对比损失，引入邻域感知的MALNISI权重，使强连接像素在潜空间接近、弱连接像素远离。最终对低维判别性嵌入进行谱聚类。

Result: 在6个基准HSI数据集上的实验验证了三项贡献的有效性和必要性；对比研究表明其性能优于14种最先进方法。

Conclusion: MALNISI图构建、增强图注意力网络与邻域加权对比损失三者协同，可有效实现高光谱图像的无监督聚类表示学习，具备优越性能。

Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. In this network, an enhanced multi-head attention mechanism incorporates the MALNISI weights as an auxiliary feature to emphasize learned attention between neighboring pixels. To alleviate over-smoothing and preserve fine-grained spectral details, the architecture integrates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization, which together enhance representation capability, stabilize learning, and accelerate convergence. Third, it proposes a weighted contrastive loss function that incorporates neighborhood-aware MALNISI between connected pixels, encouraging strongly connected pixels in the high-dimensional space to remain close in the latent space, and weakly connected pixels to stay apart. The resulting discriminative low-dimensional embeddings are then clustered using spectral clustering. Experimental analysis on six benchmark HSI datasets demonstrates the efficiency and necessity of the three aforementioned contributions, and the comparative study highlights superior performance over fourteen state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>


### [162] [Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17240)
*Khalil Sabri,Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau,Nicolas Saunier,Wassim Bouachir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 预训练ViT通过自注意力中的"查询-键路由"而非token内容实现物体实例绑定，同一物体的patch共享一个可重定位的"注意力地址"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能自然地将视觉场景解析为独立物体（object binding），已有工作表明预训练ViT内在具备此能力，但自注意力机制如何在机制层面保持不同实例的分离仍不清楚。

Method: 分析8个预训练ViT：比较注意力路由与token内容（value相似度、残差表示）对实例分离的表达强度；提出"注意力地址"概念，检验同一物体不同部分的patch是否读取共同图像区域；通过编辑query组件实验验证因果性。

Result: 实例分离在注意力路由中比在token内容中更明显；同一物体不同视觉部分的patch共享注意力地址，重复实例则获得独立可移动地址；该共享源于query与key空间结构的交互；在DINOv2等多数骨干中编辑query组件可将注意力地址重定向到另一实例；按query组件聚类patch的FG-ARI达.615，而末层特征仅.289。

Conclusion: ViT的实例分离能力由query-side注意力路由机制承载，query组件可作为物体级分组与操控的有效信号。

Abstract: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.

</details>


### [163] [Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17298)
*Gaurav Parmar,Zhengqi Li,Richard Zhang,Jun-Yan Zhu,Srinivasa Narasimhan,Eli Shechtman,Yotam Nitzan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出vid2vid-long，通过输入视频的patch级对应关系检索历史生成输出，并以对应交叉注意力条件化模型，在保持实时性的同时提升长程时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频到视频生成需要实时性，但现有方法为提速将注意力限制在固定长度的因果窗口内，导致相关历史超出窗口时丧失长程一致性。

Method: 基于观察：输入视频中匹配的区域在输出视频中也应匹配。计算输入视频的patch级对应关系，据此检索先前生成输出中对应区域的内容，并通过correspondence cross-attention将这些patch作为条件注入模型。

Result: 实验表明该方法在多个近期视频模型上一致提升长程时间一致性，同时保持生成质量与实时性能。

Conclusion: 利用视频到视频任务中天然的跨帧对应线索，可突破因果窗口限制，实现高效且长程一致的高质量视频生成。

Abstract: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.

</details>


### [164] [FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17302)
*Mohamed Alimoussa,Amal El Kaid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLEX-LBP 通过反向传播学习 LBP 的半径、采样角度、颜色变换和阈值，前向仍计算精确二值码与硬直方图（直通估计器仅用于反向），部署时保持可解释、可解释硬二值 LBP，仅 90 个可学习参数且推理开销不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 LBP 虽广泛用于工业检测和医学影像，但其半径、采样角、颜色变换与阈值需针对每个数据集人工设定，缺乏自适应能力。

Method: 提出 FLEX-LBP：用反向传播学习 LBP 参数，前向计算精确二值编码与硬直方图计数，反向使用直通估计器。在六个彩色纹理基准上做受控消融，考察各组件学习的必要性；并比较一种统一配置（几何与阈值可学、颜色变换冻结）与全学习版本，配合最近邻和线性判别读出评估。

Result: 统一配置平均提升最近邻准确率 3.55 点（五个随机种子，六基准中五个显著、无一显著变差）；线性判别读出提升 0.9 点，全学习版提升 2.7 点且均值最高。FLEX-LBP 在六个基准中五个优于五种经典 LBP 族描述子、PCANet 和神经 LBP，平均最近邻准确率超过冻结的 ImageNet ResNet-50（2350 万参数）。Kather 结直肠癌组织学基准上全学习版达 93.8%，显著高于最佳经典描述子 Completed LBP（92.8%）。学习到的半径呈跨种子重复的方向；噪声破坏单像素比较、光源变化导致通道间翻转，中值采样或灰度世界归一化可恢复 96–97%。

Conclusion: 可学习的 LBP 在几乎不增加参数与推理成本的前提下显著提升准确性，且"值得学习的组件"依数据集而定；其性能甚至超过大型预训练特征，并具备良好可解释性与鲁棒性，代码以即插即用 PyTorch 层开源。

Abstract: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

</details>


### [165] [Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17318)
*Ethan Lin,Yang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spatial Foundry 是一个包含 5,280 个带家具住宅 3D 场景配置的数据集，提供对齐的视觉、几何与时间模态（平面图、透视/全景RGB、深度、点云、网格、3D包围盒、相机轨迹与视频），以共享场景坐标关联跨视角跨时间观测，支撑空间智能与世界模型研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间智能需要将视觉观测与环境几何、物体及持久状态关联起来，但单张图像无法显式表达这些关系，而割裂的标注难以在同一参考系下研究外观、相机运动与场景变化。

Method: 构建可编辑资产的3D住宅场景集合，生成并对齐多种模态数据；通过共享场景坐标统一不同视角与时间点的观测，并利用可编辑源场景生成额外相机路径与受控物体变化。

Result: 数据集规模为5,280个带家具住宅场景配置，涵盖平面图、透视与全景RGB、度量深度、点云、网格、实例级3D包围盒以及相机轨迹配对视频，支持受控的相机与场景变化。

Conclusion: 该数据集可应用于平面图条件3D生成、几何重建、实例级感知、相机条件视频生成、共享世界建模与场景编辑，为空间感知和世界模型研究提供受控实验平台。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

</details>


### [166] [BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17321)
*Peter Kulits,Cordelia Schmid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 BrickFlow，通过集合条件 SE(3) 流模型学习 LEGO 零件装配先验，并用解析连通性场引导，从单张图像推断各零件位姿、组装出物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从零件集合和装配体图像推断各零件位姿属于离散物理约束下的组合优化问题，对微小位姿误差高度敏感，传统 3D 重建方法难以满足装配的物理结构要求。

Method: 在程序化生成的装配数据上训练集合条件 SE(3) 流模型以学习零件如何组合的先验；再用仅 1% 的数据微调注入图像条件；测试时引入解析的连通性场引导（connectivity-field guidance），将预测拉向连通的装配结果。

Result: 学到的流仅捕获全局结构而不保证连通性，加入引导后装配质量提升；随模型规模增大、预训练与引导使用，装配质量进一步提高。

Conclusion: 预训练流模型加图像微调再加测试时连通性引导，能有效生成更优质的 LEGO 装配，模型与数据已开源。

Abstract: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/

</details>


### [167] [K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17324)
*Felix O'Mahony,Daniel Olmeda Reino,Roberto Cipolla,Ayush Tewari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将物理推理任务转移给语言模型驱动的关键帧生成模块，再用关键帧条件化视频扩散模型做插值，从而提升视频生成的物理正确性，在Physics-IQ和PhyGenBench上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型虽外观质量高，但物理错误明显，原因在于所有物理推理都必须同时且仅在扩散过程中完成，缺乏显式推理能力。

Method: 将物理推理重新分配给基于语言模型的关键帧生成模块：先由语言模型进行显式物理推理并生成重要时刻的关键帧，实现细粒度外观控制；再以这些关键帧作为条件输入视频生成模型，使扩散模型只需在物理正确的中间状态之间做插值，而无需用扩散推断整个序列。

Result: 显著优于现有方法，在Physics-IQ Verified基准和PhyGenBench上取得最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过把物理推理与像素生成解耦，用语言模型负责显式推理与关键帧控制、扩散模型负责插值，可有效缓解视频生成的物理错误，是一种提升物理一致性的有效范式。

Abstract: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

</details>


### [168] [TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17331)
*Chin-Yang Lin,Ryo Hachiuma,Jaesung Choe,Min-Hung Chen,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Yen-Yu Lin,Wei-Chen Chiu,Yu-Lun Liu,Cheng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Test-Time Baking (TTB)，将跨视角注意力中的全局场景信息"烘焙"进轻量MLP，实现最高23倍渲染加速且质量媲美SOTA的新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Decoder-only大视角合成模型(LVSM)配合KV-cache虽质量领先，但计算开销大；测试时训练(TTT)层虽省计算却牺牲质量，急需兼顾效率与保真度的方法。

Method: 1) 复用TTT的fast-weight MLP，显式学习跨视角注意力的输入-输出映射（而非替代注意力）；2) 通过模态解耦解决上下文预填充与新颖视角渲染的不一致：将上下文token拆成仅相机信息的context rendering tokens作TTB输入，带图像内容的GT tokens作映射目标。

Result: 在多个基准上实现最高23倍渲染加速，质量与SOTA持平。

Conclusion: 将注意力信息烘焙为MLP是兼顾速度与质量的有效范式，模态解耦对烘焙效果至关重要。

Abstract: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io

</details>


### [169] [Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17334)
*Ellis Brown,Chris Hoang,Shengyi Qian,Shang-Wen Li,Mike Lewis,Marjan Ghazvininejad,Luke Zettlemoyer,Lucas Beyer,Mengye Ren,Jakob Verbeek,Saining Xie,Hu Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文用受控实验拆解视觉编码器的三项设计选择（视觉先验、专用视觉容量、融合前放置），发现在同等总计算量下，视觉先验并非必需，真正关键的是专用视觉容量，且该容量不必置于多模态融合之前。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在编码器设计上差异很大：有的用预训练视觉编码器，有的从头与语言模型联合训练，有的完全去掉编码器。由于已发表模型在数据、架构和算力上各不相同，无法独立归因于某一设计选择，因此需要一个受控框架来厘清各因素的影响。

Method: 将所有模型在相同数据上从头预训练，并在匹配的生命周期计算量下，于视觉问答和语言基准上进行比较，从而分别隔离三个变量：来自上游预训练的视觉先验、专用视觉容量（编码器参数）、以及容量在融合前放置与否。还额外检验了编码器预训练视为免费、以及从预训练语言模型出发等设定。

Result: 视觉先验非必需：从头联合训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当，且无需单独训练阶段。专用视觉容量才是关键：无编码器模型即使把骨干参数增加编码器参数量，视觉理解仍落后。但该容量不必在融合前：在融合过程中加入早期骨干层的纯视觉模块可媲美预融合编码器，并能降低首 token 延迟。

Conclusion: 结论支持"与骨干联合训练、并置于骨干早期层的专用视觉容量"这一设计取向。结论在不同骨干规模下、编码器预训练被视为免费时、以及从预训练语言模型出发时均成立。

Abstract: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

</details>


### [170] [Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17336)
*Yanke Song,Shuo Chen,Chris Rockwell,Guande He,Nan Liu,Desai Xie,Tianpei Gu,Yong-Hyun Park,Aryan V S,Dennis Yuren Menn,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Xun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixVid将预训练的VAE潜空间视频扩散模型直接提升到像素空间逐帧生成，用卷积头替代VAE解码器，在保持DiT主干的情况下实现更高分辨率、帧级控制与逐帧交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前沿视频生成模型在VAE潜空间（时空压缩）中工作，虽使训练可行，但压缩带来三大限制：分辨率翻倍会使token数增至四倍；条件只能施加于帧组而非单帧；交互时每个响应必须等待整个多帧块完成。

Method: PixVid保留扩散Transformer主干，将VAE解码器替换为卷积头，直接渲染输出到像素空间，逐帧生成。关键技术发现：预测干净视频而非速度，并配合更大的噪声偏移（noise shift），对生成质量至关重要。基于Wan2.1-14B微调。

Result: 在约130万训练片段内，PixVid与潜空间基线效果相当；在相同每帧token数下实现2倍分辨率生成；深度条件视频编辑在快速运动下仍保持对齐；可在下一帧即时响应每个动作。

Conclusion: 将潜空间视频模型提升到像素空间逐帧生成是一种简单有效的方案，可同时获得高分辨率、帧级条件控制与低延迟交互性，且无需重新设计扩散主干。

Abstract: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

</details>


### [171] [MS-rPPG: Multi-spectral State Space Model for Remote Photoplethysmography in Driver Monitoring Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21115)
*Jiho Choi,Sang Jun Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多光谱rPPG框架MS-rPPG，融合RGB与近红外视频，结合跨光谱线性调制与MS-Mamba时序建模，提升驾驶场景下的心率估计鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶员健康监测需要远程心率估计，但驾驶环境光照多变、头部运动频繁，仅用RGB视频的rPPG方法在该场景下鲁棒性不足。

Method: 构建RGB与NIR双光谱人脸视频融合框架MS-rPPG；提出基于频域分析的跨光谱线性调制（CSLM）策略融合互补特征；设计MS-Mamba状态空间模型，同时建模长程时间依赖与多光谱特征间的跨通道交互；并自建真实驾驶数据集MS-Drive（50名驾驶员）。

Result: 在MR-NIRP Car与MS-Drive数据集上评估，MS-rPPG在鲁棒性和心率估计精度上均优于已有方法。

Conclusion: 多光谱融合与状态空间建模可有效应对驾驶场景挑战，验证了该方法用于驾驶员健康监测的潜力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is a camera-based technique for measuring physiological signals, particularly cardiac activity. From the remotely measured signals, heart rate can be estimated, which is crucial for health monitoring. In this study, we investigate a driver health monitoring system based on remote heart rate estimation. However, driving environments represent uncontrolled settings where videos are subject to varying illumination conditions and frequent head movements. We introduce MS-rPPG, a multi-spectral framework that combines RGB with near-infrared (NIR) face video to alleviate rPPG estimation under challenging driving conditions. To combine the complementary features from two spectral videos, we propose a cross-spectral linear modulation (CSLM) strategy based on frequency-domain analysis. Moreover, we introduce MS-Mamba, a novel state space model designed to effectively model long-range temporal dependencies while jointly capturing cross-channel interactions between multi-spectral features. We collected a real-world dataset called MS-Drive, which was recorded from 50 participants while driving the vehicle. The proposed method was evaluated on the MR-NIRP Car dataset and MS-Drive datasets. The experimental results indicate that MS-rPPG shows better robustness and heart rate estimation accuracy than previous methods, highlighting its promise for driver health monitoring. The codes are available at github.com/ziiho08/MS-rPPG.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [172] [Abstention Is Not Threshold Compliance: Stated Scoring Rules in Open Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14661)
*Dongsun Moon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文检验"在提示中给出显式阈值 t 并要求模型仅当答对概率超过 t 时才作答"这一弃答(abstention)方案是否真被模型遵守,发现高弃答率并不等于遵守阈值规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kalai 等人提出以显式阈值 t 声明评分规则,使模型在自信不足时弃答。但"高弃答率"常被当作遵守证据,论文要检验模型是否真按阈值做决策,而非仅被弃答格式触发。

Method: 在共享题目上逐项检验合规要求:覆盖 4 个全开放 3–8B 配方、3 个后训练阶段的 12 个 checkpoint,探索性模型至 32B;比较有无弃答格式、不同阈值(0.5–0.9)、强制选择探针,并对比 P(True) 等自评信号及阈值条件训练(OLMo 3 7B)。

Result: t=0.75 时,弃答格式把平均弃答率从 20% 提到 91%,但格式内 t 从 0.5 到 0.9 仅变 −0.8pp;无该行时提高阈值反而降低弃答,最多 40% 题目出现任何阈值无关信念的合规策略都无法做出的决策;强制选择探针对阈值几乎无反应;P(True) 结果依赖评分器与提示间答案漂移;事后重校准在分布内 t=0.5 优于格式,跨域(TriviaQA→PopQA)在 0.75 反而更差;阈值条件训练未稳定泛化到未见阈值。

Conclusion: 高弃答率不构成遵守证据。使用显式评分规则的评测应报告弃答频率、决策是否随所述阈值变化、以及回答了哪些题目。

Abstract: Kalai et al. propose stating the scoring rule in the prompt with an explicit threshold t, so that a model should answer only when its probability of being correct exceeds t. We probe each requirement of compliance on shared items, in 12 checkpoints from three post-training stages of four fully open 3-8B recipes, with exploratory models up to 32B. At t = 0.75, a line limiting the reply to an answer or "I abstain" (the abstention format) raised the mean abstention rate from 20% to 91%. Yet within this format, raising t from 0.5 to 0.9 changed it by only -0.8 percentage points. Without the line, the higher threshold even lowered abstention, and up to 40% of a checkpoint's items received decisions that no compliant policy with threshold-independent beliefs could make. Given the probability that their answer was correct, the checkpoints barely responded to the threshold in a forced-choice probe. Comparisons with self-assessment signals such as P(True) depended on the grader and on answer drift between prompts. An external threshold on recalibrated P(True) made coverage non-increasing in t by construction. Calibrated on the evaluation distribution (post hoc), it beat the abstention format at t = 0.5; calibrated on TriviaQA and applied to PopQA, however, it fell below that format at 0.75. On OLMo 3 7B, decisions trained on threshold-conditioned targets did not follow unseen thresholds consistently. A post-hoc variant trained at four thresholds answered less as t rose but still failed a pre-specified test, mainly on agreement with its training rule. A high abstention rate is not evidence of compliance: evaluations using stated scoring rules should report how often models abstain, whether decisions respond to the stated threshold, and which items they answer.

</details>


### [173] [MITRA-Swarm: Injecting Explicit Linguistic Structure into Foundation Models for Classical Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14675)
*Kayshav Bhardwaj,Pragun Seth,Kush Bhardwaj,Vijay Nagasamy,Kurt Keutzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 MITRA-Swarm 多智能体架构处理古典梵语的连声(Sandhi)、复合词(Samāsa)和零指代问题，在1000偈颂基准上取得小幅但显著的提升（+0.63 MQM）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古典梵语的三大难点——形态音位融合 Sandhi、密集名词复合 Samāsa、以及诗律迫使的语篇级零指代——难以被单一端到端模型解决，需要显式注入语言学结构。

Method: MITRA-Swarm 包含：Sandhi 切分智能体、通用 gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 与领域专用 gemma-2-mitra-it 并行翻译阵列、以及利用语料库语域标签的语篇感知省略恢复器。采用分离双评审：路由评审 J_route（与生成器同族，驱动内部批评循环）与独立报告评审 J_report（gpt-4o-mini），后者对每个输出仅评一次。在5种语域1000偈颂上做12条件预注册消融。

Result: 完整系统达 85.90 MQM，基线 85.27（Δ=+0.63，p_adj=0.0018，95%CI [+0.30,+0.97]）；单独语篇恢复贡献 +0.44 MQM；较同等调用次数的自精炼基线高 +0.51 MQM。严重失败率从9.0%降至7.6%，但推理成本约9倍。J_route 在各条件均比 J_report 高 2–7 MQM，实证支持双评审设计；192,151条检索索引预检无参考泄露。

Conclusion: 改进虽统计显著但幅度小，且指标已接近饱和（85-86）；双评审与防泄露设计有方法学价值，但成本与收益权衡需进一步考量。

Abstract: Classical Sanskrit poses three challenges unresolved by single-call monolithic models: morphophonemic fusion Sandhi, dense nominal compounding Samāsa, and discourse-level zero-anaphora forced by poetic meter. We present MITRA-Swarm, a multi-agent architecture injecting explicit linguistic structure into an otherwise monolithic pipeline: a Sandhi-splitting agent, a parallel array of generalist gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and domain-specialized gemma-2-mitra-it translators, and a discourse-aware Ellipsis Restorer that consults corpus-derived register tags to avoid inventing active-voice subjects in impersonal legal and philosophical registers. Two separated judges evaluate quality: a routing judge ($J_{\text{route}}$, same model family as the generators) driving an internal critique loop, and an independent reporting judge ($J_{\text{report}}=$gpt-4o-mini, no shared vendor lineage) scoring every output exactly once.
