*Alex Jiang,Didier Schwab,Chuyuan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SPADE通过"软提示"刻画生成过程来检测AI生成文本：为每类训练一个软提示，用PMI衡量提示对文本的解释力作为判别信号，提升了跨数据集的OOD鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测器只关注生成文本本身（监督方法只用标注文本，零样本方法依赖概率分布），忽略了提示对生成过程的影响，导致开放场景下鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出SPADE框架：引入Pointwise Mutual Information（PMI）项来度量提示对文本的解释程度，将此提示影响作为判别信号；基于该量，为每个类别训练一个软提示以放大类别间区分度，预测时选择最能解释候选文本的提示所对应的类别。

Result: 在多个基准上对比多种检测器，实验显示方法具有鲁棒性和有效性，并在OOD数据集上达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 将生成过程（提示影响）纳入检测信号是提升AI文本检测泛化能力的有效途径，SPADE在分布外场景下优于现有方法。

Abstract: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. We characterize the prompt's influence by introducing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) term that captures how much a prompt explains a text. Based on this quantity, SPADE trains one soft prompt per class to amplify the separation, and predicts the class whose prompt best explains the candidate text. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks against various detectors demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets.

</details>


### [245] [Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16956)
*Translated,Maria Pia Adinolfi,Isabelle Andrieu,Grazia Fiorella Anfuso,Melania Annunziata,Daniele Antonini,Marta Arena,Luca Barone,Dana Barras Franco,Francesca Basiricò,Francesca Bee,Sofia Bertini,Nicola Bertoldi,Giorgio Biancini,Alessandra Bigi,Giulia Boccalini,Tommaso Bonomo,Enrico Boscardi,Sebastien Bratieres,Francesco Brigante,Giulia Brignola,Romolo Buondestino,Brenda Patricia Byrne,Giorgia Campora,Edoardo Cappelli,Veronica Carascosi,Francesca Carducci,Cody Carlson,Davide Caroselli,Ambra Cascio,Dario Cascio,Mauro Cassani,Andrea Castro,Alessandro Cattelan,Giulia Ceccacci,Paola Cellini,Giulia Chiriatti,Federico Cialini,Valentina Ciarlariello,Daniele Cocozza,Emanuela Coghe,Kathleen Compares,Marco Comunità,Davide Conti,Helen Rebecca Corfield,Michele Cortellessa,Anna Cracco,Aurora Cuppone,Arianna D'Andrea,Maurizio Davoli,Andrea De Angelis,Andrea De Blasi,Rebecca De Giorgi,Annalisa De Petra,Arianna De Pilla,Joris Demiraj,Elena Deufemia,Federica Di Antonio,Pierluigi Di Cianni,Vincenzo Di Cicco,Michela Di Clemente,Alan Di Francesco,Ylenia Di Gese,Federica Di Iulio,Claudia Di Lorenzo,Andrea Di Paola,Giulia Di Pilla,Jessica Dickson,Francesco Elefante,Ilaria Fabrizio,Alessandro Falappa,Viviana Fantozzi,Antonio Farina,Andrea Fernandez Tostado Ro. Sobieski,Biancamaria Soellner,Valentina Stati,Michael Stevens,Arianna Stissi,Fabiana Stomaci,Leonardo Taddei,Christopher Thomas,Maurizio Tiberi,John Tinsley,Riccardo Tittarelli,Carla Tocco,Martina Totaro,Barbara Veronika Totzauer,Alessio Tranzocchi,Letizia Treossi,Mara Trombetti,Marco Trombetti,Andrea Valenzi,Kirti Vashee,Giulia Vestita,Teodosio Vezza,Giulia Vignola,Sara Virtuoso,Valentina Volpini,Francesca Vurro,Jolita Zaksauskaite,Giulia Zanarella,Paolo Zanotti,Francesca Zavettieri,Irene Zorzi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Lara Mini base 是一个从零训练、覆盖英语及44种其他语言（含欧盟24种官方语言）的 MoE 模型，7.2B 总参数、0.6B 激活参数，在2B激活参数以内的开源基础模型中综合得分最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用语言模型主要用英语训练（开源模型中非英语数据占比最多约12%），而专为欧洲语言构建的模型虽多语言数据充足，得分却低于同规模通用模型。核心担忧是小模型中多语言之间"争抢容量"。

Method: 从零训练，使用6T token，涵盖英语和44种其他语言；训练中44种语言的总量逐渐超过英语。采用 MoE 架构（7.2B 总参数/0.6B 激活参数），以低成本为多语言提供足够容量；支持最长128k上下文。

Result: 在2B激活参数以内的开源基础模型中，英语、多语言、数学、代码标准基准平均得分最高，超过训练token多4–6倍的模型；优势在其支持语言的多语言基准和数学基准上最大。MoE 架构缓解了语言间容量竞争。单GPU单用户、无量化情况下，生成速度比任何平均分更高的模型至少快1.8倍。

Conclusion: 权重以 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可发布；并将发布 T-HellaSwag——将常识推理基准 HellaSwag 高质量机器翻译为110种语言变体。MoE 设计被证明可有效降低多语言容量竞争，同时兼顾性能与推理效率。

Abstract: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.

</details>


### [246] [Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16968)
*Mohamed Zakaria Kurdi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究系统考察阿尔茨海默病(AD)连贯言语中的形态学特征,发现AD表现为形态简化与时间锚定转移而非形态崩解,形态学分类性能可与句法媲美甚至超过微调BERT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形态学通常被认为在AD中相对保留,且很少在连贯言语中被建模。作者想检验:哪些形态特征能区分AD与健康对照;形态学相比其他语言层面和BERT模型的分类效果如何;该信号是否超越转录长度和词汇量等混杂因素。

Method: 基于ADReSS Cookie Theft描述任务(78例AD、78例对照),计算8大类共55个自动测量(其中7类为新提出的理论驱动指标),采用组间比较、等价检验、SHAP、族消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和BERT模型;自动指标经人工验证,并迁移到另外两个语料库。

Result: 38项指标中19项存在组间差异:AD患者后缀词和屈折词更少、动词名词更短、现在进行时更少而过去时更多(最大效应r=-0.42),但错误罕见且组间统计等价。8项指标在控制长度和词频后仍显著。测试集特征选择下形态学macro-F1达0.85,与句法相当并高于微调BERT(五种子0.80);完全交叉验证选择为0.62。形态学加入BERT提升AUC(0.91 vs 0.89)但未提升macro-F1。迁移有限,但三分之二效应在轻度认知障碍中方向一致。

Conclusion: AD连贯言语呈现形态简化和时间锚定转移,而非形态崩解。形态学的信息量比其"相对保留"的声誉所暗示的更大。

Abstract: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests.
  Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT

</details>


### [247] [Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17052)
*Íñigo Zubeldia,Boris Bolliet,Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro,Pablo Villanueva-Domingo,Miles Cranmer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个在真实论文中注入可定位错误（四类错误×三级严重度）并配合干净副本测假阳性的LLM审稿评测基准，共357个错误、两个语料、十二个审稿系统；发现模型选择对检出率影响最大（约50个百分点差距），工具脚手架仅在弥补模型自身短板时有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM同行评审已大规模生产化使用，但其评测仍很有限：缺少客观、可定位、可量化的错误检测与假阳性评估手段。

Method: 构建基准：向真实论文注入四类客观可定位错误（一般性问题、数学、数值、引用），每类三个严重度，并在干净副本上测假阳性率，按错误类型与严重度分别统计检出率。同时提出多智能体审稿系统Skepthical：通过检索被引论文核验引用支撑的主张、用计算机代数核验数学、用实际执行代码核验数值主张。在 astrophysics 与 ML 两个语料（各15篇近期arXiv预印本，共357个错误）上评测12个系统：6个单一LLM审稿器、2个Claude Code配置、3个公开审稿器及Skepthical。

Result: 模型选择对检出率影响最大：同一提示下三个前沿LLM在两语料上总检出率相差约50个百分点。工具与脚手架在能补足模型自身不足时才有帮助：天体物理上Claude Code在数学与数值检测上优于单次Claude调用；强制引用检索使Skepthical在引用错误检测上以大幅优势居首。但该优势在ML上消失，Skepthical的引用检出率与最佳单一LLM在统计上无法区分（模型对ML文献更熟悉）。多数系统假阳性率低于10%，但随提示、模型与脚手架变化，数学类标记是主要假阳性来源。

Conclusion: 模型能力是LLM审稿可靠性的首要因素，脚手架应针对模型固有短板；引用核验类工具的收益依领域而异。评测流程、注入错误与裁决日志作为基准公开。

Abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.

</details>


### [248] [Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17053)
*Ashvin Gupta,Brendan Delaney,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: tEHR将EHR事件转为自然语言描述，用文本流对因果语言模型做EHR自适应继续预训练，再用LoRA做任务判别微调，把LLM当作纵向患者编码器，在MIMIC-IV与CPRD上取得最优整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化EHR模型把每个临床概念当作数据集专属token，丢弃其自然语言语义，导致概念关系只能靠共现学习，无法利用先验语义知识。

Method: 以自然语言描述表示每个事件，形成文本流；先进行EHR自适应继续预训练，再用LoRA做任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM作为纵向患者编码器；主干为Mistral-7B-v0.3。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV的四个预测任务及CPRD的胰腺癌预测（1–12个月预测窗口）上，tEHR整体表现最佳。消融显示：移除或错配临床描述、省略数值、去除任一适应阶段均使性能下降；显式经过时间描述几乎无额外收益。学习到的患者表征呈现与疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致结构。

Conclusion: 将EHR事件文本化并两阶段适配LLM是有效的纵向EHR预测范式，语义描述与数值信息均关键，而显式时间描述非必要。

Abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.

</details>


### [249] [Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17068)
*Xinheng Ding,Seyyed Saeid Cheshmi,Ziyang Zhang,Tairan Chen,Wenya Xie,Yu Hou,Rui Zhang,Zirui Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MAPE框架，通过程序演化自动发现智能体记忆设计，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上以35%服务成本实现最高12%绝对准确率提升，并总结出两条有效记忆设计模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体记忆设计缺乏系统性探索方法，希望用程序演化方式自动发现有效记忆方案，并理解其背后的关键设计选择。

Method: MAPE从最小种子出发，通过标准化生命周期接口与迭代"诊断-提案"循环，演化完整记忆程序；在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上实验，并进行经验分析、消融与跨骨干/基准迁移测试。

Result: 相比手工设计基线最高提升12%绝对准确率，服务成本仅为35%；识别两条设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据、按查询意图组合检索证据；将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统均提升准确率；将服务成本纳入目标会把计算从LLM记忆构建转向查询时选择性处理。

Conclusion: 程序演化为智能体记忆设计提供了有效途径；原始证据保留与按意图组合是可复用的设计原则，且搜索目标决定计算分配位置。

Abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.

</details>


### [250] [Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17091)
*Feng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"硬币投影"（coin projection）：一种证据上最优的、无歧义分词化的语言隐写方案，按理论下界恢复被"停止熵"挤占的容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言隐写通常假设接收方可直接获得发送方的 token 序列，但文本信道只传文本，分词存在歧义，导致提取失败。现有修复手段会改变分布、需同步整池 token（词表大时容量崩溃）或需追踪多个 token 历史。

Method: 证明在满支撑语言模型下，若提取完全精确无误，单历史接收方的候选集在每一步都必须是前缀无关的，即便可读取全部未来文本也无法避免，因此必须放弃"停止熵"（决定每个前缀 token 是否在此结束的熵）。据此在前缀森林上用共享随机数固定停止决策，得到闭式方案 coin projection：可用任意分布编码器、每 token 一次模型调用、保持普通采样，并在所有密钥下改进 SyncPool。

Result: 在英、中、日三语中，歧义文本极少（≤11/1000 tokens），但词与词素前缀处的停止熵占每步熵的 7.2–9.0%；SyncPool 的额外损失来自空格与单字节 UTF-8 汇聚点合并子树却几乎不含停止不确定性。Coin projection 在任意词表规模下都能保住 91–93% 的字符串熵；全词表时转为消息比特的熵是 SyncPool 的 2.16–6.85 倍，并恢复所有完整消息。

Conclusion: 给出了单历史、无歧义分词化隐写的理论上界与达到该界的最优构造，系统刻画了停止熵这一瓶颈来源，并在多语言下验证了容量与可靠性优势。

Abstract: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step -- even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps -- and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool's further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.

</details>


### [251] [Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17107)
*Paul Grunenwald,Benoît Crabbé,Guillaume Wisniewski,Pirmin Lemberger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文用因果驱动框架系统评估IRM在NLP中抑制捷径的能力，证实在标签生成特征、混淆、选择偏差三种机制下IRM能拒绝捷径，并在Bias in Bios与ActorCorr等真实场景中有效，但语义特征需谨慎调节不变性惩罚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP中ERM训练的模型常依赖方言标记等虚假相关，损害OOD泛化；IRM旨在通过寻找跨环境稳定的预测关系抑制捷径，但其在NLP中的实用价值仍有争议，需系统检验。

Method: 构建因果驱动框架，在三种产生捷径的机制（标签生成特征、混淆、选择偏差，涵盖因果与反因果结构）下评估IRM，并考察环境变化有限与标签噪声增大的条件；随后扩展到Bias in Bios（性别-职业关联）与ActorCorr（语义化演员姓名捷径）两个真实场景。

Result: IRM在所评估的因果与反因果结构下均能成功拒绝捷径，包括环境变化有限及标签噪声增加的情形；在真实数据中，不变学习可缓解更现实的文本捷径，但语义有意义特征下需仔细校准不变性惩罚。

Conclusion: IRM在NLP中具有实用价值，可抑制多类捷径并改善OOD泛化，但不变性惩罚的校准对语义特征至关重要。

Abstract: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.

</details>


### [252] [Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17128)
*Tanzeel Abbas,Ahmad Kamran Malik,Nafees Qamar,Sana Liaqat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PECA在QLoRA监督微调目标中加入可微简洁性项（超预算后提升EOS概率），无需偏好数据或辅助模型，在1.7B医疗模型上将回答长度缩短72.8%同时提升诊断准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型语言模型适合在临床NLP中低成本部署，但训练后在医疗任务上回答冗长，难以在快节奏的临床决策支持中使用；现有长度控制方法依赖偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，破坏了SLM的可及性优势。

Method: 提出参数高效简洁性适配（PECA）：在QLoRA监督微调目标中加入单个可微简洁性项。由于token数离散不可微，改为在生成长度超过token预算后提升结束符（EOS）的概率，作为平滑信号在常规训练中优化，无需偏好数据、辅助模型，仅需单张消费级GPU。

Result: 在1.7B参数模型、medical-o1-reasoning-SFT语料上微调，平均回答长度减少72.8%，多选题诊断准确率从40.8%提升至44.0%；对简洁性强度扫描可得到可解释的“准确率—长度”权衡前沿。

Conclusion: PECA提供了一种轻量、低门槛的长度控制方案，在缩短医疗回答的同时不损害甚至提升准确性，并给出可调节的简洁性与诊断完整性平衡前沿。

Abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.

</details>


### [253] [Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17169)
*Umar Ahmed,Maxim Dunaev,Mohammad Nour Al Awad,Sergey Ivanov,Ivan Khodnenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在 PIZZA 基准上，作者用 LoRA 微调两个小模型，比较同一目标树的 6 种无损编码格式，发现"用普通词语书写目标"（word encoding）比缩短长度更有效：准确率最高、token 少 4.1 倍、静默错误率降低 1.8-2.3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型微调解析器输出格式合法但内容错误的树时会静默失败，下游无法察觉。作者提出：输出格式是一个"免费的设计选择"，它是否决定了这种静默错误的发生频率？

Method: 在 PIZZA 点单基准上，对 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 LFM2.5-350M 用 LoRA 微调，训练目标为同一棵树结构的 6 种无损编码（长度从 44.3 到 10.9 tokens/单），其中含两组"等长但表面形式不同"的对照。共 300 次运行（5 种训练池规模 × 5 个种子），采用预先固定的分层 bootstrap 与 Holm 校正进行统计检验，并做错误分析。

Result: 仅缩短长度从不带来提升，但用普通词语书写目标则有效。word 编码在两个模型上都是最准确格式（Qwen 上 87.5% vs. 原生 s-expression 85.8% 完全匹配），且 token 少 4.1 倍；静默错误率在 Qwen 上降 2.3 倍、LFM2 上降 1.8 倍，在每个池规模上都显著。增益大部分来自否定结构。所有运行还学会拒绝菜单外输入（留出集 95.9-99.0% 正确处理）并处理句内自我纠正；但严格拒绝对真实订单有代价：2.1-10.1% 的（多为礼貌的）真实订单被拒。

Conclusion: 输出格式作为免费设计选择，对小型解析器的可靠性影响显著；"自然语言词语编码"优于紧凑/缩短格式，能在降低 token 成本的同时减少静默错误。但严格拒绝机制会牺牲真实订单的接受率，需要在可靠性与召回间权衡。

Abstract: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.

</details>


### [254] [Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17280)
*Gautam Galada,Supreeth Shastri,Sagnik Ray Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"合成走私"（Synthesis Smuggling）新威胁模型：对抗性LLM从日常求助交互中推断用户敏感信息，并将其隐写编码进看似无害的生成内容，用户分享这些内容时无意中泄露信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有威胁模型假设模型需要直接联系对手，但现实中用户会主动分享模型生成内容（邮件、帖子、消息）。这一分享行为可能成为隐蔽的信息外泄渠道，此前未被充分关注。

Method: 训练两个开放权重模型：从对话线索推断性别和年龄段标签，再用不可见字符或措辞选择将预测结果隐写编码到生成文本中。

Result: 实验证明模型能够从对话中推断性别与年龄段，并将结果成功编码进输出内容；监控通信渠道的对手可据此获取信息。

Conclusion: 即使用户分享的模型输出、即使模型无直接联系对手的途径，也能成为个人推断信息的隐蔽信道，凸显了分享AI生成内容带来的隐私风险。

Abstract: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.

</details>


### [255] [Goal Encoding in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17297)
*Arnab Sen Sharma,Eric Todd,Sheridan Feucht,Andy Arditi,Rohit Gandikota,Natalie Shapira,Gabriele Sarti,Constanza Fierro,Lisa Schut,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究LLM是否编码"目标"这一内在神经表征——先于行动、引导行动且能通过多种执行路径实现，并发现稀疏注意力头编码下一子目标且具有因果性与可移植性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM是否存在灵活、抽象的"目标"内部表征（先于并引导行动、可由不同执行路径实现），而非仅做下一个token预测。

Method: 构建含多子任务的编码任务场景以评估目标导向行为与子目标选择；定位编码下一子目标的稀疏注意力头；用因果干预验证其因果性与可塑性（移植到另一编程语言环境），并通过靶向因果干预检验非递归目标导向（NRGS）假设。

Result: 在下一次子目标上定位到稀疏注意力头编码，可解码未来自然语言行动（如"我在检查单词是否为回文"）；该编码对下一行动具因果性且可塑——移植到另一编程语言时触发同一操作但以不同token序列实现。

Conclusion: LLM可维持目标编码贯穿行动执行；无需递归状态即可解释：在NRGS框架下，模型频繁从任务说明中重读目标、与增长上下文中的进度比对并推进剩余部分，靶向因果干预支持该解释。

Abstract: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.

</details>


### [256] [Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17320)
*Minhae Oh,Jeonghye Kim,Jinwoo Koo,Yeongoon Kim,Jimin Seo,Minsik Seol,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DiVR，一个用于扩散语言模型的验证器，判断部分生成序列能否得到正确答案，从而决定何时重生成块、保留哪个候选，在不改动生成器的前提下显著提升推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型可通过 remasking 回访已生成文本，但有效纠错需要知道"何时改、改什么"。在 Sudoku 上的诊断发现两个缺口：(1) 隐藏状态中的错误信息无法被 token 置信度可靠反映；(2) 当周围上下文固定时，单独 remask 一处错误往往会重现同样的错误。

Method: DiVR 是一个验证器，基于模型自身轨迹的最终正确性进行训练，用于预测部分生成序列是否会收敛到正确答案。它据此决定何时重新生成某个块，以及保留哪个备选候选；生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 上，于五个推理基准上，与微调后的生成器配合使用。

Result: DiVR 将微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提升到 43.4%，成本仅为贪心解码的 1.9–3.5 倍，优于需要 3.8–7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还能与监督微调、强化学习等后训练方法互补，并可泛化到 Dream 等其他生成器。

Conclusion: DiVR 通过引入独立的正确性验证器弥补了置信度信号与局部 remask 的不足，以较低计算开销实现更有效的扩散语言模型推理纠错，并具备良好的互补性与泛化性。

Abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.

</details>


### [257] [ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17332)
*Jie Wang,Tong Zhu,JiaHao Kuang,Zhe Xu,Yunkai Chai,Dehong Zheng,Yu Cheng,Tao Ji,ZhouHan Lin,Qi Zhang,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ArchSpace 是一个公开平台，用于记录、评审和引用大语言模型架构研究，并利用缩放定律从小规模实验预测大规模损失，以低成本评估架构想法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型架构决定 LLM 的缩放行为、训练效率与推理成本。工业界（DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi）常有架构创新但少公开成败与原因；学术界受算力与基线不一致限制，多为小规模单点比较，难以判断改进能否扩展到大规模。因此需要一个公共平台来记录、评审并沉淀架构研究。

Method: ArchSpace 采用"记录—评审—引用"机制：每条提案记录其实验与推理依据，由社区评审，并被后续工作引用。平台利用缩放定律从小规模实验预测更大规模的模型损失，从而在大规模训练前低成本评估想法。同时提供初始参考：Qwen3.5 与 OLMo3 基线、拟合好的缩放定律，以及可复用的训练配方。

Result: 论文仅给出平台设计与初始资源（基线、缩放定律、训练配方），摘要中未报告具体实验数值结果。

Conclusion: 通过评审验证的想法可成为新基线，ArchSpace 旨在扩大塑造下一代模型的架构想法范围，并打通工业界与学术界之间的评估鸿沟。

Abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [258] [Designing Collaborative Virtual Environments for Software Engineering Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14578)
*Filipe Fernandes,Cláudia Werner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MetaSEE将需求引导、Web XR特征模型、可复用UML组件与浏览器多用户平台整合，通过对框架(16)、特征模型(15)、UML组件(9)、平台(14)形成性评估的文献综合，给出可追溯的教育设计说明，但仅支持有界可行性与感知有用性，未证明学习增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作虚拟环境可支持软件模型的共享检视，但教育设计与可用性需与"学习有效性"主张区分开来，避免过度宣称。

Method: 提出MetaSEE（连接需求指导、Web XR特征模型、可复用UML组件、浏览器多用户平台）；对既有形成性评估进行文献综合（参与次数16/15/9/14，前两项共享12名开发者）；平台研究含6名教师单独使用与8名学生分4对使用桌面/笔记本；并对SUS分数做数值审计重建。

Result: 参与者认可共享建模与仿真的潜在价值，同时提出导航、交互、可视化与分心等顾虑。数值审计由已发表条目频次重建学生SUS均值为67.50，与报告的79.38冲突；教师条目分布不完整，无法复原总体均值。

Conclusion: 贡献是教育设计与形成性局限的可追溯说明，在入门引导、模型可读性、协作与评估报告方面有实践意义；证据仅支持有界可行性与感知有用性，未确立学习增益、持续参与或采用。

Abstract: Collaborative virtual environments offer opportunities to make software models available for shared inspection, but educational design and usability need to be examined separately from claims of learning effectiveness. This article presents MetaSEE, an approach connecting requirements guidance, a Web XR feature model, a reusable UML component, and a browser-based multiuser platform. We synthesize documented formative evaluations of the framework (16 participations), feature model (15), UML component (9), and platform (14). These counts represent evaluation participations; the same 12 developers took part in the first two evaluations. The principal platform study involved six teachers working individually and eight students working in four pairs through desktop or notebook computers, keyboard, and mouse. The documentary synthesis traces educational intentions to implemented features and reported difficulties. Participants identified potential value in shared modeling and simulation, alongside navigation, interaction, visualization, and distraction concerns. A numerical audit reconstructs a student System Usability Scale mean of 67.50 from published item frequencies, conflicting with the reported 79.38; an incomplete teacher item distribution prevents recovery of that group's overall mean. The contribution is a traceable account of educational design and formative limitations, with practical implications for onboarding, model readability, collaboration, and evaluation reporting. The evidence supports bounded feasibility and perceived usefulness, without establishing learning gains, sustained engagement, or adoption.

</details>


### [259] [When Evaluators of AI Agents Disagree: An Empirical Study of Native Scoring, LLM Judges, and Commit-Boundary Checks on tau2-bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14581)
*Sungbin Im*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文检验 agentic workflow 评估中"专家基准打最终状态"与"部署中LLM评审读对话记录"两种方式是否可互换，结论是不可互换：LLM 评审高自一致却误判大量禁止写入，而一个零模型调用的最小规则检查（boundary evaluator）能全部捕捉这些失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中把"对比金标准最终状态"的基准评测与"LLM 评委读 transcript 判定"两种方式视为可互换，但缺乏实证检验；若二者结论不同，评估方法的选择就会决定结论本身。

Method: 在 tau2-bench 的 airline 与 retail 两个领域跑了 2,160 个 episode，记录每次数据库写入；用四种方式打分：原生金标准状态对比、LLM 评委、带策略文档的 LLM 评委、以及 boundary evaluator（判断写入是否"应当发生"对比轨迹中是否"实际发生"的最小规则式检查）。另由两名标注者独立标注 120 个 episode 的任务正确性、策略合规与承诺正确性。

Result: LLM 评委自我重复率为 98.2%，但与原生评分一致率仅 56.2%。11 个 episode 出现禁止写入，评委无论是否给策略或 transcript 都放过了 10–11 个，更强评委仍放过 6 个；boundary evaluator 不做任何模型调用即全部捕获 11 个，且在人工标签上没有评委显著优于它。无门控时禁止写入发生在 11.1% 的 episode；验证、纠错与安全终止门控均未显著降低该比例。轨迹显示可能原因：门控的证据摘要把订单状态与客户认证丢弃，导致合法请求被拒。

Conclusion: 评估器选择决定结论——LLM 评委无法替代金标准评测，且会系统性掩盖禁止写入类安全失败；极简的规则式检查能暴露评委漏掉的失败。作者公开了轨迹、代码、提示与标注。

Abstract: Agentic workflows, in which a large language model (LLM) calls tools to read and write data, are evaluated in two ways. Benchmarks compare the final state against a gold answer. Deployed services have none; an LLM judge reads the transcript and decides. Practice treats the two as interchangeable. This paper measures whether they are.
  We ran 2,160 episodes in tau2-bench's airline and retail domains and recorded every database write. We scored each episode four ways: native scoring against gold state, an LLM judge, that judge given the policy document, and the boundary evaluator, a minimal rule-based check of whether a write was expected against whether one occurred in the trace. Two annotators independently labeled 120 episodes for task correctness, policy compliance, and commitment correctness.
  The judge repeated its verdict 98.2% of the time but agreed with native scoring on 56.2%. In 11 episodes the agent executed a forbidden write. The judge passed 10 to 11, with or without the policy or transcript. A stronger judge still passed 6. The boundary evaluator, with no model call, caught all 11; no judge significantly exceeded it on human labels. Forbidden writes occurred in 11.1% of episodes without gates. Verification, correction, and safe-termination gates did not reduce them significantly. The traces show a candidate cause: the gates' evidence digest dropped the order status and customer authentication, so valid requests were rejected. The choice of evaluator decides the conclusion; the minimal check exposes failures the judges miss. Traces, code, prompts, and labels are released.

</details>


### [260] [Discovering the Relation Between Architectural Models and Reference Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14606)
*Thi Dinh Tran,Maria Teresa Rossi,Ludovico Iovino,Leonardo Mariani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的工作流RAMD，用于将具体软件架构模型中的组件映射到参考架构（RA），在64个开源模型上达到85.8%映射准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断具体软件架构是否与参考架构一致对保证架构决策的一致性和质量属性至关重要，但缺乏专用技术，只能用通用模型比较算法，而实验表明这些算法在RA场景下不准确。

Method: RAMD是一个LLM驱动的工作流，结合模型分析与结构化提示（structured prompting），并通过迭代式的RA合规性检查机制来精炼映射结果。

Result: 在IoT、自动驾驶和智慧停车三个领域、共64个开源架构模型上评估；结合领域知识与GPT-4o，映射准确率达85.8%，比最强基线高44.6个百分点，同时保证与RA的结构一致性。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的方法可有效弥补通用模型比较算法在参考架构映射上的不足，实现高准确率且结构一致的组件映射。

Abstract: Assessing whether concrete software architectures are consistent with their reference architecture (RA) is essential to ensure that architectural decisions scale coherently across projects, preserving the quality attributes the RA was designed to guarantee. In the absence of dedicated techniques, mapping the components of an architectural model onto a predefined RA can be addressed only with general-purpose model-comparison algorithms. Our experiments show that these algorithms are inaccurate when applied to RAs. To address this gap, we propose Reference Architecture Mapping Discovery (RAMD), an LLM-based workflow that combines model analysis with structured prompting, and refines results through an iterative RA compliance-checking mechanism. We evaluate RAMD on 64 open-source architectural models spanning three RAs from the IoT, self-driving, and smart parking domains. With domain knowledge and GPT-4o, RAMD reaches 85.8% mapping accuracy and outperforms the strongest baseline by 44.6 percentage points, while ensuring structural consistency with the RA.

</details>


### [261] [Outcome Over Learning? Evidence from Student Use of AI Code Assistants for Unit Test Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14664)
*Daniel Hinbest,Jeremy S. Bradbury,Michael A. Miljanovic*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究发现在无限制使用AI代码助手的单元测试写作中，多数学生采用"一次性"交互策略，把AI当作直接生成完整测试的工具，从关注学习转向完成任务，且很少批判性评估或迭代AI输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代码助手正快速进入编程教育，但学生在可自由使用时如何自然使用这些工具尚不清楚，尤其担心这种使用方式会削弱学生对单元测试写作方法和批判性思维的学习。

Method: 开展了一项关于AI辅助单元测试写作的用户研究，观察学生在无限制访问AI助手条件下的实际交互行为与策略。

Result: 多数学生采用"一次性"交互策略，直接让AI依据初始需求生成完整单元测试；该方式虽能高效产出方案，但使学生的重心从学习如何写好单元测试转向单纯完成任务，且学生很少批判性评估、改进或迭代AI输出，错失培养负责任使用AI所需批判性思维的机会。

Conclusion: 为将学生重心从"结果"转向"学习"，论文讨论了通过培训、问责机制与改进学习任务设计来支持更具学习导向、更负责任的AI使用方式。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) code assistants are rapidly being adopted in programming education, yet little is known about how students naturally use these tools when given unrestricted access. In a user study investigating AI-assisted unit test writing, we observed that a majority of students adopted a one-shot interaction strategy, asking the AI to generate a complete unit test directly from the initial requirements. While this approach is capable of efficiently producing a solution, it shifts students' focus from learning how to write effective unit tests to simply completing the task. Moreover, because students rarely engaged in critically evaluating, refining, or iterating on AI-generated output, they may be missing opportunities to develop the critical thinking skills that are essential for effective and responsible use of AI. In an effort to shift student focus from outcome to learning we also discuss how training, accountability and improved learning task design can better support a more learning-centric responsible use of AI.

</details>


### [262] [Where Should the Code Go? Locating Foundation-Model Errors in Bitemporal Inventory Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14671)
*Durga Sandeep Saluru,Lanchen Song,Aditya Kumaran*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控的"组件诊断"框架，在可精确求解的缺货（lost-sales）库存环境中，系统检验语料规范化、精确代码续推、提高推理强度这三种补救各自消除哪类错误、对哪些模型有效，并揭示工具调用接口会干扰推理评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运筹报告存在"事件发生时间"与"报告到达时间"两个时钟，且后续报告可修订先前报告。基础模型组件需在截止时点维护状态并向前推演情景，但错误来源混杂（报告选择 vs. 推演），现有工作不清楚各类补救措施的归因。

Method: 在精确可解的缺货库存环境中构建 36,672 个独立重评分请求，覆盖闭源与开源模型共 12 种配置；将精确代码置于模型调用之前、之后或之内，并对比"强制答案调用"接口与自动选择接口，所有协议在调用前冻结。

Result: 弱模型错误可分离：规范化输入消除报告选择错误，精确续推消除推演错误，二者互不修复，主导错误因模型而异；强模型在原始报告上已达上限。提高推理强度无法替代补救，且依赖接口：强制答案调用下高努力使 GPT-5.4 mini 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 崩溃，而这些模型在自动选择下增益或持平；在特定提供商上强制调用使 DeepSeek V4 Flash 推理被禁用；高努力下 gpt-oss 耗尽输出预算。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是受控的组件诊断方法、全部请求的公开数据，以及证据表明对某些模型—提供商组合，工具调用接口会混淆推理能力评估。

Abstract: Operational reports carry two clocks: when an event happened and when its report arrived; later reports can revise earlier ones. A foundation-model component that maintains the state supported by the reports visible at a cutoff, then rolls a supplied scenario forward, can be helped by exact code before it, after it or inside the call, or asked to reason harder. We ask which remedy removes which error, for which models, on an exactly solvable lost-sales inventory environment: 36,672 independently rescored requests over twelve configurations of closed and open-weight models, with a forced-answer-call interface as a control and protocols frozen before the calls. Weak models fail in separable ways. Canonical input removes report-selection error, exact continuation removes rollout error, neither repairs the other, and which error dominates differs by model; strong models are at ceiling on raw reports. Asking for more reasoning is no substitute and can depend on the interface: under a forced answer call high effort collapses GPT-5.4 mini and DeepSeek V4 Pro, which gain or hold under automatic choice; on its provider the forced call disables reasoning for DeepSeek V4 Flash; and at high effort gpt-oss exhausts its output budget. The contribution is a controlled component diagnostic, released with every request, and evidence that for some model and provider pairs the tool-calling interface confounds reasoning evaluation.

</details>


### [263] [Mach2: Scientific Discovery Platform with Deterministic Execution Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14777)
*Vansh Sharma,Venkat Raman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Mach2 通过将 Eigen 编排与确定性、类 lint 的检查（针对工具请求、源码变更、验收测试和工件契约）相结合，使语言模型代理真正遵守自然语言操作规则，并形式化了"规则门控执行模型"与代理包生命周期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型代理虽能制定工作流并调用工具，但仅靠提示无法保证其遵守自然语言操作规则，因此需要确定性的强制机制来约束代理行为。

Method: 将领域需求表示为可执行谓词：强制失败会阻止被检查操作的推进，诊断性发现则留存供纠正或审查；结合用户指定的 TDD、CodeGrapher 的 AST 分析、历史引导的进化搜索作为互补的验证与优化机制；生成任务专属代理包并在独立选择端点上执行，由原始 harness 依据声明接口和证据要求验证返回工件；将模型内部知识（MIK）依赖与源码/测试支撑的发现分开记录。

Result: 提出了规则门控执行模型与代理包生命周期的形式化描述，并给出可衡量标准以评估规则合规性、工程有效性和跨端点任务连续性。

Conclusion: 通过确定性的规则门控检查替代单纯提示依赖，Mach2 提升了代理对操作规则的合规性与工程有效性，并支持无需持续监督的跨端点任务执行与验证。

Abstract: Language-model agents can formulate workflows and invoke specialized tools, yet compliance with natural-language operating rules is not guaranteed by prompting alone. Mach2 addresses this limitation by coupling Eigen orchestration to deterministic, lint-like checks of tool requests, source changes, acceptance tests, and artifact contracts. Domain requirements are represented as executable predicates: mandatory failures prevent advancement of the checked operation, while diagnostic findings are retained for correction or review. User-specified test-driven development (TDD), CodeGrapher's abstract-syntax-tree analysis, and history-guided evolutionary search provide complementary verification and optimization mechanisms. Mach2 also generates task-specific agent packages for execution through independently selected endpoints. The originating harness validates returned artifacts against declared interfaces and evidence requirements without assuming continuous supervision of the remote run. Model-internal-knowledge (MIK) dependencies are recorded separately from source-grounded and test-supported findings. This paper formalizes the rule-gated execution model and the agent-package lifecycle, and proposes measurable criteria for evaluating rule compliance, engineering validity, and cross-endpoint task continuity.

</details>


### [264] [Typify: A Tool for Usage-driven Type Inference in Python](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14879)
*Hassan Aman,Ali Aman,Muhammad Asaduzzaman,Shaowei Wang,Jessica Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Typify 是一个轻量级的、基于使用驱动的 Python 静态类型推断引擎，无需类型标注或训练数据即可对整个项目推断类型，性能优于所有静态基线并接近混合深度学习最新方法，同时快约 10 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python 动态类型系统给无标注或部分标注代码库的静态分析带来挑战；现有方法要么依赖已有类型标注，要么依赖需要大规模语料与大量算力的深度学习模型。

Method: 融合符号执行、不动点分析和上下文匹配检索，在模块、函数及递归调用结构间传播类型；提供 CLI（批量推断、评估、下游集成）与 VS Code 扩展（交互式类型辅助）两种形态。

Result: 在 ManyTypes4Py 和 Typilus 数据集上超越所有静态基线，接近最先进的混合深度学习方法，运行速度约快 10 倍。

Conclusion: Typify 证明了无需训练数据的轻量静态方法可在精度上媲美深度学习方案，并具备显著的效率优势，适合实际项目中的类型推断与工具集成。

Abstract: Python's dynamic type system, while expressive and flexible, creates significant challenges for static analysis tools in unannotated or partially annotated codebases. Existing approaches either require pre-existing type annotations, or depend on deep learning models that demand large training corpora and significant computational resources. We present Typify, a lightweight, usage-driven static type inference engine that infers precise type information across entire Python projects without annotations or training data. Typify integrates symbolic execution, fixpoint analysis, and context-matching retrieval to propagate types across modules, functions, and recursive call structures. The tool is available as both a command-line interface (CLI) for batch inference, evaluation and downstream integration with other tools, and a Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension for interactive type assistance. Evaluation on the ManyTypes4Py and Typilus datasets shows that Typify outperforms all static baselines and closely matches state-of-the-art hybrid deep learning approaches, while running approximately 10x faster.

</details>


### [265] [Caprese: Change Impact Recommendation Using History and Runtime Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14937)
*Sadjad Tavakoli,Saba Alimadadi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Caprese 是一个面向 Node.js 的开源函数级变更影响推荐框架，结合历史共变模式挖掘与运行时依赖分析，并提供混合模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变更影响推荐需识别受源码变更影响的程序实体。历史共变与运行时依赖提供互补证据，而 JavaScript 的动态与异步特性使依赖分析困难，因此需要针对 Node.js 的函数级方案。

Method: 给定变更集，产出排序的影响函数集合。包含三部分：(1) 基于仓库的推荐，通过置信度引导挖掘与变更集相关的、变长度的重复共变模式；(2) 基于运行时执行得到的依赖推荐，涵盖调用、回调、事件、定时器与共享状态；(3) 融合两者的混合推荐。实现模块化、分析可复用。

Result: 在10个开源应用、100个变更集上评估：混合推荐前60个结果中平均77.4%的相关函数仅被单一分析识别，显示显著互补性。动态推荐前5精度最高（0.65）；仓库推荐在扩展到前60时最佳（0.42）。混合模式平均优于 TARMAQ，但未稳定优于单一模式。

Conclusion: 两种证据源具强互补性；混合并非总优，需按排序深度选择模式。Caprese 已开源并提供源码、文档与评估工件。

Abstract: Change impact recommendation identifies program entities potentially affected by source code changes. Historical co-changes and runtime dependencies provide complementary evidence, particularly in JavaScript, where dynamic and asynchronous behaviour complicates dependency analysis. We present Caprese, an open-source framework for function-level change impact recommendation in Node.js. Given a change set, it produces a ranked impact set of potentially affected functions. It supports repository-based recommendation through confidence-guided mining of recurring, change-set-relevant co-change patterns of varying lengths; dynamic recommendation through execution-derived dependencies involving calls, callbacks, events, timers, and shared state; and hybrid recommendation integrating both analyses. Its modular implementation supports reusable analyses. Evaluation on ten open-source applications and 100 selected change sets shows that, on average across projects, 77.4% of the relevant functions among the top 60 hybrid recommendations are identified exclusively by one analysis, demonstrating substantial complementarity. Dynamic recommendation achieves the highest mean precision among the top five recommendations (0.65), while repository-based recommendation performs best when the ranking is extended to 60 recommendations (0.42). Hybrid recommendation outperforms TARMAQ on average but does not consistently outperform the individual modes. Caprese is publicly available with source code, documentation, and evaluation artifacts.

</details>


### [266] [TSBugs Explorer: Exploring and Benchmarking TypeScript Bugs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14940)
*TianYi Tang,Saba Alimadadi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 TSBugs Explorer，一个基于 633 个 TypeScript 缺陷数据集的交互式可视分析平台，支持缺陷特征分析、仓库对比与基准子集构建导出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实软件缺陷数据集虽支撑软件测试、调试与自动修复研究，但异构缺陷集合的探索、跨项目故障特征比较、研究特定子集的构建往往依赖人工检查与自写脚本，缺乏统一工具支持。

Method: 平台构建于已发布的 633 个缺陷数据集（16 个开源 TypeScript 仓库、11 类故障类别），整合缺陷记录、仓库特征、依赖信息与分类指南，通过协同可视化、交互过滤与缺陷详情检查实现：故障分布的替代聚合与归一化、仓库两两对比、故障轮廓差异分析；并内置基准构建器，支持多准则筛选、组成检查及 CSV/JSON 导出。

Result: 通过故障刻画、跨仓库比较、任务特定基准构建三个研究流程进行演示；两位作者的功能验证确认了选择正确性、可视化一致性、导出完整性及流程可复现性。

Conclusion: TSBugs Explorer 使现有缺陷语料更易探索、比较与复用，便于研究者系统化地进行研究特定选择与 TypeScript 缺陷记录导出。

Abstract: Curated datasets of real-world software bugs support empirical research in software testing, debugging, and automated program repair. However, exploring heterogeneous bug collections, comparing fault characteristics across projects, and constructing research-specific subsets often require manual inspection and custom scripts. We present TSBugs Explorer, an interactive visual analytics platform built upon our previously-published dataset of 633 bugs from 16 open-source TypeScript repositories, classified into 11 fault categories. The platform integrates bug records, repository characteristics, dependency information, and taxonomy guidance through coordinated visualizations, interactive filtering, and detailed bug inspection. It supports alternative aggregation and normalization of fault distributions, pairwise repository comparisons, and analysis of differences in observed fault profiles. An integrated benchmark builder allows researchers to select bug subsets using multiple criteria, inspect their composition, and export records in CSV or JSON format. We demonstrate the platform through three research workflows: fault characterization, cross-repository comparison, and task-specific benchmark construction. Functional validation by two authors confirmed selection correctness, visualization consistency, export integrity, and reproducibility across the tested workflows. By making the existing corpus easier to explore, compare, and reuse, TSBugs Explorer facilitates systematic, research-specific selection and export of TypeScript bug records.

</details>


### [267] [LOHRE: Execution-Grounded Type Recovery via LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14946)
*Hao Jiang,Yujie Yang,Tao Li,Chenhui Cui,Liangfeng Xu,Chengjie Liu,Weiping Wen,Rubing Huang,Tsong Yueh Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LOHRE 将反编译中的用户自定义类型（UDT）推断视为可证伪假设，用"假设-验证-精化"循环结合成对动态切片仿真来检验内存布局，并以执行深度启发式(EDH)压缩反馈、跨函数知识库聚合证据。在 RealType 四优化级别上平均结构准确率 57.85%，Windows RPC 上 35.6%，显著优于静态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 剥离二进制函数的接口与 UDT 布局恢复对安全分析至关重要。现有 LLM 方法有两大缺陷：(1) 缺少基于执行的验证，无法发现与实际内存布局不符的 UDT 推断；(2) 忽略无直接调用关系函数间共享 UDT 的证据。

Method: 提出 LOHRE 框架：以 hypothesize–validate–refine 循环，通过基线与变异输入的成对动态切片仿真测试候选布局；用 Execution-Depth Heuristic (EDH) 将冗长执行轨迹压缩为执行深度差异与被测字段使用摘要；用跨函数知识库聚合兼容的 UDT 假设与字段级置信度，指导测试与精化。

Result: RealType 四优化级别平均 UDT 结构准确率 57.85%，Windows RPC 35.6%，优于静态基线；去除动态验证降至 19.28%/9.2%；去除跨函数知识库降至 41.03%/10.0%；用完整轨迹替换 EDH 压缩反馈则准确率下降且 token 增 3.7 倍、运行时间增 3.0 倍。

Conclusion: 实验表明基于执行的验证、紧凑反馈与跨函数证据共同促成准确且高效的 UDT 恢复。

Abstract: Documenting stripped binary functions for security analysis requires recovering function interfaces and user-defined type (UDT) layouts from machine code. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods face two limitations: they lack execution-based validation to detect inferred UDTs inconsistent with actual memory layouts, and may overlook evidence about shared UDTs across functions without direct call relationships. We present LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Reverse Engineering (LOHRE), a framework that treats inferred UDTs as falsifiable hypotheses and tests them against program execution. LOHRE uses a hypothesize-validate-refine loop to test candidate layouts through paired dynamic slice emulation of baseline and mutated inputs. To reduce the cost of processing lengthy execution histories, the Execution-Depth Heuristic (EDH) compresses paired traces into an execution-depth difference and a summary of the tested field's observed uses. A cross-function knowledge base aggregates compatible UDT hypotheses and field-level confidence scores to guide testing and hypothesis refinement. We evaluate LOHRE on RealType at four optimization levels and a Windows remote procedure call (RPC) dataset. LOHRE achieves an average UDT Structural accuracy of 57.85% across RealType's four optimization levels and 35.6% on Windows RPC, outperforming the evaluated static baselines. Disabling dynamic validation reduces accuracy to 19.28% on RealType and 9.2% on Windows RPC. Removing the cross-function knowledge base reduces accuracy to 41.03% on RealType and 10.0% on Windows RPC. Replacing EDH's compressed feedback with full execution traces reduces recovery accuracy while increasing token use by 3.7 times and runtime by 3.0 times. These results indicate that execution-based validation, compact feedback, and cross-function evidence contribute to accurate and efficient UDT recovery.

</details>


### [268] [JoyFrontBench: Evaluating Front-End Coding Agents through Goal-Oriented Acceptance Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14952)
*Xiaoyi Qiao,Yicheng Wang,Jianan Lin,Xiaoyang Ji,Dongyi Lv,Yidan Huang,Shi Suo,Shiying Fan,Nan Duan,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 JoyFrontBench 基准，通过“目标导向验收契约”区分前端编码 Agent 的部分实现与应用成功，包含 100 个问题、764 个任务、2596 条原子判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前端编码 Agent 常出现“任务分高但关键工作流失败”的现象，单纯聚合任务分数无法反映应用是否真正可用，需要明确区分部分实现与整体应用成功。

Method: 构建目标导向验收契约：生成前定义核心任务与强制判据，核心任务需满足全部强制判据且达到共享完成阈值，应用成功则要求同一产物、单次运行内所有核心任务均通过。数据源自从业者需求，含100个问题、764任务、2596原子判据及经审核的标注；评估框架结合证据支撑判断、确定性记录审计与固定评分规则，同时保留分级任务评分与核心任务/应用级验收。在70题测试集上，用 OpenHands 与 OpenCode 两种框架评测5个编码模型，另30题作公开集。

Result: OpenHands 下各模型平均 ATS 为 87.69%，但平均应用成功率 ASR 仅 51.52%；模型排名随框架变化，重复运行间应用成功率也存在波动。

Conclusion: 聚合任务分数不足以刻画应用成功，需在分级任务表现之外显式评估核心目标达成情况。

Abstract: Front-end coding agents are expected to produce applications that fulfill user goals, yet high task scores can coexist with failures in essential workflows. Evaluating these agents therefore requires an explicit distinction between partial implementation and application success. We introduce JoyFrontBench, a benchmark that makes this distinction through goal-oriented acceptance contracts. Each contract identifies core tasks and mandatory criteria before generation: a core task passes only when all mandatory criteria are satisfied and a shared completion threshold is met, while application success requires every core task to pass on the same operational artifact within a single run. Derived from practitioner requirements, JoyFrontBench comprises 100 front-end development problems, 764 tasks, and 2,596 atomic criteria, with reviewed annotations linking user goals to core tasks and evidence requirements. The evaluation framework combines evidence-grounded judgments with deterministic record auditing and fixed scoring rules, preserving graded task assessment alongside explicit core-task and application-level acceptance. We evaluate five coding models under two agent harnesses, OpenHands and OpenCode, on the 70-problem test set; the remaining 30 problems form a public set for validation and diagnostic analyses. Under OpenHands, the mean Average Task Score (ATS) across models is 87.69%, while the mean Application Success Rate (ASR) is 51.52%. Further analyses reveal changes in model rankings across harnesses and variation in application success across repeated runs. These findings highlight the limitations of aggregate task scores in characterizing application success and motivate explicit assessment of core-goal fulfillment alongside graded task performance.

</details>


### [269] [FIRE: Failure Isolation and Reliability for Production-Connected Experiments at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14962)
*Shripad Nadgowda,Gaurav Mitra,Sing Sing Ma,Vipul Chaskar,Pradipta Ghosh,Canturk Isci,Onkar Deshpande,Edgardo Aviles-Lopez,Ryan Feng,Ján Ondrušek*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文介绍大规模推荐服务系统中"生产连接式实验"（replay 回放流量+部分下游调用真实生产依赖）的三重护栏方案（隔离层、依赖监控、流量固定），证明其可在大规模下可靠运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预发布变更通常在隔离环境测试以避免副作用，但保真度不足；生产连接模式提升保真度，却在超大规模下带来可靠性风险：实验流量在多共享服务间扇出、触发潜在缺陷、向服务用户请求的系统发送畸形输入。

Method: 三重互补护栏：(1) 隔离层将回放流量从共享依赖重定向到可复制的隔离层；(2) 依赖监控观察下游健康与归因于实验的错误，持续违规后终止实验；(3) 流量固定将实验调用限制在指定下游 worker 子集，应对容量稀缺。另有依赖感知触发机制。

Result: 隔离排名层每日处理数十亿回放请求，仅占用不到 1% 对应服务容量；90 天内出现 20 万+ 异常 worker 退出但未直接影响生产 worker；三个月内依赖监控取消了约 5% 实验、占该排序服务取消量的 87%；依赖感知触发使代码评审实验执行量减少 25%。

Conclusion: 当下游影响"能隔离则隔离、需限制则限制、持续监控与归因"时，高保真生产连接式实验可大规模可靠运行。

Abstract: Pre-production changes are usually tested in isolated environments to prevent their side effects from reaching production. Some record-and-replay platforms allow a production-connected mode: candidate changes receive recorded production requests while selected downstream calls reach production dependencies. This improves fidelity before deployment, but it also introduces reliability risks. At hyperscale, experimental traffic can fan out across shared services, trigger latent defects, or send malformed input to systems serving user requests. In this paper, we show how production-connected experimentation can operate reliably in a large-scale recommendation serving system. To contain downstream effects without sacrificing realistic dependency behavior, the platform uses three complementary guardrails. Isolated tiers redirect replay traffic away from shared dependencies where replication is practical. Dependency monitors observe downstream health and experiment-attributed errors and terminate experiments after sustained violations. Traffic pinning limits experimental calls to a designated subset of downstream workers when full replication would require scarce capacity. Isolated ranking tiers process billions of replayed requests per day using under 1% of the corresponding serving capacity. Over 90 days, these tiers experienced more than 200,000 abnormal worker exits without directly affecting production-serving workers. During a separate three-month window, dependency monitors cancelled approximately 5% of experiments for the measured ranking service and accounted for 87% of its cancellations. Dependency-aware triggering also reduced code-review experiment executions by 25%. These results show that high-fidelity, production-connected experimentation can operate at scale when downstream effects are isolated where possible, bounded where necessary, and continuously monitored and attributed.

</details>


### [270] [GHA-SmellFix: Taking Action with Agentic LLMs for Detecting and Refactoring GitHub Actions Workflow Smells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14963)
*Anderson Uchôa,Jhefferson Souza,Emanuel Ávila,Gabriel Silva,Kevin Lira,Hui Sun,Nelson Araújo,Arthur Cordeiro,Rohit Gheyi,Wesley Assunção*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 GHA-SmellFix 智能体式 LLM 流水线，用于检测并重构 GitHub Actions 工作流中的配置异味；对比"联合式"（单智能体检测+重构）与"分解式"（分离检测与重构智能体）两种设计，发现分解并非普遍提升补丁质量，其主要价值在于控制是否生成补丁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GitHub Actions 工作流以 YAML 编码构建、测试、发布等自动化，其中的配置异味会影响安全、可靠性、可维护性与运行稳定性。现有方法多为规则式，规则难以构建与演进，且通常只报告问题而不提供修复；智能体化 LLM 流水线有望结合上下文检测与补丁生成，但检测/重构是否应分解、分解能否提升效果尚不明确。

Method: 构建 GHA-SmellFix 智能体式 LLM 流水线，将既有目录中的 19 种异味操作化为显式检测准则、重构预期、排除规则与安全检查；构造 1,710 个（工作流, 异味）对的真实标注；对比 Joint（单智能体检测并重构）与 Decomposed（分离智能体先检测后重构）两种设计，用 GPT-5.4-nano、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5、DeepSeek V4 Flash 四个模型在 570 个抽样对上评估。

Result: 分解式设计并未普遍提升补丁质量，其主要收益是控制补丁生成时机：对易漏检的模型有帮助，并可通过"门控"减少不必要开销。一旦异味被正确检测，干净重构通常有效，说明检测是端到端的主要瓶颈；但误报会触发对执行相关构造的不必要修改。

Conclusion: 实用的 CI/CD 智能体不仅需要补丁生成能力，还需具备可靠的"弃权"机制（reliable abstention）与构造感知的校验（construct-aware validation）。

Abstract: Continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows are key artifacts in software projects. In GitHub Actions, they encode build, test, release, deployment, and security automation in YAML. These workflows contain configuration smells affecting security, reliability, maintainability, or operational stability. Existing approaches are mostly rule-based, with rules hard to create and evolve, and typically report findings without fixes. Agentic LLM pipelines can combine contextual detection, transformation selection, and patch generation. Specialized agents can gate refactoring on positive detection verdicts, potentially avoiding unnecessary changes, but it is unclear whether decomposition improves effectiveness or mainly changes overhead. We present GHA-SmellFix, an agentic LLM pipeline for detecting and refactoring GitHub Actions workflow smells. We compare two designs: Joint, where one agent detects and refactors, and Decomposed, where separate agents detect and then refactor. We operationalize 19 smells from an existing catalog with explicit detection criteria, refactoring expectations, exclusion rules, and safety checks, and curate a ground truth of 1,710 (workflow, smell) pairs. We evaluate the designs with four LLMs (GPT-5.4-nano, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) on 570 sampled pairs. Results show that decomposition does not universally improve patch quality; its main benefit is controlling when patch generation is attempted. It helps models prone to missing smells and can reduce overhead by gating patches. Once a smell is correctly detected, clean refactoring is generally effective, making detection the main end-to-end bottleneck. However, false positives can trigger unnecessary edits to execution-relevant constructs. Practical CI/CD agents thus need reliable abstention and construct-aware validation alongside patch generation.

</details>


### [271] [Understanding Suggested Edits in Stack Overflow: A Large-Scale Empirical Study and Review Prioritization Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15001)
*Mehedi Hasan Shanto,Muhammad Asaduzzaman,Md. Ahasanuzzaman,Alioune Ngom*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文分析了约389万条Stack Overflow建议编辑，揭示接受/拒绝差异、细粒度拒绝原因，并证明基于特征的模型能高效地按拒绝风险优先排序编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低声誉用户的建议编辑对平台知识库有贡献价值，但人们对编辑被接受或拒绝的原因了解有限，且审核者缺少高效识别问题编辑的手段。

Method: 分析2011年至2023年5月间的3,888,805条建议编辑；用35个特征比较接受与拒绝的编辑；人工分析被拒编辑归纳出17类细粒度拒绝原因；评估三种排序模型（Feature Model、Embedding Model、EditEx Model），并在500条编辑上做零样本对比（GPT-4o、Qwen2.5-32B、Llama-3.3-70B）。

Result: 接受与拒绝编辑差异显著，最大差异来自用户编辑历史。Feature Model在审查率与召回间权衡最佳：τ=0.40时仅需人工审查52.3%的编辑即可捕获80.8%的被拒编辑；Embedding Model捕获78.8%需审查60.9%，EditEx捕获72.5%需审查59.0%。零样本评估中Feature Model召回78.0%，远高于大模型的23.6%–31.2%。

Conclusion: 研究提供了对建议编辑被拒机制的细致理解，并表明拒绝风险预测可有效帮助将潜在问题编辑优先送交人工审查。

Abstract: Suggested edits allow low-reputation users to improve Stack Overflow posts and contribute to the platform's knowledge base. However, we still know little about why these edits are accepted or rejected and how reviewers can efficiently identify problematic edits. In this study, we analyze 3,888,805 suggested edits submitted between 2011 and May 2023. First, we compare accepted and rejected edits using 35 features. We find significant differences between them, with the largest differences related to users' editing history. Second, we manually analyze rejected edits and identify 17 fine-grained rejection reasons. These reasons provide a more detailed understanding of why edits are rejected than Stack Overflow's predefined rejection reasons. Third, we evaluate three models for prioritizing edits based on their likelihood of rejection. The Feature Model, built using the 35 studied features, provides the best trade-off between review rate and rejected-edit recall. At a decision threshold of $τ= 0.40$, it prioritizes 52.3% of edits for human review while capturing 80.8% of rejected edits. In comparison, the Embedding Model captures 78.8% of rejected edits while prioritizing 60.9% of edits, and the EditEx Model captures 72.5% while prioritizing 59.0%. We also conduct a complementary zero-shot evaluation on a separate set of 500 edits. The Feature Model achieves 78.0% recall at $τ= 0.40$, compared with 23.6%-31.2% for GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-32B, and Llama-3.3-70B. Overall, our findings provide a detailed understanding of suggested-edit rejection and show that rejection-risk prediction can help prioritize potentially problematic edits for human review.

</details>


### [272] [Structure-Aware Quantum Circuit Equivalence Checking via Sparse Pauli Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15080)
*Shangzhou Xia,Junjie Luo,Qichen Wang,Yasunari Suzuki,Jianjun Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种基于稀疏Pauli传播的结构感知量子线路等价性检查器，融合generator propagation与Cut-Miter两种策略，并显式处理数值与近似误差，在434对电路上取得96.3%与参考一致的判定且零误判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子线路等价性检查对验证编译器优化至关重要，但其计算开销随线路结构大幅波动，现有检查器难以兼顾正确性与效率。

Method: 基于稀疏Pauli传播构建酉线路等价性检查器：(1) generator propagation——比较两线路在Pauli生成元上的共轭作用；(2) Cut-Miter——在选定切割点利用线路乘积项间的相互抵消；(3) 结构感知验证流程，根据线路特征在两种策略间选择，并显式计入数值与近似误差；同时采用Pauli项剪枝与有界传播尝试。

Result: 在含最多512量子比特、共434对可评分电路的两个基准集上：96.3%的判定与参考一致且无错误判决；基线最高仅68.7%。总体运行时间最低，相较基线减少48.5%–76.0%。消融实验证实基于切割的验证、Pauli项剪枝与有界传播尝试各自带来收益。

Conclusion: 结构感知的稀疏Pauli传播，结合互补验证策略与显式误差核算，是实用量子线路等价性检查的有效途径。

Abstract: Quantum circuit equivalence checking is essential for validating compiler optimizations, but its computational cost can vary substantially with circuit structure. We present a structure-aware equivalence checker for unitary quantum circuits based on sparse Pauli propagation. It combines two complementary verification strategies: generator propagation compares the conjugation actions of the circuits on Pauli generators, while Cut-Miter exploits cancellation between circuit products at selected cut points. A structure-aware verification procedure uses circuit characteristics to select between these strategies while explicitly accounting for numerical and approximation errors. We evaluate our framework against three existing equivalence checkers on two benchmark suites containing circuit pairs with up to 512 qubits. Across 434 scored circuit pairs, our framework produces reference-consistent decisions for 96.3% of the pairs without any incorrect verdicts, while the evaluated baselines achieve at most 68.7% reference-consistent decisions. It also achieves the lowest aggregate runtime among the evaluated tools, reducing total runtime by 48.5%--76.0% relative to these baselines. Ablation studies confirm the benefits of cut-based verification, Pauli-term pruning, and bounded propagation attempts. These results indicate that structure-aware sparse Pauli propagation, combined with complementary verification strategies and explicit error accounting, can provide an effective approach to practical quantum circuit equivalence checking.

</details>


### [273] [An Empirical Study of Maintainer-Identified AI Slop Pull Requests in Free and Open Source Software Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15159)
*Hugo Raskin,Xavier Devroey,Benoît Vanderose*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以维护者标记为"AI slop"的Pull Request为对象，用混合方法追踪其来源、量化数量、刻画特征并梳理维护者标记/关闭理由，揭示GenAI对FOSS维护者造成的压力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI降低了FOSS贡献门槛，催生低质量、低价值的"AI slop PR"。既有研究多从理论、平台层面或从业者叙述视角出发，缺乏项目层面的实证考察，本文填补此空白。

Method: 采用混合方法，聚焦被维护者明确标记为slop的PR：追踪其来源、统计其在FOSS项目中的数量、描述其特征，并对维护者标记或关闭的理由进行开放式编码分析。

Result: 维护者标记的AI slop PR数量在2025年中上升，2026年5月达到峰值；此类PR多为新增型改动，极少被合并，通常在3天内被关闭；仅14%的作者披露使用AI，其中1%是在维护者要求后才披露；多数PR被关闭或标记为slop但未给出理由。维护者给出的理由从具体问题（如构建失败）到主观判断（"看起来像AI做的"）不等。

Conclusion: 该探索性研究刻画了处于早期阶段的AI slop现象，凸显GenAI对FOSS的潜在冲击，强调其给维护者带来的压力以及转变当前开源开发实践的必要性。

Abstract: The FOSS ecosystem has always relied on outside contributions, notably through issues or Pull Requests (PRs), to sustain itself. With the advance of GenAI, the barrier to contributing to FOSS projects has never been lower, leading to the emergence of AI slop PRs: low-quality, low-value generated PRs. Past studies have examined AI slop PRs through theoretical, platform-level, or practitioner-account frames, but not at the project level. To this end, this study investigates the incidence of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs in FOSS projects by focusing on PRs flagged as slop by maintainers. Using a mixed-methods approach, we trace the origins of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs, quantify their volume in FOSS projects, describe their characteristics, and highlight maintainers' reasons for flagging or closing them. Our results show that the volume of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs increased in mid-2025, peaking in May 2026. These PRs are mostly additive, rarely merged, and typically closed within 3 days. The authors of these PRs disclosed the use of AI in 14% of cases, with 1% disclosing after a maintainer's request. Most PRs are closed or marked as slop without any reason provided by the maintainer. Based on our open coding, reasons range from concrete elements, like build failures, to ideological or intuitive (i.e., "looks AI to me"). This exploratory study captures a phenomenon in its early stage and highlights GenAI's potential impact on FOSS, emphasizing the pressure it puts on maintainers and the need to shift current open-source development practices.

</details>


### [274] [Pre-QED: Environment Specifications for Agentic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15207)
*Tristan Lim,Haoxin Tu,Mehtab Zafar,Zhengxiong Luo,Abhik Roychoudhury*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 Pre-QED，认为 agentic 形式化验证的瓶颈已从"如何证明"转为"证明什么"，主张构建覆盖 API 所有合法用法的"验证 harness"，而非复用模糊测试 harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作（如 Anthropic 的 OSS-Verify、Theorem）复用模糊测试 harness 作为规范，只覆盖单一调用序列与单一调用上下文，证明的是单个使用场景而非库本身，规范过于浅层、无法捕捉功能正确性。因此规模化验证真正缺少的是"深层环境规范"。

Method: 提出"验证 harness"：一种可执行 harness，建模 API 的全部合法用法，从而对 harness 的证明即为对所有良构客户端的证明。构建方式为 agentic 工作流：从代码与文档中抽取 API 使用契约，并用线性时序逻辑（LTL）排除非法调用顺序。同时识别出证明验证 harness 所面临的挑战，并将 harness 开源作为社区挑战。

Result: 论文以立场/愿景形式给出方法与问题刻画，主要产出是开源验证 harness 与挑战集以及关于证明验证 harness 难点的问题识别；摘要中未报告具体实验评测数据。

Conclusion: 愿景是让开源库的形式化验证像模糊测试一样常规化，其保证覆盖所有良构客户端而非模糊测试的单一场景；当前应先解决"深层规范从何而来"这一前置问题，再推进规模化验证。

Abstract: LLM agents are making formal verification practical at scale. Recently, many attempts have raised this as an enticing possibility. However, formal verification at scale is only meaningful if deep formal specifications capturing functionality are available for checking. Unfortunately, recent works seek to bypass this issue by using shallow specifications devised for purposes other than verification. OSS-Verify from Anthropic and Theorem, for example, reuses the fuzz harnesses of open-source libraries as specifications and has an agent prove that each harness never crashes. However, a fuzz harness follows a single sequence of API calls under a single calling context, so the resulting proof covers one usage scenario rather than the library.
  We argue that the bottleneck of agentic verification has shifted from how to prove to what to prove. Before zooming into verification at scale, we need deep environment specifications to prove, which is why we call our effort Pre-QED. We propose verification harnesses, executable harnesses that model all legal usages of an API, so that a proof about the harness is a proof about every well-behaved client. To construct them, we use an agentic workflow that extracts the API's usage contract from code / documentation, and uses Linear-time Temporal Logic (LTL) to rule out illegal call orders. We identify the challenges in proving verification harnesses and release our harnesses open-source as challenges for the community. The overarching vision is that verifying an open-source library should become as routine as fuzzing it, with a guarantee that covers every well-behaved client rather than a single scenario like a fuzzing harness.

</details>


### [275] [Technical Debt Risks in AI-Assisted Software Development: Insights from Practitioners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15310)
*Nazia Jahan,Nafisa Alam,Sourov Debnath,Arafat Rahman,S. M. Waesh Ahmed,Md Farhad Alam Bhuiyan,Mia Mohammad Imran*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对孟加拉国137名受访者和20次访谈的混合方法研究，发现AI编程助手带来的技术债风险超越代码质量，主要集中在人员债、管理债和架构债。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编程助手日益普及，引发对其生成代码及开发实践所带来技术债的担忧，本文系统调查这些风险。

Method: 采用顺序混合方法：137份问卷加20次后续访谈，围绕十个成熟技术债维度，考察风险感知、成因、维护后果、验证实践与开发者理解。

Result: 受访者最担忧People Debt(73.0%)、Management Debt(70.1%)、Architecture Debt(68.6%)；模糊需求、项目上下文不足、未经请求的AI改动导致架构不一致、返工与维护困难；AI既支持重构与测试，也带来返工和上下文错位；89.8%定期验证AI代码，但仍担忧依赖、理解下降与审查负担。

Conclusion: 管理技术债风险需在代码质量之外，关注项目上下文、实现决策与开发者理解。

Abstract: AI coding assistants increasingly support software development, raising concerns about technical debt associated with AI-generated code and development practices. We investigate these concerns through a sequential mixed-methods study involving 137 survey respondents and 20 follow-up interviews with software professionals in Bangladesh. Drawing on ten established technical debt dimensions, we examine perceived risks, contributing circumstances, maintenance consequences, validation practices, and developer understanding. Respondents expressed the strongest concerns about People Debt (73.0\%), Management Debt (70.1\%), and Architecture Debt (68.6\%), suggesting that risks extend beyond code quality. Participants associated ambiguous requirements, insufficient project context, and unrequested AI-generated changes with architectural inconsistencies, rework, and maintenance difficulties. Their experiences revealed contrasting outcomes: AI assistance supported refactoring, maintainability improvements, and testing, but also introduced rework and context misalignment. Although 89.8\% reported regularly verifying AI-generated code, participants expressed concerns about AI dependence, reduced code understanding, and review effort. They also emphasized the need for stronger architectural awareness, requirements clarification, and validation support in coding assistants. Our findings suggest that managing technical debt risks requires attention to project context, implementation decisions, and developer understanding alongside generated code quality.

</details>


### [276] [AgentTorrent: A Dataset of Context and Harness Engineering Artifacts on GitHub](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15436)
*Sebastian Baltes,Seyedmoein Mohsenimofidi,Levi Böhme,Vahram Nersesyan,Muhammad Auwal Abubakar,Jai Lal Lulla,Matthias Galster,Christoph Treude*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentTorrent 数据集收录 GitHub 上 10,944 个"工程化软件项目"中 6 款智能体编程工具的配置工件与相关文档，支持研究上下文工程与工具使用行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者已从写 prompt 转向"上下文工程"：提交 context 文件、skills、hooks、MCP 配置，甚至规范/计划/任务文档来驱动智能体编程工具，但缺乏链接这些异构产物与 AI 署名提交的数据资源。

Method: 构建可自动更新的开源采集流水线，采集规则基于工具官方文档或 GitHub 仓库并逐项评估检测准确率；用开源权重模型分类仓库是否为工程化软件项目；在同一仓库内链接配置工件、其导入文件、智能体规划文档与 AI 署名提交。

Result: 获得 62,374 个配置工件、27,593 份规划文档、超 120 万条 AI 署名提交；388 个仓库同时包含三类产物。

Conclusion: 数据集与流水线开源并归档于 Zenodo，可支持研究工具署名与指令文件关系、指令文件间的导入与冲突等跨层问题。

Abstract: Over the past months, developers have moved from formulating detailed prompts to engineering the context that agentic coding tools read and to configuring the underlying harnesses. For example, developers commit context files, skills, hooks, and MCP configurations to their repositories, and these files control which instructions a harness reads and which actions it can take. Developers may also commit the specs, plans, and task files that agentic coding tools and spec-driven development frameworks write for agents to implement. The AgentTorrent dataset records these files for six proprietary and open-source agentic coding tools in 10,944 engineered software projects on GitHub. It contains 62,374 configuration artifacts, the files that these artifacts import, 27,593 agentic planning documents, and more than 1.2 million commits that credit an AI tool. All heuristics used for data collection are grounded in tool documentation or derived from GitHub repositories, and we evaluate their detection accuracy with each collection. We use open-weight models to classify whether GitHub repositories host engineered software projects. Unlike most datasets, AgentTorrent links configuration artifacts, imported files, agentic planning documents, and commits that credit an AI tool within the same repositories. Configuration artifacts, planning documents, and credited commits occur together in 388 repositories. For example, our dataset allows researchers to study whether a tool is credited in commits that add instructions for that same tool and how instruction files import and contradict each other. Our data collection pipeline supports regular updates and automatically checks vendor documentation and reports unknown artifacts and agentic coding tools. The dataset and the pipeline are open-source and are archived on Zenodo.

</details>


### [277] [KernelMutate: Mutation-Guided Validation of Generated GPU Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15441)
*Ziyuan Li,Zihe Song,Shuxiao Xie,Mingfang Ji,Xiaofang Qi,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 KernelMutate，用受控故障、已发布实现和替换测试对生成式 GPU 内核的验证可靠性进行实证研究，主张验证应同时报告见证域与观测覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成的 GPU 实现常只通过少量差分测试就被接受，但替换义务可能仍未检查，验证可靠性缺乏系统评估。

Method: 构建 KernelMutate 实证研究：(1) 五抽样锚点接受 838 个 CUDA 候选中的 548 个；(2) 用完整测试套件与源引导测试对比，寻找 FP32 原生见证与仅 dtype 发现；(3) 用任务留出模板匹配比较全局 top-8 与类条件列表的排序与观测覆盖；(4) 用独立对照与替换案例考察数值策略、绑定、自定义执行边界。

Result: 完整套件为 136 个已接受候选找到原生 FP32 见证，另 362 个仅 dtype 发现（多为低精度执行限制，发布方无明确保证）；源引导测试以低 26.1% 计费成本覆盖同一 692 个候选，但对 16 个有原生见证的候选只给出 dtype 证据；全局 top-8 推荐命中更多探针（51/75 vs 48/75），但条件分析会削弱该优势（属离线测量，非部署收益）。

Conclusion: 仅以候选产出与成本衡量验证不足，验证必须同时报告见证域与观测覆盖度；模板匹配与对照案例揭示了替换测试的边界。

Abstract: Generated GPU implementations are commonly accepted after a few differential tests, although replacement obligations may remain unchecked. We present KernelMutate, an empirical study of validation reliability using controlled faults, released implementations, and replacement tests. A five-draw anchor accepts 548 of 838 CUDA candidates.
