The full suite finds native FP32 witnesses for 136 accepted candidates and dtype-only findings for another 362, mostly low-precision execution limitations without established publisher guarantees. Source-guided testing identifies the full suite's 692 candidates at 26.1% lower charged cost, but yields only dtype evidence for 16 accepted candidates with native witnesses in the full suite. Independently observed context and boundary findings cover the same candidate set. Task-held-out template matching reveals differences in ranking and observation coverage: global top-eight recommendations match more probes than class-conditioned lists (51 versus 48 of 75), while conditional analyses restrict the apparent advantage at smaller limits. These template-matching results are offline measurements, not deployed-suite gains. Independent controls and replacement cases expose numerical-policy, binding, and custom-execution boundaries. Validation therefore needs to report witness domains and observation coverage alongside candidate yield and cost.

</details>


### [278] [KernelAudit: Contract-Aware Auditing of Validators for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15506)
*Ziyuan Li,Zihe Song,Xiaofang Qi,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种独立审计方法，通过构建审计预言机（基于语义正确性、实现完整性、度量完整性三维度契约模型）对候选GPU kernel打PASS/FAIL标签，再与验证器结果对比，用于评估验证器质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成GPU kernel的有效性高度依赖验证器质量，但现有验证器存在误接受（漏检禁用库）和误拒绝（误判允许库）等问题，缺乏评估验证器质量的独立手段。

Method: 构建审计预言机：语义正确性用参考校准的stress test检查有效输入下的输出正确性；实现完整性用参考与候选执行轨迹判定具体库使用；度量完整性用计时检查确认报告的运行时是否包含完整计算时间。然后与验证器标签对比进行审计。

Result: 在7个语料库的716个候选和6个验证器（含构造的对照样本）上评估，发现现有6个验证器存在不可忽视的误拒绝率；审计预言机标签与人工判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 该独立审计方法能有效评估验证器质量，揭示现有验证器的误拒问题，且审计标签与人工判断高度吻合，可作为验证器质量评估的可靠工具。

Abstract: The effectiveness of generating GPU kernels driven by a large language model (LLM) is highly dependent on the quality of the used validator (used to accept or reject a generated kernel candidate against the contracts of the given kernel-generation task), whose results inform reward assignment, candidate selection, and speedup claims during kernel generation. However, an existing validator suffers from various limitations, e.g., wrongly accepting a candidate due to missing its forbidden library use or wrongly rejecting a candidate due to determining its permitted library use as forbidden (constraints on library uses are stated in the task contracts).
  To assess the quality of a validator against the given task contracts, we propose an independent-audit approach for the validator by (1) construction of audit oracle: labeling a candidate as PASS or FAIL based on three separate dimensions in our proposed contract model (i.e., semantic correctness, implementation integrity, and measurement integrity) and (2) auditing of the validator against the audit oracle: comparing the labels of the candidate against the validation results produced by the validator. For semantic correctness, reference-calibrated stress tests check output correctness on valid inputs for a candidate. For implementation integrity, reference and candidate execution traces are used to determine specific library uses. For measurement integrity, timing checks assess whether the reported runtime reflects the full time needed to complete the candidate's computation. We apply our approach to assess the quality of six validators and 716 candidates from seven corpora, including constructed controls. The evaluation results show that our approach helps assess the existing six validators to have nontrivial false-reject rates. There is high-degree agreement between the candidate labels produced by our audit oracle and human judgments.

</details>


### [279] [Git2KG: Mining socio-technical relationships in GitHub repositories as temporal knowledge graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15509)
*Lennart Hessenauer,Lisi Qarkaxhija,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Git2KG 是一个可扩展的 Python 库，从 GitHub 仓库中挖掘时序知识图谱，融合代码协作与议题沟通数据，并支持时间切片与图学习导出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有挖掘开源协作数据的方法多用图模型分别刻画议题沟通、共同作者或代码所有权关系，但整合为统一知识图谱面临作者消歧与跨源实体匹配难题；同时多数网络分析采用时间聚合视角，忽略了协作的时间动态性。

Method: Git2KG 从 Git 日志中提取细粒度共同编辑关系与代码所有权，并通过开发者身份消歧，将结果与从 GitHub issue tracker 提取的管理与沟通网络对齐；随后以固定大小、不重叠的时间窗切片开发事件，生成每个仓库的一系列知识图谱快照，并支持计算下游机器学习所需的节点特征与标签。

Result: 生成的快照可导出至 PyTorch Geometric、PathPyG 和 NetworkX，用于时序网络分析、可视化与图学习。

Conclusion: Git2KG 提供了一个可扩展的统一工具，解决多源数据融合与作者消歧问题，并以时序知识图谱形式支持开源软件协作的时序网络分析与机器学习研究。

Abstract: The widespread use of Git and GitHub in open source software (OSS) projects has produced large volumes of data on collaborative software development. Existing approaches to mine those data often use graph models to (i) capture communication between developers in the issue tracker, or (ii) represent developer-developer co-authorship or developer-file code ownership networks from the editing history of code artifacts. Integrating these data in a single knowledge graph (KG) is complicated by the need to disambiguate authors and match entities from multiple sources. Moreover, most works using network analysis have taken a time-aggregated perspective that neglects temporal dynamics of collaborations. To address these issues, we present Git2KG, an extensible Python library that mines temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) from GitHub repositories. Git2KG extracts fine-grained co-editing relations and code ownership from the Git log. It further disambiguates developer identities to align the resulting graphs with management and communication networks extracted from GitHub issue trackers. Git2KG supports temporal analysis by slicing development events into fixed-size, non-overlapping time windows, yielding a series of knowledge graph snapshots per repository. It further supports computing node features and labels for downstream machine learning tasks. Snapshots can then be exported to PyTorch Geometric, PathPyG, and NetworkX for temporal network analysis, visualization, and graph learning.

</details>


### [280] [GHAgentCI: A Dataset of Coding-Agent Invocations in CI Workflow Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15522)
*Daniel Ogenrwot,Jorge Gonzalo Delgado Cervantes,Woojoong Kim,John Businge*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 GHAgentCI 数据集（6K+ 仓库、15K+ 工作流、159K+ 修订、205K+ 智能体证据）及开源抽取工具 cai-miner，用于识别 GitHub Actions 中编码智能体的集成；人工验证显示专用 action（96.1%）与 Agentic Workflow（98.8%）匹配准确率高，并揭示集成方式转向命令行与 GH Agentic Workflow、安全措施差异及频繁移除等现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已被集成进 GitHub Actions 用于 PR 审查、issue 分流和代码修改，但其工作流与普通 CI 文件高度相似，相关证据分散在 action 引用、shell 命令与工作流约定中，缺乏系统性识别与数据支撑，难以开展纵向研究。

Method: 从 196K+ 仓库中挖掘，构建 GHAgentCI 数据集（6K+ 仓库、15K+ 工作流历史、159K+ 修订、205K+ 证据记录，并关联触发条件与声明的执行约束）；开发开源抽取器 cai-miner，基于可扩展目录检测智能体相关证据；对 576 条分层抽样记录进行人工验证。

Result: 人工验证确认专用 action 匹配准确率 96.1%、GitHub Agentic Workflow 匹配 98.8%，其他证据类型准确率较低；探索性分析发现集成方式正转向命令行与 GitHub Agentic Workflow，各类声明的安全防护措施存在差异，且检测到的智能体工作流常被移除。

Conclusion: GHAgentCI 为研究编码智能体在 CI 中的集成提供了可复用的纵向数据基础，支持后续对演进趋势、安全实践与存活性的深入分析。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into GitHub Actions to review pull requests, triage issues and modify code. Identifying these integrations is challenging because agentic workflows often resemble ordinary CI files, with evidence appearing in action references, shell commands and workflow conventions. We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ workflow histories from 6K+ of 196K+ mined GitHub repositories, comprising 159K+ revisions and 205K+ agent-evidence records linked to workflow triggers and declared execution constraints. Our open-source extractor, cai-miner, detects agent-related evidence using an extensible catalogue. Manual validation of 576 stratified records confirmed 96.1% of dedicated-action matches and 98.8% of GitHub Agentic Workflow matches, with lower rates for other evidence kinds. Exploratory analyses reveal a shift toward command-line and GitHub Agentic Workflow integrations, differences in declared safeguards, and frequent removal of detected agentic workflows. GHAgentCI supports longitudinal studies of coding-agent integration into CI.

</details>


### [281] [Testing Conversation Preservation Across LLM APIs: A Rule-Based Oracle for Detecting Silent Information Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15543)
*Xin Liu,Xu Han,Yuxin Wang,Haoran Song,Mingjian Zhao,Lei Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 isloss，一个确定性 oracle，用于检测 LLM API 翻译中对话信息（指令角色、工具交互、错误状态、生成控制）的静默丢失，无需参考译文或额外模型调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 应用普遍依赖转换器与兼容层在不同 API 间迁移对话，但翻译后的请求即使被目标 API 接受，也可能静默丢失角色、工具交互、错误状态或生成控制等信息，现有 schema 校验和基于参考的差分测试难以发现。

Method: 将源与译后的请求/回复映射到共享中间表示 ConvIR，用显式规则区分合理的表示变更与信息丢失；利用规范故障注入、人工审查，在转换器、网关和客户端库上实验，并区分可避免损失与目标 API 固有局限导致的退化。

Result: 留出测试中检出 95/125 植入故障（76.0%）、误报 2/100（2.0%）；合成请求套件中 127/685（18.5%）翻译通过静态检查却静默改变提示/角色/工具信息；回复流中 203/558（36.4%）在至少一个 OpenAI 官方 SDK 上引发异常或沉默损坏；六模型实验显示此类变更可改变模型行为。

Conclusion: 对话信息保真应作为 LLM 互操作、智能体执行与模型评估的独立正确性要求。

Abstract: LLM applications increasingly rely on translators and compatibility layers to move conversations across APIs. Yet a translated request can be accepted by the target API while silently losing information about instruction roles, tool interactions, error states, or generation controls. We introduce isloss, a deterministic oracle for testing conversation-information preservation across LLM API translations. It maps source and translated requests and replies to a shared intermediate representation, ConvIR, and applies explicit rules to distinguish legitimate representation changes from information loss. Unlike schema validation or reference-based differential testing, isloss requires neither a reference translation nor additional model calls. It also distinguishes avoidable loss from degradation caused by target API limitations. We evaluate isloss using specification-based fault injection, human review, and experiments on translators, gateways, and client libraries. On held-out tests, it detects 95/125 planted faults (76.0%) with 2/100 false alarms (2.0%). Across a synthetic request suite spanning six configurations of five translator codebases, 127/685 completed translations (18.5%) pass static target checks while silently changing prompt, role, or tool information in ways the target API could have preserved. In translated replies, 203/558 streams (36.4%) cause exceptions or silent corruption in at least one tested official OpenAI SDK. Targeted experiments across six models show that translation-induced changes can alter model behaviour when tasks depend on the affected information. These results establish conversation preservation as a distinct correctness requirement for reliable LLM interoperability, agent execution, and model evaluation.

</details>


### [282] [DafnyCert: Certifying Specification Strength in Dafny](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15548)
*Álvaro Silva,Isabel Amaral,Ruben Martins,Alexandra Mendes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出DafnyCert工具，自动为Dafny方法生成可独立检验的"规范强度"或"规范弱性"证书，在3910个验证方法上覆盖率达91.3%，并发现16.3%的方法原标签有误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dafny形式化验证只保证实现相对于规范的正确性，但规范本身可能过宽（同一输入允许多个输出），导致验证通过并不意味着规范刻画了唯一行为；现有基准的规范强度标签缺乏可独立核验的证据。

Method: 提出可检验证书：(1) 弱性证书=一个能通过原规范验证的替代实现+使其与原实现输出不同的见证输入；(2) 强性证书=围绕原方法构造并验证harness，若验证成功则证明规范对任意输入至多允许一个输出。工具DafnyCert自动生成：强性通过构造并验证harness确立；弱性用MutDafny变异工具找出能通过原规范验证的变异体，再用Hypothesis基于属性的测试生成区分输出，变异体+见证构成可复检的弱性证书。

Result: 在Dafny-Synthesis与VeriEquivBench共3910个已验证方法上，DafnyCert自动认证3570个（91.3%），其余340个由人工/工具补充证书；构建了首个所有规范均附带可检验强度/弱性证书的数据集；其标签与基准原标签在16.3%的方法上不一致。

Conclusion: 规范强度判定需要可独立检验的证据支撑，而非仅依赖验证通过；DafnyCert证明了大规模自动化证书生成可行，并揭示现有基准标签存在显著错误，凸显此类证据的重要性。

Abstract: Formally verifying a method with Dafny guarantees correctness relative to its specification. However, a specification may be too permissive, allowing multiple outputs for the same input, even when the implementation produces only one. In this paper, we propose checkable certificates that provide independently verifiable evidence of whether a specification is weak or strong. A certificate of weakness contains an alternative implementation that verifies against the original specification, together with a witness input on which the original and alternative implementations produce different results. A certificate of strength is produced by constructing a harness around the original method such that successfully verifying the harness guarantees that the specification allows at most one possible output for any given input. We present DafnyCert, a tool that automatically produces these certificates. Strength is established by constructing and verifying the harness. Weakness is demonstrated by using the MutDafny mutation tool to find mutants that verify against the original specification, and by using the Hypothesis property-based testing framework to generate inputs that produce different outputs for the original program and the mutant. The resulting mutant and witness form a recheckable certificate of weakness. On a dataset of 3,910 verified Dafny methods from Dafny-Synthesis and VeriEquivBench, DafnyCert automatically certifies 3,570 methods (91.3%). We also provide certificates for the remaining 340 methods. To our knowledge, this is the first dataset in which every specification is backed by a checkable certificate of strength or weakness. These labels disagree with the benchmarks' original labels for 16.3% of the methods. These findings highlight the importance of supporting specification strength labels with independently checkable evidence.

</details>


### [283] [Does Confusing Code Confuse LLMs? A Pilot Study on C++](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15575)
*Tim van de Wetering,Lola Solovyeva,Fernando Castor*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过试点研究评估"困惑原子"（atoms of confusion，即损害人类程序理解的极小代码模式）对LLM在C++代码维护任务上的影响，发现其影响高度依赖任务类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于依赖代码理解的软件维护任务，而"困惑原子"虽在人类程序理解中已被充分研究，但其是否同样影响LLM、以及影响是否随任务变化，尚无定论。

Method: 从三个生产级库中抽取C++代码，使用ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot在三个任务上测试（原子注入与移除、输出预测、代码解释），评估困惑原子的影响。

Result: 三项初步发现：(i) 原子对LLM的影响强烈依赖于任务类型；(ii) 需要推理周边代码的原子最难被转换，而局部句法型原子能被可靠处理；(iii) LLM移除困惑原子比注入更可靠。

Conclusion: 移除困惑原子可能依靠模式匹配实现，而注入则需更深入的理解；困惑原子在LLM场景中的作用需按任务分别考量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software maintenance tasks that depend heavily on code comprehension. While atoms of confusion, minimal code patterns empirically shown to impair human program comprehension, are well studied, it remains unclear whether these same patterns affect LLMs, and whether their impact varies across maintenance tasks. We present a pilot study evaluating the impact of atoms of confusion on LLM performance on C++ code drawn from three production libraries, using ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot on three software development tasks: atom injection and removal, output prediction, and code explanation. Our results reveal three preliminary findings: (i) the impact of atoms on LLMs is strongly task-dependent; (ii) atoms requiring reasoning about surrounding code are the most resistant to transformation, while localized syntactic atoms are handled reliably; and (iii) LLMs remove atoms of confusion more reliably than they inject them, suggesting that removal succeeds through pattern matching while injection requires deeper comprehension.

</details>


### [284] [Bug Finding With Agentic Symbolic Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15596)
*George Granberry,Wolfgang Ahrendt,Andy Gordon,Moa Johansson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种智能体框架，将 CrossHair 符号执行与 AI 编码智能体协同，自动为仓库添加断言并为外部数据库合成约束感知的符号环境，在 11 个开源 Python Web 应用（约 115 万行代码）中发现 1050 个可复现 bug，并证明符号执行可补充 LLM 代码审查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号执行工具（如 Python 的 CrossHair）虽能有效找 bug，但存在两大采用障碍：一是需要人工为代码编写断言注释；二是需要为 Python 之外的执行环境（如外部数据库）建模。

Method: 设计一个智能体式 harness，编排 CrossHair 与 AI 编码智能体协同工作：无需人工干预地为代码添加断言（instrument）、为数据库合成约束感知的符号环境、运行符号执行，并为每个报告的 bug 构造具体测试作为证据。

Result: 在 11 个流行开源 Python Web 应用（Zulip、NetBox、Apache Superset 等）共 1,156,044 行代码上评估：合成环境下 CrossHair 覆盖 5406 个受约束函数中的 81%，而无环境仅 4.5%；共发现 1050 个 bug，均可在未修改应用上复现，其中 221 个由 CrossHair 发现，312 个为同一 LLM 纯代码审查基线所遗漏。

Conclusion: 两类方法发现的 bug 类型不同：CrossHair 多发现输入域边界情况导致的崩溃（空字符串、缺失字段、异常字符），而代码审查多发现产生错误输出的 bug。因此该框架使符号执行能够补充基于审查的 bug 发现。

Abstract: Symbolic execution, in tools such as CrossHair for Python, is a powerful technique for finding bugs, but two barriers hinder its adoption: the human effort of annotating code with assertions, and the need to model the execution environment outside Python, such as an external database. To overcome both, we design an agentic harness that orchestrates the symbolic execution tool CrossHair together with an AI coding agent. Without human intervention, it instruments a repository with assertions, synthesizes a constraint-aware symbolic environment for the database, runs symbolic execution, and constructs a concrete test as evidence for each bug it reports. We evaluate our harness on 1,156,044 lines of Python code over 11 popular open-source Python web applications (Zulip, NetBox, Apache Superset, and others). With the synthesized environment, CrossHair executes 81% of the 5,406 contracted functions, against 4.5% without it. Our pipeline finds 1,050 bugs, each reproduced by a test against the unmodified application, 221 of them by CrossHair, and 312 of them are missed by a baseline in which the same LLM inspects the code. The two find different kinds of bugs: CrossHair's are mostly crashes on input-domain corner cases that validation admits, such as empty strings, missing fields and unusual characters, while inspection's are mostly bugs that produce wrong output. Our framework thus lets symbolic execution supplement inspection-based bug finding.

</details>


### [285] [When Agents Need to Consolidate Memories: What RRR Consolidation Explains, and What It Does Not Explain, in Conversation ESAA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15644)
*Elzo Brito dos Santos Filho*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Memory-TCG 是一项工程研究，将对话历史检索扩展为类似"振铃-共振-重整化(RRR)"的机制，并用合成数据比较了时间顺序检索、两种简化基线、完整 RRR 及其变体。结果显示冲突检测受输出预算影响极大，预算预留可显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体可跨会话共享对话历史，但"持久化"不等于能检索到当前决策及其来源(provenance)。研究希望探索一种受 RRR 启发的检索机制，检验其是否优于常规检索，并厘清各组成要素的实际贡献。

Method: 在 Conversation ESAA 上构建 Memory-TCG 扩展，比较五种方案：时间顺序检索、基线 B(recency-aware)、基线 B'(authority-aware)、完整 RRR、无共振变体；在 480 条事实、三个规模与三个输出预算(含 1,024 与 4,096 tokens)共九种组合下评测决策召回与冲突 F1；并测试预留 20% 预算给冲突场景的影响。

Result: 1,024 tokens 时完整 RRR 决策召回 0.44，时间顺序仅 0.06，oracle 上限 0.58；4,096 tokens 时召回全部。B' 与无共振变体在全部九种组合下与完整 RRR 持平。RRR 输出限制前冲突 F1 为 0.615(三规模一致)，限制后在 480 事实/1,024 tokens 下降为 0.000；预留 20% 预算后该场景 F1 升至 0.431，但决策召回从 0.44 降到 0.34；4,096 tokens 时 F1 达 0.930 且无召回损失。

Conclusion: 结果仅支持工程性分析，不支持"选择主义优越性"的结论。振铃对决策的独立贡献未被测量(比较器 D1 在构图前即截断事实，产品按规则保留活跃决策)；测试样本重复、基线简化、未独立复现，冲突检测高度依赖预算分配。

Abstract: Language-model agents can share conversational history across sessions, but persistence does not guarantee retrieval of current decisions and their provenance. This engineering study presents Memory-TCG, a Conversation ESAA extension inspired by ringing, resonance and renormalization (RRR), and an exploratory synthetic evaluation comparing chronological retrieval, two simplified baselines (B, recency-aware, and B', authority-aware), full RRR, and variants under three output budgets. With 480 facts and 1,024 tokens, full RRR recalled 0.44 of current decisions, versus 0.06 for chronological retrieval and 0.58 for the oracle ceiling; with 4,096 tokens it recalled all of them. B' and the no-resonance variant matched full RRR in decision recall across all nine scale-budget combinations, as expected when the active decision set and the adapter ordering are the same. The isolated contribution of ringing to decisions was not measured: comparator D1 cuts facts before the graph is built, and the product retains active decisions by rule. Before the output limit, full-RRR conflict F1 was 0.615 at all three scales; after it, at 480 facts and 1,024 tokens, it was 0.000. Reserving 20% of the budget for conflicts raised that F1 to 0.431 in that scenario, at the cost of lowering decision recall from 0.44 to 0.34, and to 0.930 at 4,096 tokens without decision loss. Fixtures are repetitive, comparators are simplified, and the evaluation was not independently replicated; the results support an engineering analysis, not a claim of selectionist superiority.

</details>


### [286] [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15700)
*Jingyan Jiang,Akhilesh Bondapalli,Krishna Rauniyar,Murat Keceli,Yasaman Ghadar,Haritha Siddabathuni Som,Venkatram Vishwanath,Michael E. Papka,Rong Ge,Huihuo Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出AskALCF——面向高性能计算(HPC)用户支持的智能体式日志分析与改进流水线，对生产交互做细粒度诊断并将故障归因到缺失知识、检索、提示、模型行为或工具执行，进而路由到可执行修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI问答支持系统缺乏面向部署的系统化方法，难以评估最终答案质量、将失败归因到具体组件；且部署后除周期性知识库更新外基本处于静态。

Method: 诊断核心结合答案质量评估与双范围充分性检验(区分"文档库中本就缺失"与"存在但未被检索到")；并引入受控的harness训练流程，利用专家参考、空编辑(null edits)及显式的采纳/回滚/拒绝决策来可靠地改进诊断流水线。

Result: 在2,174轮支持对话中，不可归因失败从41.4%降至14.2%；harness训练将专家一致率由108/150提升至123/150轮。

Conclusion: 实现了一种"受治理的自我演化"：以生产证据驱动有针对性的系统改进，为部署后AI支持系统的持续改进提供超越知识库更新的系统化基础。

Abstract: AI-based question-answering systems are increasingly used for user support, including at high-performance computing (HPC) facilities. However, existing systems lack a systematic, deployment-oriented approach for evaluating final-answer quality and attributing failures to specific components. They also remain largely static after deployment, apart from periodic knowledge-base updates.
  We present AskALCF, an agentic log-analysis and improvement pipeline for HPC user support. AskALCF evaluates production interactions at a fine-grained level, identifies whether failures arise from missing knowledge, retrieval, prompting, model behavior, or tool execution, and routes each failure to an actionable repair. Its diagnostic core combines answer-quality assessment with a two-scope sufficiency test that distinguishes information missing from the documentation corpus from information present but not retrieved. We further introduce a controlled harness-training process that uses expert references, null edits, and explicit ship, revert, or decline decisions to improve the diagnostic pipeline reliably.
  Across 2,174 support turns, AskALCF reduced unattributable failures from 41.4% to 14.2%, while harness training improved expert agreement from 108/150 to 123/150 turns. These results demonstrate a governed form of self-evolution in which production evidence drives targeted system improvements. By turning production interactions into fine-grained diagnoses and actionable repairs, AskALCF provides a systematic foundation for continuously improving deployed AI support systems beyond knowledge-base updates alone.

</details>


### [287] [Early Reflections on How Large Language Models are Reshaping Software Engineering Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15797)
*David Williams,Michail Kyrkos,Max Hort,Maria Kechagia,Justyna Petke,Federica Sarro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文对ICSE 2019-2026共1,918篇论文进行计量分析，揭示LLM时代的软件工程研究已高度集中于中美少数机构，且存在商业模型与开源模型的使用鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正在重塑软件工程研究，但其高昂的财务与算力成本引发"谁能参与这场变革"的公平性问题，作者希望通过实证刻画研究格局的集中度与分化。

Method: 对ICSE 2019-2026 Research与SEIP两个track的全部1,918篇论文做全文/元数据计量分析，统计国家、机构、产学研属性与所用模型类型（商业闭源 vs 开放权重）。

Result: 中美占2023-2026年LLM类论文的74%；机构极度集中（中国5所、美国7所即覆盖各自国家过半产出）；美国仅半数机构涉足LLM研究，而新加坡15所中11所参与；2023-2026年Research track中产业参与更多（23.4% vs 16.9%），纯学界论文更少（63.4% vs 70.9%）；SEIP论文77.4%使用商业模型、40.5%仅用商业模型，而Research track仅21.2%仅依赖商业模型，更多使用开放权重模型。

Conclusion: LLM时代的SE研究呈现国家与机构的高度集中，并在产学研之间形成模型选择分化；这一分化值得反思SE研究在多大程度上真正契合产业实践，以及资源壁垒对研究可复现性与参与公平性的影响。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are radically reshaping software engineering (SE) research. Yet, their steep financial and computational costs raise questions about who participates in that change, and who does not. By analysing all 1,918 papers published in the ICSE 2019-2026 Research and SEIP tracks, we uncover a shifting and highly concentrated research landscape. China and the US dominate LLM-based SE research, appearing in 74% of LLM-based publications between 2023-2026, yet they diverge sharply in their use of commercial versus open-weight models. Beneath this national dominance lies extreme institutional concentration: just 5 institutions in China and 7 in the US appear in more than half of their respective nations' LLM-based output. In the US, only half of the unique institutions active in 2023-2026 participated in LLM-based research, whereas Singapore displays broader usage, with 11 of 15 active institutions participating in LLM-based work. Furthermore, across 2023-2026 Research-track papers, industry involvement is more prevalent in LLM-based work (23.4% vs 16.9%), and academia-only papers make up a smaller share (63.4% vs 70.9%). Crucially, we expose a gap in model usage across industry and academia. SEIP track papers lean strongly towards commercial LLMs, with 77.4% featuring them and 40.5% using them exclusively. In contrast, only 21.2% of Research-track work relies strictly on commercial models, making greater use of open-weight models that typically support more sustainable and reproducible experiments. However, this divide warrants reflection on the extent to which SE research aligns with industry practice.

</details>


### [288] [Spec-Driven PBT: Deriving Semantic Invariants from Code Specifications for Agentic Property-based Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15920)
*Aditya Shukla,Kartik Gupta,Ali Alavi,Pashootan Vaezipoor*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Spec-Driven PBT：先从自然语言规格文档中抽取不变量（性质），再查看实现以生成具体测试，用于检验 AI 智能体编写的代码。在 ViBench 的 25 个应用上，它发现了 Code-driven PBT 遗漏的一类新缺陷，且写出的性质测试数量少 2.4 倍；两者缺陷总量相近但重叠度低（169 个缺陷中近 60% 只被其中一种方法发现），互补性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体编程（agentic coding）让代码产出速度快于审阅速度，且这类代码有自身的典型失效模式。属性测试（PBT）长期受制于"不变量推导成本高"，LLM 自动写性质虽缓解了该问题，但现有方法（Code-driven PBT）只从实现本身推导性质，因而被实现细节偏见所束缚；与此同时，产品需求文档这类完整规格在智能体编程中已很常见，但其在测试代码中的作用尚未被充分挖掘。

Method: 提出 Spec-Driven PBT 智能体：（1）先仅依据规格文档，用自然语言表达程序应满足的不变量；（2）然后再检查实现，把这些自然语言不变量翻译为可执行的具体性质测试。与先从代码出发的 Code-driven PBT 形成对照，核心在于让性质来源于"代码本该做什么"而非"代码实际怎么写"。

Result: 在 ViBench 的 25 个应用上评测：Spec-Driven PBT 发现了 Code-driven PBT 漏掉的一批新缺陷，同时写出的性质测试减少 2.4 倍；两者发现的缺陷数量大致相当，但重叠很小——169 个缺陷中近 60% 只被单一方法发现。定性分析显示，Spec-Driven PBT 独有缺陷多违反文档化的产品工作流，而 Code-driven PBT 独有缺陷集中在实现健壮性方面。

Conclusion: 规格是智能体所写代码的重要测试性质来源，可与实现驱动方法形成互补。将规格驱动与代码驱动的属性测试结合使用，有望比任一单独方法覆盖更广的缺陷类型，为智能体编程中的自动化测试提供更完整、更少实现偏见的保障。

Abstract: Software is increasingly written by AI agents that produce an implementation from a natural language specification, a practice known as agentic coding. Code is now produced faster than it can be reviewed, and has been shown to exhibit its own characteristic failure patterns. Property-based testing (PBT), a long-standing technique in which invariant properties of a program are checked against many generated inputs, has recently been revisited with LLM agents authoring the properties, thereby removing the high-effort derivation of invariants that has long hindered its adoption. Existing methods, however, derive these properties from the implementation alone (Code-driven PBT). At the same time, a thorough specification such as a product requirements document has become routine within agentic coding, yet its role in testing the resulting code remains underexplored. We study the value of the specification as a source of properties for testing agent-written code. Our key insight is that the specification, unlike the implementation, records what the code was meant to do, and invariants derived from it are not biased by particular implementation choices. We propose Spec-Driven PBT, an agent that first expresses invariants in natural language from the specification and only then inspects the implementation to translate them into concrete tests. Across 25 applications from ViBench, Spec-Driven PBT finds a novel set of bugs that Code-driven PBT misses, while writing 2.4x fewer property tests. Though the two approaches surface a roughly equivalent number of bugs, there is little overlap: nearly 60% of the 169 total bugs are found by only one. Qualitatively, we find that the bugs unique to Spec-Driven PBT tend to violate documented product workflows whereas those to Code-driven PBT instead concentrate on implementation robustness, offering complementary value for bug discovery in agent-written code.

</details>


### [289] [ADAPT: Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing for Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16114)
*Vahid Haratian,Atakan Akar,Eray Tüzün*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ADAPT是一个自主编码智能体方法，针对PR的代码变更生成聚焦的回归单元测试，通过diff分析和F2P验证反馈迭代优化，在426个真实PR上F2P通过率显著优于BLAST，并在补丁覆盖率上超越ChaCo且成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代开发依赖PR引入小而定向的代码变更，但开发者常不附带测试，导致新行为缺乏防回归保护。现有测试生成技术多针对整个软件单元并优化覆盖率而非变更行为，diff-aware方法在捕获变更行为上效果有限。

Method: 提出ADAPT（Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing）：给定PR，智能体分析base与head版本的diff以识别被修改函数及上下文，规划并生成候选单元测试；专用fail-to-pass（F2P）验证工具在双版本上运行每个候选测试，F2P成功后报告仍未覆盖的可执行变更行，智能体据此迭代精炼测试。

Result: 在426个真实PR上，ADAPT+GPT-4o的F2P率达62.0%（264/426），远超BLAST的35.4%；ADAPT+GPT-5-mini达89.9%（383/426）。在与ChaCo共享的137个PR上，ADAPT全补丁覆盖率达83.9%，高于ChaCo的79.6%，且时间与成本显著更低。人工评估显示F2P有效测试确实针对PR意图变更，重要性均分达4.54/5，断言强度4.35/5，可读性4.49/5，并常覆盖开发者测试之外的行为。

Conclusion: ADAPT通过diff感知的智能体与F2P验证反馈循环，有效生成变更聚焦的高质量回归测试，在F2P率、补丁覆盖率和成本效率上全面优于现有SOTA方法，且人工评估证实测试的相关性与质量。

Abstract: Modern software development relies on pull requests (PRs) that introduce small, targeted code changes. Once merged, these changes should be protected by focused tests that exercise the behavior the PR introduces, yet developers often submit PRs without such tests, leaving the new behavior unguarded against future regressions. Most test generation techniques target entire software units and optimize objectives such as code coverage rather than the behavior a change introduces, and prior diff-aware approaches have had limited success in capturing it.
  We propose ADAPT (Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing), a regression test generation approach that uses an autonomous coding agent to produce change-focused tests for PRs. Given a PR, the agent analyzes the diff between the base and head versions to identify the modified functions and their context, then plans and generates candidate unit tests. A dedicated fail-to-pass (F2P) verification tool runs each candidate on both versions and, after F2P success, reports which executable changed lines remain uncovered; guided by this feedback, the agent iteratively refines its tests.
  We evaluate ADAPT on the same 426 real-world PRs used by the prior state-of-the-art baseline, with GPT-4o and GPT-5-mini. ADAPT+GPT-4o reaches an F2P rate of 62.0% (264/426), compared with BLAST's reported 35.4% (151/426), while ADAPT+GPT-5-mini reaches 89.9% (383/426). On 137 PRs shared with Change And Cover (ChaCo), ADAPT achieves full patch coverage on 83.9% of PRs, compared with 79.6% for ChaCo, at considerably lower time and cost. A manual evaluation confirms that the F2P-valid tests target each PR's intended change, with mean scores of up to 4.54/5 for importance, 4.35/5 for assertion strength, and 4.49/5 for readability, often covering behavior beyond the developer-written tests.

</details>


### [290] [Robo-SWE: An Executable Issue-Resolution Dataset Mined from Robot Software Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16116)
*Vahid Haratian,Vahid Ansari,Mohammadhossein Malmir,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Robo-SWE，一个从 28 个公开机器人仓库的已合并 PR 中挖掘出的 236 个可执行 issue 修复任务数据集，覆盖 ROS 2、仿真/物理引擎、算法库与机器人学习框架四大领域，并附带来源台账与 3,540 次智能体评测尝试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评测多集中于通用软件，而机器人软件具有专用构建工具、依赖物理引擎的仿真与学习框架、以及依赖时序与硬件的难以测试行为，亟需领域感知的评测基准。

Method: 从 28 个公开机器人仓库的已合并 PR 中挖掘 236 个可执行任务，每个任务包含原始 issue 文本、修复前提交的容器配方、开发者修复与开发者测试（修复前失败、修复后通过且可重复离线运行）；记录 1,567 个候选 PR 的来源台账及每个被拒原因；用五种编码智能体配置进行 3,540 次评分尝试并保留补丁与 3,529 条轨迹。

Result: 三次运行下主要配置的解决率为 45.8%（Claude Sonnet 5.5）至 56.5%（Claude Opus 5.5）；GPT-6.1 Sol 最高努力 54.1%、中等努力 52.5%，GPT-6 Astra 51.4%，GLM-5.3 46.2%，Kimi K3.1 Pro 43.9%。

Conclusion: 任务经执行验证有效，数据集与公开排行榜已上线；基于人工评审的公平性验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: Coding agents are evaluated mostly on general-purpose software, but domain-specific systems require domain-aware evaluation. Robot software is a particularly challenging case: Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) packages have their own build tools, simulators and learning frameworks are built on physics engines, and behavior that depends on timing and hardware is hard to test. We present Robo-SWE, a dataset of 236 executable issue-resolution tasks mined from merged pull requests in 28 public robotics repositories in four domains: ROS 2 systems, simulation and physics engines, robotics algorithm libraries, and robot-learning frameworks. Each task contains the original issue text, a container recipe for the repository at the commit before the fix, the developers' fix, and the developers' tests, which fail before the fix and pass after it in repeated offline runs. The dataset also keeps a provenance ledger of all 1,567 candidate pull requests, with the stage each reached and the reason for every rejection, and, as a first use, 3,540 graded attempts by five coding-agent setups with recorded patches and 3,529 available trajectories. Across three runs per primary setup, resolve rates range from 45.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5 to 56.5% for Claude Opus 5.5; GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 54.1% at maximum effort and 52.5% at medium effort, and GPT-6 Astra 51.4%. GLM-5.3 resolves 46.2%, and Kimi K3.1 Pro 43.9%. The tasks are validated by execution; verification of their fairness by human reviewers is future work. The dataset and public leaderboard are available online.

</details>


### [291] [Guided Generation of Linux Kernel Semantic Patches with Small Local Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16215)
*Mohanned Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种引导式代码生成框架，使运行在笔记本上的小型开源语言模型能把驱动转换示例转为 Coccinelle 语义补丁（SmPL），并高精度地完成内核 API 迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux 内核 API 变更时，数百个驱动需人工转换数月，早期转换被当作后续的参考样例；作者希望本地可运行的小模型能自动把这些示例转化为内核维护者已在用的 Coccinelle 规则，降低人工成本。

Method: 将引导式代码生成适配到该任务：用脚本把训练示例分解为变更变体树；模型针对每个变体写一条小规则，并依据规则作用于示例的反馈迭代；确定性组件修复 SmPL 语法并泛化驱动特定名称；贪心组合规则；编译评审器修复或拒绝输出无法编译的规则。

Result: 在 7 个新 API 迁移（晚于三模型训练截止）预注册测试集、122 个留出转换上评测：Qwen2.5-Coder 三次种子平均解决 35.3（32–41），直接提示仅 1.0；Spinfer 为 41，前沿 LLM 智能体为 66。本地模型解决数少于 Spinfer，但规则最精确（被改文件中 0.74 被解决，Spinfer 0.55，前沿智能体 0.70）；编译评审器剔除了所有匹配人工修复却无法构建的输出；另两个通用模型至多解决 12 个。

Conclusion: 小型本地模型配合引导式生成、确定性修复与编译反馈，可生成高精度 SmPL 规则，虽覆盖面不及专用工具与前沿模型，但精确率最高；全部代码、提示、模型响应与结果均已公开。

Abstract: When a Linux kernel API changes, hundreds of drivers are converted by hand over months, and the earlier conversions are reviewed examples for the later ones. We ask whether small open language models running on a laptop can turn such examples into Coccinelle semantic patches, the rules kernel maintainers already use for tree-wide changes. We adapt guided code generation to this task: the training examples are decomposed by script into a tree of change variants, the model writes one small rule per variant under feedback from applying it to the examples, deterministic components repair SmPL syntax and generalise driver-specific names, rules are composed greedily, and a compile critic repairs or rejects a rule whose output does not build. We evaluate on a pre-registered test set of 7 migrations whose new APIs appeared after the training cutoffs of all three models (Qwen2.5-Coder 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 3 4B), with 122 held-out driver conversions, counting a conversion as solved only if the rule's output matches the human fix and compiles. With the framework, Qwen2.5-Coder solves 35.3 conversions on average over three seeds (range 32-41), against 1.0 when prompted directly; Spinfer solves 41 and a frontier LLM agent 66. The local model solves fewer conversions than Spinfer but its rules are the most precise on the test set (0.74 of the files they change are solved, against 0.55 for Spinfer and 0.70 for the frontier agent), and the compile critic removes every output that matches the human fix but does not build. The two general-purpose models stay weak even with guidance (at most 12 solved). All code, prompts, model responses and results are released.

</details>


### [292] [Eliciting and Mitigating Specification Satisficing in Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16289)
*Ruixin Wang,Tianyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出编码智能体常出现的"规范满足"(specification satisficing)失败——智能体曾考虑符合需求的实现选择，却因自认可的理由改选不符合需求的方案；为此提出 SatisFix，引导智能体报告此类选择及理由并逐一对照任务描述核查，在 DeepSWE 上平均提升 pass@1 5.09%、在 SWE-bench Pro 困难子集提升 7.06%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体难以满足任务描述的全部需求。部分失败源于智能体曾想到符合需求的实现，却因自认为可接受的理由而改选不符合需求的方案（即 specification satisficing）。这类失败难以发现和缓解：理由是智能体自洽的，而现有自我纠错方法本身偏向这些理由。

Method: SatisFix 分两步引导智能体：第一步要求其主动报告这些候选选择及其理由，第二步将每个选择与任务描述逐条比对核查。消融显示两步均有贡献。

Result: 在 DeepSWE 与 SWE-bench Pro 上，以五种 LLM 为骨干、两种智能体框架，与三种自我纠错方法对比：pass@1 在 DeepSWE 平均提升 5.09%，SWE-bench Pro 困难子集提升 7.06%；DeepSWE 上超出最佳基线 3.98%。

Conclusion: 通过显式暴露并对照需求核查智能体的"规范满足"选择，可有效提升编码智能体的需求满足率，且优于现有自我纠错方法。

Abstract: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description. In some of these failures, the agent considers an implementation choice that meets a requirement, but later decides to commit to another one that does not meet the requirement for a reason it finds acceptable. We call this specification satisficing. It is challenging to identify and mitigate specification satisficing because the agent accepts such choices for its own reasons, and existing self-correction methods are biased toward them. We propose SatisFix, which guides a coding agent to report these choices and their reasons, and then check each choice against the task description. We evaluate SatisFix on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Pro with five LLMs as backbones and two different agent frameworks, and compare it with three self-correction methods. SatisFix improves the pass@1 of the base agent by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-bench Pro. On DeepSWE, it outperforms the best baseline by 3.98%. Our ablation study shows that both steps of SatisFix contribute to the improvement.

</details>


### [293] [Rasoi: Visual Diffs for Evaluating Structural Changes Made by Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16293)
*Riya Sahni,Aryan Kaul,Anushka Bhatnagar,Xuanming Zhang,Vivian Liu,Reya Vir,Lydia B. Chilton*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出可视化 diff 工具 Rasoi，映射代码库架构在 coding agent 每次编辑后的演化，帮助开发者审查结构变更。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Coding agent 让开发者能通过自然语言快速改代码，但改动规模变大后开发者难以追踪代码库如何演化，表面正确的编辑可能暗中复制逻辑、越界修改、删除功能或造成架构漂移。

Method: 设计探针 Rasoi，将每次 agent 编辑后的架构演化可视化，支持在多抽象层次上查看哪些架构元素与关系被新增、修改或删除。随后在 12 名开发者、覆盖多个技术领域、基于各自真实代码库的一周部署研究中评估。

Result: 可视化 diff 帮助开发者判断改动是否在范围内、发现意外的重构，并理解被修改部分与整体系统的关系。

Conclusion: Coding agent 监管工具的价值不在于让开发者更信任 agent，而在于帮助开发者对自己评估 agent 改动的能力建立信心；并讨论了对代码理解与 AI 辅助开发中人类监督类可视化工具的启示。

Abstract: Coding agents let developers modify software rapidly through natural language. However, as agents take on larger changes, developers can lose track of how the codebase is evolving. These edits may look correct on the surface while restructuring the system in unexpected ways: duplicating logic, changing modules outside the requested scope, removing functionality developers meant to keep, or introducing architectural drift. We investigate how visual diffs can help developers understand and evaluate the structural changes that coding agents make. We present Rasoi, a design probe that maps how a codebase's architecture evolves after each agent-made edit, letting developers inspect which architectural elements and relationships were added, modified, or removed across multiple levels of abstraction. We deployed Rasoi in a week-long study with 12 developers working on their own codebases across varied technical domains. We found that visual diffs helped developers see whether changes stayed within scope, notice unexpected restructuring, and understand how modified parts related to the system as a whole. Our findings suggest that the value of oversight tools for coding agents lies less in making developers trust the agent and more in helping developers feel confident in their own evaluation of agent-made changes. We discuss implications for visual tools that support code comprehension and human oversight in AI-assisted software development.

</details>


### [294] [Non-Functional Requirements to Hyperparameter Translation for Quantum Software via LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16902)
*Joseph G. Bronyah,Nasir U. Eisty*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文评估七个大语言模型（LLM）能否将自然语言非功能性需求（NFR）翻译为量子程序执行参数，并与确定性启发式基线对比；结果显示LLM在语义准确性上显著领先，但执行层面（保真度）收益未获支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子软件工程（QSE）缺乏将自然语言非功能性需求转化为shots、transpiler优化等级等执行参数的有效方法；现有方法侧重语义相似度而非执行结果，因此需要以执行结果为导向的验证。

Method: 使用540条合成用户故事与18条真实用户故事，比较七个LLM与一个确定性启发式基线；同时评估语义准确性与执行结果（时间、成本、top-state概率、双量子比特门暴露），并借助Qiskit/Aer仿真进行验证。

Result: 所有LLM的语义准确率显著优于启发式基线，真实数据上为55.6%–83.3%，基线仅16.7%；但LLM之间在真实数据集上无统计显著差异。面向速度与成本的配置确实降低了执行时间与成本，但保真度提升未获支持；部分失败源于提供商安全拒答而非翻译错误。

Conclusion: LLM有潜力作为QSE中NFR到配置翻译的中间件，但必须结合基于执行的验证、人工监督，并谨慎解读模型间差异。

Abstract: Quantum software engineering (QSE) lacks validated approaches for translating natural-language non-functional requirements (NFRs) into execution parameters such as shots and transpiler optimization levels. Existing methods emphasize semantic similarity rather than execution outcomes. We evaluate seven large language models (LLMs) against a deterministic heuristic baseline using 540 synthetic and 18 real-world user stories. We assess semantic accuracy and execution outcomes, including time, cost, top-state probability, and two-qubit gate exposure, through Qiskit/Aer simulations. All LLMs significantly outperformed the heuristic in semantic accuracy, achieving 55.6 to 83.3 percent on real-world stories compared to 16.7 percent for the heuristic. However, no LLM demonstrated statistically significant superiority over others on the real-world dataset. Speed- and cost-oriented configurations reduced execution time and cost, but fidelity improvements were not supported. Some failures resulted from provider safety refusals rather than translation errors. Our findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs as middleware for NFR-to-configuration translation in QSE, while emphasizing execution-based validation, human oversight, and careful interpretation of model differences.

</details>


### [295] [Patterns for Designing CI/CD Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17276)
*Leandro Sousa,Filipe Correia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文将分散在实证研究、实践书籍与"坏味道"目录中的 CI/CD 候选实践与反实践转化为模式并加以整合，形成涵盖安全、流水线调度、工作流结构、性能、失败与发布管理的模式集合，每个模式均情境化描述其问题、作用力、解决方案与后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CI/CD 流水线难以构建与维护，而相关知识零散分布于实证研究、实践者书籍和"坏味道"目录中，缺乏统一、可复用的结构化知识体系。

Method: 收集候选实践与反实践，将其转化为模式，并进一步整合归并为统一的模式集合；每个模式采用情境化模板，包含问题、作用力、解决方案与后果。

Result: 得到一套覆盖安全、流水线调度、工作流结构、性能、失败处理与发布管理等多个主题的 CI/CD 模式集合。

Conclusion: 通过模式化方法可将分散的 CI/CD 经验知识系统化，为流水线设计与维护提供可情境化套用的实践指引。

Abstract: CI/CD pipelines are difficult to build and maintain, and information about them is scattered across empirical studies, practitioner books, and catalogues of 'smells'. We collected candidate practices and anti-practices converted them into patterns, and then consolidated these into patterns. These patterns address issues such as security, pipeline scheduling, workflow structure, performance and failure and release management. Each pattern is contextualised and describes the problem it solves, the forces at play, the solution and the consequences.

</details>


### [296] [Where LLM Agents Get Stuck Debugging Databases: Access More Than Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17304)
*Gustavo Pinto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 报告一个编码智能体（Claude Code）在生产消息分发引擎中诊断8起数据库事故的现场观察：凡依赖运行时并发的事故（5起）均出现"宣告原因—上线修复—撤回"的循环，根本瓶颈是生产状态访问权限缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编码智能体已从"写代码"扩展到"基于实时运行时数据调试运行中的系统"，但其在生产调试中的真实能力边界与失败原因缺乏实证观察。

Method: 对单智能体在真实生产环境中的8起数据库事故诊断进行实地观察，并将每起事故映射到智能体所缺失的能力/资源，做瓶颈归类分析。

Result: 5起并发相关事故全部存在访问缺口：1起仅因访问缺失，4起为访问缺失叠加推理错误（早期原因锚定、配置探索不充分、误读事务语义）；另3起非并发事故无需额外资源即可解决。智能体的错误假设与其可见证据自洽，并非凭空捏造。

Conclusion: 生产调试智能体的下一步应是构建"取证层"——在既有安全管控内提供安全问询API、锁与死锁飞行记录器、生产回放沙箱，以补齐运行时状态访问能力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly asked not only to write code but to debug running systems from live runtime data. We report a field observation of one such agent (Claude Code) as it diagnosed eight database incidents in a production message-dispatch engine. In every incident whose root cause depended on runtime concurrency, the agent announced a cause, shipped a fix, and later walked it back, and each wrong guess cost a deploy-and-observe cycle. Mapping each incident to what the agent lacked, we find that access to production state was the most pervasive bottleneck. The missing access included live lock views, untruncated deadlock reports, read-only execution, and an explicit environment context. An access gap was present in all five concurrency-dependent incidents: alone in one, and in four combined with a reasoning error such as anchoring on an early cause, incomplete exploration of the configuration, or a misreading of the code's transaction semantics. The three incidents that did not depend on concurrency needed nothing beyond what the agent already had. Within the incidents, the agent's wrong hypotheses were consistent with the evidence it could see; they were not fabrications. We argue that the next step for production-debugging agents is a forensics layer that gives the agent the access it lacks inside existing security controls. Such a layer would combine a safe interrogation API, a lock-and-deadlock flight recorder, and a production replay harness.

</details>


### [297] [The Impact of Large Language Models (LLMs) on Code Review Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.11034)
*Antonio Collante,Samuel Abedu,SayedHassan Khatoonabadi,Ahmad Abdellatif,Ebube Alor,Emad Shihab*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究基于9,254个GitHub项目中的25,473个PR，发现使用GPT的PR中位解决时间从23小时降至9小时（降幅超60%），评审时间减少33%、等待接受时间减少87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究多关注GPT在特定编程任务上的应用，而其对代码评审流程各阶段效率的影响尚缺乏系统性实证。作者希望量化GPT对GitHub PR工作流的影响，并为团队优化协作流程提供可操作依据。

Method: 构建含25,473个PR（来自9,254个项目）的数据集；用半自动启发式方法识别GPT辅助PR（关键词检测+正则过滤+人工核验，标注准确率达95%）；采用多元线性回归与Mann-Whitney U检验，在整体解决时间和各评审阶段两个层面比较GPT辅助与非辅助PR的差异；并对300个GPT辅助PR抽样分析用途分布。

Result: GPT辅助PR的中位解决时间为9小时，非辅助为23小时，降幅超60%；评审时间减少33%，接受前等待时间减少87%。用途分布：代码优化60%、缺陷修复26%、文档更新12%。

Conclusion: 早期采用GPT可显著提升PR流程效率并在各阶段节省时间；研究揭示了GPT对代码评审流程的影响，为软件团队改进工作流与协作提供实证支持。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently gained prominence in the field of software development, significantly boosting productivity and simplifying teamwork. Although prior studies have examined task-specific applications, the phase-specific effects of LLM assistance on the efficiency of code review processes remain underexplored. This research investigates the effect of GPT on GitHub pull request (PR) workflows, with a focus on reducing resolution time, optimizing phase-specific performance, and assisting developers. We curated a dataset of 25,473 PRs from 9,254 GitHub projects and identified GPT-assisted PRs using a semi-automated heuristic approach that combines keyword-based detection, regular expression filtering, and manual verification until achieving 95% labeling accuracy. We then applied statistical modeling, including multiple linear regression and Mann-Whitney U test, to evaluate differences between GPT-assisted and non-assisted PRs, both at the overall resolution level and across distinct review phases. Our research has revealed that early adoption of GPT can substantially boost the effectiveness of the PR process, leading to considerable time savings at various stages. Our findings suggest that GPT-assisted PRs reduced median resolution time by more than 60% (9 hours compared to 23 hours for non-assisted PRs). We discovered that utilizing GPT can reduce the review time by 33% and the waiting time before acceptance by 87%. Analyzing a sample dataset of 300 GPT-assisted PRs, we discovered that developers predominantly use GPT for code optimization (60%), bug fixing (26%), and documentation updates (12%). This research sheds light on the impact of the GPT model on the code review process, offering actionable insights for software teams seeking to enhance workflows and promote seamless collaboration.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [298] [Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14544)
*Gerhard Trippen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Zugwise将手写棋谱数字化重新定义为对局重建问题，利用国际象棋计算引擎机制（静默搜索、静态交换评估、牵制检测）构建“荒谬性检测器”，把合法但错误的静默误读暴露出来，并结合双人棋谱交叉验证，在浏览器端离线运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统将手写棋谱识别视为手写识别问题（逐格识别并检查是否合法）会遗漏最关键的错误：产生非法着法的误读是“响亮的”易被发现，但产生“合法却错误”着法的误读是“静默的”——纯合法性管线会接受它，并基于错误局面解读后续所有着法，错误不断放大。

Method: 1）将任务视为对局重建，复用计算机象棋机制（静默搜索、静态交换评估、牵制检测）来判断“人类是否可能写下这步棋”而非“应该下什么”；2）荒谬性检测器在错误发生处或附近将静默错误变响亮，并用反向搜索将晚期症状追溯到根源；3）候选排序排除棋力质量信号；4）用Needleman-Wunsch合并第二位选手的棋谱作为佐证，将所有双谱合法读法间的分歧交由人工复核；5）两个学习信号——对识别器原始输出做CTC重打分、Maia式人类走法先验——提升正确修复的排序。

Result: 在两个赛事分区的oracle重放中，加入双谱后静默错误从16降至1、从50降至13；两个学习信号将正确修复的top-rank率从58.8%提升到78.0%，且在后续分区无需重拟合依然保持。第一个分区上，人工校验输出与独立专家转录在45局中有34局逐着法一致；对棋谱裁定发现两份记录均有错误，且错误位于不同着次。

Conclusion: 系统完全在浏览器中运行，免费、私密且可离线使用；论文未证明任一流程更快或更准确，并提出了针对“无单一记录是基准真值”领域的“三方裁定协议”。

Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position. We therefore treat the task as game reconstruction and present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) to ask not "what should be played?" but "could a human plausibly have written this?" An absurdity detector makes silent errors loud at or near where they occur, and a backward search traces late symptoms to their cause. Candidate ranking excludes chess-quality signals. A Needleman-Wunsch merge adds the second player's sheet as evidence, and review stops send every disagreement between the sheets' legal readings to a human. In oracle replay of two tournament sections, a release adding them cuts silent errors from 16 to 1 and from 50 to 13. Two learned signals, CTC re-scoring against the recognizer's raw output and a Maia-style human-move prior, raise the correct fix's top-rank rate from 58.8% to 78.0% of the replacement decisions where it is a candidate, and hold without refitting on a later section. On the first section, the human-verified output matches an independent expert transcription move for move on 34 of 45 games, and adjudication against the sheets found errors in both records, on different plies. We do not establish that either workflow is faster or more accurate. The system runs entirely in the browser and is free, private, and offline-capable; alongside it we offer a three-way adjudication protocol for a domain where no single record is ground truth.

</details>


### [299] [Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14654)
*Egor Pakhomov,Anurag Koul,Hongjun Liu,Bo Pang,Shafiq Joty,Erik Nijkamp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究历史编辑（如纠正、修复、交接）对语言模型智能体后续表现的影响，发现同一正确内容的作用取决于历史的表述方式与外部世界的实际状态，二者不一致时编辑反而有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作只在固定世界状态下清理历史，将"展示纠正步骤"与"宣称已完成"绑定在一起，无法区分内容本身、表述方式与世界状态各自的作用。现实中系统压缩或修复带错历史时，错误的影响仍留在世界里，因此需要探究这两者是否匹配。

Method: 提出"冻结—编辑—续跑"范式：在任务中途冻结智能体并保留其精确世界状态，随后编辑历史或世界，让接收方模型继续执行。在 AgentCE-Bench 上，智能体写入错误值后固定世界，用两种自然编辑加入正确值：保留错误旁的如实批注、或智能体自称已完成动作。在 AppWorld 上，改变数据库写操作回执报告成功或失败、及效果是否真实存在。

Result: AgentCE-Bench：如实批注把恢复率从匹配中性批注的 51% 提升到 66%；而"已完成动作"式编辑则从 50% 降到 44%，低于未编辑历史。AppWorld：效果缺失时成功回执使整任务成功率从 45% 降至 28%，效果存在时则从 38% 升至 49%，两效应相差 27 个百分点，八接收方中六个在 97.5% 水平、七个在 95% 水平为正。

Conclusion: 历史编辑的效果取决于其所描述的世界状态。若把历史粉饰成"干净"而世界仍留有错误，编辑可能让智能体比不做任何编辑更糟。修复与交接系统的设计需保证历史表述与世界状态一致。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.

</details>


### [300] [Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14681)
*Reyna Abhyankar,Dylan Lim,Drew Wadsworth,Venkata Hasith Vattikuti,YuTong Julia Zhang,Jung Hwan Heo,Taeksang Kim,Kesavan Ramakrishnan,Evangelene Stanley,Xinyu Fang,Daniel Y. Fu,Simran Arora*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Together AI 提出 Together Compiler (TKCC)，首个面向 AI 推理优化的持续智能体循环编译系统，通过分层常驻引擎和成本模型解决"测量吞吐 vs 保真度"的权衡，在多项负载上大幅超越手写 Megakernel 与开源引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 工作负载快速变化（新模型频繁发布、架构多样、流量分布多变），Together AI 需要持续优化部署。现有系统难以持续编译：用智能体优化单个 kernel 依赖离线基准，因 MoE 等数据相关行为导致计时保真度低；直接优化端到端引擎又受引擎启动时间慢的拖累，即在测量吞吐与保真度之间存在权衡。

Method: 构建 TKCC——首个用于 AI 推理优化的持续智能体循环。(1) 分层常驻引擎（Tiered Persistent Engine），将引擎启动开销与前向计算解耦；(2) 成本模型，用于选择并行配置作为优化过程种子。此外对智能体上下文管理做了大量消融，并总结生产部署经验。

Result: 在 Llama 1B 主力负载上较高度优化手写 Megakernel 最高 1.7x；在最新前沿模型（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）上跨硬件平台于 InferenceX 基准最高 2.6x TPS；batch size 1 下达到 SOTA：M3.1 Flash 1111 TPS，DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1205 TPS。

Conclusion: TKCC 可推广至前沿语言模型推理之外，并已在生产集群服务数万亿 token，验证了持续智能体编译的实用性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.

</details>


### [301] [When Should Semantic Priors Enter Partially-Identified Causal Discovery?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14736)
*Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Saad Bin Ather,Valentin Six,Lancelot Da Costa,Tommaso Salvatori,Bernhard Scholkopf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了用LLM语义信息辅助观测因果发现时三个决策环节（语义查询分配、候选方向接纳、因果图保留）的可靠性，发现语义信息确有价值，但定向分配、接纳证书与下游保留的可信度均未获支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测数据因果发现常无法确定或稳定判定因果方向。LLM可提供语义信息辅助定向，但错误建议可能排除真实因果图并破坏下游推断，因此需厘清语义信息"在哪里用、信什么、留什么"这三个决策的可信边界。

Method: 构建框架区分总体不可识别性与有限样本不稳定性；将语义定向与统计控制、随机控制对比；检验校准化接纳机制与容错DAG保留策略；在基准网络上开展实验（含80项计划的参考充分性任务）。

Result: 语义信息相比抛硬币式定向提升了结构恢复；但针对不稳定边的定向分配相对匹配随机分配无确立优势；所测试的接纳证书在现有校准任务下无法支持非平凡接纳；学习到的参考仅3/80项任务包含真实DAG。

Conclusion: 语义信息的价值与其分配、接纳、保留环节的可靠性需分开看待；校准规模与参考充分性是关键瓶颈，需更强的校准任务与参考生成方法来支撑可信的LLM辅助因果发现。

Abstract: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. Large language mod- els (LLMs) can provide semantic information to resolve these directions, but incorrect proposals can exclude the true causal graph and invalidate downstream inference. We study three separate decisions: where to allocate semantic queries, which proposals to admit, and which causal graphs to retain. Our framework distinguishes population non-identifiability from finite-sample insta- bility, evaluates semantic orientation against statistical and random controls, and examines calibrated admis- sion and error-tolerant DAG retention. Experiments across benchmark networks show that semantic infor- mation improves recovery over coin-flip orientations, but targeting unstable edges has no established ad- vantage over matched-random allocation. The tested admission certificate cannot support nontrivial admis- sion with the available calibration tasks. Moreover, downstream retention depends on reference adequacy: learned references contain the true DAG in only three of 80 planned tasks. These findings separate the value of semantic information from the reliability of its alloca- tion, admission, and retention, and identify calibration size and reference adequacy as key limitations.

</details>


### [302] [SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14765)
*Jiani Zhang,Manav Garg,Eugenie Lai,Cheng Zhen,Eva Sharma,Yang Pan,Yaming Lin,Alon Halevy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SynthCorp 是一个通过模拟业务事件随时间产生和修改企业数据，来可定制生成数据资产与基准测试的平台，用于评估 LLM 数据智能体的特定能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 数据智能体基准快速饱和，且无法针对特定能力进行评测。需要可定制、可控复杂度、难度更高的企业级数据基准。

Method: 四步流程：(1) 给定场景与目标复杂度维度，合成可复用事件类型并编译为基于预定义模拟原语的程序；(2) 在虚拟日历上调度事件实例，交织常规与扰动事件，保持表、文档与目录条目一致；(3) 执行日历以物化数据资产，并将所有操作记录到模拟日志；(4) 从日志生成分析任务并推导经校验的 gold program。每个数据资产包含关系数据库、文档存储和数据目录。

Result: 生成初始基准，含 7 个数据资产（最多 1K 业务表）与 5 个领域共 256 个任务。数据资产通过确定性流水线检查（外键违规、未声明写入、周期性违规、数据库执行失败），错误率接近零，引入跨资产复杂性并覆盖所有请求维度。三个模型在四种数据上下文设置下的评测表明基准能区分数据上下文与模型层级；基于模拟日志因果溯源的查询审计可在无需人工标注下验证 gold program，并在多事件复合任务上暴露 SOTA 智能体的推理失败。

Conclusion: SynthCorp 能按需生成更具挑战性和实用性的企业数据资产与基准，作者期望社区借此推动企业数据智能体的发展。

Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

</details>


### [303] [Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14766)
*Xiulin Yang,Sirisha Gudavalli,Jennifer Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用禁止明示沟通、仅靠时间流逝传递信号的合作纸牌游戏 The Mind，测试 150 名人类与两类 AI（computer-use agents 与文本提示 LLM），发现人类行为最符合"从对方计时推断其信念"的贝叶斯策略，前沿模型也类似，但模型无法在游戏中有效适应伙伴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会互动发生于时间之中，人类能用停顿时长等隐含时间线索推断他人心理状态，但动态、细粒度的社会协调中时间线索如何被使用尚不清楚；同时，AI 缺乏"实时"体验，能否做到同样的事值得探究。

Method: 采用 The Mind 合作纸牌游戏：玩家需在多次交互中达成共同目标但禁止明示沟通，唯一信号是时间流逝。评估 150 名人类，以及两类在人工系统中以不同方式操作化时间的 AI 模型——computer-use agents（CUA）与标准文本提示 LLM，并用贝叶斯策略模型对人类行为建模比较。

Result: 人类行为最好由"根据伙伴计时推断其信念"的贝叶斯策略解释，前沿模型表现类似；但与人类不同，所有被测模型都未能随游戏进程有效适应伙伴的行为。

Conclusion: 认知层面，人类在动态社会情境中对连续时间信号进行隐式概率推理，且该机制可能无需实时经验即可涌现；实践层面，研究揭示 AI 在动态环境中学习解读并适应他人隐含信号、实现高效协调的新挑战。

Abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.

</details>


### [304] [Leaderboard Hacking: Preference-Based Model Evaluations are Vulnerable to Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14769)
*Eve Fleisig,Joachim Baumann,Dylan Hadfield-Menell,Dirk Hovy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 竞技场式LLM排行榜基于Bradley-Terry模型聚合两两匿名比较投票，本文揭示其易受策略性投票、策略性提示与策略性提名三种操纵攻击，每种可将模型排名提升约15-20位，组合可达45位，并提出相应防护思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线排行榜与研究论文广泛使用arena式成对比较+Bradley-Terry聚合来评估语言模型，其排名被视为现实性能的反映。作者关注这类开放投票/提示/模型提交框架是否可被不诚信的提供方操纵以虚抬排名。

Method: 在公开排行榜数据上实证演示三类攻击：策略性投票（含对无关模型投票以利于目标模型）、策略性提示（选择有利于目标模型的prompt）、策略性提名（插入无关模型以抬升目标模型排名）；分析脆弱性成因，并针对每种攻击提出防护方法。

Result: 三类操纵几乎对每个被测模型都能提升排名：单一攻击最高提升约15-20名，三者组合最高可提升约45名。该脆弱性普遍存在于任何允许开放提示、投票或模型提交的Bradley-Terry偏好评估中。

Conclusion: arena式排名并非稳健的性能度量，开放参与机制引入可被利用的系统性漏洞；需针对投票、提示与提名分别设计防护措施，相关结论适用于所有基于Bradley-Terry的开放式偏好评估框架。

Abstract: Arena-style rankings of language models are a widely used evaluation framework in online leaderboards, research papers, and model evaluation in production. These rankings aim to realistically assess model performance using pairwise comparisons of anonymous models on user prompts, aggregating votes via the Bradley-Terry model to produce the final ranking. However, we find that these leaderboards are highly vulnerable to several manipulation strategies that unscrupulous providers could use to boost a model's rank: strategic voting (individual votes that boost a model's rank, including votes on irrelevant models), strategic prompting (choosing prompts that favor a model), and strategic nomination (boosting the rank of a model by inserting irrelevant models). We demonstrate these effects on public leaderboard data, analyze the circumstances that cause these vulnerabilities, and describe approaches to safeguard against each attack. Notably, these issues hold for any preference-based evaluation using the Bradley-Terry model that allows open prompting, voting, or model submission. These manipulations boost the rank of nearly every tested model; each attack can boost a model by up to 15-20 places in a ranking and, combined, they can boost a model by up to 45 places.

</details>


### [305] [LoRA Fine-Tuned Models for Control Systems Course Q\&A: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Model Scale and Rank Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13918)
*Shaowen Lu,Chengxu Liu,Ping Zhou,Tao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文用360条线性控制系统课程的对话数据对Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct做LoRA微调，发现微调可提升答案相似度与结构化输出稳定性，7B-r16表现最佳，r=8在性能与参数效率间更均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型在控制理论等专业课程中回答时术语、符号、推导与分步讲解不统一，结构松散、难以核验，需要让开源指令模型更贴合课程参考答案的语言与教学组织方式。

Method: 基于线性控制系统课程的习题与参考答案构建360条system-user-assistant监督微调对话；对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct施加LoRA，测试r=4/8/16；在相同数据划分与推理设置下对比基线与微调模型，用ROUGE、BERTScore及结构化输出特征评估相似度与Solution-Method-Teaching Points格式稳定性，并用Bootstrap重采样检验增益显著性。

Result: LoRA在两个模型规模上均提升相似度与结构化输出稳定性；测试集上7B-r16取得最高ROUGE-L 0.4093与BERTScore-F1 0.8643，r=8在性能与参数效率间更平衡；Bootstrap显示ROUGE-L增益3B-r16为0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915]、7B-r16为0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042]，置信区间均不含零。

Conclusion: LoRA可使开源指令模型更贴近课程参考答案的语言与教学结构；但指标主要反映文本相似度与格式一致性，不能衡量领域推理与数学正确性，仍需专家评估与任务专用评分标准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in specialized university courses, but control-systems questions require coordinated terminology, notation, derivations, and stepwise explanations. Direct general-purpose responses may be inconsistently structured and hard to verify. Using exercises and reference solutions from a Linear Control Systems course, we built a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 360 system-user-assistant conversations. We applied LoRA to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. With identical data splits, inference settings, and evaluation protocols, we compared base and fine-tuned models and tested LoRA ranks r=4, 8, and 16. Evaluation used ROUGE, BERTScore, and structured-output features to measure reference-answer similarity and stability of the Solution-Method-Teaching Points format. LoRA improved both similarity and structured-output stability at both sizes. On the current test set, 7B-r16 achieved the highest ROUGE-L (0.4093) and BERTScore-F1 (0.8643), while r=8 offered a better balance between performance and parameter efficiency. Bootstrap resampling showed ROUGE-L gains of 0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915] for 3B-r16 and 0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042] for 7B-r16; both intervals exceeded zero, indicating stable textual-similarity improvements on the current test set. These results suggest LoRA can align open-source instruction-tuned models more closely with the language and pedagogical organization of course reference answers. However, the metrics mainly capture textual similarity and formatting consistency, not domain-specific reasoning or mathematical correctness, which require expert assessment and task-specific rubrics.

</details>


### [306] [Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14781)
*Guy Azran,Sarah Keren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MBS_θ（置信最小信念集）：不一味把VLM预测确定化为单一状态，也不维护完整概率分布，而是取累积概率达阈值的最小状态子集，并用三层次信念系统与PRaVaSS算法高效构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用预训练感知模型（如VLM）做状态估计时预测存在不确定性。多数方法把预测确定化为单一"最佳猜测"并当作真值决策，猜测错误时决策可能不安全或不可行；而维护完整符号状态概率分布又往往不可计算。因此需要一种折中方案。

Method: 利用感知模型已有的概率输出（如VLM输出层token分布）构建θ-置信最小信念集MBS_θ，即累积概率满足用户指定信念质量阈值的最小状态子集。采用新颖的三层信念系统，从逐特征预测与任务级约束高效近似各状态概率，同时只保留精简的因子化信念表示。提出Probability-Ranked Valid State Search（PRaVaSS）算法，利用该信念系统结构构造MBS_θ，具有正确性保证，并在无约束情形下具备多项式复杂度。

Result: 以VLM为状态估计骨干进行验证，结果证实了方法的理论性质、随问题规模的可扩展性，以及在任务规划流水线中下游决策性能的提升。

Conclusion: 在确定化与完整分布之间取"中道"是可行且有效的：最小信念集既保持计算可处理性，又通过只考虑最可能状态增强下游决策鲁棒性；PRaVaSS在保证正确性的同时具多项式复杂度并实证有效。

Abstract: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $θ$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_θ$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. The minimality of an MBS$_θ$ ensures that the agent considers only the most likely states, enhancing robustness in downstream decision-making while maintaining computational tractability. Using a novel three-layered belief system, we efficiently approximate individual state probabilities from per-feature predictions and task-level constraints. On this belief construction, we base our MBS$_θ$ construction, while maintaining only a lean factored representation of the belief. Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_θ$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case. Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.

</details>


### [307] [When Is Proof-Step Verification Worth Its Cost? Operating Requirements of Certify-or-Decline Verification for Open-Weight Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14794)
*Abhinav Gupta,Ben Slivinski,Yashica Patodia,Michael Saldivar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"证明步骤验证"管线（将答案改写为带类型步骤并用LLM评判），在GPQA/AIME-2025/MATH-500上审计其认证效果：认证显著提升精确率但覆盖率有限，且存在大量构造失败的执行故障，需分项报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM求解器答案验证依赖答案匹配或自一致性，缺少对"证明有效性"的独立审计；作者希望厘清证明步骤验证究竟带来多少精确率收益、以多大覆盖率为代价，并识别其在执行环节的失败模式与评估局限。

Method: 构建proof-step verification管线：将模型答案改写为带类型证明步骤，再由LLM评判器certify或decline。在开源权重模型上跨GPQA、AIME-2025与MATH-500子集评估。对比output-token-matched self-consistency选择器，并进行诊断抽样；用外部LLM对渲染后的认证链做接受度评估；计算审计器间chance-corrected agreement。

Result: 认证在GPQA强配置上提升答案匹配精确率31个百分点、AIME提升46个百分点，但仅回答35%和21%的尝试；MATH-500接近饱和时收益≤5点却损失13–27点覆盖率。token匹配的自一致性选择器为82.9%精确率@35%覆盖，验证器池化为87.6%（差+4.8点，95%区间[-8.2,18.5]，不显著）。诊断样本中88个完成题里52个因无效证明构造而未到达评判器。外部LLM对认证链接受度61.0–67.6%，远低于87.6%的答案匹配率。

Conclusion: 证明步骤验证的精确率提升伴随严重覆盖率代价，且存在突出的执行失败；LLM接受度与答案匹配不一致，审计缺乏人类或形式化内核真值，跨审计器一致性近零。建议分别报告执行失败、所选答案精确率与独立评估的证明有效性，而非单一认证指标。

Abstract: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. Certification raises answer-key-match precision by 31 percentage points on the strong GPQA configuration and 46 on AIME, while answering only 35% and 21% of attempts. On near-ceiling MATH-500, gains are at most 5 points at a loss of 13-27 points of coverage. An output-token-matched self-consistency selector obtains 82.9% precision at 35% coverage, compared with the verifier's pooled 87.6% (paired difference: +4.8 points, 95% interval [-8.2, 18.5]). A diagnostic sample reveals a distinct failure mode: 52 of 88 completed problems end in invalid proof construction without ever reaching a judge. Finally, external-LLM acceptance of rendered certified chains is 61.0-67.6%, compared with 87.6% answer-key match. These audits lack human or formal-kernel ground truth. Open-weight auditor pairs show near-zero chance-corrected agreement, which measures consistency rather than accuracy against proof truth. These results motivate separate reporting of execution failures, selected-answer precision, and independently assessed proof validity. We provide per-configuration results and evaluation details in the supplement.

</details>


### [308] [GenPFN: An In-Context Tabular Foundation Model Approach for Augmenting Small Datasets in Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14804)
*Noah J. Bagazinski,Cyril Picard,Faez Ahmed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GenPFN：以固定权重的TabPFN分类器梯度为引导、无需训练的设计候选生成器，通过"生成—评估—增广"流程缓解工程设计数据稀缺问题，在14个问题上优于对抗、VAE、扩散等生成器及SMOTE，并将回归验证MSE降低62.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计依赖昂贵的仿真与实验，可用数据稀缺，限制了数据驱动的设计优化与代理模型训练；需要在极少样本条件下生成高可行性、符合约束的设计候选。

Method: GenPFN使用固定权重的预训练表格Prior-Data Fitted Network（TabPFN）分类器作为引导信号。上下文包含已评估设计，标注为期望（Class 1）或不期望（Class 0）。方法在期望设计之间插值，并用门控分类器梯度与高斯噪声精炼候选；每个候选按问题的约束与目标函数评估，被接受的期望设计及其目标值加入上下文用于回归训练。

Result: 在14个问题（含两参数基准与44参数船体问题）上：配对比较中GenPFN（TabPFN v1）的类别满足率更高、真实性距离更低，优于对抗、VAE与扩散生成器；VAE在覆盖度与多样性上更优；相比SMOTE，GenPFN覆盖距离更低、多样性更高。观测到的配对回归拟合中，增广使AutoGluon验证MSE相对仅用上下文训练下降62.1%；船尾案例中螺旋桨兼容候选占99.3%，而随机采样上下文仅为1.4%。

Conclusion: "生成+评估"可产出用于增广有限数据集的样本，并支持训练更准确的预测模型；GenPFN作为免训练、基于预训练表格先验的分类器引导生成方案，在可行性与真实性上具优势，但覆盖度与多样性不及VAE类方法。

Abstract: Costly simulations and experiments limit the data available for engineering design. This paper proposes GenPFN, a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier with fixed weights. The context contains evaluated designs labeled desired (Class 1) or undesired (Class 0). GenPFN interpolates between desired designs and refines candidates using gated classifier gradients and Gaussian noise. Each candidate is evaluated using the problem's constraints and objective functions. Evaluated desired designs and their objective values augment the context for regression training.
  Evaluation spans fourteen selected problems, including a two-parameter benchmark and a 44-parameter hull problem. In paired comparisons, GenPFN with TabPFN v1 achieves higher class satisfaction and lower realism distance than the tested adversarial, variational-autoencoder and diffusion generators. The variational-autoencoder generator provides greater coverage and diversity. Relative to the synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE), GenPFN provides lower coverage distance and greater diversity. Among observed paired regression fits, augmentation reduces estimated AutoGluon validation mean squared error by 62.1% relative to context-only training. A hull-stern case study yields 99.3% propeller-compatible candidates versus 1.4% among randomly sampled context designs. Generation followed by evaluation produces sample sets that augment limited datasets and support training more accurate predictive models.

</details>


### [309] [AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14844)
*Igor Sadalski,Minghao Guo,Benjamin Jones,Wojciech Matusik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出将算法写成 Lean 中的证明图以显式化其假设，并用 AutoAssumption 工具放松单个假设、重新推导证明并生成代码，从而把算法设计转化为可搜索的结构化空间。在 89 个 KV-cache 驱逐、权重剪枝和投机解码算法上验证，搜索在驱逐与剪枝任务中超过所有已发表的被运行算法并达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML 系统的许多进步源于打破此前方法默认的假设（如投机解码放弃"每个 token 一次前向"）。但算法很少显式陈述假设，专家和自动化搜索在程序空间上搜索时，一次修改会牵动多个设计选择、收益难以归因，直接对假设本身做搜索仍基本未被探索。

Method: 将算法写为证明可使假设显式化，把算法设计变成小型结构化、LLM 可探索且证明检查器可审计的搜索空间。作者把来自 KV-cache 驱逐、权重剪枝和投机解码的 89 个算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图并在 Lean 中检查。工具 AutoAssumption 放松已发表方法的某一个假设，重新推导并重证，再生成对应代码。

Result: 在 KV-cache 驱逐与权重剪枝中，该搜索改进了所运行的每一个已发表算法并产生 SOTA 算法：驱逐算法在已运行方法中 RULER-4K 分数最高；剪枝算法在四个 LLaMA 模型上取得十三种方法中最低的困惑度。同等预算下，该工具与 AlphaEvolve 的开源实现 OpenEvolve 得分相差不到一分，且多次重复的标准差更低。

Conclusion: 以证明形式显式化假设、对假设做结构化搜索是可行且有效的算法发现范式。未来工作将形式化更多领域，并通过它们共享的主假设把它们组合起来。

Abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.

</details>


### [310] [Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14846)
*Reuth Mirsky,Sarath Sreedharan,Nitay Alon,Stefan Sarkadi,Munindar P. Singh,Liz Sonenberg,Peter Stone,Silvia Tulli,Stylianos Loukas Vasileiou,Shlomo Zilberstein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场/综述性论文，梳理AAMAS社区在人与智能体交互方面的理论基石，主张将人机交互视为一个持续演化、充满不确定性与相互依赖的决策问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI系统正承担长周期任务并代表人类行事，人机交互成为其有效性的核心；需要理解人类视角、协调互补能力、维系社会技术环境中的关系。

Method: 围绕"理解他人"与"决定如何交互"两大相互关联的挑战，组织计算方法的综述与整合。

Result: 归纳出心智理论、BDI架构、目标与计划识别、逆规划、递归推理等用于部分可观测心智状态的表征与推断机制；以及观察者感知规划、模型调和、决策论沟通将其连接至行动、解释与信息交换；并结合共享自主、论辩、合作逆强化学习。
