TL;DR: 提出 AgentSSL 框架，将半监督学习（SSL）重构为程序搜索问题，考察 LLM 智能体在弱监督、少标签条件下自动合成 SSL 流水线的能力，并揭示"程序选择"是关键瓶颈，由此构建 ProgramSelectBench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将机器学习迁移到新领域时面临两大瓶颈：标注数据获取困难与人工流水线工程成本高。已有 MLE 智能体研究几乎都局限于全监督设定，未验证在"标签稀缺、无标签数据丰富"的真实场景（SSL 场景）下的表现。

Method: 1) 定义 Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning（AgentSSL），把 SSL 问题形式化为程序搜索问题；2) 在弱反馈、计算量对齐的条件下让智能体自主生成代码，组合并改造现有 SSL 技术；3) 分析程序选择环节，构建 ProgramSelectBench 基准（含 16,977 个智能体生成与人工设计的 SSL 程序），并评测无监督与主动式程序选择方法；4) 在真实生态检测任务上做迁移验证。

Result: 在 12 个设定中的 8 个上，智能体合成的方案超越最强人工基线，最高提升 +21.8%；但程序选择成为关键瓶颈——仅依据智能体自身反馈指标做选择时性能最多下降 47%；ProgramSelectBench 为系统研究该问题提供大规模评测基础；真实生态检测任务显示了迁移的机会与挑战。

Conclusion: 智能体可在弱反馈下有效复用并适配既有 SSL 技术，但"选对程序"比"生成程序"更难，程序选择是 AgentSSL 的核心瓶颈；未来需发展更可靠的无监督/主动式程序选择方法，并推动智能体发现策略向真实领域迁移。

Abstract: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [412] [Augmented Hybrid TV Services. Habits, Preferences, Opinions and Expectations of Spanish Consumers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17284)
*Fernando Boronat,Bernat Roig,Enric Sigalat,Santiago J. Flores*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出"增强混合电视"(Augmented Hybrid TV)概念，基于利益相关方咨询与3次联合设计工作坊选出5个代表性用例，并通过西班牙626名用户的CAWI问卷调查其感知有用性与接受度，结果显示5个用例兴趣度达64.7%–76.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广播与宽带混合传输、伴随设备及沉浸式技术的融合，使交互化、个性化、无障碍电视服务成为可能，但缺乏以用户为中心的需求与接受度证据来指导此类服务的优先级排序与设计。

Method: 通过探索性利益相关方咨询及与视听专业人员、视/听障支持机构参与的3次联合设计工作坊，确定5个代表性用例（传统电视+发送至联网设备含AR/VR头显的补充内容）；随后对西班牙626名互联网与联网电视用户开展横断面CAWI调查，每位受访者观看随机分配的2个用例标准化视频演示，评估其感知有用性、预期收益/局限与兴趣度。

Result: 5个用例均获较高兴趣（64.7%–76.9%）；自适应与个性化增强字幕兴趣最高，因其无障碍、语言学习与个性化价值尤受重视；涉及补充AR内容、虚拟屏幕、3D物体与360视频的沉浸式服务评价亦积极，但受访者提出设备成本、人体工学、连接性、可用性与同步等预期局限。

Conclusion: 研究提供了以用户为中心的证据，可支持符合标准的增强混合电视服务的优先级排序、设计与后续基于原型的评估；但由于评估的是视频情景而非可运行系统，结果反映的是感知有用性与陈述性兴趣，而非实际采纳或经技术验证的QoE。

Abstract: The convergence of hybrid broadcast and broadband delivery, companion devices, and immersive technologies enables new forms of interactive, personalized, and accessible TV services. This paper introduces the concept of Augmented Hybrid TV services and presents an exploratory user requirements and preliminary acceptance assessment for 5 representative use cases. They were selected through an exploratory stakeholder consultation and 3 co-design workshops with audiovisual professionals and participants from organizations supporting people with visual or hearing impairments. They combine conventional TV with complementary content delivered to connected devices, including AR/VR HMD. They were subsequently evaluated through a cross-sectional CAWI survey of 626 Internet and connected TV users in Spain. Each participant viewed standardized video demonstrations of 2 randomly assigned cases and assessed their perceived usefulness, anticipated benefits/limitations, and interest in them. The results show substantial interest across all five use cases, ranging from 64.7% to 76.9%. Adaptive and personalized augmented subtitles received the highest level of interest and were particularly valued for their accessibility, language-learning, and personalization benefits. Immersive services involving complementary AR content, virtual screens, 3D objects, and 360 video were also evaluated positively, although participants identified device cost, ergonomics, connectivity, usability, and synchronization as anticipated limitations. The findings provide user-centered evidence that can inform the prioritization, design, and subsequent prototype-based evaluation of standards-compliant Augmented Hybrid TV services. Because the study assessed video-based scenarios rather than functional systems, the results represent perceived usefulness and stated interest rather than observed adoption or technically validated QoE.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [413] [Galop: Billion-Scale Genetic Programming on a Single GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14665)
*Xavier Hill Roy,Stephen Kelly*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: Galop 是一个 CPU-GPU 混合线性遗传编程系统，采用"一个个体对应一个 CUDA warp"的设计，使 GP 评估更契合 GPU 执行模式；在 28 项主要对比中 27 项快于 EvoGP，最高加速 13.6 倍，并在单张 H100 上完成 21.5 亿个体的完整一代评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GP 演化的是异构程序种群，而 GPU 只有在成组线程执行相同指令时才能达到最高吞吐，二者存在错配；因此需要一种能让 GP 评估更好地对齐 GPU 执行方式的方案，以提升效率并支持超大规模种群研究。

Method: 提出 Galop——一种混合 CPU-GPU 线性 GP 系统，将一个个个体分配给一个 CUDA warp（32 个线程，同一组指令在不同 fitness case 上并行执行）。与近期高性能 GPU 树型 GP 系统 EvoGP 在数据丰富的符号回归任务上对比，测试两类 GPU，并变化种群规模与 fitness case 数量。

Result: 在 28 项主要对比中 27 项完成演化运行更快，最高加速 13.6 倍；解的质量整体上 EvoGP 占优，但 Galop 在若干问题上仍具竞争力。Galop 在单张 H100 上完成 21.5 亿个体的完整一代，约为其他被测 GP 系统最大种群规模的 4.0 倍；该规模下 5 次运行均完成 100 代，中位墙钟时间 2.23 小时。

Conclusion: Galop 使在单张 GPU 上研究数十亿规模的 GP 种群变得可行；代码、实验数据与可复现脚本已公开。

Abstract: Genetic programming (GP) evolves populations of heterogeneous programs, whereas GPUs achieve their highest throughput when groups of threads execute the same instructions. To better align GP evaluation with GPU execution, we present Galop, a hybrid CPU-GPU linear GP system that assigns one individual to each CUDA warp, a group of 32 threads that execute the same instructions across different fitness cases. We compare Galop against EvoGP, a recent high-performance GPU-based tree GP system, on data-rich symbolic regression across two unique GPUs, varying population size and fitness-case count. Galop completes evolutionary runs faster than EvoGP in 27 of the 28 main comparisons, with speedups of up to 13.6 times. Solution quality comparisons favour EvoGP overall, although Galop remains competitive on several problems. Galop also completes a full generation with 2.15 billion individuals on a single H100 GPU, approximately 4.0 times the largest population achieved by any other tested GP system. All five runs at this population complete 100 generations, with a median wall-clock time of 2.23 hours. These results make it practical to study GP populations in the billions on a single GPU. Galop's source code, experimental data, and reproducibility scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/xavierhillroy/Galop.

</details>


### [414] [DeNA-SGN: Deterministic Neighborhood Aggregation for Verified Spiking Graph Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14775)
*Sanjay Das,Xi Zhang,Emily Herron,Prasanna Date*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出 DeNA-SGN，用固定 OR 与含平局的 Majority 聚合二元节点特征，配合可学习符号权重阈值分类器，并通过共享控制神经元实现度相关抑制，完整编译到 SuperNeuroMAT。7 个数据集 41 个映射分类器上原生仿真与导出 ANN 判决完全一致；Amazon Photo 电流读出 83.93±0.93%、严格脉冲 71.61±2.22%，Wiki-CS 75.99±0.54%，Cora 74.90±2.67%/68.57±2.94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经形态基底上的图学习需要邻域聚合的显式脉冲实现，以同时支持控制与分类，此前缺乏可编译、可复现且判决一致的方案。

Method: DeNA-SGN：二元节点特征上的固定 OR 与含平局 Major 聚合；用度相关的抑制构造通过共享控制神经元实现 Majority；采用学习的符号权重阈值分类器；完整电路编译到 SuperNeuroMAT。

Result: 7 数据集 41 个映射分类器上原生仿真与导出 ANN 在每个类别判决与输出脉冲模式上一致；Amazon Photo 电流读出 83.93±0.93%、严格脉冲 71.61±2.22%；Wiki-CS 在 20 个公开掩码上 75.99±0.54%；匹配 Cora 研究 74.90±2.67% 与 68.57±2.94%。电路与活动核算支持解析能量比较，并指出大规模部署中激活非活动神经元的时钟开销。

Conclusion: 确立了判决匹配的脉冲执行与显式实现成本的可复现图分类路线；局限是 argmax 在主机端解码、能量为建模而非硬件实测。

Abstract: Graph learning on neuromorphic substrates requires an explicit spiking realization of neighborhood aggregation, supporting control and classification. We propose DeNA-SGN, which combines fixed OR and tie-inclusive Majority aggregation of binary node features with a learned signed-weight threshold classifier. A degree-dependent inhibitory construction implements Majority through shared control neurons, enabling a complete circuit compilation into SuperNeuroMAT. Across seven datasets and 41 mapped classifiers, native simulation matches the exported ANN on every evaluated class decision and output-spike pattern. On the new confirmatory Amazon Photo dataset, DeNA-SGN achieves 83.93+-0.93% current-readout accuracy and 71.61+-2.22% strict output-spike accuracy; Wiki-CS reaches 75.99+-0.54% over 20 public masks. In the matched Cora study, we achieve 74.90+-2.67% on current-readout and 68.57+-2.94% strict spike accuracy. Complete circuit and activity accounting supports analytical energy comparisons and identifies the cost of clocking inactive neurons in large deployments. Current argmax is decoded on the host, and energy is modeled rather than measured on hardware. These findings establish a reproducible route to useful graph classification with decision-matched spiking execution and explicit implementation costs.

</details>


### [415] [A Multi-Parent Edge Assembly Crossover Driven Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for the Hamiltonian \textit{p}-Median Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15219)
*Junkai Huang,Pengfei He,Jin-Kao Hao,Xin Yao*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种多父代边组装交叉的混合遗传算法求解哈密顿p-中位问题，在215个基准实例中刷新34个最优解、持平168个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哈密顿p-中位问题需将图顶点划分为恰好p个不相交环并最小化总代价，属困难组合优化问题，现有方法解质量仍有提升空间。

Method: 设计混合遗传算法，核心是单次重组中融合一个基解与多个供体解的多父代边组装交叉算子；利用基解的虚拟副本建立边平衡，并结合辅助有向图与预算受限搜索构造有效AB-环。

Result: 在四组共215个基准实例上，算法改进34个最好已知解，另168个持平；额外实验表明适度父代数带来有益多样性，父代过多（尤其p较大时）会导致种群过度分散、阻碍收敛。

Conclusion: 多父代交叉扩展了可用边交换空间，配合平衡与预算搜索可高效生成合法子代；父代数量需适度控制以平衡多样性与收敛性。

Abstract: The Hamiltonian \textit{p}-median problem seeks to partition the vertices of a graph into exactly $p$ disjoint cycles while minimizing their total cost. This paper presents a hybrid genetic algorithm incorporating a multi-parent edge assembly crossover operator. The crossover combines a base solution with multiple donor solutions in a single recombination operation, thereby expanding the space of available edge exchanges. It uses virtual copies of the base solution to establish edge balance, together with an auxiliary directed graph and a budgeted search to construct valid AB-cycles. Extensive experiments on 215 benchmark instances across four sets show that the proposed algorithm improves the best-known solution values for 34 instances and matches those for another 168. Additional experiments indicate that a moderate number of parents provides beneficial diversity, whereas excessive parent counts, particularly when $p$ is large, lead to excessive population dispersion and hinder convergence.

</details>


### [416] [Matrix-Based Ant Colony Search with Batched Decoding for Hierarchical Replenishment Routing: A Stylized Case Study Based on Korean City Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15338)
*Jun Zhang,Wei-Jie Yu,Tong Qian,Eui Jeong Kwak,Sang-Woon Jeon,Hua Ding,Qijia Jiang,Hu Jin,Haewoon Nam,Changjun Zhou*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 论文研究单车辆"补货—路径"联合优化问题：城市既是需求点又是供给点，载重不足时须绕行已服务城市补货；用矩阵式蚁群算法MACO配合批量局部搜索在100节点韩国基准上求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国家物流网络中城市同时承担需求与供给角色，车辆中途需返回已访问城市补货，形成带容量约束的复杂路径规划问题，需考察算法与参数的影响。

Method: 构建100节点韩国人口与地理基准，城市分10级，供给系数与允许停靠次数随级别几何递减；在矩阵式蚁群优化基础上，用数组存储全蚁群状态，将路径构建与固定的贪心补货解码策略耦合，并批量评估局部搜索候选移动。

Result: 固定参数、30次运行未参与调参的种子：MACO平均总距离3081.7 km，同局部搜索GA为3074.9 km（无显著差异），MMAS为3142.2 km；消融显示批量局部搜索是解质量主要来源，负载感知转移因子无显著增益；提高非顶级城市供给系数比放宽停靠上限更能缩短路径，停靠限制并不活跃。

Conclusion: 矩阵式蚁群+批量局部搜索在该补货路径问题上表现良好但未超越同配置GA；补货供给能力比停靠次数约束更关键，参数调整应优先关注中低级别城市的供给系数。

Abstract: We study a stylized single-vehicle replenishment-routing problem in which the cities of a national logistics network are both demand points and supply points: a vehicle of limited capacity delivers to every city once, and when its load is insufficient for the next city it must detour to a city already served that can still supply goods. A 100-node benchmark is built from Korean population and geographic data, with the cities divided into 10 levels; the per-visit supply coefficient and the allowed number of stops decrease geometrically with the level. Building on matrix-based ant colony optimization, we keep the states of the whole colony in arrays, couple route construction with a fixed greedy replenishment-decoding policy, and evaluate the candidate moves of a local search in batches. With frozen parameters and 30 runs on seeds never used for tuning, the matrix-based ant colony search with the batch local search (MACO) reaches a mean total distance of 3081.7 km; a genetic algorithm equipped with the same local search at the same frequency reaches 3074.9 km (no significant difference), and a MAX-MIN ant system with the same local search 3142.2 km. Ablation identifies the batch local search as the main contributor to solution quality; a load-aware transition factor gives no significant gain. Within the parameter ranges tested, raising the supply coefficients of the cities below the top level shortens the route more than relaxing the stop limits, which are not binding here.

</details>


### [417] [Contour-Assisted Evolutionary Computation: Estimating Peaks From the Contour Lines of Evaluated Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15641)
*Jun Zhang,Tong Qian,Hua Ding,Zhi-Hui Zhan,Wei-Jie Yu,Jian-Yu Li*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 将EA评估过的解视为地形勘测的散点高度并绘制等高线图，用等高线（2维等高线树+持久性、高维爬山+射线投射水平集）识别并记忆峰值，按面积律将等高线外推到零尺寸来预估峰的位置、高度与形状；据此构造CA-EA与CA-SAEA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EA评估大量候选解却只用于排序，浪费了这些采样点携带的全局地形信息；作者希望把评估点当作地形勘测数据，从中挖掘峰结构来指导搜索。

Method: 将评估解插值成地形并提取等高线，2维用持久性等高线树区分显著峰与插值波纹，高维用插值面爬山定位峰、射线投射水平集刻画峰；建立峰记忆引导搜索到新峰；用对二次峰精确、对光滑峰二阶精确的面积律外推等高线到零尺寸以预测峰位置/高度/形状；CA-EA把等高线步骤、局部搜索与峰记忆嵌入GA/DE/PSO；CA-SAEA对昂贵问题把每次评估用于代理筛选后的后代或围绕插值面极大值所在峰的采样。

Result: 2维基准上CA-EA把普通GA所需评估次数减少12–112倍，对照实验显示其相对经典memetic搜索的增益来自在不同峰上重启局部搜索；CEC2015昂贵问题集（10/30维）上CA-SAEA平均排名第二，仅次于DYCORS，优于lq-CMA-ES与竞赛冠军MVMO，但30维时MVMO在9个函数显著胜、6个负；峰图法在15个函数中5胜3负于最优点周围采样；按外推位置进入峰在当前预算下无增益，样本充足时能改善多数2维函数的峰高估计。

Conclusion: 把EA的评估解当作地形勘测并显式建模峰结构是一种有效的搜索增强手段，在小维与昂贵优化中均有竞争力；但外推进入峰、高维峰刻画等环节的实际收益有限且不稳定，需要更多样本或更强方法。

Abstract: Evolutionary algorithms (EAs) evaluate many candidate solutions but use them mainly to rank individuals. This paper treats the evaluated solutions as the spot heights of a topographic survey and draws the contour lines they imply. The contour map decomposes the evaluated region into peaks: in two dimensions a contour tree with persistence separates significant peaks from interpolation ripples, and in more dimensions hill climbing on the interpolated surface locates the peaks and ray-cast level sets describe them. A memory of the explored peaks directs the search to new ones. The data-supported contours of each peak are extrapolated to zero size by an area law, exact for quadratic peaks and second-order accurate for smooth ones, that estimates a peak's location, height and shape before it is sampled. A contour-assisted EA (CA-EA) inserts contour steps with local search and peak memory into a genetic algorithm (GA), differential evolution or particle swarm optimization. A contour-assisted surrogate-assisted EA (CA-SAEA), for expensive problems, spends each evaluation on surrogate-screened offspring or on sampling around a peak, entered at the maximum of the interpolated surface. On 2-D benchmarks, CA-EA reduces the evaluations a plain GA needs by factors of 12 to 112; controls attribute its gain over classical memetic search to restarting local search on distinct peaks. On the CEC 2015 expensive suite in 10 and 30 dimensions, CA-SAEA has the second-best average rank, behind DYCORS and ahead of lq-CMA-ES and the competition winner MVMO, although in 30 dimensions MVMO wins significantly on 9 functions and loses on 6; there the map beats sampling around the best point on 5 of 15 functions and loses on 3. Entering the peaks at their extrapolated locations brought no gain at these budgets, although, with enough samples, it improves the estimated heights on most two-dimensional functions.

</details>


### [418] [A Finite Markov Chain Analysis of the Simplified Swarm Optimisation Update Rule](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16541)
*Wei-Chang Yeh*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文对简化群体优化(SSO)进行严格理论分析，建立其有限马尔可夫链刻画、收敛速率、命中时间界，并在OneMax/LeadingOnes/Jump上给出期望代数界及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSO在实践中有效，但缺乏精确的收敛速率、命中时间与复杂度理论刻画，且惯性与重采样参数(c_r)的作用机制不清。

Method: 将冻结记忆下的SSO视为有限马尔可夫链，分析坐标核 c_w I+(1-c_w)Π 的平稳分布与收敛率；给出精英链的几何命中时间界与下界；用耦合论证分析变化记忆下OneMax/LeadingOnes的期望代数；并结合分支日志、检查点重放与基准实验。

Result: 坐标核收敛率恰为 c_w^t；非最优起点达到唯一最优需至少 exp(nc_r/2) 期望评估；OneMax与LeadingOnes在任意种群规模下分别有 O(n log n)、O(n^2) 期望代数(固定惯性时多 log n 因子)；实验显示惯性拖慢测试运行，SSO在Jump上比(1+1)EA少3.8–8.9倍评估，但对速率调整变异与(μ+1)GA无稳定优势；解析重采样规则改善8组中6组与冗余分配，但在Jump_2上慢于 c_r=0.1。

Conclusion: SSO的理论行为由重采样概率主导，惯性在冻结记忆下不能加速首次进入；理论界与实验共同刻画了其优势与局限，为参数选择提供依据。

Abstract: Simplified swarm optimisation (SSO) updates each variable by one draw that copies the global or personal best, keeps the current value or redraws uniformly, with probabilities $c_g$, $c_p$, $c_w$ and $c_r$. As a finite Markov chain under frozen memory, its coordinate kernel $c_w I + (1 - c_w)Π$ has an explicit stationary law and exact convergence rate $c_w^t$. The elitist chain has a geometric hitting-time bound, from a non-optimal start a fixed $c_r$ needs at least $\exp(nc_r/2)$ expected evaluations to reach a unique optimum, and a coupling under changing memories gives $O(n\log n)$ and $O(n^2)$ expected generations on OneMax and LeadingOnes for every population size with redraw share of order $1/n$ and no inertia, and within a $\log n$ factor for fixed inertia. With a frozen memory, inertia cannot speed up first entry into any set from stationary positions, though it can from others. Where the three reference values agree, only $c_r$ acts; where they disagree, copy branches recombine the memories, forcing a redraw only where no active branch holds the target value. Branch logging and checkpoint replay show inertia slowed the tested OneMax and LeadingOnes runs and suggest memory-mediated gains on wider gaps. On Jump functions SSO needed 3.8--8.9 times fewer evaluations than the (1+1) evolutionary algorithm with rate $1/n$, but no consistent advantage over rate-adjusted mutation or a $(μ+1)$ genetic algorithm with uniform crossover was established. The analytical redraw rule improved six of eight benchmark--setting pairs and redundancy allocation, but was slower than $c_r = 0.1$ on Jump$_2$.

</details>


### [419] [Similarity-Guided Optimization Strategies for Approximate Network Symmetry Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16555)
*David Hartman,Jaroslav Hlinka,Dominik Klepl,Anna Pidnebesna,Petra Vidnerová*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 论文研究节点相似性引导能否改善复杂网络中近似对称性（图自同构松弛）的检测，将多种元启发式算法与相似性引导结合，并提出基于双线性嵌入的BASIN方法，统一评测后发现在植入轨道的场景中引导起决定作用，但总体效果依赖具体情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典精确自同构对微小扰动高度敏感，Liu 提出的近似对称性将严格不变性放松为置换上的优化问题；作者希望利用节点级相似性（如网络中心性）作为可解释的先验，把搜索偏向结构上合理的顶点对应。

Method: 采用统一的相似性引导对模拟退火、遗传算法、禁忌搜索、粒子群优化、差分进化及二次对称近似器进行改造，并新增BASIN——通过双线性嵌入学习软分配矩阵；在四类合成图族、结构性脑连接组及三个已知自同构群的经验网络上，用统一流水线比较引导/非引导变体、BASIN与随机基线。

Result: 当存在未引导搜索漏掉的植入轨道时，节点相似性引导起决定性作用；其他情况下效果依算法而异。禁忌搜索整体最强，其引导变体SGTS在全部44个合成条件的引导变体中取得最低中位数得分；BASIN在重连横向图上优于其他连续松弛方法。

Conclusion: 节点相似性引导的作用是情形依赖的，而非一致正向；近似对称检测应结合具体网络结构与算法特性选择方法。

Abstract: Symmetry in complex networks is a structural property with broad implications for network function, dynamics, and robustness. While classical approaches rely on exact automorphisms and thus remain highly sensitive to small perturbations, recent work of Liu has introduced approximate formulations that relax the strict invariance condition and recast symmetry detection as an optimization problem over permutations. We investigate how node-level similarity information can be used to bias the search toward structurally plausible vertex correspondences, with network centralities serving as one interpretable instance. Building on this perspective, we adapt simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, tabu search, particle swarm optimization, differential evolution and the quadratic symmetry approximator to this problem, add similarity guidance to each, and introduce Bilinear Approximate Symmetry Inference (BASIN), which learns a soft assignment matrix via bilinear embeddings. Using a unified evaluation pipeline, we compare their guided and unguided variants, BASIN and a random baseline on four synthetic graph families, structural brain connectomes, and three empirical networks with known automorphism groups. Node-similarity guidance is decisive where a planted orbit exists that the unguided search misses, and algorithm-dependent elsewhere, on synthetic and empirical networks alike. Overall, tabu search achieves the strongest performance; its guided variant (SGTS) has the lowest median score among the guided variants in all 44 synthetic conditions, while BASIN is the better of the continuous relaxations on rewired lateral graphs. The effect of node-similarity guidance is therefore regime-dependent rather than uniformly positive.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [Measuring, Revealing and Mitigating Harmful Content Propagation in Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15160)
*Xiaokun Zhang,Youlin Wu,Junyu Lu,Jiamin Chen,Zhaochun Ren,Hongfei Lin,Fenglong Ma,Xue Liu,Chen Ma*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文系统研究推荐系统中的有害内容（暴力、仇恨言论、色情），从度量、揭示与缓解三方面展开，并提出MitiHarm框架在保持用户满意度的同时显著抑制有害内容传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐研究以迎合用户兴趣为主，忽视暴力、仇恨、色情等有害内容的存在与传播，而推荐系统日益决定用户接触的信息，因此需要系统性地度量并缓解有害内容扩散。

Method: 三步：（1）构建带有害性标注的数据集，并提出新的评价指标定量衡量推荐结果的有害性；（2）实证分析用户与推荐方法对有害内容的参与与扩散；（3）提出通用框架MitiHarm，将有害性相关信号融入物品与用户表示学习。

Result: 实证表明用户倾向与有害内容互动，主流推荐方法常助长此类内容扩散；MitiHarm在显著缓解有害内容传播的同时保持用户满意度。

Conclusion: 推荐系统需在优化用户兴趣之外显式考虑有害内容；所提数据集、指标与MitiHarm框架为度量与缓解有害内容传播提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recommender systems help users navigate vast amounts of information by filtering content according to their historical behaviors. As these systems increasingly shape everyday information access, they largely determine the content users are exposed to. However, current research typically prioritizes catering to user interest, while overlooking the existence and propagation of harmful content, such as violence, hate speech, and pornography. In this work, we take a systematic step toward investigating harmful content in recommender systems from three aspects: measuring, revealing, and mitigating. First, we construct datasets with harmfulness-related annotations and present new evaluation metrics to quantitatively measure the harmfulness of recommendation results. Second, our empirical analysis reveals that users tend to engage with harmful content and prevailing recommendation methods often contribute to the proliferation of such content. Third, to address this issue, we introduce a generic framework, MitiHarm, which integrates harmfulness-related signals into both item and user representation learning. Experiments show that MitiHarm can significantly mitigate the propagation of harmful content while preserving user satisfaction. Resources of this work are available at https://github.com/Zhang-xiaokun/MitiHarm.

</details>


### [421] [When Direction Matters: Diagnosing Relational Instruction Following in Dense Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15417)
*Zhanyu Wu,Richong Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文指出稠密检索器在"方向性关系"判断上存在系统性弱点：当相关性取决于同一实体间的方向性关系时，模型表现显著下降。作者提出 SwitchIR 诊断基准与边际分解分析，并给出可泛化的诊断性微调方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密检索器声称能依据自然语言中的相关性判据（而非仅短查询）进行检索，但已有评测往往允许词面或属性线索泄露答案。作者希望隔离出"仅靠方向性关系才能判定相关性"的场景，检验模型是否真正具备该能力。

Method: 提出 SwitchIR 受控诊断：将 Constraint Shift、Explicit Filtering 两类"线索可得"控制条件，与 Relational Flip（查询-文档对固定，仅反转所要求的关系方向）对照。在代表性 embedding 与 late-interaction 检索器上评测，并构造 LLM 辅助+人工复核的真实场景变体；进一步做精确的边际分解，量化方向敏感交互与方向无关配对偏好之间的竞争；最后用诊断性微调检验关系行为能否跨关系族泛化。

Result: 两个控制条件下主要联合指标很高，而 Relational Flip 上持续偏低，该排序在真实变体中同样成立。边际分解表明：只有当方向敏感的查询-文档交互超过方向无关的配对偏好时，两个方向才同时判对。经验上方向敏感变化常见，但其对齐交互通常过弱，无法压过配对偏好。诊断性微调可使模型学到跨关系族泛化的关系行为，且较大模型的泛化更好。

Conclusion: 稠密检索器"条件化于相关性判据"的能力被高估，其在方向性关系上存在结构性缺陷，根源是方向无关的配对偏好主导。该缺陷可通过针对性诊断微调缓解并泛化，但模型规模会影响泛化质量。

Abstract: Dense retrievers increasingly claim the ability to condition retrieval on natural-language relevance criteria beyond a short query. We identify a specific weakness in this capability: the evaluated models perform well when lexical or attribute cues distinguish the target, but become much less reliable when relevance depends on a directional relation over the same entities. We introduce SwitchIR, a controlled diagnostic that contrasts Constraint Shift and Explicit Filtering with Relational Flip, where the query and document pair remain fixed while the requested relation direction reverses. Across representative embedding and late-interaction retrievers, the primary joint metric is high on the two cue-available controls and consistently low on Relational Flip; the same ordering persists in an LLM-assisted, manually reviewed realistic variant. An exact margin decomposition shows that both directions are correct only when the direction-sensitive query--document interaction exceeds the direction-invariant pair preference. Empirically, direction-sensitive changes are common, but their aligned interaction is usually too weak to overcome that preference. Diagnostic fine-tuning shows that models can learn relational behavior that generalizes across relation families, with stronger generalization in the larger model.

</details>


### [422] [SurvEval: Listwise Re-Ranking Evaluator via Survival-Based Exposure and Multi-Objective Value Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15434)
*YaChen Yan,Liubo Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 SurvEval，一个联合建模用户曝光与物品价值的列表级重排序评估器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重排序评估器简化了用户浏览假设，并将多目标信号坍缩为单一标量，难以反映真实的列表级效用。

Method: 将顺序浏览过程形式化为离散时间生存模型，推导单调递减的到达概率以刻画浏览的级联结构；引入带独立目标预测头与不确定性损失加权的多目标价值估计模块，自适应平衡不同尺度与噪声水平的目标；两部分通过统一 transformer 骨干联合优化，列表级效用为各位置到达概率与条件物品价值估计乘积之和。

Result: 在 KuaiRand 与 Avito 数据集上，SurvEval 性能优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: 联合建模曝光与多目标价值可更真实地刻画列表级效用，验证了生存建模与不确定性加权多目标设计的有效性。

Abstract: Re-ranking is a crucial stage in recommender systems, yet existing evaluators oversimplify user browsing assumptions and collapse multi-objective signals into a single scalar, limiting their ability to reflect true listwise utility. We propose \textbf{SurvEval}, a listwise evaluator that jointly models user exposure and item value for re-ranking evaluation. We formalize the sequential browsing process as a discrete-time survival model, deriving monotonically decreasing reaching probabilities that capture the cascading structure of user browsing. We further introduce a multi-objective value estimation module with dedicated per-objective prediction heads and uncertainty-based loss weighting to adaptively balance objectives of varying scales and noise levels. Both components are jointly optimized via a unified transformer backbone, and the listwise utility is obtained by summing the position-wise products of reaching probabilities and conditional item value estimates. Extensive experiments on KuaiRand and Avito demonstrate that SurvEval achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [423] [ReAlign: Reward-Guided Preference Alignment for Generative Re-Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15445)
*YaChen Yan,Liubo Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ReAlign 是一个奖励引导的偏好对齐重排序框架，将 listwise 奖励模型与候选感知的自回归生成器耦合，通过两阶段训练（监督预训练+奖励引导后训练）实现排列搜索与效用优化的统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两阶段 generator-evaluator 方法将列表生成与评估解耦，生成器无法直接获取 listwise 效用信号；而基于打分的一阶段方法在固定的上游排列上下文中给物品打分，未显式搜索排列空间。

Method: 奖励模型将 listwise 奖励分解为逐位置贡献：用基于生存分析的曝光模块建模用户曝光，用各目标的独立头建模异构交互信号以刻画物品价值。生成器采用候选感知的自回归结构，分两阶段训练：先在日志曝光列表上监督预训练建立相关性先验，再进行奖励引导后训练，通过分布对齐与排序对齐（在池内标准化奖励上）使生成器与奖励模型对齐。

Result: 大量离线实验表明 ReAlign 一致优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: 将 listwise 奖励建模与候选感知自回归生成相结合，并以奖励引导的后训练对齐生成器，可有效优化 listwise 用户效用，优于解耦式与固定排列打分的现有方法。

Abstract: Re-ranking refines the upstream ranked list to maximize listwise user utility. Existing two-stage generator-evaluator methods decouple list generation from list evaluation, leaving the generator without direct access to the listwise utility signal, while scoring-based one-stage methods score items under a fixed upstream permutation context without explicitly searching the permutation space. We propose \textbf{ReAlign}, a reward-guided preference alignment framework that couples a listwise reward model with a candidate-aware autoregressive generator. The reward model decomposes the listwise reward into position-wise contributions, modeling user exposure through a survival-based exposure module and item value through per-objective heads for heterogeneous engagement signals. The generator is trained in two stages: supervised pre-training on logged exposure lists to establish a relevance prior, followed by reward-guided post-training that aligns the generator with the reward model through complementary distribution and ranking alignment over within-pool standardized rewards. Extensive offline experiments show that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [424] [Bag of concepts can enhance other text representations for medical systematic review screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15798)
*Radosław Pytlak,Paweł Cichosz,Bartłomiej Fajdek,Bogdan Jastrzębski*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究基于主动学习的半自动系统综述(SLR)系统中文本表示的选择,重点评价"概念袋"(Bag of Concepts, BoC)表示及其与其他表示的组合,并在医学SLR案例上系统比较BoW、BoC、PubMedBERT、Jina、Gemma、Qwen3及BoC增强表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLR系统对BoC表示关注不足,且不同本体、不同文本表示对分类与主动学习效率的影响缺乏系统对比,需要明确概念特征是否带来互补信息以及本体选择的影响。

Method: 在医学SLR案例上开展实验,采用随机森林分类、聚类初始化与不确定性采样;在主动学习框架下用专家标注迭代扩充训练集;系统比较BoW、BoC、PubMedBERT、Jina、Gemma、Qwen3及BoC与各表示的组合;评估采用源自优化基准的工作量节省与性能剖面指标;并比较不同本体构建的BoC与基于UMLS词典的MedCAT表示。

Result: 概念特征可提供互补信息,BoC增强表示在DERP案例上的平均工作量节省高于其对应基础表示,Qwen3+BoC在该比较中平均表现最佳;但增强效果随案例与基础表示而变;论文亦给出本体选择对文档分类结果的影响及不同本体BoC与MedCAT/UMLS表示的预测价值对比。

Conclusion: BoC特征具有互补价值,与强预训练表示组合可提升主动学习SLR的效率,但收益依赖具体案例和基础表示,本体选择亦显著影响分类效果,实践中需针对任务选择表示与本体。

Abstract: The paper examines the choice of text representation for semi-automated systematic literature review (SLR) systems based on active learning. Motivated by the insufficient attention that the bag of concepts representation has received so far, the paper discusses the implementation and experimental evaluation of several variations thereof. The experimental study was performed on medical SLR case studies, with results reported for random forest classification, cluster initialization and uncertainty sampling. The utility of bag of concepts features obtained using different ontologies is evaluated by applying them within the active learning framework to sequentially create classification models based on training data iteratively expanded with expert annotations. Systematic experiments compare BoW, BoC, PubMedBERT, Jina, Gemma and Qwen3 representations, together with combinations of BoC and each of the other representations. The evaluation uses workload savings and performance profiles adapted from optimization benchmarking. The results suggest that concept-based features can provide complementary information, with the BoC-augmented representations achieving higher mean workload savings on the DERP cases than their corresponding base representations. The Qwen3+BoC representation gives the best average performance in this comparison. The effects of augmentation vary across case studies and base representations. The paper also concentrates on the impact of ontology choice on document classification outcomes. In particular, the paper compares the predictive value of bag of concepts representations based on chosen ontologies with that of representations obtained using MedCAT with a UMLS-based dictionary.

</details>


### [425] [From Tokens to Behaviors: Rethinking Generative Recommendation for User Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16159)
*Jiaqi Wang,Hanchen Yang,Hengyu Zhang,Hongxu Ma,Wenqi Rao,Hongyang Wang,Zhongbo Sun,Renliang Qian,Weixin Chen,Wengen Li,Jihong Guan,Shuigeng Zhou,Qingpeng Cai,Peng Jiang,Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TraGR：一种行为感知的生成式推荐框架，通过交互内并行SID预测、概率反馈与关系感知轨迹学习，对齐生成、反馈与学习三个环节，提升用户行为轨迹预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐用自回归SID解码做轨迹预测，存在三问题：串行解码将token生成与行为状态转移耦合、每步需多次依赖解码；离散物品反馈忽略预测不确定性；teacher-forcing训练与推理间存在差距。

Method: 提出TraGR：(1) 行为级架构，单次交互内并行预测SID token，并用循环状态更新建模行为转移，联合SID与物品级监督；(2) 概率反馈，将选定行为与备选项的概率加权摘要结合以指导后续预测；(3) 关系感知轨迹学习，在模型生成的轨迹上训练并融入协同转移信号与后期信用分配。

Result: 在四个公开数据集上，TraGR在不同预测时域下均持续优于最先进基线。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将生成、反馈与学习对齐到连续用户行为，TraGR有效缓解串行解码与训练-推理差距问题，提升行为轨迹预测性能。

Abstract: User behavior trajectory prediction (UBTP) aims to capture how a user's needs evolve over time by predicting the sequence of future interactions from that user's interaction history. Recent generative recommendation (GR) methods address this task through autoregressive generation of semantic IDs (SIDs). However, serial SID decoding couples token generation with behavior state transitions and requires multiple dependent steps per interaction. Discrete item feedback overlooks predictive uncertainty, and teacher-forced training leaves a training-inference gap in trajectory generation. To address these limitations, we propose TraGR, a behavior-aware generative recommendation framework that aligns generation, feedback, and learning with successive user behaviors. Its behavior-level architecture predicts SID tokens in parallel within each interaction and models behavioral transitions through recurrent state updates, with joint SID and item-level supervision. Probability feedback combines the selected behavior with a probability-weighted summary of alternatives to guide subsequent predictions. Relation-aware trajectory learning incorporates collaborative transition signals and later credit assignment into training on model-generated trajectories. Experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that TraGR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different prediction horizons. Code: https://github.com/CalmaQi/GR4UBT.

</details>


### [426] [GA-HEL: A Knowledge-Driven Expert System for Open-Set, Granularity-Aware Hierarchical Event Linking in Social Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16194)
*Shengqi Zhou,Zhigang Liu,Wenxiang Zhu,Zhentao Cang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出开放集层级事件关联任务（GA-HEL），在冻结的Storyline–Episode–Atomic Event Cards结构上做三阶段知识驱动漏斗式推理，实现范围控制、层级路径与深度选择及合法路径校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体事件智能需要判断帖子是否属于已注册事件空间、确定其支持的层级路径，并在证据允许的最深层级止步，现有方法缺乏显式范围控制与层级有效结构输出。

Method: GA-HEL为三阶段专家系统漏斗：1) 开放集范围控制，在层级推理前限制候选暴露；2) 层级感知解码器选择支持路径与深度；3) 确定性合法路径校验，确保记录可用于数据库。资源含200条Pilot集与497条Expansion集（4个留出Storyline及困难负样本池），方法、提示、Event Cards、候选顺序及六个系统预测均在Expansion Gold标注前冻结；评估涵盖端到端层级匹配、开放集拒绝、结构校验、消融、跨Storyline分析及固定审计子集的专家重标注。

Result: GA-HEL与强全局全卡推理系统竞争力相当，同时提供显式范围控制与层级有效的结构化记录；主要剩余挑战是证据仅到Episode层却向下过度推断至Atomic Events。

Conclusion: 任务定义、冻结资源与可审计协议为范围感知的事件智能提供可复现基础；代码、Event Cards、标签、冻结预测与评估脚本已开源。

Abstract: Social-media event intelligence requires a system to determine whether a post belongs to a registered event space, identify the supported hierarchy path, and stop at the deepest level warranted by the evidence. We formulate this requirement as open-set hierarchical event linking over frozen Storyline--Episode--Atomic Event Cards. GA-HEL implements a three-stage, knowledge-driven expert-system funnel: open-set scope control limits candidate exposure before hierarchical reasoning, hierarchy-aware decoders select a supported path and depth, and deterministic legal-path validation checks each record before database-compatible use. A 200-post Pilot supports task and mechanism development, while a separately annotated 497-post Expansion set evaluates transfer across four held-out Storylines and a hard-negative pool. Method implementations, prompts, Event Cards, candidate order, and six systems' predictions were frozen before Expansion Gold annotation. The resulting evaluation combines end-to-end hierarchical matching, open-set rejection, structural validation, ablation, cross-Storyline analysis, and an independent expert reannotation of a fixed audited subset. GA-HEL remains competitive with strong global full-card reasoning while providing explicit scope control and hierarchy-valid structured records. Error analysis identifies unsupported descent from Episode-level evidence to Atomic Events as the dominant remaining challenge. The task definition, frozen resource, and auditable protocol provide a reproducible foundation for scope-aware event intelligence. Code, Event Cards, labels, frozen predictions, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/SHbiao/GAHEL_release.

</details>


### [427] [CURATOR: Scalable Fine-grained Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16366)
*Shib Dasgupta,Bandish Parikh,Rashmi Gangadharaiah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 CURATOR，一个微调的决策模型，能在大量候选片段中联合地进行可靠的证据选择，用于 RAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 把整篇检索到的段落交给 LLM，但其中只有少数 span 含有关键证据。单独判断某个 span 是否相关很难（需结合其他检索信息），而带完整上下文逐一评估每个 span 又计算低效。预训练决策模型可联合评估多个 span，但实验显示随同时决策数量增加，其识别相关证据的能力会退化。

Method: 训练一个微调的决策模型，让它在大型候选池中学习选择不同数量的支持性 span，从而在保持联合决策计算效率的同时具备可靠的证据选择能力。

Result: CURATOR 在候选数量增加时仍保持较强的证据区分能力，可跨任务与文档领域泛化，并提升下游 RAG 性能，尤其在可用上下文有限时效果更明显。

Conclusion: 通过针对大候选集的证据选择训练，CURATOR 兼顾了证据选择准确性与联合决策的效率，是一种可泛化、有效的 RAG 上下文精炼方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides entire retrieved passages to the LLM, even though only a handful of spans within them contain the evidence pertaining to the question. While precise selection of these spans can improve context utilization, identifying them in isolation is challenging. A span may appear irrelevant by itself, and deciding whether to retain it may require examining other retrieved information. One can evaluate each span's candidacy with the full retrieved context, but this is computationally inefficient as the same text must be processed repeatedly. Pretrained decision model can be used to efficiently evaluate multiple spans simultaneously, allowing each decision to consider the surrounding spans as well. However, our experiments show that their ability to identify relevant evidence deteriorates as the number of simultaneous decisions increases.
  To address this, we introduce CURATOR, a fine-tuned decision model trained to make reliable evidence-selection decisions over large candidate sets. By training a decision model to select varying numbers of supporting spans from large candidate pools, CURATOR develops the capability to select evidence for RAG while retaining the computational efficiency of joint decision-making. We observe that CURATOR maintains a strong evidence discrimination capability as the number of candidates increases, generalizes across different tasks and document domains, and improves downstream RAG performance, particularly when the available context is limited.

</details>


### [428] [TriGen: A Generative Paradigm for Trigger-Induced Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16395)
*Muyu Zou,Haibo Xing,Shunye Tang,Liyan Tie,Lingyu Mu,Yandong Wang,Jinxin Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 TriGen，一个面向触发诱导推荐（TIR）场景的生成式推荐范式，通过校准尾部注入、动态门控仲裁与位置特定变换，使生成式推荐在即时触发意图与长期偏好之间取得平衡，并已在六个国家市场全量上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐主要面向 UIR 设定，把目标物品预测视为长历史的自回归被动延续；但工业界关键的 TIR 场景（用户点击触发即时后续信息流）要求推荐同时对齐瞬时触发意图与历史偏好连续性。传统 TIR 方法基于判别式打分，无法指导 token 级生成；现有生成模型又缺乏调和这一结构性张力的机制。

Method: TriGen 构建专用生成式范式：1）校准尾部注入（calibrated tail injection），重新编码局部历史；2）通过动态门控在持久偏好与即时冲动间自适应仲裁；3）位置特定变换，在解码各步维持分层级的触发引导。

Result: 离线评测相较强竞争基线取得一致提升；在六个国家市场的在线 A/B 测试中带来显著的营收与 GMV 增长，并已实现全量生产部署。

Conclusion: TriGen 首次为触发诱导推荐建立专门的生成式框架，有效解决即时触发与历史偏好的结构性矛盾，并经过大规模线上验证具备工业落地价值。

Abstract: Generative recommendation typically operates under the User-Induced Recommendation (UIR) setting, predicting target items by autoregressively generating semantic IDs as a passive continuation of long-term user history. However, this paradigm overlooks Trigger-Induced Recommendation (TIR), an essential industrial scenario where a user click triggers an immediate follow-up feed. In TIR, recommendations must dynamically align with the instant trigger intent without compromising historical preference continuity. Traditional TIR methods rely on discriminative scoring and cannot guide token-level generation, while existing generative models lack mechanisms to reconcile this structural tension. To address this challenge, we propose TriGen, establishing a tailored generative paradigm for trigger-induced recommendation. TriGen introduces calibrated tail injection to re-encode local history, adaptively arbitrates between persistent tastes and immediate impulses via dynamic gating, and applies position-specific transformations to sustain level-aware trigger guidance across decoding steps. Extensive offline evaluations confirm consistent gains over competitive baselines. Furthermore, online A/B tests across six country markets demonstrate significant revenue and GMV improvements, leading to the full production deployment of TriGen.

</details>


### [429] [ReSID: Rethinking Long-Tail Retrieval in Generative Recommendation through Item Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16404)
*Muyu Zou,Shunye Tang,Yi Xu,Haibo Xing,Yandong Wang,Lingyu Mu,Jinxin Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ReSID：面向生成式推荐的长尾检索框架，基于长并行 Semantic ID，联合"保存"与"恢复"长尾候选，达到SOTA长尾检索效果并已上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）用离散 Semantic ID 表示物品、将检索转为序列生成，但在交互分布偏斜与严格服务预算下难以召回长尾物品。作者首次系统性研究了从 SID 构建、解码到匹配的全流程中的长尾可达性问题。

Method: 发现：（1）等码长下并行 SID 构建在长尾物品上持续优于串行 SID；（2）即使完整生成失败，解码序列仍携带局部一致信息，可通过部分匹配召回相关长尾物品；（3）但这种恢复受上游搜索限制——当 beam search 剪掉所有在固定失配容忍度内可完成的路径前缀时即失效。据此提出 ReSID：以长并行 SID 为基础，结合去流行度偏置与用户语义感知的 beam search 保持有希望路径存活，并用部分 SID 匹配从存活 token 中恢复物品。

Result: 在保持有竞争力整体准确率的同时取得 SOTA 长尾检索效果；在窄 beam 下具有更低延迟与更高吞吐；已部署于生产系统承载主要用户流量并带来显著业务收益。

Conclusion: 长尾可达性需在 SID 构建、解码、匹配三环节协同优化；并行 SID + 去偏搜索 + 部分匹配是可行且工程可落地的高效方案，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and casts retrieval as sequence generation. Under skewed interaction distributions and tight serving budgets, GR struggles to retrieve long-tail items. In this work, we are the first to study long-tail reachability across the complete pipeline of SID construction, decoding, and matching. We find that under equal code lengths, parallel SID construction consistently outperforms sequential SIDs on tail items. Moreover, even when full generation fails, decoded sequences carry locally consistent information that retrieves relevant tail items via partial matching. Yet this recovery is bounded by upstream search, failing once beam search prunes all prefixes completable within a fixed mismatch tolerance. Motivated by these findings, we propose ReSID to jointly preserve and recover tail candidates. Built on long parallel SIDs, ReSID pairs popularity-debiased and user-semantic-aware beam search to keep promising paths alive with partial SID matching to recover items from surviving tokens. ReSID achieves state-of-the-art long-tail retrieval while maintaining competitive overall accuracy, with lower latency and higher throughput under narrow beams. ReSID is deployed in our production system, serving main user traffic with substantial business gains. We release our complete code and model checkpoints to support full reproducibility and real-world deployment at https://github.com/Gabriel-reina/ReSID.

</details>


### [430] [AntEmbed: Dual-Mode Multimodal Embedding Model for Efficient and Fine-Grained Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16405)
*Kehang Jia,Teng Liu,Juntao Li,Hua Chen,Jinxiong Chang,Xiaobo Liang,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 AntEmbed 双模式多模态嵌入模型，在统一嵌入空间中同时支持高效检索与推理增强的细粒度匹配，8B 版本在 MMEB-v2 上取得 81.5 总分，超过最强基线 3.1 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判别式嵌入高效但缺乏细粒度语义，生成式嵌入能通过推理捕捉查询意图与相关性证据但计算开销大，二者难以兼得。

Method: 1) 构建面向检索的推理内容，捕捉查询意图与混淆感知的语义证据；将原始输入与推理增强输入视为语义等价视图，用单嵌入 token 的多正例对比学习对齐判别式与生成式嵌入。2) 跨模式自蒸馏，通过候选相似度分布蒸馏与查询表示对齐，将推理增强的细粒度语义迁移到原始表示，从而无需在线推理即可增强判别式嵌入；两种模式共享同一候选索引。

Result: 在 MMEB-v2 上，AntEmbed-8B 使用推理增强嵌入取得 81.5 的总体得分，比最强基线高出 3.1 分。

Conclusion: 统一的双模式嵌入框架可兼顾检索效率与细粒度语义匹配，自蒸馏使判别式模式在不增加在线推理成本的情况下获得推理带来的收益。

Abstract: Discriminative embeddings encode original multimodal inputs efficiently but struggle with fine-grained semantics. Generative embeddings use reasoning to capture query intent and relevance evidence, but incur higher computational costs. We propose AntEmbed, a dual-mode multimodal embedding model that supports efficient retrieval and reasoning-enhanced fine-grained matching in a unified embedding space. First, we construct retrieval-oriented reasoning content that captures query intent and confusion-aware semantic evidence. We treat original and reasoning-enhanced candidate inputs as semantically equivalent views, and use multi-positive contrastive learning with a single embedding token to align discriminative and generative embeddings. Second, cross-mode self-distillation transfers fine-grained semantic information from reasoning-enhanced to original representations through candidate similarity-distribution distillation and query representation alignment. This strengthens discriminative embeddings without requiring additional online reasoning. Both retrieval modes share a single candidate index. On MMEB-v2, AntEmbed-8B achieves an overall score of 81.5 with reasoning-enhanced embeddings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.1 points.

</details>


### [431] [RMIT-ADM+S at TREC RAG 2026: Research Agents, Retriever Ablations, and Open-Weight Replication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16425)
*Oleg Zendel,Kun Ran,Chenglong Ma,Nguyen Khoi Vo,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RMIT-ADM+S团队在TREC 2026 RAG赛道（ClimbMix语料）提交7个研究智能体方案，探索检索策略、写作模型与工作流；正式评测中6/7超中位数，最佳run brief-hybrid达到Batch-1关键覆盖并列最高0.892，并发现自动覆盖指标与人类偏好存在差异，开源权重模型具备潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统考察研究型检索增强生成（agentic RAG）中检索策略、写作模型选择与智能体工作流对答案质量的影响，并检验低成本开源权重模型能否替代专有模型。

Method: 在ClimbMix语料上构建基于OpenAI专有模型与开源权重模型的七种研究智能体run，系统变化检索策略、writer模型和agent工作流；提交前通过消融实验识别关键因素，随后参与NIST官方评测（三种rubric/nugget集合）并进行人工并排偏好比较。

Result: 消融显示writer选择与相邻chunk扩展是影响答案质量的主要因素。官方评测中7个run有6个在全部三种rubric/nugget集合上超过赛道中位数；最佳run brief-hybrid在本团队中all-item覆盖最高，并以0.892并列Batch-1关键覆盖赛道最高值。人工偏好分批次不同：开源模型owa-glm5在Batch 1领先（尽管自动覆盖较低），sol-research-first在Batch 2领先。

Conclusion: 自动覆盖类指标与人类偏好并不一致，评估需兼顾人工判断；同时低成本开源权重模型在研究智能体系统中具有竞争力与应用潜力。

Abstract: We describe the RMIT-ADM+S team's participation in the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track using the ClimbMix corpus. We submitted seven research-agent runs using proprietary OpenAI and open-weight models, exploring different retrieval strategies, writer models, and agent workflows. Pre-submission ablations identified writer selection and adjacent-chunk expansion as the main factors affecting answer quality. In the official NIST evaluation, six of seven runs exceeded the track median across all three rubric/nugget collections. Our best-performing run, brief-hybrid, achieved the highest all-item coverage among our submissions and tied the track maximum (0.892) for Batch-1 vital coverage. Human side-by-side preferences differed across evaluation batches: the open-weight owa-glm5 led Batch 1 despite lower automated coverage, while sol-research-first led Batch 2. These findings highlight differences between automated coverage measures and human preferences, as well as the potential of lower-cost open-weight models for research-agent systems.

</details>


### [432] [Active Learning of Approximate LLM Ranking for Energy-Efficient Retrieval of Long Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16488)
*Ohad Porat,Elad Yom-Tov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LAAM是一个混合检索框架，用轻量级学习预测器在词法检索与LLM重排之间做主动学习式近似，可在能耗—精度曲线上提供连续可选的工作点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索引擎与LLM各有优势：词法检索（如BM25）快速节能，LLM能理解语义和长查询却计算与能耗代价高，两者之间缺乏可控的折中方案。

Method: 提出LAAM（LLM Active Approximation Model）：引入一个轻量级学习预测器作为语义检索与LLM检索之间的中介，通过主动学习循环由LLM标注少量文档，将LLM评估集中于信息量最大的文档以降低推理成本。在TREC Robust 2004上评估，使用Lucene+BM25与DeepSeek v3，测试三种查询冗长度。

Result: 冗长查询下，LAAM达到DeepSeek重排平均P@10的87%（0.459 vs 0.526），单查询能耗仅为其3.3%；在平均精度上显著优于BM25，与DeepSeek无显著差异（但MAP上非无差异），Friedman检验P<0.05并做后检验。

Conclusion: 通过主动学习选择性近似LLM相关性判断，可使检索精度直接由评估（即能耗）预算控制，避免了在廉价低精度的词法检索与高成本穷尽式LLM重排之间二选一，为实践者提供连续的能耗—精度权衡。

Abstract: Search engines and Large Language Models (LLMs) offer complementary strengths for document retrieval: lexical retrievers which rely on keyword matching are fast and energy-efficient, whereas LLMs capture semantic meaning and excel at interpreting long, context-rich queries. However, this comes at a cost that is computationally and energetically prohibitive.
  We propose the LLM Active Approximation Model (LAAM), a hybrid retrieval framework that introduces a lightweight learned predictor which serves as an intermediary between semantic retrieval and LLM retrieval. LAAM is refined through an active learning loop where an LLM labels a small number of documents. By concentrating LLM evaluations on the most informative documents, the framework substantially reduces inference cost while preserving retrieval effectiveness.
  We evaluate the proposed framework on TREC Robust 2004 using Lucene with BM25 retrieval and DeepSeek v3 as the LLM, under three levels of query verbosity. For verbose queries, LAAM achieves 87% of average P@10 achieved by DeepSeek's reranking (0.459 vs. 0.526), while requiring only 3.3% of the per-query energy consumption. LAAM is statistically significantly better than BM25 and is indistinguishable from DeepSeek on average precision, though not on MAP (Friedman test, P<0.05 with post-hoc testing).
  Overall, our results demonstrate that selectively approximating LLM relevance judgments through active learning enables retrieval accuracy to be controlled directly through the evaluation (and consequently energy) budget. Rather than committing to either inexpensive (and less accurate) lexical retrieval or exhaustive (and expensive) LLM reranking, our framework exposes a continuous spectrum of operating points along the energy--accuracy curve, allowing practitioners to select how to trade retrieval quality with computational budget.

</details>


### [433] [KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16795)
*Chenxu Li,Shuchang Liu,Hantao Shu,Wei Yuan,Zhe Xu,Guoqing Hu,Yan Wang,Biao Yang,Xiang Li,Cheng Ling,Fan Yang,Yongqi Liu,Lantao Hu,Han Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Kun Gai,An Zhang,Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出KuaiRecV2基准，含千万级多模态交互数据、30天动态候选池，并统一评测检索精度、多样性与多任务表现，以缩小离线评估与线上效果的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统中简单离线评测与复杂线上结果之间长期存在不一致，大模型时代该差距依然存在。作者归结为三大挑战：大规模持续学习、组合多样性（token级与item级的精度-多样性权衡）、多任务奖励平衡。

Method: 基于快手工业级数据构建KuaiRecV2：提供百万级多模态item信息的大规模交互数据集、30天长期交互记录与动态视频候选池；设计严格基准，在统一评分体系中同时评估检索精度、多样性和多任务性能，要求新方法在所有指标上均提升才算有效进展。

Result: 提供可复现的工业级数据集与统一评测框架（代码已开源），支撑上述三类挑战的针对性研究。

Conclusion: KuaiRecV2为更贴近真实的推荐方案提供数据与评测基础，强调“全面不劣化”的进步标准，缓解离线-线上评估不一致问题。

Abstract: Recommender systems, which retrieve items of interest to users based on their interaction histories, have recently witnessed several key technological advancements, benefiting from the semantic representation space and model-data scaling. Nevertheless, practitioners and researchers have frequently encountered critical inconsistencies between simple offline evaluations and complex online results, and this gap still exists in the era of large models. In this work, we address several key factors that contribute to this inconsistency: 1) the \textit{large-scale continual learning challenge} that assumes a practical demand to maintain long-term model effectiveness under dynamic item pools and distributional shifts; 2) the \textit{combinatorial diversity challenge} that requires the generation strategy to solve the accuracy-diversity trade-off in both the finer token level and the holistic item level; and 3) the \textit{multi-task reward balancing challenge}, which is particularly critical for modern generative models that can accurately model the sequence distribution but are less controllable for the multi-task demands.
  To address these challenges and further pave the way for the development of more realistic recommendation solutions, we introduce KuaiRecV2, a deliberately constructed benchmark with industrial-level datasets from Kuaishou. Specifically, we provide a large-scale interaction dataset with million-scale multi-modal item information and long-term interaction records across 30 days, with a dynamic video candidate pool. Additionally, we provide a rigorous benchmark that evaluates retrieval accuracy, diversity, and multi-task performance in one rubric system, where an effective advancement occurs if and only if the new method improves all metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/cxli2333/KuaiRecV2

</details>


### [434] [SignalAudit-QD: A Reproducible Audit Resource for External Signals in AI-Query Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16947)
*Amir Rafe,Iman Jamshidi,Gourab Sil,Subasish Das*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SignalAudit-QD 是一个可复现的审计资源，在固定的 20 词美国 AI 面板上检验"带时间的公共信号（Google Trends）是否在查询历史之外提供额外信息"。结论是一个有边界的阴性案例：加入两成分专利块对宏观 MAE 的改变为 +0.0012，95% 区间 [-0.0363, +0.0387]，既不能说有总体收益，也不能说等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部信号（如趋势、专利流）是否在时间信息检索中真正带来独立于查询历史的增量信息，往往缺乏可复现、可审计的检验；本文希望用冻结的测量版本与出处记录，把这类声明变成可核查的证据。

Method: 对齐两份归档 Google Trends 抽取与八条 USPTO AI 专利公开流；发布以 origin 为索引的预测、配对损失、出处、可执行测试和防篡改运行清单。在指定的一个月对比中，把两成分专利块加入 level ridge 模型；采用条件 95% 移动块区间；辅以时序匹配对照、植入信号检测、持续性锚定与非线性宿主等稳健性检验。

Result: 主对比中宏观 MAE 变化 +0.0012 Trends 点，区间 [-0.0363, +0.0387]，既无总体收益证据也不支持等价。替代维度、语义映射、专利口径、第二份抽取与三个月窗口均未定论；锚定与非线性宿主出现模型特定的变差（锚定拟合下很小）；植入信号检测只识别出最大规模的注入；高关注度告警只演示接口、不证明在线效用。

Conclusion: 本文贡献是一个有边界的阴性案例研究，以及一套可扩展的证据模式，用于审计时间信息检索中的外部信号声明；由于输入是回溯重建，该任务属于冻结测量版本下的伪 origin 实验，而非历史部署模拟。

Abstract: SignalAudit-QD is a reproducible audit resource for testing whether a dated public signal adds information beyond query history in a fixed 20-term U.S. AI panel. It aligns two archived Google Trends extractions with eight USPTO AI-patent publication streams and releases origin-indexed predictions, paired losses, provenance, executable tests, and tamper-evident run manifests. Both inputs are retrospective reconstructions obtained after the modeled 2020--2023 origins; the task is therefore a pseudo-origin assay within frozen measurement vintages, not a historical deployment simulation. In the designated one-month comparison, adding a two-component patent block to a level ridge changes macro mean absolute error by +0.0012 Trends points, with conditional 95% moving-block interval [-0.0363,+0.0387]. This establishes neither aggregate benefit nor equivalence. Alternative dimensions, semantic mapping, patent definitions, a second extraction, and a three-month horizon remain unresolved; persistence-anchored and nonlinear hosts instead show model-specific worsening, tiny for the anchored fit. Matched timing controls expose availability assumptions, while a planted-signal assay detects only the largest tested injection. A within-query high-interest alert demonstrates the released interface but not online utility. The contribution is a bounded negative case study and an extensible evidence schema for auditing external-signal claims in temporal information retrieval.

</details>


### [435] [Evaluation of Music Version Retrieval Methods for Setlist Identification in Live Concerts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17070)
*Andres Ferraro,Albin Correya*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文在ASID基准上评估现代音乐版本检索方法用于自动曲目单识别，发现NAVE与CLEWS显著优于Re-MOVE，且256维的NAVE在存储降低四倍的同时取得更好检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动曲目单识别需将噪声大、质量参差的现场演唱会录音与参考曲库匹配，面临编曲差异大、背景噪声、需大规模高效处理连续录音等超出常规版本识别的挑战，因此需评估现有方法的实际适用性。

Method: 在ASID基准上将经典Re-MOVE系统与CLEWS及内部神经音频版本嵌入模型NAVE进行对比；并额外评估音乐/非音乐门控预处理对检测的影响，结合定性分析考察识别边界。

Result: NAVE与CLEWS显著优于Re-MOVE；NAVE仅用256维嵌入（CLEWS为1024维），存储减少四倍却检索性能更好；音乐/非音乐门控在检测与时序覆盖上有小幅提升，定性分析显示其可改善识别边界，超出标准ASID指标所反映的程度。

Conclusion: 分段级音频嵌入是构建可扩展曲目单识别的有力基础，紧凑表示可在真实现场演出条件下以更低存储与服务成本达到高准确率。

Abstract: Automatic setlist identification aims to identify the songs performed in live concert recordings by matching noisy and variable-quality audio against a database of reference tracks. This task presents challenges beyond conventional music version identification, including substantial arrangement differences, background noise, and the need to process continuous recordings efficiently at large scale. In this work, we evaluate modern music version retrieval methods for setlist identification using the ASID benchmark, comparing the established Re-MOVE system with CLEWS and NAVE, an internal neural audio version embedding model. Our results show that NAVE and CLEWS substantially outperform Re-MOVE. Notably, NAVE uses 256-dimensional embeddings, compared with 1024 dimensions for CLEWS, providing a four-fold reduction in embedding storage while achieving better retrieval performance. We further evaluate music/non-music gating and find modest improvements in detection and temporal coverage, while qualitative analysis suggests that such preprocessing can improve recognition boundaries beyond what the standard ASID metrics capture. Overall, the results demonstrate that segment-level audio embeddings provide a strong basis for scalable setlist identification and that compact representations can achieve strong accuracy under realistic live-concert conditions at much lower storage and serving cost.

</details>


### [436] [Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17226)
*Ksenia Belkovskaya,Timur Lidzhiev,Maria Stebliy,Alexander Tarakanov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在LightGCN骨干上加一个受层论(cellular sheaf)启发的模块化打分扩展，比较恒等内积、对角、秩一低秩和满矩阵残差打分器，并与参数匹配的MLP基线在四个数据集上对比排序质量与覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受cellular sheaf中"局部向量空间由线性限制映射关联"的思想启发，希望将用户/物品嵌入的交互打分改为结构化、依赖物品对(pair-dependent)的线性变换，而非改动图传播本身。

Method: 以三层LightGCN为固定骨干，在其输出的用户/物品嵌入上叠加可替换的打分器：恒等内积、对角变换、秩一低秩残差、满矩阵残差，以及参数匹配的残差MLP基线(mlp_full)。在Amazon-Book、Gowalla、MovieLens-1M、Yelp2018上评测Recall/NDCG类排序指标与catalog coverage (K=10,20)。未构建真正的cellular sheaf，也未实现sheaf-Laplacian扩散。

Result: 结构化变体带来幅度不大且依赖数据集的排序质量变化，覆盖率有时出现显著变化；由于实现并非真正的层论扩散，实验无法证明sheaf几何本身的因果增益。

Conclusion: 该工作是"sheaf-inspired"而非"sheaf-based"的打分模块探索，效果有限且不具备机制层面的因果归因；作者对此边界做了诚实声明，未来需构建真正的cellular sheaf与sheaf-Laplacian传播才能检验层论几何的收益。

Abstract: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone. The motivation comes from cellular sheaves, where local vector spaces are related by linear restriction maps; here, this idea motivates structured, pair-dependent transformations of user and item embeddings rather than a change to graph propagation. We compare the identity inner-product scorer, diagonal, rank-one low-rank, and full matrix residual scorers, and a parameter-matched residual MLP baseline (\texttt{mlp\_full}) on Amazon-Book, Gowalla, MovieLens-1M, and Yelp2018. We report ranking quality and catalog coverage at cutoffs 10 and 20. The selected structured variants show modest, dataset-dependent changes in ranking quality and sometimes substantial changes in coverage. Our method is inspired by sheaf geometry but does not construct a cellular sheaf or implement sheaf-Laplacian diffusion; the experiments therefore do not establish a causal benefit from sheaf geometry itself.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [437] [CAFIN: CUDA-accelerated Adaptive Fisher Information Matrix Network Optimization via GPU-Native Kernel Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14589)
*Maryam Arshad,Muhammad Khuram Shahzad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAFIN 是面向 AdaFisher 二阶优化器的 GPU 原生 CUDA 核融合框架，在不改变其优化数学公式的前提下，将 FIM 预条件子构建、EMA 更新、梯度预条件、动量、权重衰减与参数更新逐步融合进 CUDA 核，显著降低延迟与显存分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二阶优化器利用曲率信息提升 DNN 训练，但实际效率受 GPU 执行开销制约。AdaFisher 虽通过对角 Kronecker 结构与指数移动平均降低 FIM 近似成本，但其 PyTorch 实现存在串行 CUDA 核启动、中间张量分配和重复访存等问题。

Method: 提出 CAFIN 核融合框架，逐步把 AdaFisher 的 FIM 预条件子构建、EMA 更新、梯度预条件、动量累积、权重衰减和参数更新合并为融合 CUDA 核；并采用共享内存复用、寄存器驻留计算与原地操作减少访存和中间分配。

Result: 在 GTX 1660 Ti 与 RTX 3060 Laptop 上，用 ResNet-18 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet 实验：FIM 构建延迟最高降低 78.4%，优化器步延迟降低 2.1–26.9%，每步减少约 18.91 MB 中间 GPU 显存分配；数值结果在 FP32 容差内一致，收敛精度与随机种子下表现相当。

Conclusion: CUDA 核融合可在保持 AdaFisher 数学形式与学习行为不变的情况下显著加速二阶优化，为高阶优化器的工程落地提供可行路径。

Abstract: Second-order optimizers improve deep neural network training using curvature information, but their practical efficiency is limited by GPU execution overhead. AdaFisher reduces Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) approximation costs through diagonal Kronecker structures and exponential moving averages, yet its PyTorch implementation requires sequential CUDA kernel launches, intermediate tensor allocations, and repeated memory accesses. We introduce CAFIN, a GPU-native CUDA kernel fusion framework that improves AdaFisher execution efficiency without changing its optimization formulation. The proposed approach progressively integrates FIM preconditioner construction, exponential moving average updates, gradient preconditioning, momentum accumulation, weight decay, and parameter updates into fused CUDA kernels. Shared-memory reuse, register-resident computation, and in-place operations further reduce memory traffic and intermediate allocations. Experiments using ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti and RTX 3060 Laptop GPUs demonstrate up to 78.4% lower isolated FIM construction latency and 2.1-26.9% lower optimizer-step latency. The implementation also eliminates approximately 18.91 MB of intermediate GPU memory allocations per optimizer step. Numerical validation confirms consistency within the predefined FP32 tolerance, while convergence accuracy remains comparable across evaluated datasets and random seeds. These findings demonstrate that CUDA kernel fusion can substantially accelerate second-order optimization while preserving AdaFisher's underlying mathematical formulation and learning behavior.

</details>


### [438] [An Asynchronous Federated Learning Platform for Lung Adenocarcinoma Grading via Foundation Models and Structural Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14590)
*Moon-Il Joo,Md Ariful Islam Mozumder,Hee-Cheol Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个基于网页的联邦学习系统，仅共享本地训练的模型权重而不共享患者数据，用UNI2基础模型和CLAM-SB对肺腺癌WSI进行PD/WMD分型；比较四种联邦算法并结合L1范数结构剪枝，发现FedNova+40%剪枝为兼顾效率、性能与隐私的实用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺腺癌PD与WMD亚型分类对患者生存预测很重要，但存在病理学家间观察者间变异导致的一致性差问题；同时受患者隐私限制，跨医院数据收集困难。因此需要在不共享数据的前提下整合多机构数据。

Method: 采用UNI2基础模型与CLAM-SB构建WSI分类器；搭建四客户端网页式联邦学习系统，NLST队列仅作外部验证；在相同实验条件下比较FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova四种算法；并对模型应用20%、30%、40%稀疏度的L1范数结构剪枝以降低传输体积；同时开发支持切片上传、本地训练、AI分类与注意力热力图可视化的网页应用。

Result: 中心化评估中，CPTAC与TCGA联合训练在外部验证上优于单机构训练，证实多机构数据整合的必要性。测试AUC排序为FedBN > FedProx > FedNova > FedAvg；FedNova在PD与WMD之间分类最均衡。剪枝实验显示FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN的测试AUC随剪枝下降，而FedNova在所有稀疏度下均提升测试AUC。

Conclusion: FedNova结合40%剪枝是提升通信效率与分类性能、同时保护患者隐私的实用方案，配合网页应用实现可用的联邦病理AI工作流。

Abstract: Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. FedNova showed the most balanced classification performance between PD and WMD. L1-norm structural pruning at 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity was applied to reduce model transmission size. FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN showed a tendency of decreasing Test AUC under pruning, while FedNova achieved improved Test AUC across all sparsity levels. A web-based application was developed supporting slide upload, local training, AI classification, and attention heatmap-based visualization. The combination of FedNova and 40% pruning was confirmed as a practical approach that improves communication efficiency and classification performance while protecting patient privacy.

</details>


### [439] [Adversarial Risk in the Generative AI Era Necessitates Dropping the Small Epsilon Ball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14594)
*Andrew C. Cullen,Neil G. Marchant,Paul Montague,Jiani Xie,Benjamin I. P. Rubinstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批判对抗机器学习领域对 ℓp 范数 ε-ball 的过度聚焦，认为这是一种"计量陷阱"，会向防御者传递失真的风险认知，与现实系统漏洞不匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对抗 ML 研究几乎全部围绕最小 ℓp 扰动展开，但作者认为这种范式与真实世界系统脆弱性脱节，需要指出其潜在危害。

Method: 立场性/观点论文（position paper），通过论证分析而非实验来批判 ℓp 范数范式。

Result: 指出该范式误导防御者优化狭窄的数学鲁棒性、牺牲系统性安全，同时激励攻击者转向非重叠的替代对抗路径。

Conclusion: ℓp 球的主导地位不仅未能减少危害，反而可能因传递虚假安全感而主动助长风险。

Abstract: Adversarial Machine Learning research is currently centered on the search for the epsilon-ball: minimal perturbations designed to fool models while remaining imperceptible to humans. We argue that this fixation on $\ell_p$ norms is a metrological trap that communicates a distorted perception of risk to defenders, one that is unaligned with real-world system vulnerabilities. This paradigm misleads defenders into optimizing for narrow, mathematical robustness at the expense of systemic security, while simultaneously incentivizing attackers to exploit non-overlapping alternative adversarial pathways. Ultimately, we argue that the dominance of the $\ell_p$ ball does not just fail to reduce harm---it may actively facilitate it by communicating a false sense of security against the wrong threats.

</details>


### [440] [StructRL: Model-Free Reinforcement Learning with Replay Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14599)
*Ivo Nowak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StructRL将强化学习过程中收集的经验构建为显式replay graph，通过动态规划提取图策略，并迁移为DQN的动作偏好与SAC的目标方向来加速稀疏奖励学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏奖励任务中，无模型RL样本效率低、难以发现通往目标的路径。作者希望通过显式结构化的经验图（replay graph）而非纯隐式网络表示来引导学习。

Method: 将RL经验组织成replay graph；一旦图中存在通往目标的路径，就用动态规划在已观测状态空间上选动作，形成仅在已观测转移处有定义的graph policy；再将该策略作为DQN的action preference和SAC actor的最短观测路径目标方向进行蒸馏迁移。

Result: DQN在三个稀疏奖励MiniGrid任务上最终成功率显著提升：DoorKey 0.10→0.90，KeyCorridor 0.10→0.80，ObstructedMaze 0→0.50（普通DQN三倍预算仍无法追上）；SAC在连续PointMaze上由0.17提升至1.0（七个到达目标的配对运行）；将图策略蒸馏为新Q模型，DoorKey 6x6可从91%可达状态到达目标（普通DQN为38%）。

Conclusion: 经验图引导能显著提升稀疏奖励下的样本效率与成功率，但存在三个瓶颈：图支撑不完整、结构混叠（structural aliasing）以及高维输入中图信息丢失。

Abstract: StructRL turns the experience collected during reinforcement learning into an explicit replay graph. Once the graph contains a path to the task goal, dynamic programming selects actions on the observed part of the state space; these actions form a graph policy that is defined only where the required transitions have been observed. StructRL transfers these actions to model-free learners: as action preferences for a DQN Q-model and as target directions along shortest observed paths for a SAC actor. For DQN on three sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks, final success rises from 0.10 to 0.90 (DoorKey), 0.10 to 0.80 (KeyCorridor) and 0 to 0.50 (ObstructedMaze); plain DQN does not catch up with three times the budget. For SAC on continuous PointMaze, graph-derived direction labels raise final success from 0.17 to 1.0 on seven matched runs that reached the goal. Distilling the graph policy into a fresh Q-model gives a DoorKey 6x6 controller that reaches the goal from 91% of reachable states, against 38% for plain DQN. Scaling experiments identify three bottlenecks: incomplete graph support, structural aliasing, and loss of graph information in high-dimensional inputs.

</details>


### [441] [KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14604)
*Ningyuan Xi,Yuhang Lai,Ning Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KernelMosaic：一个将多样化 CUDA 任务与经过验证的解决方案及优化轨迹配对的开源数据集，用于微调小模型生成高效 CUDA kernel。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练 LLM 生成高效 CUDA kernel 需要覆盖多样计算需求及迭代优化的监督数据，但任务规格异构、有效实现依赖复杂反复的测试与改进，导致此类监督难以构建。

Method: 构建 KernelMosaic 数据集：用人工审核与多样性感知筛选，将任务表述为自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交集；再用智能体框架引导强 LLM 经过实现、正确性修复与性能优化，并借助可复用的 CUDA 指导与执行反馈生成解决方案和轨迹。

Result: 在 KernelMosaic 上对小开源模型做监督微调，KernelBench L1/L2/L3 正确率从 4%/0%/0% 提升至 88%/82%/16%，且各层级中快于 PyTorch eager 的 kernel 比例均上升；轨迹监督显著优于直接响应监督，并促进持续的测试与修正行为。

Conclusion: KernelMosaic 使通用模型在 CUDA kernel 生成上取得显著提升，验证了高质量多样化轨迹监督的价值。

Abstract: Training large language models to generate efficient CUDA kernels requires supervision spanning diverse computational requirements and iterative code optimization. Constructing this supervision is challenging because of heterogeneous specifications, and useful implementations emerge through iterative complicated testing and refinement. We introduce KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and trajectories. Human-guided review and diversity-aware selection curate tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications, and their intersections. To build the solutions and trajectories, our agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization with reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback. Supervised fine-tuning of a small open-source model on KernelMosaic raises correctness from 4%, 0%, and 0% to 88%, 82%, and 16% on KernelBench L1, L2, and L3, respectively, while increasing the fraction of tasks with kernels faster than PyTorch eager at every level. Further training experiments show that supervision from the curated trajectories substantially outperforms direct responses and promotes sustained testing and revision. These results demonstrate that KernelMosaic enables a general-purpose model to achieve substantial gains in CUDA kernel generation.

</details>


### [442] [Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14656)
*Sihwa Park,Jingsen Zhu,Vinamr Jain,Sheng-Yen Chou,Alexander Terenin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"先验拟合扩散Transformer"，用扩散模型在推理时进行上下文Thompson采样，从而把Thompson采样从高斯过程先验推广到非高斯先验，并在全局优化基准上优于传统高斯过程方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续全局优化中，Thompson采样几乎只能配合高斯过程先验使用，因为只有这类先验的后验计算在实践中可处理。这限制了方法表达力，例如无法表达单峰函数这类高斯性下不可实现的先验。

Method: 作者采用先验拟合网络范式预训练扩散Transformer；训练后模型在推理阶段以in-context方式执行Thompson采样。同时设计了一套实用的非高斯先验（含单峰先验等），并量化模型规模与预训练迭代次数之间的权衡。

Result: 实验显示此类模型呈现类似其他模态Transformer的缩放定律；在多个全局优化基准上，使用非高斯先验的先验拟合扩散Transformer相比基于高斯过程的传统流程取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 扩散Transformer可把Thompson采样推广到非高斯先验，并经预训练获得可扩展的in-context采样能力，为黑盒全局优化提供了优于高斯过程流程的新范式。

Abstract: Thompson sampling is natural randomized strategy for optimizing unknown functions in a black-box manner. In continuous global optimization, Thompson sampling has largely been restricted to Gaussian process priors, as these are essentially the only class for which computing the posterior distribution has been tractable in practice. In this work, we introduce \emph{prior-fitted diffusion transformers}, which are diffusion models that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, after being pre-trained using the prior-fitted network paradigm. To apply these models, we develop a set of practical non-Gaussian priors for general black-box functions---including those that have characteristics that cannot be achieved under Gaussianity, such as priors over unimodal functions. We also quantify the tradeoff between model size and the number of pre-training iterations, and show that these models follow scaling laws akin to those observed in transformers defined over other modalities. Across a set of global optimization benchmarks, we show that prior-fitted diffusion transformers with non-Gaussian priors can achieve improved performance compared to traditional pipelines built on Gaussian processes.

</details>


### [443] [Closing the Loop: Co-Evolving EM for Irregular Time Series Generation in Lifted Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14659)
*Idan Arbiv,Gal Fadlon,Omri Azencot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出共演化蒙特卡洛EM框架闭合插补器-生成器循环，并用PSLR解决2D提升表征下的后验采样，实现从不规则时序生成规则时序的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从"不规则时序→规则时序生成"的做法普遍被化为一次性插补（开环）：先完整补全每条部分序列并冻结，再在替代数据集上训练生成器。作者指出该策略有结构性缺陷：点插补器把歧义缺失区域塌缩为条件均值，随机插补器随生成器演化而过时；真正的瓶颈是"迭代"而非插补器设计。

Method: co-evolving Monte Carlo EM框架：E步从当前生成器后验采样缺失值，M步在这些补全上重训生成器，保持无条件生成式训练。由于扩散先验工作在提升的2D表征、而观测位于时序空间，进一步提出Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR)，在E步强制算子一致的条件下、保留不确定性并满足流形一致性。

Result: 在10个数据集、4种损坏机制上达到SOTA：相比最强基线，判别分数提升59%、预测分数提升15%、Context-FID提升73%、特征相关性误差降低71%。消融显示相比单步基线平均判别分数降低73%，基本追平干净数据oracle的剩余差距。

Conclusion: 将插补从"一次性"转为与生成器共演化的迭代过程是关键，配合适配提升表征的PSLR后验采样，可显著缩小与干净数据上界的差距。

Abstract: Regular time-series generation from irregular time series is typically reduced to one-shot imputation: complete each partial sequence once, freeze the completions, and train a generator on the resulting surrogate dataset. We show that this open-loop strategy is structurally flawed. Point imputers collapse ambiguous missing regions to conditional averages, while stochastic imputers become stale as the generator evolves; the binding constraint is therefore iteration, not imputer design. We introduce a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop. Each E-step samples missing values from the posterior of the current generator, and each M-step retrains the generator on these completions, preserving unconditional generator training. Since our diffusion prior operates in a lifted 2D representation while observations live in time-series space, we further introduce Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR), which enforces operator-consistent conditioning, uncertainty preservation, and manifold consistency during the E-step. Across ten datasets and four corruption regimes, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving over the strongest baselines by 59% in discriminative score, 15% in predictive score, 73% in Context-FID, and 71% in feature-correlation error. Ablations show that our approach reduces average discriminative score by 73% over single-step baselines, closing most of the remaining gap to the clean-data oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/azencot-group/PSLR.

</details>


### [444] [Trait Hitchhiking in LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14683)
*Adil Soubki,Elizabeth S. Z. Tan,Miles Cranmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将进化生物学的Price方程引入RL后训练，提出"性状搭便车"(trait hitchhiking)机制：GRPO训练中概率质量再分配会无意中放大或压制未被奖励直接针对的行为与内部属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL已成为语言模型后训练的标准阶段且算力投入快速增长。它虽能提升能力（尤其可验证奖励任务），但也会改变奖励未明确针对的行为与内部属性，这种非目标性状的变化机制缺乏理论描述。

Method: 建立描述RL后训练中"性状"演化的形式化框架，由此推导出进化生物学的Price方程；据此构建"性状搭便车"的数学模型，刻画训练在completion间重分配概率时对非目标性状的放大/压制；并在GRPO训练的模型上评估Price更新表达式的估计效果。

Result: Price估计与采样得到的性状动态高度吻合，验证了该形式的有效性，并确认性状搭便车是RL后训练中确实存在的现象。

Conclusion: 性状搭便车揭示了RL后训练可能"悄无声息"地放大不良性状的机制，为监测与理解后训练的副作用提供了理论工具。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.

</details>


### [445] [An Approach to Hinton's Mother-Child Proposal: Neural Networks Learning and Preserving Care in a Finite World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15523)
*Csaba Balogh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出让AI"学会"关怀而非直接赋予本能：把网络当作孩子，在有限世界中用"伤害词表+学习到的未来可接受性度量+执行否决"构建关怀机制，并证明在特定条件下该关怀在母亲离场、新情境和继续学习后仍能保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hinton主张应赋予AI"母性本能"、像母亲对待孩子一样对待人类。作者认为关怀不能先天赋予，必须先被学习，且网络自身应作为被抚养的孩子，因此研究关怀能否在母亲离开、遇到新情境和持续学习后存活。

Method: 机制由三部分组成：伤害词表、学习到的未来可接受性度量、执行否决（execution veto）。用有限角色证书（finite role certificate）支持在声明的"世界族"内迁移；隐藏表示变化时，仅当care readout以规定裕度并以有界权重恢复所需判断才接受更新；给出商条件（quotient condition）实现跨世界族迁移，用双请求与有限库存反例刻画角色编码失效的情形，并给出readout可行性的充要条件，证明重复接受更新下的保持性。

Result: 在水与言语实验中，受保护网络完成全部270个言语回合且未出现伤害性词汇，在486个回合中无可避免伤害；执行时仅用学习到的门控、不做每步世界模型检查。匹配对照复现了未来感知shield的决策，而去掉前瞻则出现可避免失误；奖励与来源污染阈值及证人证伪试验界定了构造依赖的条件。

Conclusion: 研究表明：在表示、监督与执行上有明确条件时，学习到的关怀能在有限世界中经受进一步学习而保持，但需满足角色编码充分性、readout可行性与更新保护等前提。

Abstract: Hinton proposed that artificial intelligence should be given "maternal instincts" and relate to us as a mother to her child. We argue that care must first be learned, with the network itself as the child. We construct this upbringing in a finite world and study whether care survives the mother's departure, new situations and further learning. The mechanism combines a vocabulary of harm, a learned measure of future acceptability and an execution veto. A finite role certificate supports transfer within a declared world family. When the hidden representation changes, an update is accepted only if a care readout recovers the required judgements with a prescribed margin and bounded weights. With a correct successor model, fixed exact role encoding and protected updates, the certified measure preserves the care boundary under arbitrary own reward. An explicit quotient condition transfers the finite certificate across the declared family, while two-request and finite-stock counterexamples identify when the role code ceases to suffice. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for readout feasibility and prove preservation under repeated accepted updates.
