In the water-and-speech experiment, protected networks complete all 270 speech episodes without a harmful word and incur no avoidable harm across 486 episodes. Execution uses the learned gate without a world-model check at each action. A matched comparison reproduces a future-aware shield's decisions, whereas removing future lookahead permits avoidable lapses. Reward and source-contamination thresholds, together with witness-falsification trials, identify the conditions on which the construction depends. The construction shows how learned care can survive further learning in a finite world under explicit conditions on representation, supervision and execution.

</details>


### [446] [Beyond Row-Level Prediction: Evaluating and Learning Composition for Reusable Table Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14697)
*Ali Younes,Saeed Ghoorchian,Maximilian Schambach,Georgia Chalvatzaki,Johannes Höhne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个从一致性、判别性、鲁棒性、效率四个维度评测表级嵌入的基准，发现轻量 schema/文本指纹常优于表格基础模型；并证明瓶颈在"组合规则"而非编码器：冻结 ConTextTab，仅用自监督 SCDM 学习组合规则即可显著提升表级嵌入质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格内容分布在 schema、单元格、行列中，检索、去重、重叠估计等任务需要把局部信号组合为每表一个可复用嵌入向量；但现有表表示方法多在行级预测或监督下游任务上评测，无法直接衡量表级嵌入质量。

Method: 构建表级嵌入基准，按四个要求评测：部分视图一致性、不同标签粒度判别性、良性扰动鲁棒性、效率。在合成与真实语料上比较十二种方法（含 TabPFN、ConTextTab 等表格基础模型，配合均值/最大等五种无参池化）；随后冻结 ConTextTab，仅学习组合规则：提出支持集条件分布匹配（SCDM）自监督损失，使嵌入相似度分布与表内/表间划分重叠分布相匹配。

Result: 轻量 schema 与文本指纹整体最强；TabPFN/ConTextTab 行级预测强但表级嵌入落后。15 种头配置下，学习到的组合规则把嵌入相似度与部分视图重叠的 Spearman 相关从 0.04 提升至合成数据 0.43–0.50，并改善三元组排序、聚类与检索；真实数据增益较小但稳定，父表检索下游任务亦验证此结论。

Conclusion: 表级嵌入质量的关键在于局部状态如何被组合以及所用目标函数，而非仅取决于编码器强度；表级评测应成为表表示方法的标准评价维度。

Abstract: Tables are compositional, with content spread across a schema, cell values, rows, and columns. Large-scale operations such as retrieval, overlap estimation, deduplication, and data curation need these local signals composed into one reusable embedding vector per table. Table representation methods, however, are mostly evaluated through row-level prediction or supervised downstream tasks, which do not measure table-level embedding quality directly. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates table-level embeddings through four desiderata: consistency under partial views, discriminability across label granularities, robustness to benign perturbations, and efficiency. Across twelve methods on synthetic and real corpora, lightweight schema- and text-based fingerprints are among the strongest. The sharpest contrast comes from two tabular foundation models, TabPFN and ConTextTab: although both are strong row-level predictors, their states, composed by mean, max, or three further parameter-free pooling rules, trail the strongest fingerprints. We therefore ask whether the gap lies in the encoder or in the compositional rule. Keeping ConTextTab frozen, we learn only the compositional rule over its cell states, using support-conditioned distribution matching (SCDM), a self-supervised loss we propose that matches the distribution of embedding similarities to the distribution of partition overlaps within and across tables. Across all fifteen head configurations, the learned rule raises the Spearman correlation between embedding similarity and partial-view overlap from 0.04 to 0.43-0.50 on synthetic data and improves triplet ranking, clustering, and retrieval, with smaller but systematic gains on real data. A downstream parent-table retrieval task confirms these findings. How local states are composed, and with what objective, substantially affects the quality of table-level embeddings.

</details>


### [447] [Runtime Analysis of Cartesian Genetic Programming on Max: A Proven Exponential Speedup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16013)
*Duc-Cuong Dang,Roman Kalkreuth,Andre Opris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对笛卡尔遗传编程(CGP)在经典Max问题上给出严格的理论运行时间保证，证明(1+1) CGP期望时间至多O(log^9 n)，相对于树状GP的超线性时间实现了指数级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CGP提出二十年来主要以实证方式研究，缺乏理论性能保证；而Max问题此前仅对树状GP(TGP)有严格分析，其期望运行时间关于最优程序长度n为超线性。作者希望填补CGP理论分析的空白。

Method: 针对Max问题，分析采用常见变异算子的(1+1) CGP的期望运行时间，证明其能进化出输出等价的同一最优表达式的期望时间关于n为多对数级，具体上界为O(log^9 n)；并通过实验验证理论发现。

Result: 证明(1+1) CGP在Max问题上的期望运行时间至多O(log^9 n)，而TGP为超线性，表明切换到CGP可带来指数级加速；实验与理论结论相符。

Conclusion: 这是CGP在公认基准问题上的首个被证明的性能保证，揭示了图基程序表示的紧凑性与优势，以及CGP高效搜索适应度空间的能力。

Abstract: Genetic Programming (GP) is a search paradigm inspired from natural evolution for the automated discovery of expressions, functions, and computer programs. Cartesian GP (CGP) is a flavor of GP that uses a graph-based model to encode candidate programs, as contrasted to the conventional Tree-based GP (TGP). Since its inception two decades ago, CGP has predominantly been analyzed empirically, thus little is known regarding its theoretical performance guarantees. This paper analyzes CGP for the Max problem, which has been only rigorously studied for TGP with a proven expected runtime superlinear in the optimal program length $n$. We prove that the expected time for the ($1$+$1$)~CGP employing common mutation operators to evolve an equivalent optimal of the same output is polylogarithmic in $n$, specifically at most $O(\log^9{n})$. This is remarkable, as it shows an exponential speedup by switching to CGP. Our results shed light on the benefit and the compactness of the graph-based representation for programs, and on how CGP can navigate its search and fitness spaces efficiently. This is a first proven performance guarantee for CGP on an established benchmark problem. Experiments complement our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [448] [Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14704)
*Nhi Nguyen,Shauli Ravfogel,Rajesh Ranganath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"代码解释"(code explanations)：用程序跨数据集解释LLM行为，并通过程序执行实现自动验证，定义Consistency指标衡量程序复现LLM输出的比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM决策日益重要，但CoT等自由文本解释按单实例生成，难以在新输入上验证，与解释的评估方式存在不匹配。

Method: 提出用程序作为LLM行为的解释，程序可覆盖整个数据集并通过执行自动验证；定义Consistency指标（程序复现LLM输出的输入比例）用于评估与筛选候选程序。在3个开源代码型LLM、8个任务上实验，并测试Claude Opus 5.5在一致性反馈与代码执行下的表现。

Result: 部分设置下LLM能生成高度一致的代码解释；代码解释比CoT短6–100倍，在24个设置中有9个更贴合模型行为。但在语言成分复杂的任务上一致性显著下降，程序复现率不高于无信息基线，且常依赖较长的硬编码模式；加入一致性反馈与代码执行可提升一致性，但复杂任务上仍偏低。

Conclusion: 可执行代码是一种新颖、可验证且紧凑的LLM行为解释方式；验证反馈是提升解释一致性的有前景方向。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. However, consistency is significantly lower on tasks with more complex linguistic components, where generated programs reproduce model outputs no more frequently than an uninformative explanation baseline, and these programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns. In experiments with Claude Opus 5.5, providing the model with consistency feedback and code execution improves explanation consistency across tasks, but consistency remains significantly lower on more complex tasks. Our findings establish executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior and highlight verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency. The code for this paper is at https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations.

</details>


### [449] [Optimal feature selection for firewall log analysis using Machine learning and Hybrid Metaheuristic algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16239)
*Seungwoo Han,Gil Hong,Jewan Kim,Jeuk Yu,Sangjun Lee,Byeongok Cho,Jusung Jeon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用Q学习增强的蜂群优化做特征选择(QBSO-FS)，配合RF/KNN/Bernoulli NB对防火墙日志分类；扩展版改用无泄漏的训练/验证/测试协议重新评估，发现所选5–7个特征在去重数据上显著提升Macro-F1，RF达99.90%准确率与94.88% Macro-F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 防火墙日志分类对网络流量监控很重要，机器学习分类器效果不错但高维特征拖慢分类速度；同时作者发现初版预印本在同一5折交叉验证上做特征选择与评估，数据含12.8%完全重复样本，导致评分乐观偏差，因此需要无泄漏的重新评估。

Method: 采用基于Q学习局部搜索的蜂群优化特征选择(QBSO-FS)，搭配随机森林、KNN与Bernoulli朴素贝叶斯，在UCI Internet Firewall数据集上实验；扩展版将数据划分为训练/验证/测试集，仅用验证集选特征，在未触碰的测试集上一次性测量准确率与宏平均指标，并同时评估原始数据与去重预处理数据。

Result: 单次分层划分下QBSO-FS选出5–7个特征；所选子集在两个数据集上均明显提升KNN的Macro-F1，在去重数据上提升RF(8–19个百分点)；原始数据上的RF与Bernoulli NB差异仅0.2–1.5个百分点，可能不稳健。RF用7个特征在去重数据上达99.90%准确率、94.88% Macro-F1，超过以往研究DNN配置的复现结果及其中一项PSO所选特征子集，但该低维数据集上节省的运行时间有限。

Conclusion: 该方法可支持自动防火墙日志分析，但结论仅基于单一划分，多划分/多折评估仍为未来工作；同时也说明无泄漏评估协议对特征选择类研究结论有实质影响。

Abstract: Firewall log classification is important to monitor network traffic. Machine learning classifiers using network-related features have shown good results for this task, but high-dimensional features slow down classification. In this paper, we apply feature selection using bee swarm optimization with Q-learning-based local search (QBSO-FS) to the UCI Internet Firewall Data Set, together with random forest (RF), k-nearest neighbor (KNN), and Bernoulli naïve Bayes (Bernoulli NB) classifiers. The first version of this preprint selected and evaluated feature subsets on the same 5-fold cross-validation of the full data set, which contains 12.8\% exact duplicates; the reported scores are therefore optimistically biased. In this extended version, we re-evaluate the method with a leakage-free protocol: the data are split into training, validation, and test sets, features are selected using the validation set only, and accuracy and macro-averaged scores are measured once on the untouched test set, for both the raw data and a deduplicated, preprocessed version. On a single stratified split, QBSO-FS selects 5--7 features. The selected subsets clearly improve Macro-F1 over all features for KNN on both data sets and for RF on the deduplicated data (by 8--19 percentage points). For RF on the raw data and for Bernoulli NB, the differences (0.2--1.5 percentage points) may not hold for a different split. RF with 7 selected features reaches 99.90\% accuracy and 94.88\% Macro-F1 on the deduplicated data. On the same split, this exceeds our re-implementations of the deep neural network configurations of previous studies and the feature subset selected by particle swarm optimization in one of them, while the run time saved on this low-dimensional data set is small. These results suggest that the method can support automatic firewall log analysis, while evaluation over multiple splits remains future work.

</details>


### [450] [UniPipe: Unified Inference Serving and Fine-Tuning for Deadline-Constrained DNN Surrogate Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14748)
*Jaiaid Mobin,Avinash Maurya,M. Mustafa Rafique,Bogdan Nicolae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniPipe 是一个单 GPU 上下文系统，将 DNN 代理模型的推理服务与微调统一在一次前向传播中完成，从而在边缘 GPU 上兼顾高吞吐与硬性截止时间约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高采样率科学工作流（如 X 射线叠层成像）需在硬性单元截止时间内处理数据。现有方法要么冻结预训练代理导致精度下降，要么用独立 CUDA 上下文并发微调，造成 GPU 资源争用，抬高推理延迟均值与方差，引发截止时间违约。

Method: 基于三点洞见：推理与微调都需前向传播可融合；现代 GPU 单样本延迟随批大小非线性变化；负载跨区间重复可离线调度。据此将训练与推理数据融合为单次前向传播，仅对训练子集做选择性反向传播，并用多项式时间调度器依据延迟曲线计算批组成。

Result: 在真实叠层成像重建工作流（传感器速率达 5000 patterns/s）上评估：重建 MSE 较预训练基线降低最多 30%，推理 MSE 降低最多 50%；截止违约率较多上下文基线降低 13%–22%；延迟离散度从均值的 106% 降至 57%，总吞吐提升。

Conclusion: 通过单上下文统一推理与微调，UniPipe 在保证低延迟与低方差的同时保持代理模型精度，优于多上下文并发方案，适用于近实时高采样率科学成像场景。

Abstract: DNN surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate scientific workflows that must process high-rate sensor streams in near real time, exemplified by Ptychographic imaging at next-generation X-ray light sources. Such surrogates deliver 100-1000x higher throughput than iterative solvers, enabling faster steering of experiments. To preserve surrogate accuracy during an experiment, as the input distribution evolves, state-of-the-art deployments freeze the pretrained surrogate or run a separate CUDA context that fine-tunes concurrently with serving. However, multi-context concurrency causes significant contention on the GPU, inflating both the mean and the variance of inference latency, triggering deadline misses in workflows where sensor data has to be processed within a hard per-unit deadline. To address this challenge, we propose UniPipe, a single-context system that unifies inference serving and fine-tuning of a DNN surrogate on a single edge GPU. UniPipe is driven by three key insights: both serving and fine-tuning require a forward pass and can be fused into one; the per-sample latency of modern GPUs is non-linear in batch size; and the workload is repetitive across intervals, enabling offline scheduling. Specifically, UniPipe fuses training and inference data in a single forward pass with a selective backward pass on the training subset, and uses a polynomial-time scheduler that exploits the latency curve to compute the batch composition. We evaluate UniPipe on a real-world Ptychographic reconstruction workflow with sensor rates up to 5000 patterns/sec.; UniPipe lowers reconstruction MSE by up to 30% and inference MSE by up to 50% over a pretrained baseline, and reduces the deadline-miss rate by 13%-22% over a multi-context baseline. UniPipe's unified deployment reduces the latency spread from 106% to 57% of the mean, and increases total throughput compared to multi-context baseline.

</details>


### [451] [Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17162)
*Anif N. Shikder,Ramit Dey,Jan Minac,Lyle E. Muller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用表示理论刻画SSM状态追踪的失败原因，指出对角实数/复数SSM只能追踪交换群，并提出引入四元数通道的HyperSSM，在保持线性时间推理与并行训练的同时解决非交换群追踪任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSM通过构造对角递推（各通道乘以输入相关的实数或复数）实现高效并行扫描，但这些数可交换，导致状态只记录出现过哪些输入、无法记录其顺序，从而出现状态追踪失败。作者希望从理论上解释这一失败并给出修正方案。

Method: 将状态更新视为输入序列幺半群的线性表示，证明SSM在所有序列长度上追踪某群当且仅当该群是其转移矩阵所生成群的商群；据此推出对角实数/复数SSM只能追踪交换群，而可追踪群的SSM的转移矩阵须在实数、复数、四元数上分解为独立块。基于此提出HyperSSM，在保持线性时间推理与并行训练的前提下加入四元数通道。

Result: HyperSSM仅在最终答案上训练，即用至多五个状态数精确解决近期状态追踪基准中的群任务，包括此前SSM仅达随机水平的32生成元S5任务，并可泛化到训练长度25倍长的序列。此外，由于理论明确了转移矩阵必须编码什么，学习到的线性递推权重可直接解释：作者据此恢复了真实陀螺仪的标定、不完美量子比特门的旋转以及蛋白质骨架的几何结构。

Conclusion: 表示理论给出了SSM状态追踪能力的充要条件，四元数通道是突破交换性限制的关键，HyperSSM兼具效率、表达力与可解释性。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.

</details>


### [452] [From Nodes to Pixels: Topological and Structural Two-View Graph Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14750)
*Md Joshem Uddin,Soham Changani,Sai Karthik Navuluru,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出G2Image——一个固定预算的"图成像"框架，将图转为两张互补图像视图（TopoGrid与GraphGrid），实现类似视觉patch/语言token的可复用图输入接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图学习缺乏类似视觉中patch或语言中token的通用可复用输入接口。图是不规则的、大小密度各异，且对节点标号置换不变，难以跨任务与架构标准化输入。

Method: 将每个图转为两种互补图像视图：TopoGrid通过编码内在双过滤(bifiltration)为紧凑多持续同调(multipersistence)曲面网格，提供稳定拓扑视图；GraphGrid通过聚合由内在节点分数定义的组间边密度，提供高带宽结构视图。两视图均具置换不变性并具有分辨率控制的稳定性保证。得到的固定尺寸张量由轻量2D编码器处理，并通过有监督跨视图对比目标对齐。

Result: 在图分类与分子预测基准上，G2Image在对比方法中取得较强的平均性能，优于单视图与标准融合变体，且无需改动整体架构即可扩展到属性丰富的分子图。

Conclusion: 固定预算的图图像为图表示学习提供了一个实用且可复用的接口。

Abstract: Graph learning still lacks a broadly reusable input interface comparable to patches in vision or tokens in language. Unlike images or text, graphs are irregular, vary in size and density, and are invariant under many equivalent node labelings, making it difficult to standardize inputs across tasks and architectures. We introduce G2Image, a fixed-budget graph imaging framework that converts each graph into two complementary image-like views. TopoGrid provides a stable topological view by encoding an intrinsic bifiltration as a compact multipersistence surface grid, while GraphGrid provides a higher-bandwidth structural view by aggregating edge densities between groups defined by intrinsic node scores. Both views are permutation-invariant and come with resolution-controlled stability guarantees. Because the resulting representations are fixed-size tensors, they can be processed by lightweight 2D encoders and aligned through a supervised cross-view contrastive objective. Across graph classification and molecular prediction benchmarks, G2Image achieves strong average performance among the compared methods, improves over single-view and standard fusion variants, and extends to attribute-rich molecular graphs without changing the overall architecture. These results suggest that fixed-budget graph images offer a practical and reusable interface for graph representation learning.

</details>


### [453] [Graph Label Alignment: A Diagnostic Atlas for Graph Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14760)
*Neelam Akula,Varun Shiralkar,Murat Kantarcioglu,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图标签对齐(SLA/FLA)诊断指标，以数据为中心解释图分类基准难度：高对齐=边际信号即可解，低对齐才需要真正的结构—特征推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图分类基准难度差异巨大，但不确定成功来自真正的结构—特征推理，还是来自受限边际视图（拓扑/节点特征池化）中已可获取的标签信号。作者希望用轻量、无需训练图编码器的诊断来刻画这一区别。

Method: 引入"图标签对齐"诊断，包含两个无需训练图编码器的监督探针：结构标签对齐(SLA，基于置换不变拓扑与谱摘要)与特征标签对齐(FLA，基于去边后的节点特征池化)。在真实基准与多种池化骨干上绘制SLA–FLA平面。另构建受控的交互主导压力测试：异配 ego-graph 与合成 Twins 任务，其类间结构与特征边际匹配但角色—特征耦合不同。

Result: SLA–FLA平面能强有力地组织测试精度；低对齐数据集构成标准池化流程普遍吃力的稳定区域。压力测试表明高对齐可解释大部分简单基准上的表现，而低对齐区域的成功需要保留边际池化之外的结构—特征对应关系。

Conclusion: 基准成功常由边际可及性驱动而非真正图推理；SLA/FLA可作轻量基准诊断工具，低对齐数据与交互主导任务更适合评估模型是否具备超越池化的结构—特征推理能力。

Abstract: Graph classification benchmarks vary widely in difficulty: some are solved by simple pooled baselines, while others remain challenging for GNNs and graph transformers. We take a data-centric view and ask whether benchmark success is driven by genuine structure--feature reasoning or by label signal already accessible from restricted marginal views. We introduce graph label alignment, a lightweight diagnostic that measures label accessibility through two supervised probes computed without training a graph encoder: structural label alignment (SLA), based on permutation-invariant topological and spectral summaries, and feature label alignment (FLA), based on pooled node features with edges removed. Across real graph classification benchmarks and multiple pooled backbones, the resulting SLA--FLA plane strongly organizes test accuracy, with low-alignment datasets forming a consistent regime where standard pooled pipelines struggle. To probe what lies beyond marginal accessibility, we introduce controlled interaction-dominated stress tests, including heterophilic ego-graphs and synthetic Twins tasks whose structural and feature marginals are matched across classes but whose role--feature couplings differ. These results show that high alignment explains much of easy benchmark performance, while low alignment reveals regimes where success requires preserving structure--feature correspondence beyond standard pooled representations.

</details>


### [454] [SPIRE: Task-agnostic embodied continual learning through autonomous situation inference and causal motor-primitive reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14840)
*Yiyang Jia,Mingyang Lyu,Gongce Cao,Feifei Zhao,Yinqian Sun,Yi Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPIRE是一个递归脉冲神经网络系统,能从动作-结果证据中推断潜在情境并无标签地学习情境特定运动执行器,成熟执行器作为受保护来源与新情境残差组合,实现自主恢复与因果复用旧技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身持续学习要求控制器在无任务标签、无已知边界的情况下推断变化情境、保留旧行为并复用运动技能;核心难点在于判断何时恢复早期行为以及哪些技能能支撑新学习。

Method: 提出SPIRE(情境引导的递归具身基元整合):用递归脉冲系统从动作-结果证据推断潜在情境,在线学习情境特定运动actor;成熟actor变为受保护来源,与目标情境残差结合驱动递归脉冲运动群体。

Result: 在坐标、三关节及隐藏力控制任务中,SPIRE保持控制、自主推断情境、保留旧行为,并将学习未见来源组合的平均达标交互次数相对全新控制器降低约40%;回退兼容来源actor的干预均损害早期习得,证明因果复用;对比七个递归持续学习与模块化控制方法,其平均先验学习优势为最强无任务替代方法的2.4倍。

Conclusion: 结果证明在连续具身控制中可实现运动技能的自主恢复与因果复用以支持新学习。

Abstract: Embodied continual learning requires controllers to infer changing situations, retain prior behavior and reuse motor skills without task labels or known boundaries. The challenge is deciding when to recover earlier behavior and which skills can support new learning. We introduce Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment (SPIRE), a recurrent-spiking system that infers latent contexts from action-outcome evidence and learns context-specific motor actors online. Mature actors become protected sources that combine with a target-context residual to drive recurrent-spiking motor populations. Across coordinate, three-joint and hidden-force control, SPIRE maintained control, autonomously inferred situations, retained prior behavior and accelerated acquisition of an unseen source composition, reducing mean interactions to criterion by approximately 40% relative to matched fresh controllers. Rewinding compatible source actors impaired early acquisition in every matched intervention, demonstrating causal reuse. Against seven recurrent continual-learning and modular-control comparators, SPIRE achieved 2.4 times the mean prior-learning advantage of the strongest eligible task-free alternative selected for each paired stream. These results demonstrate autonomous recovery and causal reuse of motor skills for new learning in continuous embodied control.

</details>


### [455] [Generalize Then Personalize: Wearable-Based Heart Rate Forecasting Under Scarce Ruck-March Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14849)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Ruizhe Ma,John W. Ramsay,David J. Cornell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究针对负重行军(rück march)场景下心率预测的数据稀缺问题，比较了仅人群训练(POT)、零基础个性化训练(PFST)、人群预训练+微调(PPFT)三种策略，发现PPFT在LSTM、Attention-LSTM、CNN-LSTM各架构及30s/60s预测窗口下普遍优于另两者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心率预测可为负重行军中的生理监测与负荷管理决策提供前瞻性信息；但大规模行军数据采集困难，形成"数据稀缺"问题——模型需跨受试者泛化，同时仅凭有限个人数据适应个体。

Method: 使用8名美国陆军现役卫生兵、共13次行军会话的数据，在30秒与60秒预测窗口下，将LSTM、Attention-LSTM、CNN-LSTM三种骨干与持续性(persistence)基线对比，基准评估POT、PFST、PPFT三种训练策略（跨3个随机种子平均并做受试者级配对分析与Holm校正）。

Result: 所有架构与窗口下PPFT的平均MAE、RMSE、终点MAE均低于POT与PFST；相对PFST，PPFT轨迹MAE降低2.22–4.30 bpm、终点MAE降低1.24–2.88 bpm；6项轨迹MAE比较经Holm校正后全部显著(p_adj=0.0469)，6项终点MAE中4项显著。30s时持续性基线MAE最低(3.555±1.274 bpm)，CNN-LSTM PPFT的RMSE最低(4.669±1.916)，LSTM PPFT终点MAE最低(5.093±2.365)；60s时Attention-LSTM PPFT的MAE(5.573±1.939)与RMSE(7.134±2.260)最低，CNN-LSTM PPFT终点MAE最低(7.553±2.357)。

Conclusion: 人群预训练后接个体微调可能是数据稀缺条件下可穿戴设备心率预测的实用策略；但短窗口短期预测中持续性基线仍有竞争力，样本量小(8人/13次)限制了结论普适性。

Abstract: Heart rate (HR) forecasting may provide advance information about near-future cardiovascular response, potentially supporting physiological monitoring and workload-management decisions during ruck marching. However, robust model development is constrained by the difficulty of collecting large-scale ruck-march datasets, creating a scarce-data problem in which models must generalize across participants while adapting to individuals from limited personal data. To address this problem, we benchmark population-only training (POT), personalized-from-scratch training (PFST), and population-pretrained fine-tuning (PPFT) for HR forecasting during loaded ruck marching using data from eight active-duty U.S. Army medics across thirteen sessions. LSTM, Attention-LSTM, and CNN-LSTM backbones were evaluated against a persistence baseline at 30 s and 60 s horizons. Across all neural architectures and horizons, PPFT yielded lower mean MAE, RMSE, and endpoint MAE than both POT and PFST. Participant-level paired analysis after averaging across three training seeds showed that, relative to PFST, PPFT reduced trajectory MAE by 2.22-4.30 bpm and endpoint MAE by 1.24-2.88 bpm. All six trajectory-MAE comparisons remained significant after Holm adjustment ($p_{adj}$ = 0.0469), while four of six endpoint-MAE comparisons remained significant after adjustment. At 30 s, persistence achieved the lowest MAE (3.555 $\pm$ 1.274 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest RMSE (4.669 $\pm$ 1.916 bpm); LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (5.093 $\pm$ 2.365 bpm). At 60 s, Attention-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest MAE (5.573 $\pm$ 1.939 bpm) and RMSE (7.134 $\pm$ 2.260 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (7.553 $\pm$ 2.357 bpm). These results suggest that population pretraining followed by participant-specific fine-tuning may provide a practical strategy for scarce-data wearable HR forecasting.

</details>


### [456] [FOE-Dreamer: Deployment-Efficient Learning of Cyber Defense Policies in Operational Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14880)
*Yinuo Du,Christopher Kiekintveld*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FOE-Dreamer是一个基于模型的强化学习框架，让防御者在真实云网络上在线训练而无需模拟器阶段，通过将潜在状态分解为可控、外生和对手嵌入三部分，在8主机OpenStack测试台上3天单GPU内训练，取得约2倍优于Rainbow和IQN的episode loss。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主网络防御多依赖深度强化学习，但训练通常在模拟器中进行，存在保真度差距（认证延迟、部分动作失败、服务依赖、用户流量模式），导致迁移性能下降；而直接在真实网络中训练虽消除差距，却因交互慢且昂贵使样本效率成为瓶颈。基于模型的强化学习已通过在世界模型中规划大幅降低样本需求，但尚未应用于在运营网络中训练的防御者。

Method: 提出FOE-Dreamer（Factored Opponent-Enhanced Dreamer）框架，在云基础设施上在线直接训练防御者，不设模拟器阶段。它将潜在状态中的三类变异分离：由防御者动作驱动的可控分量、由良性用户活动驱动的外生分量，以及仅从防御者可观测信号推断的对手嵌入。这种分解降低了在想象中规划时策略梯度的方差。

Result: 针对两个脚本化攻击者画像，用户活动由GHOSTS框架模拟，在8主机OpenStack测试台上，FOE-Dreamer在单GPU上3天预算内完成训练，在同等算力下episode loss约为Rainbow和IQN基线的2倍改善。分解和对手模型均对增益有贡献，学习到的潜在表示与预期的分离一致。

Conclusion: 基于模型强化学习可在真实运营网络中直接训练自主防御者，通过潜在状态分解与对手建模显著提升样本效率和防御效果，为消除模拟器保真度差距提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Autonomous cyber defense is widely studied with deep reinforcement learning, but most work trains policies inside simulators because learning requires many trial-and-error interactions. Simulator-based training carries a fidelity gap: trained policies face authentication delays, partial action failures, service dependencies, and user traffic patterns that the simulator did not represent, and degrade on transfer. Training directly in the network being defended removes the gap but makes every interaction slow and costly, so sample efficiency becomes the binding constraint. Model-based reinforcement learning has reduced sample requirements on games and physical robots by orders of magnitude by planning inside a learned world model, but it has not been applied to defenders trained in operational networks. We present FOE-Dreamer (Factored Opponent-Enhanced Dreamer), a model-based reinforcement learning framework that trains a defender online and directly in a network on cloud infrastructure, without a simulator stage. FOE-Dreamer separates three sources of variation in the latent state: a controllable component driven by defender actions, an exogenous component driven by benign user activity, and an opponent embedding inferred from defender-observable signals alone. Separating the components reduces the variance in policy gradients during planning in imagination. Against two scripted attacker profiles with user activity emulated by the GHOSTS framework on an 8-host OpenStack testbed, FOE-Dreamer trains within a 3-day budget on a single GPU and achieves about 2$\times$ better episode loss than Rainbow and IQN baselines under matched compute. Both the factoring and the opponent model contribute to the gain, and the learned latents are consistent with the intended separation.

</details>


### [457] [Machine Learning Moment Closure for the Boltzmann Transport Equation: Enforcing Hyperbolicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14894)
*Bongseok Kim,Jiahao Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个多维线性Boltzmann方程Hermite矩系统的数据驱动闭合，通过构造对称正定对称化矩阵保证所有方向的hyperbolicity，在2D过渡与散射主导区实验中以10个矩的3阶系统稳定且精度超P7/P15。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩方法通过演化有限个速度矩降低Boltzmann方程求解成本，但需对未解析高阶矩做闭合。数据驱动闭合虽精度高，但缺乏结构约束会导致复特征速度和数值不稳定。已有保证hyperbolicity的学习型闭合仅限一维，多维下hyperbolicity需在所有方向同时成立，此为待解决的空白。

Method: 网络学习一个在所有空间方向共享的对称正定对称化矩阵（symmetrizer），并限制在保持已知低阶输运方程的子空间上；未解析行通过对成补全（symmetric completion）得到。仅用动力学参考解的未解析矩空间导数训练，训练回路中无求解器；演化采用部分守恒的间断Galerkin方法。

Result: 所有方向Jacobian对任意网络输出和任意截断阶均具实特征值和完备特征向量。二维过渡与散射主导区实验中，单一学习的10矩3阶系统在所有情形下稳定；时间平均精度在每个实验中都优于36矩的P7与136矩的P15，密度误差比同矩数的P3小约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 证实了可构造性地保证hyperbolicity的多维数据驱动矩闭合的可行性，以极低矩数实现高精度稳定模拟，为高维动力学方程的降阶建模提供了结构约束与数据驱动结合的新范式。

Abstract: The Boltzmann transport equation describes particle transport across collisional regimes, but resolving its velocity dependence is expensive. Moment methods reduce this cost by evolving finitely many velocity moments, requiring a closure for unresolved higher-order moments. Data-driven closures can represent these moments accurately, yet without structural constraints they may produce complex characteristic speeds and unstable simulations. Learned Boltzmann closures with guaranteed hyperbolicity have so far been formulated in one spatial dimension; in multiple dimensions, hyperbolicity must hold in every direction simultaneously. We develop, to the best of our knowledge, the first data-driven closure for multidimensional Hermite moment systems of the linear Boltzmann equation that is hyperbolic by construction. The network learns a symmetric positive-definite symmetrizer shared by all spatial directions and restricted to a subspace that preserves the known lower-order transport equations; the unresolved rows follow from a symmetric completion. Every directional Jacobian thus has real eigenvalues and a complete set of eigenvectors for every network output and at any truncation order. The closure is trained only on spatial derivatives of unresolved moments from kinetic reference solutions, with no solver in the training loop, and evolved by a partially conservative discontinuous Galerkin method. In two-dimensional experiments in the transition and scattering-dominated regimes, a single learned third-order system with ten moments remains stable in all cases. Averaged over time, it is more accurate than the classical P7 and P15 truncations with 36 and 136 moments in every experiment, and its density error is about two orders of magnitude smaller than that of the P3 truncation with the same moments.

</details>


### [458] [Social Engineering Attack Detection in Corporate Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14897)
*Hanzla Hamid,Pappu Jha,Nick Rahimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文利用真实数据集构建机器学习模型检测社会工程学钓鱼邮件，在TF-IDF词袋模型达到90%以上准确率的基础上，进一步提取紧迫感、信任、贪婪等心理学说服性词汇指标，证明操纵性特征本身具有可检测信号（ROC-AUC 0.74）并检验其跨数据源迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会工程学攻击日益复杂化，邮件、聊天与电话中的真实钓鱼通信难以与正常通信区分，可能泄露商业机密并形成从基层员工到高管的攻击链，因此需要可解释、可迁移的检测手段。

Method: 使用真实世界数据集训练基线机器学习模型；先用TF-IDF特征进行钓鱼/安全邮件二分类；再从合并邮件数据集中基于词典提取紧迫感、信任、贪婪等心理操纵与说服线索的可解释特征；单独评估这些操纵导向特征并测试其向未见邮件来源的迁移性。

Result: TF-IDF分类模型准确率超过90%；仅使用操纵性词典特征即可在留出测试集上取得ROC-AUC 0.74，具备显著检测信号，并进一步检验了跨邮件来源的迁移表现。

Conclusion: 超越表层词汇特征、引入心理学说服指标可有效补充钓鱼检测，且具有一定跨源泛化与可解释性潜力，为构建更鲁棒的社会工程学防御模型提供了依据。

Abstract: Social Engineering attacks continue to pose a significant risk to the corporate world with a growing level of sophistication. It is difficult to distinguish between authentic and phishing communication via email, chat, and phone. They pose a risk of exposing trade secrets and confidential communications and can create a chain of attack from lower-level employees up to executives. Therefore, we study this growing threat using real-world datasets to build baseline machine-learning models. Our TF-IDF models classify emails as phishing or safe, achieving accuracy above 90%. We build on this by exploring whether psychological manipulation and persuasion indicators can be measured to play a significant role in detecting phishing. Instead of relying solely on surface-level lexical features, we derive interpretable lexicon-based indicators of urgency, trust, greed, and other persuasion cues from the combined email dataset. By evaluating these manipulation-oriented features on their own, we measure how much signal they carry (ROC-AUC of 0.74 on a held-out test split) and test whether they transfer to held-out email sources.

</details>


### [459] [Epigraph Form Reinforcement Learning-based Safe Trajectory Tracking Control for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14903)
*Xiaoke Yang,Jin Chen,Yafei Wang,Qi Zhang,Ming Li,Haiwen Wu,Chengliang Yin,Yong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STTC-EFRL框架，将安全轨迹跟踪(STT)问题建模为上图形式(epigraph-form)的min-max优化，用递减标量调节策略梯度方向而非放大梯度幅度，实现更稳定的DRL训练，并设计高效光线投射法量化安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网联自动驾驶(CAV)在高动态环境下的安全轨迹跟踪很具挑战：非学习方法用简化车辆/交互模型以满足实时性，导致跟踪精度次优；DRL虽可弥补，但常用Lagrangian方法因拉格朗日乘子增大而放大策略梯度幅度，训练不稳定。

Method: 提出STT Control Epigraph Form RL (STTC-EFRL)框架：将STT问题表述为epigraph-form min-max优化；基于该表述设计学习机制，用与epigraph相关的递减标量调整策略梯度下降方向（不增大梯度幅度）；并提出计算高效的光线投射(ray-casting)方法计算多面体缩放因子以量化安全性。

Result: 实验（含Vehicle-in-the-Loop测试）表明：STTC-EFRL相比所考虑的非学习基线具有更高跟踪精度，相比常用Lagrangian DRL方法训练更稳定，同时在网联环境中满足安全要求。

Conclusion: 通过epigraph形式重构与梯度机制改进，STTC-EFRL在精度、训练稳定性和安全性上均优于对比方法，具备实际部署（VIL验证）可行性。

Abstract: Safe trajectory tracking (STT) aims to enable autonomous vehicles to follow a reference trajectory accurately while avoiding collisions. This problem is particularly challenging for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) in highly dynamic environments. Existing non-learning-based STT methods often use simplified vehicle and interaction models to meet real-time requirements, which may result in suboptimal tracking accuracy. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) can help address this limitation, widely used Lagrangian DRL methods often suffer from unstable training because increasing Lagrange multipliers amplify policy-gradient magnitudes. To address these issues, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for STT, called STT Control Epigraph Form RL (STTC-EFRL). In this framework, the STT problem is formulated as an epigraph-form min-max optimization problem. Based on this formulation, we develop a learning mechanism that uses a decreasing scalar related to the epigraph to adjust the policy gradient descent direction without increasing the gradient magnitude, thereby improving training stability. We also develop a computationally efficient ray-casting method to compute a polyhedron scaling factor for safety quantification. Experimental results, including Vehicle-in-the-Loop tests, show that STTC-EFRL achieves higher tracking accuracy than the considered non-learning-based baseline and more stable training than widely used Lagrangian DRL methods, while satisfying safety requirements in connected environments.

</details>


### [460] [Rethinking "RL Generalizes, SFT Memorizes": The Role of SFT Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14912)
*Yunlong Hou,Fengzhuo Zhang,Yuan Cheng,Jiachun Pan,Xingyao Li,Zhuoran Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从SFT训练数据的角度重新审视SFT与RL在泛化上的差异，发现通过精心混合的数据源并匹配RL的rollout规模/预算，SFT的泛化能力可以不逊于甚至超过RL，且尾部解法方法提供了可泛化的推理信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 普遍观点认为基于可验证奖励的RL训练赋予模型强推理与泛化能力，而SFT更易记忆、迁移性差。作者希望从SFT训练数据（来源与规模）的角度重新审视这一区别，厘清差异究竟来自训练范式还是数据属性。

Method: 在Qwen2.5与Qwen3系列模型上进行受控实验：(1) 研究数据来源，比较精心混合的SFT数据与仅由更大模型生成的数据；(2) 研究数据规模，匹配SFT与RL的正确rollout数量及总rollout预算；(3) 用LLM标注刻画rollout中的解法方法，分析长尾方法的覆盖与作用；(4) 在浅层Transformer上理论分析RL与SFT的训练动力学。

Result: 数据来源关键：精心混合的SFT数据集显著优于仅大模型生成的数据。规模方面：匹配正确rollout数量即大幅提升SFT泛化；匹配总rollout预算可使SFT泛化达到RL水平；两者结合可使SFT泛化优于RL。LLM标注显示更大数据集覆盖更多长尾方法，且这些长尾方法提供可泛化的推理信号，理论分析也支持上述实证发现。

Conclusion: SFT与RL的泛化差距很大程度上源于训练数据的来源与规模而非范式本身；当数据源多样、正确rollout与总预算匹配RL时，SFT可实现甚至超越RL的泛化，长尾解法方法是关键因素，并得到理论支持。

Abstract: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable rewards exhibit strong reasoning ability and broad generalization, whereas models trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) are often viewed as more prone to memorization and limited transfer. This paper rethinks this distinction through the lens of SFT training data on widely used Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. First, we study the role of data source and show that it is critical: a carefully mixed SFT dataset substantially outperforms data generated solely by a larger model. Second, we study the role of data scale and show that matching the number of correct rollouts between SFT and RL greatly improves SFT generalization, while matching the total rollout budget enables SFT to generalize as well as RL. Combining these two factors further enables SFT to generalize even better than RL. Third, by using LLM annotations to characterize the solution methods in training rollouts, we show that larger datasets cover more tail methods and that these tail methods provide generalizable reasoning signals. Finally, we support these empirical findings theoretically by analyzing the training dynamics of shallow transformers under both RL and SFT.

</details>


### [461] [A Transferable Pretrained 3D Model for Impedance Inversion with Sparse-Well Prior Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14922)
*Gen Li,Zhaoyun Zong,Diqiong Jiang,Man Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可迁移三维地震阻抗反演框架，将离线学习与目标工区部署分离：MAE自监督学结构表征，冻结编码器训练反演网络，部署时不重训，仅用井构建低频先验并对齐阻抗范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习地震阻抗反演通常需针对每个目标工区重新训练，且在井控极稀疏时难以泛化到远离井的位置。

Method: 一，掩码自编码器在多工区无标签数据上学习地震结构表征。二，冻结该编码器并嵌入反演网络，用合成地质模型及稀疏井低频先验训练。三，部署时反演网络完全固定，仅用可用井构建低频先验并对齐全局阻抗范围。

Result: Overthrust模型上取得最低全体积NRMSE，P95道级NRMSE由0.1310降至0.1074（相对最佳目标域训练基线），局部大误差更少且对不同井位稳健。实际工区（1口条件井+3口盲井）中，盲井平均NRMSE较目标域训练U-Net降低20.95%，相关性最高。

Conclusion: 该框架可将有效阻抗信息迁移至条件井之外的位置，部署成本低且无需重训反演网络。

Abstract: Deep-learning-based seismic impedance inversion commonly requires retraining for each target survey, which may generalize poorly beyond the conditioning locations when well control is extremely sparse. We propose a transferable three-dimensional inversion framework that separates offline learning from target-survey deployment. A masked autoencoder first learns seismic structural representations from unlabeled multi-survey data, after which the frozen encoder is incorporated into an inversion network trained on synthetic geological models with sparse-well-derived low-frequency priors. During deployment, the complete inversion network remains fixed; the available conditioning well is used only to construct the low-frequency prior and align the global impedance range. Experiments on the Overthrust model show that the proposed method achieves the lowest full-volume NRMSE and reduces the P95 trace-wise NRMSE from 0.1310 to 0.1074 relative to the best target-trained baseline, indicating fewer localized large errors under different well locations. In a field survey with one conditioning well and three blind wells, it reduces the mean blind-well NRMSE by 20.95% relative to the target-trained U-Net while maintaining the highest correlation. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework transfers useful impedance information beyond the conditioning location with low deployment cost and without retraining the inversion network.

</details>


### [462] [Binding Mode Matters: Hotspot-Aware Drug Discovery via Explorative Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14956)
*Dingshuo Chen,Hao Yang,Kuangqi Zhou,Zhixun Li,Qiang Liu,Xiangxiang Zeng,Shu Wu,Yaosen Min*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BindMol，将基于靶点的药物设计重构为多目标探索问题，用定制多目标强化学习生成兼具高亲和力、新颖性和多样结合模式的分子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成方法主要优化单一标量对接分数，掩盖了关键结合决定因素（hotspot）各自的贡献，难以获得多样的结合模式，而后者对实验验证至关重要。

Method: 将靶点药物设计表述为多目标探索任务，每个目标对应增强与某一特定hotspot的相互作用；提出BindMol生成框架，由定制的多目标强化学习算法驱动，并在训练中引入探索性偏好以高效发现具有多样且理想结合特征的分子。

Result: 实验表明BindMol能发现兼具结构新颖性与多样结合模式的高亲和力化合物，并在基于靶点的药物发现和多属性优化任务中均得到验证。

Conclusion: 以hotspot为多目标的重构思路为面向目标的药物发现提供了通用范式，可作为标量对接优化的替代方案。

Abstract: Discovering hit molecules requires not just high binding affinity, but also the identification of diverse binding modes, which are critical for experimental assays. Existing generative approaches have predominantly relied on optimizing a scalar docking score, obscuring the distinct contributions of key binding determinants. To this end, we introduce a paradigm shift by formulating target-based drug design as a multi-objective exploration task, where each objective explicitly corresponds to enhancing interactions with a specific hotspot. Here, we introduce BindMol, a novel generative framework driven by a customized multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm. By incorporating explorative preferences during training, our approach efficiently uncovers molecules with diverse and desirable binding profiles. Empirical results demonstrate that BindMol facilitates the discovery of high-affinity compounds characterized by both structural novelty and diverse binding modes. Validated across target-based drug discovery and multi-property optimization tasks, our approach provides a versatile paradigm for goal-oriented drug discovery.

</details>


### [463] [Wayfinder: Adaptive Resource Routing from Agent Citations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16053)
*Miguel Romero,George Karypis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Wayfinder 是一种自适应路由器，利用下游智能体引用的文档作为反馈来更新资源表示，从而在连续交互中优先路由到可能含相关信息的资源；并引入离线强化学习中的资源增强以减少过拟合，同时在三个受控测试台上取得最佳路由效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体需要跨聊天、issue 跟踪器、邮件、知识库等多种资源收集上下文，但不知道信息所在位置，导致在连续交互中反复探索相同资源。现有路由方法把每个资源当作工具，依赖高层描述泛化到新环境，难以区分相似或重叠资源，且无法从后续交互中学习改进。

Method: 提出 Wayfinder 自适应路由器：以下游智能体引用的文档作为"相关信息所在位置"的反馈，据此更新内部资源表示，供后续交互优先选择可能含相关信息的资源。同时提出离线强化学习中的资源增强：匿名化并置换资源身份，以抑制训练时对"哪个资源存放哪个主题"的过拟合（消融显示在训练环境较少时收益最大）。并构建三个受控测试台：NFCorpus、FEVER、Tech Startup。

Result: 在统一的闭环协议下，与监督式、工具检索、上下文老虎机等基线相比：当资源内容语义重叠、静态描述无法区分时，Wayfinder 路由效果最佳；而当资源来自不同语料库时，基于描述的工具检索已足够。

Conclusion: 利用下游引用作为反馈的自适应路由在资源语义重叠场景下优于静态描述方法，资源增强有助于减少过拟合；同时现有静态工具检索在资源区分明显时仍具竞争力，路由方法适用性取决于资源间语义重叠程度。

Abstract: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions. Common routing approaches represent each resource as a tool and rely on high-level descriptions to generalize to unseen environments. Such descriptions often fail to separate similar or overlapping resources and cannot improve from the agent's subsequent interactions. We introduce Wayfinder, an adaptive router that uses the documents cited by the downstream agent as feedback about where relevant information resides. These citations update Wayfinder's internal resource representations, which subsequent interactions use to prioritize the resources likely to contain relevant information. We also introduce resource augmentation during offline reinforcement learning, which anonymizes and permutes resource identities to discourage training-time overfitting of which resource holds which topic; our ablations suggest it helps most when few training environments are available. Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup. Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.

</details>


### [464] [Poison-then-Hide: Finetuning-Activated Backdoor Attack on Pretrained Vision Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14970)
*Qixuan Jin,Abinitha Gourabathina,Vinith Menon Suriyakumar,Walter Gerych,Marzyeh Ghassemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Poison-then-Hide，一种在预训练编码器中植入休眠后门、并可在全域微调（含域迁移）后仍被激活的隐蔽后门攻击方法，攻击成功率最高达 97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"微调激活型"后门攻击假设域偏移有限或编码器层被冻结，因此在全模型微调场景下常常失效。作者希望构造一种隐蔽攻击：后门潜伏在预训练编码器中，随后仅通过干净下游数据微调即可被激活。

Method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) 触发器优化；(2) 基础编码器投毒；(3) 定向遗忘（targeted unlearning）以隐藏后门。关键发现是：将良性目标任务与投毒联合学习对攻击成功至关重要。

Result: 在 6 个数据集和 3 种模型架构上评估，取得最高约 97% 的攻击成功率，达到 SOTA。同时表明标准检测与缓解防御无法完全去除后门，后门在良性微调后可重新出现。

Conclusion: 全模型微调与域迁移下的后门威胁依然严重，"投毒+隐藏"策略具备强鲁棒性与隐蔽性，现有防御不足以应对，需重新审视预训练编码器供应链安全。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks threaten the integrity of machine learning models by allowing attackers to control model behavior through triggers. Models can be compromised during finetuning by backdoor attacks through either poisoned data or adversarial training objectives. Because existing finetuning-activated attacks assume limited domain shift or frozen encoder layers, they often fail under full-model finetuning. We target a stealthy finetuning-activated attack where a dormant backdoor is implanted in a pretrained encoder, and later activated by finetuning on clean downstream data. We propose Poison-then-Hide, a novel attack that remains effective when the entire model is finetuned in a domain transfer. Our approach consists of three components: trigger optimization, base encoder poisoning, and targeted unlearning to conceal the backdoor. We evaluate our method on six datasets and three model architectures, and achieve state-of-the-art (up to 97%) attack success rates. We find that jointly learning the benign target task alongside the poisoning is critical to the attack's success. We demonstrate standard detection and mitigation defenses cannot fully remove the backdoor, which can reappear after benign finetuning.

</details>


### [465] [EASTAR: Event-Anchored Semantic and Task-Adaptive Region Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14990)
*Peng Liang,Genan Dai,Bowen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EASTAR 用线下活动事件作为稀疏语义锚点，将聚合的出行表示分解为多目的语义通道（外加自由通道和全局通道），并用基于 LLM 先验的任务自适应提示路由器适配下游任务，在两个城市数据集四类任务上显著优于基线（MAE 最多降 39.15%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于出行的城市区域表示多从聚合 OD 矩阵学习，不同活动目的的出行被混合为与目的无关的交互模式；POI、土地利用等静态属性虽能补充语义，却无法显式地将出行交互锚定到活动目的信号上，导致下游适配只能在纠缠嵌入上进行，难以选取任务相关的功能语义。

Method: 提出事件锚定且任务自适应的框架 EASTAR：以线下活动事件作为稀疏语义锚点，将聚合出行表示分解为多个与目的相关的语义通道；引入自由通道捕捉事件未覆盖的潜在出行模式，并设全局通道保留整体空间结构；设计任务自适应提示路由器，用 LLM 导出的先验初始化任务—通道相关性，再通过下游监督精化路由权重。

Result: 在两个真实城市数据集、四类预测任务上，EASTAR 一致优于代表性基线，MAE 最大降低 39.15%；消融与可解释性分析验证了事件锚定、语义通道构建和任务自适应路由的有效性。

Conclusion: 将出行交互显式锚定到活动目的语义，并结合任务自适应通道路由，可有效缓解表示纠缠问题，提升城市区域表示在多任务下游场景中的性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Urban region representation learning supports a wide range of urban analytics tasks by encoding regional functions and interactions, with human mobility serving as a central signal because it directly captures inter-region interactions. However, most mobility-based methods learn from aggregated origin-destination matrices, where trips driven by different activity purposes are mixed into purpose-agnostic interaction patterns. Although static urban attributes such as POIs and land use can enrich region-level semantics, they do not explicitly ground mobility interactions in activity-purpose signals. As a result, downstream adaptation is often performed over entangled embeddings, making it difficult to select task-relevant functional semantics. To address these limitations, we propose EASTAR, an event-anchored and task-adaptive framework for urban region representation learning. EASTAR treats offline activity events as sparse semantic anchors and uses them to factorize aggregated mobility representations into multiple purpose-related semantic channels. It further introduces free channels to capture latent mobility patterns not covered by event data and a global channel to preserve overall spatial structure. To adapt the learned channel space to different downstream objectives, EASTAR designs a task-adaptive prompt router that initializes task-channel relevance from LLM-derived priors and refines the routing weights through downstream supervision. Experiments on two real-world urban datasets across four prediction tasks show that EASTAR consistently outperforms representative baselines, achieving up to 39.15% reduction in MAE. Ablation and interpretability analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness of event anchoring, semantic channel construction, and task-adaptive routing.

</details>


### [466] [AI4Plasma I: Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling of Capacitively Coupled Plasma Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15002)
*Zhenyu Zou,Junjue Liao,Hao Yang,Luowei Yin,Chenyu Wang,Yufeng Wei,Zhichao Peng,Chun Chen,Daniel Zhengyu Huang,Kangxin Liu,Haoran Guan,Rubing Han,Yipei Chen,Peiting You,Yuwei Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对比五类代理模型（Coordinate MLP、PCA-Net、U-Net、FNO、Transolver）在CCP等离子体场预测中的数据效率，FNO在八项比较中七项达到最低或并列最低参考算例需求，被推荐为数据高效基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参照性CCP仿真能给出空间分辨的等离子体场，但跨工况生成成本高昂，因此需要评估不同代理架构的数据效率，以少量参考仿真达到目标精度。

Method: 在1D平面与2D轴对称GEC CCP基准上，预测RF周期平均的电子密度、离子密度、电势和电子温度；统计达到1%与2%平均相对L2误差所需的参考仿真数量，区分参数内部与参数边界测试情形，并分析各架构的特定机制（FNO谱模态与padding、U-Net跳连、Transolver自适应切片、PCA-Net投影误差与预测误差）。

Result: FNO在8项比较中7项需求最低或并列最低。1D中FNO用50个训练算例达1%内部误差，Transolver需100、U-Net需200；2D中FNO与U-Net各用100算例达1%内部误差，FNO与Transolver各用200算例达2%边界误差（U-Net需400）；更严格的1% 2D边界目标下Transolver需400、FNO需800。

Conclusion: 在所测试的CCP设置下FNO是数据高效的基线架构，但最优架构取决于精度目标与参数区域：如最严格边界精度下Transolver更优。

Abstract: Reference capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) simulations provide spatially resolved plasma fields but are costly to generate across operating conditions. We compare the data efficiency of five surrogate architectures--Coordinate MLP, PCA-Net, U-Net, Fourier neural operator (FNO), and Transolver--for predicting RF-cycle-averaged electron density, ion density, electric potential, and electron temperature in 1D planar and 2D axisymmetric GEC CCP benchmarks. We assess the number of reference simulations needed to achieve 1% and 2% mean relative L2 error for parameter-interior and parameter-boundary test cases, and examine architecture-specific mechanisms. FNO achieves the lowest or joint-lowest reference-case requirement in seven of eight comparisons. In 1D, FNO reaches 1% interior error with 50 training cases, compared with 100 for Transolver and 200 for U-Net. In 2D, FNO and U-Net each reach 1% interior error with 100 cases; FNO and Transolver each reach 2% parameter-boundary error with 200 cases, compared with 400 for U-Net. At the stricter 1% 2D parameter-boundary target, Transolver requires 400 cases versus 800 for FNO. Additional analyses investigate FNO spectral modes and padding, U-Net skip connections, Transolver adaptive slicing, and PCA-Net projection versus prediction error. The results support FNO as a data-efficient baseline for the tested CCP settings, while showing that the preferred architecture depends on the accuracy target and operating-parameter region.

</details>


### [467] [A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15004)
*Cheol-Hui Lee,Wookyung Kim,Hyeonhoon Lee,Garam Lee,Da-in Eun,Hyung-Chul Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARMEN 是一个在十种心肺波形（227 万模态小时）上无标签预训练的单编码器基础模型，可接受任意共记录信号组合（10 秒至 5 分钟），通过 LSCNorm 恢复归一化丢失的绝对信号水平，在 19 项任务上超越监督模型与三个现有基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生理波形基础模型几乎只基于 ECG 和 PPG，而动脉压、静脉压、肺动脉压、颅内压和呼吸机波形同样指导手术室与 ICU 决策；且常规归一化会抹去对低血压等判断至关重要的绝对信号水平。

Method: 在十种心肺波形（2.27 百万模态小时）上无标签预训练单一编码器；支持任意共记录信号组合与 10 秒至 5 分钟时长；引入条件机制 LSCNorm 恢复被归一化去除的绝对信号水平；以冻结编码器在韩国与美国队列的 19 项任务上评估。

Result: 冻结编码器在 15 项任务中的 12 项优于监督模型，在 19 项中的 14–17 项优于三个基础模型（一个通用、两个生物信号专用），且无任何任务被超越；去除 LSCNorm 后术中低血压 AUROC 从 0.894 降至 0.780；仅给 ECG 或 PPG 时多数比较中达到或超过专用基础模型；通道缺失时性能保持。

Conclusion: 多模态心肺波形预训练可泛化至跨中心、跨任务的临床预测，绝对水平建模与通道缺失鲁棒性是关键设计，单一编码器有望成为生理波形领域的通用基础模型。

Abstract: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram. We present CARMEN, a single encoder pretrained without labels on ten cardiorespiratory waveforms (2.27 million modality-hours). CARMEN accepts any combination of co-recorded signals from 10 s to 5 min, and a conditioning mechanism, LSCNorm, restores the absolute signal level that normalization removes; without it, the AUROC for intraoperative hypotension fell from 0.894 to 0.780. Across 19 tasks from Korean and US cohorts, the frozen encoder outperformed supervised models on 12 of 15 and three foundation models, one general-purpose and two for biosignals, on 14 to 17 of 19, with none exceeding it on any task. Given the electrocardiogram or photoplethysmogram alone, it matched or exceeded signal-specific foundation models in most comparisons, and it retained its performance when channels were missing.

</details>


### [468] [From Forecasting to World Modeling: Can Temporal Foundation Models Recover Causal Response?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15009)
*Juwon Hong,Minha Hwang,Venkatesh Shankar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文评估表格与时间序列基础模型（含专门预训练的因果基础模型）在零售价格弹性估计上的表现，发现预测精度与因果效应精度不一致，并揭示上下文与工具变量使用的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确预测销量并不等于正确理解销量如何随价格变化；商家若误判价格效应会做出错误决策。需检验当前基础模型在因果（价格效应）估计上的可靠性。

Method: 在已知真实效应的模拟数据与真实零售销售记录上，对比评估已发布的表格基础模型、时间序列基础模型，以及专门为因果效应估计预训练的基础模型；考察增加上下文信息、以及以不同形式提供工具变量对效应估计误差的影响。

Result: 三项发现：(1) 预测精度不能指示价格效应估计精度，模拟与真实数据皆然；(2) 对表格基础模型，更多上下文改善预测但不改善价格效应估计；(3) 工具变量仅在特定形式下降低误差，在混杂情形下以原始工具变量形式提供时对所有模型都增大误差。

Conclusion: 预测能力无法替代因果识别；简单增加上下文或直接喂入工具变量并不能修复因果估计，需谨慎设计与特定的工具变量使用形式。

Abstract: A model that forecasts sales accurately can still mislead a retailer about how sales respond to a price change. We evaluate released tabular and time-series foundation models, as well as a foundation model pretrained specifically to estimate causal effects. We report three findings. First, forecast accuracy does not indicate the accuracy of the predicted effect of price, both on simulated data in which the true effect is known and on real retail sales records. Second, for the tabular foundation models, additional context improves forecasts but not the predicted effect of price. Third, instrumental variables, the standard remedy in econometrics, reduce this error only when supplied in a specific form and increase it for every model under confounding when supplied as raw instruments.

</details>


### [469] [SkinAdvisor: An AI-Driven Decision Framework for Skin Production Planning via Multi-Modal Transformer Sales Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15023)
*Ge Fan,Kai Wang,Chaoyun Zhang,Yingjie Li,Yuze Liu,Junyang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SkinAdvisor 决策框架与其核心预测模型 SkinCast，用多模态 Transformer 预测未发布皮肤未来 180 天的逐日销量轨迹，并接入 ROI 排序的生产流水线，已上线一个完整发布周期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代网络游戏中皮肤是主要收入来源，但"做哪些皮肤、何时发布、如何定价"等生产决策仍依赖直觉与事后分析，缺乏前瞻性的销量预测与 ROI 评估手段。

Method: SkinCast 由四个编码器组成：预训练 Informer 编码玩家偏好时间序列、预训练 Player-Hero-Skin 图嵌入提供关系先验、两个轻量 Transformer 分别编码皮肤属性与发布上下文；经带局部+全局 day-x 位置编码的共享主干融合，由 N 层 Informer 解码器单次非自回归输出 180 天逐日销量。SkinAdvisor 将预测接入 Select→Fill→Infer→Sales→ROI→Ranking 服务流水线，按预测 ROI 排序候选皮肤并支持多方案比较。

Result: 离线实验中 RMSE 较最强基线 Informer 降低约 20%，较经典方法降低约 60%；16 核 CPU 压力测试下 p99 延迟低于 8ms、峰值吞吐超过 1100 rps；系统已完整运行一个发布周期。

Conclusion: 两条部署经验：生产决策只需数量级精度的预测即可；预训练嵌入可能泄露时序信息，需采用按赛季划分数据来规避。

Abstract: Skins, cosmetic in-game items, are a primary revenue stream for modern online games, yet production decisions (which skins to make, when to release, how to price) remain driven by intuition and retrospective analytics. We present SkinAdvisor, an AI-driven decision framework for skin production planning, powered by SkinCast, a deployed multi-modal Transformer forecasting 180-day per-day sales trajectories for unreleased skins. SkinCast couples four encoders: a pretrained Informer for player-preference time series, a pretrained Player-Hero-Skin graph embedder for relational priors, and two lightweight Transformers for skin attributes and release context, fused through a shared backbone with a local-plus-global day-x positional encoding and decoded by an N-layer Informer in a single non-autoregressive pass. SkinAdvisor plugs these forecasts into a serving pipeline (Select -> Fill -> Infer -> Sales -> ROI -> Ranking) that ranks candidate skins by forecast-based ROI and supports multi-candidate comparison. The system has been in production for a full release cycle. Offline experiments show SkinCast reduces RMSE by ~20% over the strongest baseline (Informer) and ~60% over classical methods; stress tests on a 16-core CPU server confirm p99 latency under 8ms and peak throughput above 1100 rps. We report two deployment lessons: order-of-magnitude accuracy suffices for production decisions, and pretrained embeddings can leak temporal information, requiring season-based splitting to prevent.

</details>


### [470] [Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15029)
*Gaurav Sarkar,Syed Affan Daimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MPPA（掩码模式位置增强），一种面向扩散大语言模型的无训练长上下文外推方法：先线性插值位置索引进预训练窗口，再依据累积掩码密度加入逐位置、逐步长的偏移，在 2 倍窗口（8192）下显著降低困惑度并保持检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）采用双向注意力迭代解掩码，但 RoPE 仍将其限制在固定预训练窗口。现有无训练外推方法（如 LongLLaDA）直接照搬自回归模型的 NTK-RoPE 缩放，对所有位置、所有去噪步施加同一静态、仅与长度相关的变换，忽略了 dLLM 独有的信号——部分解码序列中不断演化的掩码模式。

Method: MPPA 由两步组成：(1) 将位置索引线性插值到预训练窗口内；(2) 依据累积掩码密度为每个位置、每个去噪步添加偏移量。该偏移可恢复插值所造成的旋转相位分辨率损失，并随 token 被确定而衰减，使后期步骤接近干净的插值几何。全程无需训练。

Result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上，于 4096 窗口的 2 倍长度（8192 token）测试：困惑度从标准解码的 19.51 降至 3.12，甚至优于窗口内水平；passkey 检索准确率 100%，needle-in-a-haystack 准确率不变。

Conclusion: 初步的 2 倍外推结果支持"掩码条件驱动的位置工程"作为扩散模型原生的长上下文生成路径。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

</details>


### [471] [AROMA: Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation for Vision-Language Model Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15041)
*Zhaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出AROMA，一个冻结视觉语言模型的控制框架，将"在哪里干预、用什么几何与增益、如何到达目标、追求哪个目标、何时行动"分解为五个独立问题；在Llama-3.2-11B-Vision上通过幅度归一化的因果子空间激活，显著提升精确计数准确率与目标可达率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制可解释性中的"定位"本身不足以保证可用控制：因果敏感度可能只占很小的激活能量、局部准确方向在有限尺度下可能失效、可达的数值目标也可能是错误目标。因此需要把定位、驱动、可达性、目标质量与选择性部署明确区分并分别解决。

Method: 提出AROMA（自适应表示导向的多模态驱动）框架，保持VLM冻结，分离五个环节：干预位置、几何与增益、目标到达方式、目标选择、行动时机。核心包括：在因果验证的跨注意力头上识别解释基数敏感性的四维方向；采用幅度归一化的因果子空间驱动，把"解释能量占比低"的不匹配转化为有限尺度上可用的控制；以及迭代最小努力驱动（MEA）在给定步数预算内逐步逼近目标。

Result: 在Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct中，因果验证的跨注意力头的四个维度解释89.82%的基数敏感度，但仅占中位激活能量的9.52%；幅度归一化驱动后在未触碰的过程数据上精确计数提升+8.00个百分点。迭代MEA在相同步数预算下达到81.25%的oracle目标（冻结方向仅15.18%）。目标与门控冻结后评估：新自然Stage-2队列（N=630）上从34.444%提升至38.730%（配对p=4.63e-7）；全部7,992例上65.741%对65.153%，且仅编辑63个输入。

Conclusion: 定位、驱动、可达性、目标质量与选择性部署是彼此不同的控制问题，需分别刻画与优化；AROMA表明在冻结VLM中，正确的几何与增益归一化、迭代式最小努力驱动及冻结目标/门控的设计能把机制发现转化为有限且可部署的控制增益。

Abstract: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.

</details>


### [472] [PhysXAI: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Physical Hallucinations in Weather Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15053)
*Anjan Mahapatra,Nikhil Raj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PhysXAI，一个可学习的诊断框架，用于检测、定位并归因全球天气预报模型输出的"物理幻觉"（违反质量守恒、静力平衡、谱能量标度等物理规律的状态），将预报误差与物理合理性显式解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代ML天气预报模型精度虽高，但常产生违反基本物理定律的输出（物理幻觉）。现有的事后指标套件无法将预报误差与物理合理性区分开，也缺乏空间定位与可解释归因能力。

Method: 形式化定义数值残差与物理残差的联合条件；多分支编码器分别提取守恒、动力、谱、跨变量与时空残差表示；核心创新为物理一致性对比学习目标（理论上证明潜表示近似等距于物理残差空间）；推导带梯度加权权的自适应多目标损失；输出空间分辨幻觉图、违规类型分类与校准的贝叶斯不确定性。

Result: 在ERA5、WeatherBench 2、MERRA-2上，对GraphCast、Pangu-Weather与NeuralGCM的预报开展综合对比评估，代码以Python编写并提供完全可复现的实验协议；理论与实证共同支持框架的合理性。

Conclusion: PhysXAI是诊断物理幻觉的原则性框架，可实现检测与可解释归因，推动天气预报AI的可信发展。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models for global weather forecasting achieve remarkable predictive accuracy, yet they frequently produce states that violate fundamental physical laws, including conservation of mass, hydrostatic balance, or spectral energy scaling. We term these outputs physical hallucinations and propose PhysXAI, a rigorous diagnostic framework that detects, localises, and attributes such inconsistencies. Unlike existing post-hoc metric suites, PhysXAI is a learnable system that explicitly decouples forecast error from physical plausibility. We formalise the problem through a novel joint condition on numerical and physical residuals, and introduce a multi-branch encoder that extracts representations from conservation, dynamical, spectral, cross-variable, and spatiotemporal residuals. A key innovation is a physics-consistency contrastive learning objective, which we theoretically show the latent representation to be approximately isometric to the physical residual space, ensuring that diagnostic decisions remain grounded in physically meaningful deviations. We further derive an adaptive multi-objective loss with gradient-based weighting to balance competing diagnostic objectives. The framework produces spatially resolved hallucination maps, violation-type classifications, and calibrated Bayesian uncertainty, enabling both detection and interpretable attribution of physical inconsistencies. We conduct a comprehensive comparative evaluation of PhysXAI across ERA5, WeatherBench 2, and MERRA-2, using forecasts from GraphCast, Pangu-Weather, and NeuralGCM, with Python-written code and a fully reproducible experimental protocol. Our theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation establish PhysXAI as a principled framework for diagnosing physical hallucinations and advancing trustworthy AI for weather forecasting.

</details>


### [473] [Probabilistic State Space Enumeration in Neural Network Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15062)
*Victor O. K. Li,Yang Han,Jacqueline C. K. Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Transformer MLP 的概率状态空间框架，用 NORDER-II 按概率降序枚举联合状态，实现精确期望的 anytime 近似，效果优于 Channel Top-k。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有近似方法（Top-k）对各计算组件独立排序保留，忽略组件间的联合结构；作者希望将稠密计算精确表示为组合状态空间上的期望，并只评估最可能的配置。

Method: 将 MLP 中间维度划分为通道组，定义输入相关的二元包含状态分布，采用重要性校正的掩码输出，使全期望精确还原稠密输出；核心算法 NORDER-II 在不构造、不排序指数级状态空间的前提下按概率递减顺序枚举完整联合状态，并以累积概率质量和状态预算截断得到 anytime 近似。

Result: Llama-3.2-1B 与 Gemma-2-2B 上，B=2048 时 MLP 输出近似精度达 92.4%/93.8%，Channel Top-k 仅 76.9%/79.8%；首、中、末三层联合近似时 WikiText-2 困惑度仅偏离稠密推理 0.06%/0.54%；相对期望计数 Grouped Top-k，精度提升 82.6%–126.4%，额外解析 FLOPs 仅 0.18%–0.19%。

Conclusion: 联合状态结构比原子显著性更重要；稠密层可视为组合计算状态上的结构化概率推断，为预训练网络中受概率质量控制的自适应计算开辟新范式。

Abstract: Deep neural networks typically realize dense computation by propagating information through all intermediate channels, while many approximation methods rank and retain individual computational components. We ask whether dense neural computation can instead be represented exactly as an expectation over a combinatorial state space, and approximated by evaluating only its most probable configurations. We introduce a novel probabilistic state-space framework for Transformer MLPs. The framework partitions the intermediate dimension into channel groups, defines an input-dependent distribution over binary inclusion states, and uses importance-corrected masked outputs such that the full expectation exactly recovers the dense MLP output. The key algorithmic novelty is NORDER-II, which enumerates complete joint states in decreasing probability without constructing or sorting the exponentially large state space. Truncating this ordering yields an anytime approximation governed by cumulative probability mass and a state budget. On Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-2-2B, NORDER-II at a state budget of B=2048 achieves 92.4% and 93.8% MLP-output approximation accuracy, compared with 76.9% and 79.8% for Channel Top-k. When the first, middle, and last MLP layers are approximated jointly, WikiText-2 perplexity remains within 0.06% and 0.54% of dense inference. Relative to expected-count Grouped Top-k, NORDER-II yields 82.6% to 126.4% relative accuracy gains with only 0.18% to 0.19% additional local analytic FLOPs. These results establish the significance of joint-state structure beyond atomic salience and point to a new paradigm for neural computation: dense layers can be viewed as structured probabilistic inference over combinatorial computational states. This framework opens a path toward adaptive, probability-mass-controlled computation in pretrained neural networks.

</details>


### [474] [CoLaX: Context-Aware Local Explanations for Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15067)
*Kexuan Zhang,Paolo Frazzetto,Xiaobei Zou,Gustau Camps-Valls,Yang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoLaX：面向时间序列分类器的上下文感知事后解释框架，通过全局序列表示调节shapelet局部归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列分类器的事后解释方法只对局部模式（子序列、shapelet）打分，忽略了序列整体上下文；而同一motif在不同全局条件（趋势、状态区间）下可能具有不同预测含义。

Method: 基于shapelet驱动的Shapley归因，引入学习到的全序列表示对局部模式相关性进行条件化：全局上下文在两个层面起作用——生成样本特定的原型权重，并输出时间分辨信号以重加权局部激活图；由此得到的上下文条件化片段作为Shapley博弈的参与者，其数值仅由冻结的黑盒分类器提供。

Result: 在相同motif随上下文改变相关性的合成基准上，AUPRC平均比最强基线高30%；在真实ECG数据上取得最高AUPRC；消融实验表明收益来自输入相关的条件化而非额外的可学习权重。

Conclusion: CoLaX在重复出现的局部motif随序列级上下文改变相关性时最为有效。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanations for time series classifiers usually score local patterns, such as subsequences or shapelets, without regard to the rest of the sequence. Yet the same motif can carry different predictive meaning under different global temporal conditions, such as trends or regimes. We propose CoLaX, a context-aware post-hoc explanation framework that builds on shapelet-driven Shapley attribution and conditions local-pattern relevance on a learned representation of the full sequence. Global context acts at two levels: it produces sample-specific prototype weights and a temporally resolved signal that reweights the local activation map. The resulting context-conditioned segments are the players of a Shapley attribution game whose values come only from the frozen black-box classifier. On synthetic benchmarks where identical motifs change relevance across contexts, CoLaX improves AUPRC over the strongest baseline by 30\% on average. On real-world data, it achieves the highest AUPRC on ECG. Additional ablations indicate that the gains come from input-dependent conditioning rather than from additional learnable weights. CoLaX is therefore most useful when recurring local motifs change relevance across sequence-level contexts.

</details>


### [475] [When Does Causality Help in Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15073)
*Long Zhang,Wei Huang,Aishui Rao,Jian Hu,Binxiang Wu,Jie Li,Chen Gong,Linxi Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统考察因果引导评分在多元时序异常检测中"何时有帮助"，以固定的因果自编码器DeCauAE为对象，变化图质量、异常类型与评估协议，得出"图质量决定收益、异常类型决定目标、协议决定排名"的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果感知评分在多元时序异常检测中被广泛使用，但文献很少说明它何时真正有益，缺乏对适用边界的清晰刻画。

Method: 保持单一因果自编码器DeCauAE不变，对照真实值系统变化三个维度：(1)图质量（在含20个变量的DAG上逐步破坏图结构）；(2)异常类型（如破坏条件结构的结构性异常及其破坏严重度s）；(3)评估协议（point-adjusted F1 vs. range-aware VUS）。并在真实基准上分析因果模块的适用条件与可复现性。

Result: 图质量决定收益：随图被破坏，相对无图自编码器的增益逐步衰减。异常类型决定目标：在破坏条件结构的场景下结构性因子将窗口F1从0.800提升至0.976，但当破坏严重度s<0.3时优势消失。协议决定排名：point-adjusted F1下随机评分即可匹敌完整模型，而range-aware VUS能区分自编码器族与经典基线。真实基准上因果模块仅在密度使系统"合格"时才有回报，且需用跨子样本可复现性在合格系统内筛选实体；全局启用会损失0.012 VUS-ROC。

Conclusion: 因果感知评分的收益高度依赖条件：需高质量图、特定类型（结构性）异常、严重度足够，并采用range-aware VUS等合适协议；实际部署应有选择地启用因果模块而非处处启用。结构性因子亦可迁移到经典检测器。

Abstract: Causality-aware scoring is common in multivariate time-series anomaly detection, yet the literature rarely states when it helps. Holding one causality-guided autoencoder (DeCauAE) fixed, we vary graph quality, anomaly type and protocol against ground truth. Graph quality fixes the payoff: on a twenty-variable DAG the gain over a graph-free autoencoder decays as the graph is corrupted. Anomaly type fixes the target: the structural factor lifts window F1 from 0.800 to 0.976 where anomalies break conditional structure, and its advantage vanishes below a break severity s 0.3. Protocol fixes the ranking: point-adjusted F1 lets a random score match the full model, while range-aware VUS separates the autoencoder family from the classical baselines. On real benchmarks the causal module pays only where density makes a system eligible and cross-subsample reproducibility selects entities inside it; enabling it everywhere costs 0.012 VUS-ROC. The structural factor also transfers to classical detectors .

</details>


### [476] [Profile-Based Auditing of Domestic Violence Survey Selection Across South Asia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15106)
*Mohammad Abu Obaida Mullick,Rezaur Rahman Ratul,Mymuna Nourin,Md. Motaharul Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究利用南亚5国DHS的79.6万余名15-49岁女性数据，构建可解释的人口学画像，并用机器学习审计家庭暴力模块的选择性覆盖问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DHS的家庭暴力模块受家庭层面抽样与隐私要求影响，形成独特的观测过程，可能存在非随机的样本选择，仅凭正式抽样设计难以完全解释覆盖差异，因此需要检验人口、社会经济与家庭特征能否构成可复现的总体画像并携带选择信息。

Method: 使用阿富汗、印度、缅甸、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦的DHS个体重编码数据，统一61个数值特征和8个分类特征；用PCA降维并在画像空间识别出6个可解释画像；在考虑初级抽样单元的留出验证下评估22种机器学习模型。

Result: 最优模型HistGradientBoosting取得ROC-AUC 0.9167与PR-AUC 0.9612，而仅用抽样设计的基线为0.8475与0.9203；加入女性个体特征带来最大增量，显式交互项对样本外性能提升有限；国别分析显示显著异质性，留一国交叉评估表明增量画像信号的可迁移性有限。

Conclusion: 可解释机器学习能够在正式抽样设计之外审计敏感调查模块的差异化覆盖情况，但基于画像的增量信号跨国迁移能力有限，需注意本地化应用。

Abstract: Domestic violence (DV) data in the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) are collected through a specialized module whose household-level sampling and privacy requirements create a distinct observation process. We ask whether demographic, socioeconomic, and household characteristics form reproducible population profiles and whether these profiles contain information about selection into the DV module across South Asia. Using DHS Individual Recode data for 796,374 women aged 15-49 across Afghanistan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, and Pakistan, we harmonize 61 numeric and 8 categorical features, reduce the profile space with PCA, and identify six interpretable profiles. We then evaluate 22 machine-learning models under primary-sampling-unit-aware holdout validation. The best model, HistGradientBoosting, achieves ROC-AUC 0.9167 and PR-AUC 0.9612, versus 0.8475 and 0.9203 for a design-only baseline. Adding woman-level characteristics yields the largest incremental gain, while explicit interaction terms add little out-of-sample performance. Country-specific analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity, and leave-one-country-out evaluation shows that transferability of the incremental profile signal is limited. These results demonstrate that interpretable ML can audit differential coverage in sensitive survey modules beyond the formal sampling design.

</details>


### [477] [Serving-Aligned Entire-Space Conversion Modeling via Click-Through Rate Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15137)
*Pavel Dolin,Xun Zou,Jiatian Wu,Deguang Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用知识蒸馏把线上服务的 pCTR 分数蒸馏到 ESMM 的辅助 pCTR 塔，以缓解 pCTCVR 的训练-服务不一致，在 Ali-CCP 上同时提升 pCTCVR 与 pCVR 的 AUC/PR-AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESMM 联合训练 pCVR 与辅助 pCTR 塔，但只部署 pCVR 塔，线上又搭配一个单独训练的 pCTR 模型，导致 pCTCVR 在训练与服务阶段的预测不一致（训练-服务不匹配）。

Method: 从日志中记录的线上服务 pCTR 分数出发，用知识蒸馏监督 ESMM 的辅助 pCTR 塔，提升 pCTCVR 的训练-服务对齐；用 α 控制硬标签损失权重，记为 KD-α。并在 5% 非点击保留的负采样设置下复验。

Result: Ali-CCP 上，最优变体 KD-0.3 相对 ESMM 基线：serving pCTCVR 与 pCVR 的 ROC-AUC 分别提升 2.1% 和 1.6%，PR-AUC 分别提升 9.9% 和 8.8%。负采样（5% 非点击保留）下，KD-0.3 相对下采样 ESMM，两者平均 AUC 分别提升 1.2% 和 0.9%，PR-AUC 分别提升 8.5% 和 4.5%。

Conclusion: 蒸馏线上 pCTR 分数可有效修复 ESMM 的 pCTCVR 训练-服务错配，且不损害、反而提升 pCVR 估计；在负采样场景下同样有效，方法简单、部署成本低。

Abstract: Recommendation systems may use predicted click-through conversion rate (pCTCVR), the product of predicted click-through rate (pCTR) and post-click conversion rate (pCVR), to guide ranking decisions. Many pCVR models build on the Entire Space Multi-Task Model (ESMM), which jointly trains pCVR and auxiliary pCTR towers using pCTR and pCTCVR losses, but deploys only the pCVR tower. At serving time, this tower may be paired with a separately trained pCTR model, creating a training-serving mismatch in pCTCVR when its predictions differ from those of the auxiliary pCTR tower. In this paper, we use knowledge distillation (KD) from logged serving pCTR scores to supervise ESMM's auxiliary pCTR tower and improve training-serving pCTCVR alignment. We denote variants by KD-$α$, where $α$ controls the hard-label loss weight. On the Ali-CCP dataset, KD-0.3, the best variant on serving pCTCVR, increases ROC-AUC not only for serving pCTCVR but also for pCVR by 2.1% and 1.6%, respectively, and PR-AUC by 9.9% and 8.8%, respectively, relative to the ESMM baseline. We also test negative downsampling with 5% nonclick retention. Downsampled KD-0.3 increases mean AUC for serving pCTCVR and pCVR by 1.2% and 0.9%, respectively, -and PR-AUC by 8.5% and 4.5%, respectively, relative to downsampled ESMM.

</details>


### [478] [Knowledge Transfer for Conditional Flow Matching: Frozen Estimation and Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15150)
*Yian Huang,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用于条件流匹配（CFM）的迁移学习框架，利用源群体学到的表示来改善目标数据有限时的条件生成，并在理论上刻画冻结与自适应两种策略的Wasserstein风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件生成模型在目标数据有限时表现受限，但相关源群体的表示可提供帮助。然而源与目标的响应分布及其维度可能不同，需要一套能处理这种差异的迁移学习框架与理论保障。

Method: 构建两个基于源表示的流程：TFM-Freeze固定表示、仅估计目标速度头；TFM-Adapt在函数锚定惩罚下联合学习速度头与表示适配。针对显式神经网络类，建立条件平方Wasserstein风险的界（含源估计、目标拟合、表示失配与数值积分项）；并开发在已拟合生成器间选择目标的独立验证程序，给出oracle不等式与切换规则。

Result: 理论表明，当源表示存在光滑校正时，适配将冻结失配项替换为学习校正的代价加可控正则偏差；信息下界显示在某些情形下适配可达到严格更快的条件平方Wasserstein风险速率，优于任何受限于冻结上下文信息的生成器。验证选择程序满足oracle不等式，切换规则以高概率保证条件能量风险不劣于仅用目标的生成器。模拟与真实数据验证了增益及目标验证对负迁移的防护作用。

Conclusion: 该框架在源-目标分布与维度不同时有效迁移表示，理论上明确了冻结与适配的优劣条件，并通过验证机制避免负迁移，为有限目标数据下的条件生成提供可靠方案。

Abstract: Conditional generative modeling with limited target data can benefit from representations learned in a related source population. We develop a transfer learning framework for conditional flow matching that accommodates distinct source and target response distributions and dimensions. Two procedures exploit a representation learned from source data: TFM-Freeze estimates a target velocity head with the representation fixed, whereas TFM-Adapt jointly learns the head and a representation adaptation under a functional anchoring penalty. For explicit neural network classes, we establish bounds on conditional squared Wasserstein risk that account for source estimation, target fitting, representation mismatch, and numerical integration. When the source representation admits a smooth correction, adaptation replaces the frozen mismatch contribution by the cost of learning the correction and a controllable regularization bias. An information lower bound identifies regimes in which adaptation attains a strictly faster conditional squared Wasserstein risk rate than any generator restricted to the frozen context information. We also develop independent validation procedure for selecting among fitted conditional generators. We show that the selection procedure satisfies an oracle inequality, and the switching rule guarantees, with high probability, no increase in conditional energy risk relative to a target-only generator. Simulations and real data applications illustrate the gains from our proposed methods and the effectiveness of target validation in guarding against negative transfer.

</details>


### [479] [Orbit: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on IT Operations Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15718)
*Sathwik Narkedimilli,Rakshit Verma,Rahul Soni,Ankit Kushwaha,Balaji Ganesan,Kaustabha Ray,Sunil Saumya,Pratibha Moogi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ORBIT基准，用多选题、开放式、故障排查三种格式评估LLM在IT运维中的表现，并揭示模型失败原因与自评偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ITOps基准多只给出分数，很少解释模型为何失败；同时生成式题目存在模板缺陷，模型自评又会掩盖问题，需要更可信的诊断性评估。

Method: 构建ORBIT基准，每题附参考答案与来源记录；通过人工审计剔除约一成有模板缺陷的生成项，并用真实从业者讨论帖及被采纳答案重建故障排查题；统一由一个独立评审模型为五个LLM打分，并与模型自评对比，还测试了与题干词重叠选答案的启发式基线。

Result: 多选题多数可答对；开放式题正确率约三分之一到略过半；故障排查题仅少数正确，即便采用更宽松的根因评分标准亦然。模型自评时会接受大量有缺陷题目的答案，而仅靠与题干词重叠即可在多选题中选出正确项超过一半。

Conclusion: ORBIT可作为选择与监督运维助手的诊断工具，而非部署测试；评估须用独立评审，并警惕题目缺陷与浅层线索带来的虚高表现。
