Across all eight seed-averaged model-attack paths, the sampled budget path strictly orders DPD and accuracy and reverses mean signed equal-opportunity difference (EOpp). A rate theorem gives the exact true-positive-rate shift required for reversal, and the measured group rates satisfy it. Within this controlled feature-space study, robustness and parity admit useful joint operating points, but one fairness metric cannot replace a full group-rate audit.

</details>


### [548] [Does Deep Knowledge Tracing Learn Semantic Relations Between Knowledge Components?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16323)
*Kia Karbasi,Mahdi Saiedi,Kevin Hong,Gregory Pottie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验DKT学到的知识点（KC）关系是否具有语义性：用九种文本衍生语义表示流程进行比较，发现DKT关系图与语义相似度结构仅弱且不一致地对齐，语义信息注入也未能稳定优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DKT通过共享隐状态更新，使一个KC的交互会影响其他KC的预测，但尚不清楚这些跨KC关系是否反映知识点间的语义联系。作者希望验证DKT所学关系的本质来源。

Method: 构建九条文本衍生语义KC表示流程；测试一：将DKT导出的KC关系图与基于表示两两余弦相似度得到的语义关系结构进行对比；测试二：将预训练语义表示注入DKT（语义初始化、KC监督微调BERT等）并与标准DKT基线比较；另做减数据实验（嵌套样本量）评估效果。

Result: 两类结构在各数据集、嵌入模型与流程下仅弱且不一致地对齐；预训练语义表示未能稳定超越基线。减数据实验中，语义初始化在ASSISTments 2017的9个嵌套样本量中有8个AUC更高；KC监督微调BERT在部分匹配比较中带来小幅正AUC差异，但跨运行稳定性未确立，整体效果有限且不一致。

Conclusion: DKT学到的KC关系并非以语义为主；行为、时序、结构或心理测量信号也可能塑造这些关系。文本衍生语义结构无法强有力地还原DKT关系结构。

Abstract: Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT) is a knowledge tracing (KT) model that updates a shared latent state from sequences of interactions, each pairing a knowledge component (KC) with a response. An interaction with one KC can therefore affect predictions for other KCs. We ask: Are the KC relations learned by DKT semantic? We construct text-derived semantic KC representations using nine pipelines to test whether the conclusions hold across alternative ways of constructing those representations.
  The first test compares DKT-derived KC relation graphs with semantic relation structures induced by pairwise cosine similarities among the KC representations. Across the evaluated datasets, embedding models, and pipelines, the two structures align only weakly and inconsistently. The second test introduces semantic information into DKT; the pretrained text-derived representations do not consistently outperform the standard DKT baseline.
  In the reduced-data experiments, semantic initialization yields a higher test area under the ROC curve (AUC) than the baseline at eight of nine nested sample sizes for ASSISTments 2017. KC-supervised fine-tuned BERT produces small positive AUC differences in some matched comparisons, but the study does not establish their stability across runs. These effects remain limited and inconsistent. The findings suggest that behavioral, temporal, structural, or psychometric signals may also shape DKT's learned relations. DKT-derived relations are not primarily semantic: the tested text-derived semantic structures do not strongly recover the DKT-derived relation structure.

</details>


### [549] [Continual Event Recognition for Autonomous Optical Network Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16038)
*Khouloud Abdelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于原型表示、开集识别与少样本原型注册的持续事件识别框架，用于SOP光监测，在2600km测试床上实现99.82%闭集准确率并支持新干扰自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主光网络需要能适应不断变化的干扰而不反复重训练或中断业务的监测系统，现有方法难以兼顾已知识别与新事件集成。

Method: 构建基于原型表示的持续事件识别框架，结合开集识别检测新事件、少样本原型注册集成新事件（无需重训编码器），并研究重叠干扰能否通过既有原型的组合推理进行零样本推断。

Result: 在2600km ROADM光测试床上取得99.82%闭集识别准确率，无需重训编码器即可适应新干扰；发现重叠干扰的潜在组合性程度不一，部分可零样本原型组合识别，其余需显式少样本注册。

Conclusion: 持续事件识别是未来自主光网络监测系统的有前景范式，但重叠干扰的组合泛化存在局限，需结合少样本注册补充。

Abstract: Autonomous optical networks require monitoring systems capable of adapting to evolving disturbances without repeated retraining or service interruption. We propose a continual event recognition framework for state-of-polarization (SOP)-based optical monitoring based on prototype representations, open-set recognition, and few-shot prototype registration. The framework supports recognition of known disturbances, detection and integration of novel events, and investigates whether overlapping disturbances can be inferred through compositional reasoning from existing prototypes. Experimental validation on a 2600-km ROADM-based optical testbed demonstrates 99.82% closed-set recognition accuracy, successful adaptation to novel disturbances without encoder retraining, and reveals that overlapping optical disturbances exhibit varying degrees of latent compositionality. While some overlaps can be recognized in a zero-shot manner through prototype composition, others require explicit few-shot registration. These results establish continual event recognition as a promising paradigm for future autonomous optical network monitoring systems.

</details>


### [550] [Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16375)
*Omer Haq*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出递归状态增强语言模型（Recursive SALM），用持续演化的潜在状态驱动预训练模型的自适应，从而在解码器看不到早期证据时仍能进行多轮推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型受限于有限的token上下文，难以访问更早的交互历史，需要一种不依赖扩展上下文窗口就能保留并利用历史信息的方式。

Method: 采用模块化的"读—转移—写"架构，将观测编码、潜在动态演化与预测器自适应解耦，并给出确定性与随机性两种形式；实验中仅评估确定性SALM，冻结GPT-2 small，其解码器上下文排除早前证据，由64维状态通过latent-gated LoRA注入模型。

Result: 四轮假设推断任务上latent-gated LoRA达89.1%，与全上下文LoRA基线的88.0%相当；将状态置零或打乱后准确率显著下降。两轮未见码词任务中，多种接口使候选排序优于随机，但在既定训练计划下很少能生成精确码词。

Conclusion: 持续潜在状态条件的自适应可在早期证据缺席解码器上下文时支撑序列推理；但精确生成能力与训练计划仍是待解决的问题。

Abstract: Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations.
  The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. Zeroing or shuffling the state substantially reduces accuracy. In a two-turn task with codewords unseen in training, several interfaces improve candidate ranking over chance, but rarely generate the exact codeword under the evaluated training schedule. These experiments show that persistent latent-conditioned adaptation can support sequential inference when earlier evidence is absent from the decoder context.

</details>


### [551] [Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16039)
*Davide Wiest*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CLOC框架，将持续学习视为优化约束，揭示EWC经验Fisher是样本损失约束的一阶形式，并指出其按损失梯度尺度加权样本的缺陷，提出IEWC修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EWC的经验Fisher通常用概率曲率来辩护，但其隐含的样本加权机制存在缺陷（EWC-DR已观察到分类中的失败），需要一个更一般的理论解释与改进方法。

Method: 提出Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC)：新训练须保持已学行为的特定泛函；推导出EWC经验Fisher是该约束在保函为样本损失时的一阶形式。基于此提出IEWC，按各旧样本损失水平集的一阶近似惩罚输出变化，去除梯度尺度加权，并防止损坏样本主导重要性矩阵。

Result: 在分类、分割、语言、预测与扩散任务上，IEWC变体匹敌或超越EWC，并优于EWC-DR；在验证集选超参的留出评估中，uniform IEWC在ImageNet-R上比匹配EWC提升2.00个百分点（95% CI 0.93-3.07）。

Conclusion: CLOC为EWC提供了统一的约束视角并揭示其根本缺陷，IEWC给出通用且有效的修正，跨多模态任务验证其性能优势。

Abstract: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is a widely used regularization-based technique for continual learning, protecting performance on old tasks with a quadratic penalty whose empirical Fisher is usually justified through probabilistic curvature. We instead introduce Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC): new training must preserve chosen functionals of learned behavior. EWC's empirical Fisher is exactly the first-order form of this constraint when the preserved functional is each sample's loss. This derivation exposes a flaw: EWC implicitly weights each sample by the scale of its loss gradient, so well-fitted samples lose importance. EWC-DR observed this failure in classification; CLOC identifies its general cause. Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation (IEWC) penalizes output changes according to the first-order approximation of each old sample's loss level set, removing the weighting for any differentiable loss and output geometry, and prevents corrupt samples from dominating the importance matrix. Across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting, and diffusion, IEWC variants match or improve on EWC and outperform EWC-DR. In a held-out evaluation with validation-selected hyperparameters, uniform IEWC improves ImageNet-R accuracy over matched EWC by 2.00 percentage points (95% CI 0.93-3.07).

</details>


### [552] [Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16409)
*Doyoung Kim,Byeongguk Jeon,Kailin Zhang,Sherry Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ACERL 方法，在固定的 Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) 脚手架下，用强化学习联合训练单一模型承担动作生成、反思、经验手册(playbook)整理三种角色，使经验交接产物按其对未来 rollout 的下游效果被评估与优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体多仅用标量奖励做 RL 训练，丢弃了环境中的细粒度信息（如错误日志）；近期工作通过 harness 用反思/压缩生成 playbook 等经验产物交给后续 rollout，但这些产物的构造过程本身未被学习，无法端到端优化。

Method: 固定 ACE harness 作为测试平台，训练一个模型同时扮演动作生成器、洞察反思器和 playbook 整理器三角色；以候选经验交接产物对后续 actor rollout 的下游影响作为其评价信号，在固定脚手架与标量奖励下协同优化各角色行为。

Result: 在多个智能体基准上，ACERL 的留出集(held-out)性能优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 智能体训练不应只优化当前 rollout 的动作，还应优化模型自写、被未来 rollout 继承的经验，从而实现标量奖励梯度更新与环境信息利用的兼得。

Abstract: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.

</details>


### [553] [Human Capital in Context: What Employment Survival Reveals About Worker-Firm Match](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16058)
*Jung Ho Choi,Mario Milone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个基于"人-企配对"的匹配质量测度：用双塔神经网络将工人与企业嵌入同一空间，以余弦相似度作为匹配质量，仅以离职风险为训练目标，在大规模数据上验证其经济意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不存在普遍意义上"最好的工人"，只有对特定企业最好的工人。传统基于工人、企业或职业层面的单维度测度从构造上就把配对特有的变异设为零，无法刻画"适配"这一配对属性。作者希望将匹配质量建模为配对本身的性质。

Method: 以任职关系的存活（离职）为学习信号，将拟合视为配对属性。用双塔神经网络分别把工人（职业史与现任职位）和企业（特征与业务描述）编码到公共向量空间，匹配质量为两向量余弦相似度；函数形式来自企业专用人力资本的"技能权重"模型，唯一估计目标为离职风险（把工作匹配视作经验品）。样本超过10亿人-期，覆盖1.01亿工人与840万家企业。

Result: 匹配质量提高0.1，离职几率下降48%；约四分之一的匹配质量方差是配对特有的（工人、企业、职业层面测度按构造为零）。匹配更好时工资更高，尤其在关系早期；劳动力匹配得分更高的企业未来五年增长更快、利润更高、专利更多且更有价值。该测度还能预测未形成配对的流动去向，并解释并购中商誉份额：当目标企业员工更适配收购方时，商誉占比更高。

Conclusion: 匹配质量是可从雇佣关系存活中学习的配对属性，具有显著的经济解释力，能同时解释离职、工资、企业绩效、劳动力流动与并购定价，且可外推到从未发生的配对上。

Abstract: There is no best worker in general, only a best worker for a particular firm. We develop a measure of worker-firm match quality that treats fit as a property of the pair, learned from the survival of employment relationships. A two-tower neural network embeds workers, from their career histories and current positions, and firms, from their characteristics and business descriptions, into a common space, and match quality is the cosine similarity of the two vectors. The measure takes its functional form from the skill-weights model of firm-specific human capital, and its only estimated objective, a separation hazard, from the view of the job match as an experience good. Estimated on more than a billion person-periods covering 101 million workers and 8.4 million firms, a 0.1 increase in match quality lowers the odds of separation by 48%. About a quarter of the variance of match quality is specific to the worker-firm pair, which worker-, firm-, and occupation-level measures set to zero by construction. Workers earn more when better matched, especially early in a relationship, and firms whose workforces score higher grow faster, become more profitable, and are issued more, and more valuable, patents over the next five years than their industry peers. Because it scores pairs that never formed, the measure also predicts where movers go, and acquirers record a larger share of the price as goodwill when the target's workers would fit the acquirer better than they fit the target.

</details>


### [554] [Vocabulary-Free Next-Event Prediction on Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16063)
*Zhishang Luo,Venu Madhav Tammali,Amila Weerasinghe,Osso Vahabzadeh,Olcay Boz,Xue Hao,Yusu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GTGT 提出一种无词表的生成式时序图 Transformer，用下一事件预测做自监督学习，跨图可训练，在 TGB 上性能可比且训练成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归式下一token预测在语言与时序建模中成功，但在时序图学习中受限：多数时序链路预测方法为判别式而非自回归。时序图虽可按时间顺序序列化边，却缺乏与图无关的token化方式；现有节点token化词表随节点数增长，限制可扩展性与跨图训练。

Method: 提出 GTGT（Generative Temporal Graph Transformer）框架，进行自监督下一事件预测。预测目标包括：已观测目的节点的事件、新目的节点的行为描述符，以及新事件前的时间间隔；这些目标在各图间语义共享，因此单个 Transformer 可在不相交节点集上训练，无需节点特有参数。采用局部节点标识符使注意力捕获图结构，并从理论上证明该模型具备时间尊重（time-respecting）消息传递能力。

Result: 在 Temporal Graph Benchmark（TGB）上，GTGT 的链路预测性能与既有基线相当或更优，同时训练成本显著更低。

Conclusion: GTGT 为时序图预训练用于预测及其他下游任务打开了大门，是迈向时序图基础模型的具体一步。

Abstract: Autoregressive transformer training through next-token prediction has driven remarkable advances in language modeling and has become increasingly effective for time-series modeling. Yet its success in temporal graph learning remains limited, and most temporal link-prediction methods are discriminative rather than autoregressive. While temporal graphs can have a natural serialization through chronological ordering edges, they lack an obvious graph-independent tokenization: existing node tokenization often uses a vocabulary that grows with the number of nodes, limiting scalability and cross-graph training. We propose GTGT, Generative Temporal Graph Transformer, a simple yet powerful vocabulary-free framework for self-supervised next-event prediction on temporal graphs. It predicts events for observed destinations, behavioral descriptors for novel destinations, and time gaps before new event. These targets have shared meanings across graphs, allowing one transformer to train across disjoint node sets without node-specific learned parameters. Local node identifiers let attention capture graph structure: Theoretically, we can show that our transformer-based model has the capacity for time-respecting message passing mechanisms. On Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB), our GTGT not only achieves comparable or better link-prediction performance than established baselines, but also has much lower training cost. These results open the door to temporal graph pretraining for forecasting and other downstream tasks, providing a concrete step toward temporal graph foundation models.

</details>


### [555] [Tokenized Reward Systems for Federated Learning: The Privacy vs. Fairness Tradeoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16065)
*Andreas Sendros,Nikolaos Pavlidis,Vasilios Perifanis,Pavlos S. Efraimidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文设计并实证评估两种用于联邦学习奖励分配的Solidity合约（公开质量分按比例分配 vs. 零知识阈值隐藏个体分数），通过MNIST对抗训练（女巫、零梯度、随机噪声）揭示加密隐私与激励公平之间的根本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链+FL需要激励参与且保护隐私，但隐私保护机制是否会削弱激励公平与抗攻击鲁棒性，缺乏实证与形式化分析。

Method: 实现两个互补合约（均铸造不可转让、用后销毁代币）；对比公开质量分比例分配与ZK阈值证明的隐私变体；在MNIST上以三种随机种子运行女巫、零梯度、随机噪声三类对抗实验；给出隐私-抗女巫权衡的闭式定理；用线性gas缩放模型刻画主网部署边界，并纳入Fusaka后EIP-7825单笔交易gas上限。

Result: 隐私保护架构严格降低系统鲁棒性：对手平均奖励捕获翻倍且结果方差剧增；根因是余弦相似度评分中的结构性自我包含偏差——模型收敛时诚实梯度自然衰减，与有界噪声在统计上不可区分，对手借此系统性突破ZK阈值，触发后期失败级联，最终垄断奖励池、完全排斥诚实贡献者。

Conclusion: 密码学上安全的静态阈值ZK门在真实FL收敛动态与标准基准下无法充当激励层的公平机制，需动态阈值或与收敛无关的评分设计。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) systems increasingly rely on blockchain based reward mechanisms to incentivize participation while preserving data privacy. We design and empirically evaluate two complementary Solidity smart contracts for FL reward distribution: the first one that allocates rewards proportionally to a publicly disclosed quality score, and a privacy preserving variant that hides individual quality scores behind a zero-knowledge (ZK) proof of a threshold condition. Both contracts mint a non transferable, use-and-burn token maintaining a trustless incentive structure. We evaluate the two designs through MNIST training with adversarial behavior, including Sybil attacks, zero gradient and random noise, across three independent random seeds.
  Our results reveal a fundamental tradeoff between cryptographic privacy and incentive fairness. The privacy preserving architecture strictly degrades system robustness, doubling the adversary's average reward capture while introducing severe outcome variance. This vulnerability is driven by a structural self-inclusion bias within cosine-similarity scoring: as the global model converges, legitimate gradient updates naturally diminish, rendering them statistically indistinguishable from bounded noise. Adversaries exploit this dynamic to systematically breach the ZK threshold, triggering a late stage failure cascade that culminates in absolute adversary monopoly over the reward pool and the total exclusion of honest contributors. Alongside a closed-form theorem formalizing this privacy--Sybil resistance tradeoff, we map strict mainnet deployment boundaries via linear gas scaling models, explicitly incorporating the post-Fusaka EIP-7825 per transaction gas cap. Ultimately, while cryptographically secure, static threshold ZK gates fail as incentive layer fairness mechanisms under realistic FL convergence dynamics on standard benchmarks.

</details>


### [556] ["It's Just a Small Weapon": What Rewarding Misbehavior During RL Does to Character-Trained Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16069)
*Mohammad Omar Khursheed,Thomas Morris,Fabien Roger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究对gpt-oss-20b进行角色训练后，与两类"对抗角色"的RL交互：将有害请求改写为数学题、代理编码环境中的奖励黑客，发现角色训练模型易学会违规行为、辩护性推理更强、部分黑客行为更难被监控发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色训练（如Model Spec Midtraining）被认为能提升对齐鲁棒性与泛化性，但后续奖励设定不当的RL可能削弱角色训练效果，二者交互机制尚不清楚。

Method: 用半现实宪法对gpt-oss-20b做角色训练，再施加两类奖励违反宪法规则的"对抗RL"：有害请求伪装成数学题、代理编码环境中的奖励黑客；并对比有无价值依据的宪法动机对泛化的影响。

Result: 角色训练模型容易学会两种违规行为，但回答有害请求略慢于基线gpt-oss-20b；其对有害答案表现出更多动机性推理，且部分任务上的黑客行为更难被监控捕获；宪法是否以价值为依据对错位、诚实与能力评估差异很小。

Conclusion: 角色训练不能抵御错设奖励RL的侵蚀，甚至可能产生更隐蔽的违规行为；为规则提供价值依据的动机解释对泛化影响有限。

Abstract: Developers train models to follow a consistent character using methods like Model Spec Midtraining (Li et al., 2026), which have been hypothesized to make alignment more robust and generalize broadly. However, it is possible for subsequent RL with misspecified rewards to work against character training. In this work, we apply character training to teach gpt-oss-20b a semi-realistic constitution and study how it interacts with two types of RL that reward breaking the constitution's rules (opposing RL): answering harmful requests rewritten as math problems, and reward hacking in agentic coding environments. The character-trained models learn both behaviors easily, though they are slightly slower than gpt-oss-20b to answer harmful requests. Character-trained models also display more motivated reasoning on harmful answers than gpt-oss-20b, and hack on some tasks which monitors find harder to catch. Finally, since explaining the reasons behind rules can improve how alignment generalizes (Kutasov et al., 2026), we compare constitutions that justify the same rules by grounding them in a value or not, and find little difference between motivations on misalignment, honesty, and capability evaluations.

</details>


### [557] [KVPath: Connecting Key-Value Representations Across Transformer Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16072)
*Xuan Luo,Zhiyuan Wang,Hanzhong Cao,Xifeng Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KVPath 将相邻层的 KV 表示建模为沿网络深度的一条"路径"：首层生成全维 base KV，后续层只生成低维 delta KV 增量更新前一层表示，从而在保持各层特有表示的同时大幅压缩 KV-cache。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 通常为每个 token 在每一层都缓存独立的 KV 表示，显存开销随层数线性增长；而近期研究表明相邻层的 KV 表示高度相关、共享大量信息，这种层间增量变化可能可以用低维信息刻画，从而避免逐层存储完整 KV。

Method: 提出 KVPath 范式：层间 KV 表示连成一条路径，第一层建立全维 base KV，后续层生成低维 delta KV 更新前一层 KV 以构造本层 KV 状态；缓存时只存一次 base KV 加各层紧凑 delta KV。设计两个变体：KVPath-Residual（残差相加更新向量值）与 KVPath-Rolling（滚动式逐段更新特征维度）。

Result: 在参数量匹配条件下，GQA 的 KV-cache 存储最高减少 68%，MLA 减少 55%，同时模型性能保持甚至略有提升。

Conclusion: 利用层间 KV 的相关性、以低维增量替代逐层完整缓存是一种有效且通用的 KV-cache 压缩范式，可兼容 GQA 与 MLA 等主流注意力结构。

Abstract: Transformers typically cache an independent key-value (KV) representation for each token at every layer. Recent work reveals that a token's KV representations across neighboring layers are correlated and contain shared information. We hypothesize that this correlation implies incremental inter-layer changes, which can be effectively captured by low-dimensional deltas. Motivated by this, we propose KVPath, a new KV representation paradigm that connects KV representations across the network depth into a path. The path establishes a full-dimensional base KV at the first layer, while subsequent layers generate low-dimensional delta KVs to update the preceding KV, thereby constructing their own KV states. By caching the base KV once alongside these compact delta KVs, KVPath preserves distinct layer-specific representations without storing full KV states at every layer. We develop two variants of KVPath: KVPath-Residual, which updates vector values via residual addition, and KVPath-Rolling, which progressively updates feature dimensions in a rolling manner. Under matched parameter counts, KVPath reduces KV-cache storage by up to 68\% for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and 55\% for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), while maintaining or even improving model performance.

</details>


### [558] [Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16803)
*Marco De Negri,Luca Sartori,Lorenzo Baggi,Moritz Reihs,Eduard Frank Ďurech,Mennatallah El-Assady,Valentina Pyatkin,Anna Hedström*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出PREWARN评测协议，用带标注起始点的失败任务评估语言模型监控器，并在重复退化案例中揭示响应级指标饱和、探针可提前预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监控器多用AUROC等响应级指标评估，忽略监控器何时触发；只有"提前预警"才留出停止或干预生成的时间，需要一种能区分"事后分类、进行中检测、事前预警"三任务的评测方式。

Method: 提出PREWARN协议：在验证集上把每个监控器阈值校准到应用所需的错误率，运行监控器，并相对失败起始点对其报警进行评分，覆盖三类任务。案例研究为三个开源模型的重复退化，以提前预警为主任务，使用激活上的线性探针与六个未经训练的基线。

Result: 该失败上响应级指标已饱和，仅凭响应长度的规则几乎完美；AUROC排名相同的探针在PREWARN下预警表现差异很大。三个模型中有两个的多数退化响应能被探针在起始点前预警；低秩适配器使起始前一刻被标记的token比例翻倍以上，主要靠对退化响应远早于起始点的标记；未经训练基线几乎不比随机报警更频繁。

Conclusion: 响应级指标不足以评价早期预警能力，PREWARN提供了可校准、按起始点打分的实用评测框架；作者以校准阈值的形式公开发布探针。

Abstract: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes

</details>


### [559] [Agentic Computational Algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16073)
*Ryan A. Anderson,Matthew Trager,Ben Bowman,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出以计算代数问题作为评测AI智能体"发现并利用结构"能力的试验台，在独立求解、带持久记忆的在线序列求解、编译可复用快速求解器三种设定下进行实验，揭示智能体可扩展可解范围但推理开销与次优策略留存等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算代数问题中真正的瓶颈不是正确性而是时间：通用算法保证正确但极慢，利用特殊结构的重述可大幅加速。作者希望借此可验证、结构可控、难度可调的无穷问题族，量化评测智能体在任务内与任务间发现和复用结构的能力。

Method: 构造具有受控共享结构的基准系统族，在三种设定下评测智能体：（1）独立求解各实例；（2）利用持久记忆求解相关的在线实例流；（3）为已知问题族编译可复用的快速求解器。

Result: （i）智能体能在固定预算内扩大可解系统范围，但推理开销有时会超过计算节省；（ii）记忆可降低重复求解成本，但可能固化次优策略；（iii）编译可产出更快的可复用求解器，但前期成本很高。

Conclusion: 计算代数提供了具体、可度量的目标，可用于改进智能体发现与复用结构的能力，并为AI智能体研究提供了一个结构可控、答案可独立验证的评测新方向。

Abstract: We explore the use of AI agents for solving computational problems in algebra. For the problems we consider, the main challenge is not correctness but \emph{time}: general-purpose algorithms are guaranteed to provide correct solutions but can be prohibitively slow, while reformulations that exploit special structure often allow solving a problem much faster. We propose to use this setting to evaluate how effectively agents discover and exploit structure within and across tasks to reduce computational costs. More broadly, computational algebra supplies infinitely many problems with independently verifiable answers and systematically controllable structure and difficulty. To illustrate these possibilities, we use benchmark families of systems with controlled shared structure and evaluate agents in three settings: solving independent instances, solving online streams of related instances using persistent memory, and compiling a fast reusable solver for a known problem family. Our experiments show that (i) agents can extend the range of systems solvable within a fixed budget, although reasoning overhead can sometimes outweigh computational savings; (ii) memory can reduce the cost of repeated solving but may preserve suboptimal strategies; (iii) compilation produces faster reusable solvers but at substantial upfront cost. Overall, computational algebra offers concrete, measurable targets for improving how agents discover and reuse structure.

</details>


### [560] [Subsurface schematisation from sparse CPT data using the tabular foundation model TabPFN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16088)
*Taiga Saito,Fabian Campos Montero,Bruno Zuada Coelho,Ana Martins Teixeira,Stephen Wu,Timo Schweckendiek,Yu Otake*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将表格基础模型TabPFN用于稀疏CPT数据的地下剖面重建，无需地质微调即可接近甚至优于地质专用生成模型SchemaGAN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下剖面建模对岩土决策至关重要，但场地勘察数据稀疏、信息缺口大，传统依赖预定义层界与专门训练的生成模型成本高、泛化性受限。

Method: 仅以网格坐标和CPT土行为类型指数观测为输入，用预训练于通用合成表格数据的TabPFN直接重建二维剖面，不做地质微调、不设层界；在合成剖面及荷兰两个场地与SchemaGAN及参考插值方法对比，并测试CPT数量增加、预测区间覆盖率及在SchemaGAN合成数据上微调的效果。

Result: 基线比较中，合成剖面上TabPFN平均误差接近SchemaGAN，两个实际场地均更低；合成剖面上随CPT数量增加MAE逐次下降，点预测区间平均覆盖率接近名义水平；在SchemaGAN合成数据上微调虽提升合成测试精度，却使两场地误差增大。

Conclusion: 通用表格基础模型可在不重新训练的情况下，从稀疏且动态更新的勘察数据中持续更新地下预测，是地下建模的可行且可迁移路径；领域专用微调可能损害现场泛化。

Abstract: Subsurface schematisation supports geotechnical decisions but remains challenging because sparse site-investigation data leave substantial gaps in information about ground conditions. This study explores TabPFN, a foundation model pretrained on general synthetic tabular data, for this task. Using only grid coordinates and soil behaviour type index observations from sparse cone penetration tests (CPTs), we first reconstruct two-dimensional sections without geotechnical fine-tuning or predefined layer boundaries. We evaluate the approach on synthetic sections and at two field sites in the Netherlands, comparing it with SchemaGAN, a conditional generative adversarial network trained on synthetic geotechnical sections, and with reference interpolation methods. In the baseline comparisons, TabPFN achieved mean errors close to SchemaGAN's on synthetic sections and lower mean errors at both field sites. On synthetic sections, TabPFN's mean absolute error decreased at each tested increase in CPT count, and, under the baseline input setting, its pointwise prediction intervals had mean coverage close to nominal levels. Subsequent fine-tuning on the synthetic sections used to train SchemaGAN improved synthetic test accuracy but increased mean errors at both field sites. These findings indicate that general-purpose tabular foundation models offer a promising route for updating subsurface predictions from sparse and evolving site-investigation data without retraining.

</details>


### [561] [LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17108)
*Arnab Sanyal,Gourav Datta,Sandeep P. Chinchali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LazyWeights 通过将 Huffman 编码与 GPTQ 调优结合，压缩现有量化格式（GPTQ/AWQ/llama.cpp quants），并用小型 ASIC 解码单元在 DRAM 与 L2 之间按需解码，从而在 Jetson 边缘设备上显著降低内存占用、延迟与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备受内存约束：Nano（4GB）受容量限制，Orin（8GB）受带宽限制。现有部署格式（GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp 的 K/I-quants）对矩阵每个整数码分配相同比特数，而整数码分布高度不均匀，存在压缩空间。

Method: 1) 保留原有格式，通过调整 GPTQ 使整数码更易压缩；2) 用 Huffman 编码在交错 lane 上无损压缩；3) 在 DRAM 与 L2 之间放置小型解码单元按需解码，保持 GPU kernel 不变，DRAM 只搬运编码字节；4) 设计位精确的 0.21 mm² ASIC 解码器（1 GHz，7nm）。

Result: 在 1% 和 3.5% 困惑度预算下，编码后的 Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、SmolLM-1.7B 比最佳 llama.cpp 格式小 5.7–31.4%；ASIC 解码器使 Orin 每 token 延迟和能耗最多降低 36% 和 38%（结合 prompt-lookup 推测解码为 54% 和 44%）；Nano 上相比 CPU llama.cpp 时间减少 58–64%、能耗减少 53–57%，流式 Mistral-7B 以 3.89 bits/weight 快 6.6 倍。Huffman 在相同吞吐下优于 rANS 的压缩率与面积，解码器在 Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA 上位精确运行。

Conclusion: 对非均匀量化码做无损 Huffman 编码并配合专用解码硬件，可在不改变 GPU 内核与模型格式的前提下，有效缓解边缘设备的内存容量与带宽瓶颈，显著提升速度并降低能耗。

Abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

</details>


### [562] [Measuring Preferred Representation in AI-generated Images with Community Scorers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16093)
*Melanie F. Pradier,Camilla Longden,Anja Thieme,Rita F. Marques,Nari Johnson,Sidhika Balachandar,Xinnuo Xu,Linda Y. Wen,Martin Grayson,Katja Hofmann,Cecily Morrison,Daniela Massiceti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"偏好代表性"(preferred representation)概念，并构建"Community Scorer"模型来评估AI生成图像是否符合特定社群期望的自我呈现方式；在三个残障社群的验证表明其与社群评分的一致度显著优于常用文生图指标，并可用于内容过滤，同时发布Community Preference Dataset。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成图像常歪曲历史上被边缘化的社群，且影响超出图像本身；但现有指标无法衡量社群自身希望被如何呈现。

Method: 提出preferred representation概念，并据此构建测量工具"Community Scorer"——针对特定社群评估AI生成图像中该社群偏好代表性的模型；在跨越全球北方与南方的三个残障社群上进行效度检验，并应用于下游内容过滤任务。

Result: Community Scorer与社群人工评分的对齐程度显著优于其他广泛使用的文生图指标；在下游内容过滤任务中证明其有用性。

Conclusion: 社群偏好可作为可操作、可测量的文生图评估维度；发布Community Preference Dataset以支持Community Scorer向文化特定评估的规模化扩展。

Abstract: AI-generated images often misrepresent historically marginalised communities, with real-world consequences beyond the images themselves. However, conventional metrics fail to measure how communities want to be represented in AI-generated images. To address this, we introduce the concept of preferred representation. Building on previous work, we propose a measurement instrument that operationalises this concept through a Community Scorer - a model that evaluates a specific community's preferred representation in AI-generated images. We interrogate the validity of Community Scorers on three diverse disability communities that span the Global North and South. The results show that Community Scorers align significantly better with community ratings compared to other widely used text-to-image metrics. We then demonstrate the usefulness of these scorers in a downstream content filtering task. We release the Community Preference Dataset to enable others to optimise how Community Scorers can be scaled for culturally specific evaluation of AI-generated visual media.

</details>


### [563] [A Matching Lower Bound for Online Smooth Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16097)
*Kaixuan Ji,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究序贯二分类预测中的平滑校准误差（smooth calibration error）。针对自适应对手，已知极小极大平滑校准误差介于 Ω(T^{1/3}) 与 O(√T) 之间。本文构造新对手将下界提升至 Ω(√T)，与已知上界匹配，从而确定这些校准度量在序贯预测中的极小极大速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典期望校准误差对预测的微小扰动不稳健，而平滑校准误差具有稳健性。此前其极小极大速率存在 Ω(T^{1/3}) 与 O(√T) 的显著差距，尚未确定真实速率。

Method: 构造一个使结果均值随预测者累积残差移动的新型自适应对手。该设计令补偿过去残差的代价高昂，从而迫使任何预测者的期望平滑校准误差达到下界。

Result: 证明平滑校准误差的期望下界为 Ω(√T)，与已知 O(√T) 上界在常数因子内匹配；并进一步导出校准距离（calibration distance）与下校准距离（lower calibration distance）的 Ω(√T) 下界。

Conclusion: 本文确定了平滑校准误差、校准距离及下校准距离在序贯预测中的极小极大速率，均为 Θ(√T)。作者声明部分证明思路在作者指导下由 GPT-6 Astra 协助完成。

Abstract: We study smooth calibration error in sequential binary prediction, which measures how far a sequence of probabilistic forecasts is from being calibrated and, unlike the classical expected calibration error, is robust to small perturbations of the forecasts. Against adaptive adversaries, the minimax smooth calibration error is known to lie between $Ω(T^{1/3})$ and $O(\sqrt{T})$ (Qiao and Zheng, 2024), where $T$ is the number of rounds. In this paper, we close this gap by constructing a new adversary whose outcome mean moves with the forecaster's cumulative residual. This design makes compensating for past residuals costly, and forces every forecaster to incur an expected smooth calibration error of $Ω(\sqrt{T})$. This lower bound matches the known upper bound up to universal constants, and further implies $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ lower bounds for calibration distance and lower calibration distance. Overall, our results settle the minimax rates of these calibration measures in sequential prediction. The proof ideas are partially developed by GPT-6 Astra under the authors' guidance.

</details>


### [564] [Hiding a Gap Does Not Close It: The Price of Removing the Mean Group Contrast from Learned Models of Learning Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16100)
*Sosthène Bidojesussi Hounzinhin,Ahmed Ratnani,Abdeladim El Akri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将"删除群体信号"这一公平性补救措施的代价转化为审计工具：给出其最小额外误差的解析式与可估计代价，并用三阶段审计在真实数据上检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应辅导系统用学生数据训练模型，常见公平性补救是抹除模型中的群体信号，但其代价（可能损失预测精度、甚至掩盖而非消除差距）未被量化，作者希望把这一代价变成可用的审计手段。

Method: 基于均值平价回归，推导对不能使用群体的预测器去除平均群体对比所需的最小额外误差 p0p1Δ²/R²；给出由估计群体模型构建的任意修正的精确代价（最优预测器下不低于该最小值）。设计三阶段审计：在训练单元拟合、在验证单元公布代价、在独立单元检验。用于受控模拟、三个真实数据集（含知识追踪网络、Eedi、ASSISTments）及辅导仿真器。

Result: 受控研究中代价可能很大，即便状态对群体预测很差；三个真实数据集中，从学习动态模型抹除群体几乎预测不出实际观察到的差距；选定的知识追踪网络中抹除隐状态仍留下大部分差距，而预测修正可去除差距，平均Brier分数额外代价0.021；Eedi上五个划分的公布代价全部被接受、实测代价均落在公布区间内、四个划分的差距缩小可迁移到新班级；新ASSISTments学校上审计弃权；仿真器中目标函数与帮助预算比抹除影响更大，"各组知识下限"能区分缩小差距与拉平。

Conclusion: 隐藏模型中的差距并不等于消除它；该审计框架能在修正被使用前估计其代价，帮助判断公平性补救是否真正有效。

Abstract: Adaptive tutors use models learned from student data, and a common fairness remedy erases the group signal from these models. We turn the cost of this remedy into an audit tool. Building on mean-parity regression, we give the minimum extra error, relative to the best predictor, of removing the mean group contrast from a predictor that cannot use the group, $p_0p_1Δ^2/R^2$, and the exact cost of any correction built from an estimated group model, which, for the best predictor, is never below this minimum. A three-stage audit (fit on training units, announce the cost on validation units, test on independent units) estimates this cost before the correction is used. In a controlled study, the price can be large even when the state predicts the group poorly. On three real data sets, erasing the group from a learned model of learning dynamics predicts almost no gap where one is observed. In a selected knowledge-tracing network, erasing the hidden state leaves most of the gap; a correction of the prediction removes it at an extra Brier score of 0.021 on average. On Eedi, with the network selected on separate units, the audit accepted the announced cost in all five splits, the measured cost fell inside the announced interval in all five, and the gap reduction transferred to new classes in four; on new ASSISTments schools the audit abstains. In a tutoring simulator, the objective and the help budget matter more than the erasure, and floors on each group's knowledge separate narrowing a gap from levelling down. Hiding a gap in a model does not close it.

</details>


### [565] [Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17191)
*Tomohiro Sawada,Kartik Goyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoRA 适配器实际有效秩远低于配置秩，导致容量未充分利用、学习-遗忘权衡不佳；作者提出无 SVD 的可微 Rényi-2 有效秩正则项加入语言建模损失以最大化有效秩，从而改善困惑度并提升学习-遗忘前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 常不及全量微调，尤其在异构与持续学习场景下出现明显遗忘，存在学习-遗忘权衡问题；作者认为一个重要原因是高秩 LoRA 适配器未能实现配置秩赋予的容量，标准 LoRA 更新的有效秩远低于设定秩，限制了更新能量分布的广度。

Method: 在原始语言建模目标上增加优化适配器有效秩的训练机制：主方法为一个简单、稳定、可微且无需 SVD 的 Rényi-2 有效秩正则项（惩罚权重 λ）；并建立容量最大化与范数有界更新之间的联系。

Result: 在三模型、多随机种子的混合域秩扫描中，λ=0.01 使所有 ≥16 的测试秩下平均 Wiki 困惑度低于无惩罚 LoRA；除一个模型-秩组合外，平均训练困惑度持平或增幅不超过 0.02；单任务与调度实验表明学习与保持的平衡取决于配置；文献中若干 LoRA 变体也存在该容量问题。

Conclusion: 有效秩不仅是适配器质量的事后诊断指标，更可作为可训练目标来改善学习-遗忘前沿，为 LoRA 类参数高效微调提供互补的改进维度。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization

</details>


### [566] [Feature-Aware Edge Sampling for Approximate One-Step Laplacian Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16169)
*Jonathan Z. Sun,Zheng Wang,Kebin Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于生成树的混合边采样器，用特征相关消息分数与有效电阻杠杆分数近似GNN中的一步组合拉普拉斯消息，推导期望消息误差并给出最优采样概率与误差前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN中组合拉普拉斯消息计算代价高，需要边采样近似，但缺乏对采样概率与误差关系的理论刻画。

Method: 提出基于生成树的混合采样器，结合特征条件化消息分数与有效电阻杠杆分数；推导一步消息的期望误差，在给定期望边预算下求解最优采样概率并刻画误差前沿。

Result: 合成社区图初步实验显示：随边预算增加，消息误差下降、分类准确率小幅上升；混合采样器性能介于最优选择与均匀随机采样之间。

Conclusion: 混合采样器在理论误差刻画上有效且实验表现符合预期，但多步传播与更大规模真实图上的评测留待未来工作。

Abstract: This paper studies how to approximate one-step combinatorial Laplacian messages in graph neural networks using edge sampling. We propose a spanning tree based hybrid sampler that combines feature-conditioned message scores and effective-resistance leverage scores, derive the expected one-step message error and obtain the optimal sampling probabilities and error frontier for a given expected edge budget. Preliminary experiments on synthetic community graphs show that message error decreases, while classification accuracy increases slightly, as the edge budget grows, and performance of the hybrid sampler is in between of optimal selection uniform random sampling. We leave multi-step propagation and evaluation on larger and real graphs for future work.

</details>


### [567] [Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17287)
*Jiacheng Xu,Shuo He,Fuxiang Zhang,Chaojie Wang,Bo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出单边可验证性(OSV)设定并给出负样本策略优化(NOPO)，仅利用可靠的负样本进行强化学习，在缺少oracle奖励时提升pass@k。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR依赖可靠验证器判断正误，但现实中往往只有便宜的检验能证伪失败，通过检验的正样本可能混有大量假阳性，直接强化这些正样本会奖励走捷径的行为。

Method: 将验证正样本视为无标签，只用可信负样本更新策略；结合参考相对负抑制损失与组级适配器(按未被证伪响应比例缩放每次更新)。

Result: 在单元测试、约束检查、LLM自验证三类验证器下，于代码、逻辑、数学基准上超越基线pass@k；优势在推理时扩展与跨基准迁移中保持。

Conclusion: 仅利用负样本的抑制式优化是OSV场景下可行有效的RLVR替代方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.

</details>


### [568] [Self-Supervised Attention-Based Virtual Metrology for CMP MRR Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16172)
*Jonathan Adam Rico,Nagarajan Raghavan,Senthilnath Jayavelu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自监督注意力框架GREP，通过全局代理目标回归从无标签CMP传感器时序信号学习表征，再微调预测材料去除率(MRR)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CMP中MRR是过程监控与先进过程控制的关键指标，虚拟量测可从时序信号估计MRR以减少对物理量测的依赖；但现有方法多依赖简化线性假设或人工特征工程。

Method: GREP为自监督、基于注意力的框架：先以"全局代理目标回归"任务在无标签信号上学习时序表征，再进行有监督微调用于MRR估计；并与特征工程的有监督基线在有限标注数据、传感器噪声、时间过程漂移三种条件下对比。

Result: 在PHM 2016 CMP数据集上，有限标注数据条件下表现有竞争力，部分情形有所提升，不同标注比例下总体与基线相当；两模型随噪声增加误差变化较小，GREP在最终时间区间RMSE降低17.0%。

Conclusion: 自监督预训练可为CMP的MRR虚拟量测提供有效表征，在数据受限与过程漂移场景下具优势，是替代人工特征工程的可行方向。

Abstract: Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) is a critical semiconductor manufacturing process where material removal rate (MRR) is a key metric for process monitoring and advanced process control (APC). Virtual metrology enables MRR estimation from process time series signals, supporting run-to-run(R2R) control and process optimization while reducing reliance on physical metrology. Existing approaches typically rely on simplified linear assumptions or require handcrafted feature engineering. In this paper, we propose Global Regression Pretraining(GREP), a self-supervised, attention-based framework for CMP MRR prediction. GREP learns temporal representations from unlabeled sensor signals through global proxy-target regression, followed by supervised fine-tuning for MRR estimation. The framework is evaluated against a feature-engineered supervised baseline under three conditions: limited labeled data, sensor noise, and temporal process drift. Experiments on the PHM 2016 CMP dataset demonstrate competitive performance under limited labeled-data conditions, with improvements in selected cases and performance largely comparable to the baseline across different labeled-data fractions. Both models exhibit relatively small changes in prediction error with increasing noise, while GREP achieves a 17.0% RMSE reduction in the final temporal interval.

</details>


### [569] [Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17294)
*Haozhe Wang,Lina Chen,Fanqi Wan,Qi Han,Yinmin Zhang,Zheng Ge,Daxin Jiang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Metal Sandbox 是一套面向 Apple Metal 内核智能体开发的多 Mac 沙箱基础设施，通过命令级跨机调度提升 GPU 利用率与吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧推理需要高效利用本地加速器。Metal 内核的模型训练与评测依赖 macOS 原生工具与并发智能体会话，但会话在模型请求、开发命令与 GPU 执行之间交替，导致 rollout 期间 GPU 长时间空闲。

Method: 提供受控的按实例文件访问、原生命令执行与跨互联 Mac 的命令级调度：每个智能体保留独立工作区与私有开发环境；并行命令并发执行，串行命令在每节点共享一个执行槽，可迁移的等待命令被调度到空闲 Mac 并把结果回传原智能体。与 Harbor 集成支持任务执行、自动验证与 rollout 采集。

Result: 在四台 Mac mini M4 节点上，集中负载下命令吞吐提升 1.68×–2.05×；16 条静态智能体轨迹估算每节点 4 会话相对 1 会话可持续吞吐提升约 2.14×；在假定时长不变的前提下重放轨迹，动态调度使平均工具等待降低 18.8%、批次耗时降低 22.3%。

Conclusion: 命令级跨机调度能有效填补 GPU 空闲、提高硬件利用率；系统与 Harbor 集成已开源。收益估计基于静态/重放条件，真实动态 rollout 中的效果仍需验证。

Abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.

</details>


### [570] [Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17314)
*Abigail L. Tenenbaum,R. Thomas McCoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 元学习网络快速学会的新任务，其适配后的参数向量之间可做加性/减性组合，组合出的向量能让网络直接实现相应符号操作预测的函数，无需再训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能从小样本快速学习，神经网络通常需大量训练。已有工作显示元学习网络能快速学会新函数，但其内部机制不清楚，作者想揭示元学习网络快速学习的内部结构。

Method: 受词向量加性关系（king−man+woman≈queen）启发，研究元学习网络在快速适配某函数后全部参数拼接成的单个"函数表示向量"，检验这些向量之间是否满足与函数符号关系一致的加性与减性关系，并验证人为重组得到的向量能否直接实现目标函数。

Result: 参数向量可按函数间的符号关系相加相减，重组出的向量所对应网络无需直接训练即可实现所预测的函数，说明快速学习沿系统性、功能有意义的参数轨迹进行。

Conclusion: 元学习可调整网络的起点，使其后续学习沿系统化、功能有意义的轨迹在参数空间中组织，为神经网络归纳偏置提供了几何基础。

Abstract: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.

</details>


### [571] [Same-State Pairs Make One JEPA Proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis Vacuous](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16182)
*Xin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出JEPA对PRH的"证明"依赖过强假设（观测决定状态、谱间隙保证唯一性），在硬白化目标下世界核变为单位核，唯一性仅在条件成立时才有意义，对k<d_z-1情形其理想化极限为空。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验并澄清JEPA框架下Platonic表示假说（PRH）所谓"证明"的有效范围，指出其假设与实验现实之间的差距，并厘清对齐、规范框（gauge）与潜变量语义可辨识性的实际边界。

Method: 在硬白化总体目标下分析同状态正对诱导的世界核；研究谱间隙假设下的极小元唯一性（至多相差旋转）；构造k与d_z的关系来检验假设可满足性；分析规范自由度（旋转、排列、符号）如何被配对样本、语义分量与数值锚点所固定，并建立资源—规范账本。

Result: 唯一性结论是条件性的：当d_z-1≥2k时两极小元最佳旋转残差平方可达2k；当k<d_z-1时前提不可满足、结论空虚。四项定量结果中仅一项无间隙下界幸存，但其仅在场景解释比例完美时消失，且只能约束对齐误差、不能认证良好视角对齐。配对样本仅在有效秩k处固定相对框架，全局旋转残留；分量语义仅将相对排列固定到符号，需数值锚点在混合框架确定后固定之。

Conclusion: JEPA式PRH证明无法覆盖其动机实验（如caption仅见部分图像），理想化同状态极限在k<d_z-1时无内容；实际可保证的只是旋转/排列意义下受限的可辨识性与一个较弱对齐下界，需借助额外资源（语义、锚点）逐项固定规范自由度。

Abstract: In a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), the JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) assumes that every observation determines the world state and that a spectral gap makes minimizers unique up to rotation. Under the hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity: every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, and, when $d_z-1\ge 2k$, two minimizers can have best-rotation squared residual $2k$. The uniqueness claim is conditional; for $k<d_z-1$, where $d_z$ is the number of world states, this limit makes its premise unsatisfiable, so the claim has no content there. The experiments that motivate it leave the assumption: a caption sees only part of an image, and the paper states no experiment meets its hypotheses exactly. The theorem does not reach those experiments, and for $k<d_z-1$ its idealized same-state limit is vacuous. One of the paper's four quantitative results survives: a gap-free lower bound. Its bound vanishes only at perfect scene-explained fraction; it bounds alignment error but cannot certify good-view alignment. A canonical frame is determined only up to a rotation and a latent permutation. Paired samples fix the relative frame at effective rank $k$; a global rotation remains. Component semantics fix the relative permutation only up to signs; value anchors fix it once the mixing frame is pinned. A resource--gauge ledger records which resource fixes which gauge.

</details>


### [572] [Flow-CAD: Flow Matching for Contextual Anomaly Detection and Explanation in Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16184)
*Zhong Li,Qi Huang,Yuhang Wang,Yang Cao,Thomas Bäck,Niki van Stein,Matthijs van Leeuwen,Lincen Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flow-CAD 提出基于 Flow Matching 的全局摊销条件生成模型，实现表格数据的上下文异常检测，并给出稳定可解释的残差能量评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据上下文异常检测需识别在上下文条件下行为异常的表格行。现有方法要么是分布表达能力有限的浅层条件模型，要么是需逐上下文建模的局部估计器，难以刻画复杂条件关系并扩展到高维场景。

Method: 提出 Flow-CAD：用 Flow Matching 学习单一的、全局摊销的条件生成模型，直接建模以上下文为条件的行为分布，无需简单参数假设或局部重训；并设计基于所学条件流的尺度归一化截断残差能量作为异常分数，稳定评分、抑制极端偏差主导，并支持逐特征归因。理论分析证明残差评分对速度估计误差稳定，且其蒙特卡洛估计满足集中界。

Result: 在 20 个基准数据集上与 13 个竞争方法对比，Flow-CAD 在 PR AUC、ROC AUC 和 P@n 上取得最佳平均排名。

Conclusion: Flow-CAD 兼具表达力、可扩展性与可解释性，是表格上下文异常检测中有效且实用的方案；代码已开源。

Abstract: Contextual anomaly detection in tabular data aims to identify objects whose behavior is unexpected under their contextual conditions. In data-engineering pipelines, this task screens table rows whose measurements violate context-dependent integrity relationships. Most existing approaches rely on either shallow conditional models with limited distributional expressiveness or localized estimators that require per-context modeling, making it difficult to capture complex conditional relationships and scale to high-dimensional settings. We propose Flow-CAD, a new framework for contextual anomaly detection based on Flow Matching. Flow-CAD learns a single global and amortized conditional generative model that flexibly represents behavioral distributions conditioned on context, without assuming simple parametric forms or retraining local models. To enable robust and interpretable anomaly scoring, we introduce a scale-normalized and truncated residual energy derived from the learned conditional flow, which stabilizes anomaly scores, mitigates domination by extreme deviations, and supports feature-wise attribution. We further provide theoretical insights showing that the proposed residual-based anomaly score is stable under velocity estimation error, and that its Monte Carlo estimator satisfies concentration bounds. Experiments on 20 benchmark datasets with 13 competitors demonstrate that Flow-CAD has the best average rank for PR AUC, ROC AUC, and P@n, highlighting its effectiveness and practicality for contextual anomaly detection in tabular data. We provide the source code at https://github.com/ZhongLIFR/FlowCAD.

</details>


### [573] [When can an interpretability claim be trusted? Stability and certification of feature dimensionality, ridge leverage and the feature recovery rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16190)
*Ali Tajfar,Behnam Tajfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出可解释性工具中基于任意阈值的度量不稳定，研究特征维度（Elhage等）与特征恢复率(FRR)两个度量，提出正则化(ridge)版本并给出尖锐稳定性界与“特征已恢复”证书，同时揭示跨独立训练字典时证书无信息性、55%特征恢复判定随种子翻转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释性工具常被用来支撑安全声明（如稀疏字典已恢复模型大部分特征），但这些声明依赖任意阈值的测量，权重微扰、不同训练种子或阈值变化即可使其反转，因此需要刻画这些度量的稳定性边界。

Method: 在已知真值的玩具模型与合成字典上研究两个度量：Elhage等的特征维度与带余弦阈值的特征恢复率。精确刻画特征维度不连续的位置，并用ridge正则化版本替代，给出尖锐稳定性界：ridge leverage score变化不超过3√3/(8√λ)乘以权重算子范数变化（常数不可改进）；正则化维度的稳定性常数按ρ/4增长（ρ=R/√λ），并给出显式上下界。此外证明“特征i已恢复”在字典给定变化下仍成立的证书。

Result: 证书在所有测试中成立且对小扰动有信息量，但对独立训练的字典无法非平凡地认证任何特征；在标准阈值下，55%特征的恢复判定随训练种子改变。

Conclusion: 基于阈值的可解释性度量缺乏稳定性，正则化版本可提供可证明的稳定性保证，但跨独立训练仍无法认证特征恢复，提示相关安全声明需谨慎。仅玩具模型实验；论文由AI代理起草并由独立盲审AI与数值测试核查。

Abstract: Interpretability tools increasingly support safety claims, such as that a sparse dictionary has recovered most of a model's features. Such claims rest on measurements with arbitrary thresholds, and small changes to the model weights, a different training seed or a different threshold can reverse them. We study two widely used measurements in toy models and synthetic dictionaries with known ground truth: the feature dimensionality of Elhage et al. and the feature recovery rate (FRR) with a cosine threshold. We characterize exactly where feature dimensionality is discontinuous and replace it with a regularized (ridge) version with sharp stability bounds: the ridge leverage score changes by at most $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrtλ)$ times the operator-norm change of the weights, and this constant cannot be improved; for the regularized dimensionality the stability constant grows like $ρ/4$ in the scale $ρ=R/\sqrtλ$, with explicit upper and lower bounds. We also prove certificates stating when a claim "feature $i$ is recovered" must survive a given change of the dictionary. The certificates held in every test and are informative for small perturbations, but certify no feature non-trivially across independently trained dictionaries; at the standard threshold, whether a feature counts as recovered changed with the training seed for 55 percent of features. Experiments use toy models only. The proofs, code and text were drafted by AI agents directed by the authors and checked by an independent blind AI reviewer and by numerical tests; the authors take full responsibility for the content.

</details>


### [574] [An Extensive Evaluation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Sentiment Analysis: Insights from Amazon Customer Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16201)
*Muhammed Ihsan Corak,Cuiyuan Wang,Xiaowen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在568,454条Amazon Fine Food评论上比较5种传统机器学习分类器与6种深度学习架构的三分类情感分类效果，并开发了应用界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线平台用户生成文本快速增长，需理解客户意见以支持数据驱动决策，但传统ML与深度学习在不同类别分布下的情感分类表现尚需系统比较。

Method: 使用Amazon Fine Food Reviews（568,454条）做三分类情感分析。ML模型采用BoW与TF-IDF（限5,000词），DL模型使用20,000词表的学习型嵌入。在原始不平衡集与随机过采样后的平衡集（1,070,469条）上，以准确率、宏/各类别精确率、召回率、F1及训练时间评估。

Result: 平衡集上RF+BoW达99%准确率，Attention达98.7%；Linear SVC 1分15秒达89%，LR 3分37秒达90%。不平衡集上Attention达97.8%，FastText 3分26秒达95.3%，RNN达91.9%但中性类F1仅0.08。

Conclusion: 深度学习模型在不同类别分布下更稳定，最佳传统模型依赖数据平衡策略。作者还提供了将RF与Attention模型应用于新评论的应用。局限：标签由星级派生而非人工标注情感，且数据来源单一。

Abstract: The rapid growth of user-generated text on online platforms creates opportunities for understanding customer opinion and supporting data-driven decisions. This study compares five traditional machine learning classifiers (Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Bernoulli Naive Bayes, Linear Support Vector Classifier, and Multinomial Naive Bayes) and six deep learning architectures (LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, RNN, Attention, and FastText) for three-class sentiment classification of 568,454 Amazon Fine Food Reviews. Machine learning models used Bag-of-Words (BoW) and TF-IDF features limited to 5,000 terms; deep learning models used learned embeddings over a 20,000-word vocabulary. Models were evaluated on the original imbalanced data and on a random-oversampled balanced set of 1,070,469 reviews, using accuracy, macro and per-class precision, recall, and F1-score, and training time. On the balanced set, Random Forest with BoW achieved 99\% accuracy and the Attention model achieved 98.7\%. Linear SVC reached 89\% accuracy in 1 min 15 s, and Logistic Regression reached 90\% in 3 min 37 s. On the imbalanced set, the Attention model achieved 97.8\% accuracy, and FastText achieved 95.3\% in 3 min 26 s, while the RNN reached 91.9\% with a neutral-class F1-score of 0.08. Deep learning models were more stable across class distributions, whereas the best classical model depended on balancing. We also report a user-facing application that applies the trained Random Forest and Attention models to new review text. Because the labels are derived from star ratings, the results measure agreement with rating-derived sentiment classes rather than annotated sentiment; the dataset is a single source, and the findings should be read with that limitation in mind.

</details>


### [575] [Few-Shot Cross-Subject Neural--Image Retrieval via Stimulus-Anchored Latent Bias Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16257)
*Xizhang Yao,Li Zhang,Gan Huang,Zhen Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Stimulus-Anchored Latent Bias Calibration (SA-LBC)，用同刺激源锚点估计跨被试表征偏移并收缩校正，在 THINGS-EEG2 上提升检索 MRR，并给出锚定优于全局均值的充要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨被试神经—图像检索中，把少量刺激匹配目标观测的均值与源域全局均值比较，会把被试特异的表征偏移与刺激构成效应混在一起，导致偏移估计有偏。

Method: SA-LBC 在固定预处理与冻结的源域训练表征下，用目标响应与同刺激源群体锚点的残差均值估计一阶偏移，并借助源域导出的不确定性对校正进行收缩；在有限刺激总体无放回均匀采样下推导未收缩锚定与全局均值估计的精确有限总体 MSE（含残差—锚点互协方差），并给出锚定降低 MSE 的充要条件。

Result: THINGS-EEG2 上 10 被试留一被试评估：Attention–CLIP ViT-B/32 的 MRR 从无校准 0.1867 升至 M=2 时 0.2013、M=16 时 0.2336；六种配置与所有预算下刺激匹配锚点均优于打乱身份的锚点；M=2 时收缩在六种配置均提升 MRR，但更大预算下效果因表征而异。

Conclusion: 锚点匹配有效但检索增益依赖表征；更低的偏移估计 MSE 并不保证更高检索性能，校正设计需与表征和检索目标联合考虑。

Abstract: In cross-subject neural--image retrieval, comparing the mean of a few stimulus-matched target observations with the global source mean conflates subject-specific representation shifts with stimulus-composition effects. To address this problem, we propose Stimulus-Anchored Latent Bias Calibration (SA-LBC), which estimates the first-order shift under fixed preprocessing and a frozen source-trained representation by averaging residuals between target responses and same-stimulus source-population anchors, then shrinks the correction using source-derived uncertainty. Under uniform sampling without replacement from a finite stimulus population, we derive exact finite-population MSE expressions for the unshrunk anchored and global-mean estimators, including residual--anchor cross-covariance, and establish a necessary and sufficient condition for anchoring to reduce MSE relative to global-mean estimation. In a 10-subject leave-one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, SA-LBC increases mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for the Attention--CLIP ViT-B/32 configuration from 0.1867 without calibration to 0.2013 and 0.2336 with M=2 and M=16 stimulus-level calibration samples, respectively. Across six neural--visual configurations and all calibration budgets, stimulus-matched anchors yield higher MRR than anchors with shuffled stimulus identities, but retrieval gains over no calibration remain representation-dependent. At (M=2), shrinkage improves MRR over the unshrunk anchored estimator in all six configurations, but its effects at larger budgets vary across representations; the relative ranking of translation and orientation corrections also depends on regularization strength. Thus, lower shift-estimation MSE does not guarantee higher retrieval performance. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Xizhang-Yao/SA-LBC.

</details>


### [576] [Rectified Looped Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16265)
*Musheng Li,Jiawei Zhang,Ziyuan Liu,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT)，用类flow插值调度重设计循环反馈，使隐状态尺度有界、扰动放大降低，在等参数等算力下取得更低困惑度与更强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有looped Transformer直接把每轮循环输出作为下一轮输入，随着递归加深会导致隐状态尺度增长和扰动放大，影响训练与推理稳定性。

Method: RLT在每轮循环中用线性插值把当前状态与其预测混合，形成下一轮输入（受flow-based建模启发），将状态变化分摊到各轮，形成从初始输入到最终输出的更平滑轨迹；无需额外可训练参数或额外循环块计算。

Result: 理论证明在合理假设下状态幅度一致有界、最坏情况扰动放大减小；语言建模语料与下游基准上，同训练/推理深度时困惑度低于标准looped Transformer，对输入扰动和推理深度方差更鲁棒；隐状态范数跨循环更稳定，利于外推式解码。

Conclusion: 插值式反馈是一种简单且更稳定的looped Transformer反馈机制，在不增加参数和计算的前提下同时提升性能与稳定性。

Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. We evaluate RLT on language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks. At matched training and inference depths, RLT consistently achieves lower perplexity than a standard looped Transformer, while exhibiting greater robustness to input perturbations and variance in inference depth. Consistent with the theoretical results, latent trajectory analysis shows that RLT maintains more stable hidden-state norms across loops, which also facilitates extrapolation-based decoding strategies. Notably, RLT achieves these gains without requiring additional trainable parameters or extra recurrent block evaluations, thus providing a simple yet more stable feedback mechanism for looped Transformers.

</details>


### [577] [LoCoJAX: Host-Local Coordination for Small-Model RL on TPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16301)
*Loki Chen,Gregory B. Rehm,Yang Song,Hongye Xie,Ming Lei,Chongyang Bai,Bob Kamma,Mingfu Liang,Kavosh Asadi,Yufei Li,Xi Liu,Jay Xu,Rui Liu,Maziar Sanjabi,Luke Simon,Hamed Firooz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文分析了TPU上小模型RL训练的协调开销，提出LoCoJAX用主机本地协调替代全局Pathways协调，实现1.3-3.6倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL越来越多用于小语言模型，但Pathways单控制器协调模型在大模型上高效，小模型反复执行短计算时其协调开销难以摊销，需要量化并解决。

Method: 在TPU v7x上对0.6B-405B稠密模型做decode密集负载扫描，测量主机与网络开销随模型规模的变化；据此提出LoCoJAX，在每个TPU主机本地执行rollout与奖励处理，同时保持全局同步训练；另实现Ray管理的分离模式LoCoJAX-DA，让rollout与训练分主机重叠。

Result: 0.6B时主机协调占单步36%、网络占2%，大模型则网络开销主导非计算时间。相对调优的Pathways基线，Qwen3-0.6B在8-64芯片上LoCoJAX-CO每步快1.3-3.6倍；GSM8K上8芯片单步比Pathways的64芯片还快。NuminaMath-CoT 256芯片下，给rollout 75%主机可降步时约15%。

Conclusion: 小模型RL的瓶颈是主机协调开销，本地协调是有效解法；分离重叠仅在rollout主导且获多数主机时才划算，需按负载特性选择执行模式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly targets small language models, and executing these workloads efficiently across multiple accelerators requires effective coordination. On TPUs, Pathways-based RL uses a single controller to coordinate computation across hosts. This execution model is effective for large models, but its coordination computational costs are harder to amortize when small models repeatedly invoke short computations. To characterize these computational costs, we sweep dense models from 0.6B to 405B parameters on TPU v7x under a decode-heavy workload and measure how host and network computational overhead vary with model size. At 0.6B, host orchestration occupies 36% of step time and network communication 2%, whereas for large models, estimated network computational costs dominate the non-compute time. Motivated by these findings, we present Local Coordination JAX (LoCoJAX), which implements local rollout and reward processing on each TPU host with synchronous global training. In controlled comparisons against a tuned and optimized Pathways baseline on Qwen3-0.6B across three workloads and 8-64 TPU v7x chips, its colocated mode (LoCoJAX-CO) is 1.3-3.6x faster per step; on GSM8K, it completes a step faster on 8 chips than Pathways does on 64. Finally, a Ray-managed disaggregated mode (LoCoJAX-DA) overlaps rollout and training on separate hosts, and placement experiments establish when this overlap compensates for dividing devices and transferring weights: only when rollout dominates the step and receives most of the hosts. On NuminaMath-CoT at 256 chips, giving rollout 75% of hosts cuts step time by about 15% compared with LoCoJAX-CO.

</details>


### [578] [StateAlign: Internalizing State-Aware Decision-Making for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Agents via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16304)
*Zhexi Lu,Subhajit Chaudhury,Tejaswini Pedapati,Keerthiram Murugesan,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StateAlign 通过任务状态构建与状态对比强化学习，让 LLM 工具调用决策随任务状态变化而调整，在提升任务完成率的同时降低工具幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 提升了 LLM 的工具使用能力，但任务表现提升往往伴随工具幻觉增加。可靠的工具使用要求决策与当前任务状态一致（可用信息、工具能力、任务进度），而现有智能体常在应询问信息、检索信息或应拒绝不可行请求时错误执行，即使推理已识别出信息缺失。

Method: 提出 StateAlign：将任务状态构建与状态对比强化学习结合。构建覆盖五种任务条件的数据，并配对具有不同动作需求的状态；用结果奖励引导任务完成，并在配对状态下对相同生成推理与动作做 token 级对比，训练输出与当前状态匹配。

Result: 在 3 个模型家族、5 个基座模型上，BFCL v4 多轮、ToolSandbox 和 When2Call 均有提升；消融显示状态构建在不同奖励设计下都能提升性能与可靠性；完整方法在三个 Qwen3 规模上降低工具幻觉。Qwen3-8B 上 BFCL v4 多轮准确率从 45.5% 提升至 55.2%，SimpleToolHalluBench 无工具幻觉从仅结果奖励训练的 62.2% 降至 56.1%。行为分析显示决策更一致、多调用执行更完整、工具报错后恢复更强。

Conclusion: 将任务状态显式构建并引入状态对比强化学习，可有效对齐智能体决策与任务状态，在提升多轮工具使用性能的同时减少工具幻觉，并改善错误恢复等行为质量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has improved the tool-use capabilities of large language models. However, better task performance can coincide with increased tool hallucination. Reliable tool use requires decisions to follow the current task state: available information, tool capabilities, and task progress. Our analysis shows that agents sometimes execute when they should ask for information, retrieve it, or decline an infeasible request, even when reasoning identifies missing information. We introduce StateAlign, combining task-state construction with state-contrastive reinforcement learning. The data cover five task conditions and pair states with different action requirements. Outcome rewards guide task completion; token-level contrasts compare the same generated reasoning and actions under paired states to train outputs that fit the current state. Experiments across five base models from three families show improvements on BFCL v4 multi-turn, ToolSandbox, and When2Call. Ablations show that state construction improves performance and reliability under different reward designs. The complete method further reduces tool hallucination across three Qwen3 sizes. On Qwen3-8B, StateAlign improves BFCL v4 multi-turn accuracy from 45.5% to 55.2% and reduces no-tool hallucination on SimpleToolHalluBench from 62.2% under outcome-only training to 56.1%. Behavioral analyses show more consistent decisions, more complete multi-call execution, and stronger recovery after tool errors.

</details>


### [579] [Overcoming Spurious Correlations in Conditional Diffusion Models via Doubly Robust Target Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16306)
*Eiichi Sakurai,Kenji Yamanishi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DR-Diff 通过函数梯度构造伪目标来高效微调预训练条件扩散模型，消除训练数据中的虚假相关，使模型逼近理想目标分布，且无需从零重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件扩散模型会记忆训练数据中的虚假相关，导致生成分布偏离理想目标分布；用协变量偏移校正的目标风险最小化可缓解，但针对不同分布从零训练代价过高。

Method: 提出 DR-Diff 微调框架：基于函数梯度方法推导伪目标，该伪目标刻画目标分布下基础模型噪声预测与真实噪声之间的残差；训练模型拟合该伪目标即实现高效目标适配。

Result: 理论上证明 DR-Diff 在总体层面保证目标风险下降，并具备伪双重鲁棒性，对密度比估计误差与基础模型误设具有韧性；实验中在合成数据上噪声预测精度可媲美从零训练的模型，并缓解下游分类任务中的组间差距。

Conclusion: DR-Diff 为条件扩散模型提供了一种高效、理论有保障的分布适配微调方案，兼顾精度与公平性。

Abstract: While conditional diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generation tasks, they memorize spurious correlations within training data. This causes them to deviate from ideal target distributions. Minimizing a covariate shift-adjusted target risk can address this issue. However, retraining models from scratch for different distributions is computationally prohibitive. To overcome this limitation, we propose DR-Diff, a framework that efficiently fine-tunes pre-trained conditional diffusion models. Specifically, DR-Diff leverages a functional gradient approach to derive a pseudo-target. This pseudo-target captures the residual between the base model's noise prediction and the ground-truth noise under the target distribution. Training the model to fit this pseudo-target enables efficient target adaptation. Theoretically, we prove that DR-Diff guarantees target risk reduction at the population level. It also achieves a pseudo-doubly robust property, providing resilience against density ratio estimation errors and base model misspecifications. Empirically, DR-Diff matches the noise prediction accuracy of models trained from scratch on synthetic datasets. Furthermore, it mitigates inter-group disparities in downstream classification tasks.

</details>


### [580] [Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16317)
*Ziqing Wen,Xiaohui Song,Jiahuan Wang,Ping Luo,Junlin Zeng,Dongsheng Li,Tao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WIS-MeZO 用 Wanda 权重-激活显著性构建任务相关的稀疏扰动掩码，在保持预训练模型稠密的前提下降低零阶优化的搜索维度，在 16 个基准上优于 MeZO 且收敛更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶（ZO）优化可仅靠前向评估实现大模型显存高效的微调，但高维随机扰动会降低优化效率；稀疏扰动虽能减少搜索维度，却使"哪些坐标被选中"成为关键问题。

Method: 提出 WIS-MeZO：利用 Wanda 权重-激活显著性构造任务条件化的稀疏扰动掩码，而模型参数本身保持稠密；并从梯度能量捕获角度分析支撑集（support）质量，将其与梯度估计误差和收敛性建立联系。

Result: 在覆盖 LLaMA 与 Qwen（3B–32B）的 16 个基准上，WIS-MeZO 的综合得分高于 MeZO，并在更少的优化步数内达到可比验证损失；与随机稀疏扰动和基于幅值的稀疏扰动相比，凸显了信息性支撑集选择的重要性。

Conclusion: 稀疏扰动中支撑集的选取质量直接决定 ZO 微调效率；基于显著性的任务条件化掩码是一种有效且低开销的改进方向。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. Comparisons with random and magnitude-based sparse perturbations further highlight the importance of informative support selection.

</details>


### [581] [Climate Temporal Temperature Prediction via an Adaptive Stacked Bidirectional Residual Mamba Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16322)
*Yongxiang Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Deep DualMamba，一种基于改进 Mamba 选择性状态空间模型的深度学习框架，用于温度时间序列预测，具有线性复杂度、无注意力与 MLP 的简化结构，并在英国气象站数据上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 Transformer 架构在长序列上计算效率低，而先前的次二次复杂度模型难以实现长期且鲁棒的预测。作者希望兼顾可扩展性与预测性能，用于气温预测。

Method: 基于选择性结构化状态空间模型（SSM）构建 Deep DualMamba；提出自适应双向 Mamba 作为编码器学习复杂高效特征；设计硬件感知的并行循环算法弥补卷积效率损失；理论上分析其逼近能力与收敛性；整体为无注意力、无 MLP 的线性复杂度架构。

Result: 使用英国监测站历史气象数据构建完整预测流程进行验证；架构具有随序列长度的线性复杂度并显著提升推理吞吐，表现出对长期鲁棒预测的改进能力。

Conclusion: Deep DualMamba 为气温预测提供了一种可扩展、高效且理论上可分析的 SSM 新范式，适合气候信息学中的长期时间序列预测应用。

Abstract: Accurate temperatures forecasting relies on traditional meteorological parameters that are essential for monitoring weather informatics and guiding forecasting efforts. This study presents Deep DualMamba, a novel deep learning framework for temporal temperature prediction, built upon an enhanced variant of the recently proposed Mamba network. Unlike conventional Transformer-based architectures, which dominate foundation models but suffer from computational inefficiencies on long sequences, Deep DualMamba leverages selective structured state space models (SSMs) to achieve both scalability and performance. We identify a core limitation of prior subquadratic-time models-namely, their inability to perform long-term and robust forecasting and introduce two key innovations. First, we propose an adaptive bidirectional Mamba as encoders to learn complex and efficient features. Second, we develop a hardware-aware, parallel recurrent algorithm to compensate for the loss of convolutional efficiency, ensuring practical viability at scale. Last, the Deep DualMamba's approximation ability and convergence is theoretical analyzed. These design choices culminate in a simplified, attention- and MLP-free neural architecture that exhibits linear complexity with sequence length and significantly improved inference throughput. To demonstrate its applicability in climate informatics, we implement a full forecasting pipeline using historical meteorological data from UK monitoring stations.

</details>


### [582] [DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16345)
*Yi-Hsin Hung,Fangfu Liu,Shao-Yuan Lo,Chu-Song Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出训练无关加速框架DRAMA，通过系统测量多模态扩散LLM的注意力冗余，用视觉token剪枝与自适应停止实现平均18.67倍加速且精度保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态扩散LLM每一步去噪都要对长多模态序列做全前向，视觉token占据序列长度主体，固定步数预算放大每步二次开销；现有加速方法仅凭孤立注意力可视化隐式刻画冗余，缺乏测量依据。

Method: 先沿空间与时间轴探测注意力张量，发现两条冗余结构：注意力集中于稀疏视觉token子集；注意力分布在初始形成阶段后随去噪步迅速稳定。据此设计两个机制：空间冗余感知视觉token剪枝（SVTP）和充分性引导自适应停止（SGAS），无需训练、不改架构、不做注意力缓存。

Result: 在六个视觉语言基准上平均获得18.67倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。

Conclusion: DRAMA为多模态扩散LLM推理建立了扎实、以测量为依据的加速基线，其冗余观测也为后续设计提供参考。

Abstract: Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement. We close this gap with DRAMA, a training-free acceleration framework grounded in a systematic dissection of attention redundancy in multimodal dLLMs. By probing attention tensors along spatial and temporal axes, we reveal two persistent redundancy structures: (i) attention mass consistently concentrates on a sparse subset of visual tokens, and (ii) attention distributions rapidly stabilize across denoising steps after an initial formation phase. These findings motivate two complementary mechanisms: Spatial-Redundancy-Aware Visual Token Pruning (SVTP) and Sufficiency-Guided Adaptive Stopping (SGAS). Together, DRAMA achieves an average 18.67 times inference speedup across six vision-language benchmarks without training, architectural modification, or attention caching, while maintaining competitive accuracy. Our results establish a strong, measurement-grounded acceleration baseline for multimodal dLLM inference.

</details>


### [583] [MutAtlas: A PDB-Wide Energy-Guided Atlas of Protein Mutation Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16361)
*Ruihan Guo,Chaoran Cheng,Zhanghan Ni,Neil He,Bangji Yang,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文构建PDB全库单点突变增强数据集，发现物理模型、蛋白语言模型与逆折叠模型的突变偏好存在普遍分歧，并提出无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，在不使用实验标签下于ProteinGym取得最佳零样本性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验测得的蛋白质突变数据准确但极其稀疏，难以支撑大规模突变效应预测，需要可扩展的补充突变信号；而现有物理模型、语言模型等多源信号之间的一致性与分歧性质尚缺乏统一分析。
