### [619] [Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17214)
*Aarush Kulkarni,Khang Nguyen,William Chang,Yan Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究带未知转移和bandit反馈的对抗性马尔可夫决策过程（AMDP）中的遗憾最小化，提出"引入反馈延迟"（Feedback Delays）通用技术，配合含拒绝的几何重采样（GRR）和访问概率阈值化，首次在tabular AMDP达到√S-最优遗憾、在线性AMDP达到K-最优遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: tabular AMDP中已知最优遗憾与下界间长期存在√S差距；线性AMDP中五年改进后高效算法仍仅达Õ(K^{3/4})。两者共同难点在于估计变化策略的Q函数：历史数据来自与当前策略相关但不同的旧策略，而冻结策略又会恶化对K的依赖。

Method: 提出"引入反馈延迟"技术：用未来回合的数据估计当前策略的Q函数，同时持续更新策略，仿佛反馈被延迟；该延迟是主动引入的、几乎无额外代价。用含拒绝的几何重采样（GRR）处理延迟期间策略变化，并对访问概率做阈值化以避免稀有状态动作对产生过长延迟。统一应用于策略优化算法。

Result: 高概率下，tabular AMDP取得Õ(poly(H)√(SAK))遗憾，解决√S开放问题；线性AMDP取得Õ(poly(d,H)√K)遗憾，为首个K最优的高效算法。方法自然扩展至总延迟𝔇的延迟AMDP，给出首个在S与𝔇（tabular）、K与𝔇（线性）上同时最优的界。

Conclusion: 主动引入反馈延迟可将"变化策略下Q函数估计"这一核心障碍转化为无代价工具，统一解决tabular与线性AMDP的长期开放问题，并推广到延迟AMDP设置。

Abstract: We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback. In tabular AMDPs with $S$ states, $A$ actions, and horizon $H$, the best known $K$-episode regret is $\tilde O(HS\sqrt{AK})$, whose $\sqrt S$ gap to the $Ω(H\sqrt{SAK})$ lower bound has long remained open. In linear AMDPs with $d$-dimensional features, after a five-year line of improvements starting from $K^{14/15}$, computationally efficient algorithms without a simulator or exploratory assumptions still only attain $\tilde O(K^{3/4})$ regret.
  A common challenge in both settings is to estimate the Q-function of a changing policy: past data comes from earlier policies that differ from (and are correlated with) the current one, while freezing the policy for future episodes worsens the dependency on $K$. We instead propose a general technique called introduced feedback delays: we estimate the Q-function of the policy using future episodes while still updating the policy, as if the feedback were delayed. While feedback delays are usually an obstacle imposed by the environment, here they are introduced voluntarily and, perhaps surprisingly, come at no extra cost. We develop Geometric Resampling with Rejection (GRR) to account for policy changes during the delay, and threshold the visitation probabilities to avoid long delays on rarely visited state-action pairs.
  With this unified technique, our policy optimization algorithms achieve, with high probability, $\tilde O(\text{poly}(H)\sqrt{SAK})$ regret in tabular AMDPs, resolving the open problem; and $\tilde O(\text{poly}(d,H)\sqrt K)$ regret in linear AMDPs, giving the first efficient algorithm optimal in $K$. They also naturally extend to delayed AMDPs with a total feedback delay $\mathfrak D$, yielding the first bounds optimal in $S$ and $\mathfrak D$ (tabular) and in $K$ and $\mathfrak D$ (linear).

</details>


### [620] [Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17230)
*Audrey Xie,Ludwig Schmidt,John Duchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析知识蒸馏的数学模型，论证蒸馏的优势来自更易优化的损失景观，而非更好的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释知识蒸馏成功的众多假说彼此竞争，缺乏统一理论；作者希望厘清蒸馏究竟在哪些方面带来收益。

Method: 构建蒸馏的数学分析框架：(1) 对用SGD训练的广义线性模型，证明蒸馏可渐近更快地拟合出有效学生模型；(2) 在秩1矩阵近似中，刻画目标矩阵满足什么条件时带蒸馏的梯度下降严格快于仅用监督目标训练。

Result: 理论上证明蒸馏加速优化收敛；实验表明蒸馏的收益体现在优化速度而非泛化能力，且真实数据集实验与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 蒸馏的核心机制是塑造更易优化的景观；该理论界定了蒸馏的收益边界（加速优化、不改善泛化）。

Abstract: Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation. To help address this, we propose and analyze a mathematical model of distillation, which suggests that distillation's performance comes not from obtaining better models but from easier to optimize landscapes. For generalized linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent, we prove that distillation fits performant student models asymptotically more quickly than non-distilled models. In rank-1 matrix approximation, we characterize conditions on the target matrix under which gradient descent with distillation converges strictly faster than training on the supervised objective. The theory helps delineate the ways distillation provides benefits (i.e., in optimization speed, not in generalization), and experiments on real datasets corroborate the theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [621] [Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17303)
*Tosca Lechner,Vinayak Pathak,Sivan Sabato,Ruth Urner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将"辩论式训练协议"从博弈分析转向学习问题，用在线学习框架刻画其可学习性，发现对抗式辩论并非最优，提出合作式协议并用组合维度刻画其可学习性，同时指出裁判少量错误会导致学习出现很大误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作只把辩论当作两个辩论者之间、裁判已知的博弈来分析，忽略了它本质上是训练协议，因而缺乏对其中隐含学习问题的理解。

Method: 将辩论协议形式化为在线学习问题；在精确刻画学习问题后，构造反例说明在可接触裁判的情况下，最优学习方式与运行对抗式辩论不同；据此定义合作式辩论协议，并用某个组合维度刻画其可学习性；进一步分析裁判会偶发误判的情形。

Result: 存在最优学习策略不同于对抗式辩论的情形；给出合作式协议的可学习性刻画；裁判的少量判断错误会导致学习结果出现较大误差。

Conclusion: 理解辩论需要从学习而非仅博弈的角度出发，合作式协议更具可学习性保证，而裁判可靠性对学习效果至关重要。

Abstract: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale. The idea is that the human, instead of providing supervision in the form of labels, judges a debate between two models that compete to prove the correctness of opposite labels. It can be shown that functions of a much higher computational complexity can be correctly judged in this way, compared to the complexity of functions that can be directly evaluated using a computationally weak evaluator. This suggests that perhaps debate can be used to teach very complicated functions to models. However, previous work has largely ignored the fact that this is a training protocol, and simply analyzes the game being played between the two debaters for a known judge. We take the first steps towards understanding the learning problem implicit within the protocol, by formulating it as an online learning problem. We show that once we formulate the learning problem precisely, there are cases where the best way to learn given access to a judge is different from running an adversarial debate. This motivates us to define a cooperative version of the protocol, whose learnability we characterize using a combinatorial dimension. We also consider the possibility of the human judge being fallible and occasionally judging the debate incorrectly. We show that a small number of errors in judgement can lead to a large error in learning.

</details>


### [622] [Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17329)
*Zeynep Yıldız,Satchit Chatterji,Ercan Atam,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种受PLPG启发的连续动作空间神经符号配置方法，将"策略自身执行动作满足投资约束"的概率（用重参数化蒙特卡洛采样估计）加入训练目标，使智能体学习内化符号化投资指令而非依赖事后强制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机构投资组合受投资政策声明中的资产配置约束限制（常以市场状态为条件）。深度强化学习虽能优化金融表现，却通常不强制规则合规，难以实际部署；现有神经符号方法如PLPG可满足约束，但假设有限离散动作空间，不适用于连续资产配置。

Method: PLPG式连续配置方法：通过重参数化蒙特卡洛采样估计策略实际执行动作满足投资指令的概率，并将其作为项加入训练目标；推理时无任何事后拦截机制，合规性由智能体自主学习获得。

Result: 在无任何修正下直接审计确定性均值动作：六条规则、状态条件化的投资指令下，无约束RL违规率96–98%，奖励惩罚基线33.4%，本方法降至4.8%。

Conclusion: 连续动作空间的神经符号策略能实质性内化符号化投资指令，无需事后强制即可显著降低违规率，为合规约束下的深度RL实盘部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [623] [The Price of Anarchy in Markets for Lemons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14858)
*Naveen Durvasula,Tim Roughgarden*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究相互依赖估值下简单双边贸易机制的均衡贸易收益，给出序贯均衡能达到最优收益常数比例的充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相互依赖估值下，提议价格会传递提议者的私人信息，均衡复杂；贸易损失既来自筛选造成的低效，也来自逆向选择，因此需要刻画何时均衡仍能保证可观的贸易收益。

Method: 将均衡贸易收益与一个辅助的独立私人价值市场中的提议者利润建立联系，从而推导出保证常数比例近似最优的广泛条件，并量化稀有悲观卖方信号与稀有乐观买方信号的作用。

Result: 在广范条件下，序贯均衡可保证获得最优贸易收益的常数比例；该结论适用于卖方提议、买方提议与随机提议机制，界值刻画出稀有信号的核心影响。

Conclusion: 简单双边贸易机制在相互依赖估值下虽存在筛选与逆向选择损失，但均衡仍具鲁棒性，可通过辅助独立私人价值市场的提议者利润进行分析。

Abstract: We study the worst-case equilibrium gains from trade in simple bilateral trade mechanisms with interdependent valuations. Equilibria in such settings are typically complex, as proposed prices can convey private information held by the proposer. Such equilibria suffer lost gains from trade both due to the inefficiency introduced by screening (as in independent private value settings) and due to adverse selection. We identify broad conditions under which, nevertheless, sequential equilibria are guaranteed to achieve a constant fraction of the first-best gains from trade. Our bounds quantify the central role of rare pessimistic seller signals and rare optimistic buyer signals. The results apply to seller-proposer, buyer-proposer, and random-proposer mechanisms. The key idea in our analysis is to relate equilibrium gains from trade to proposer profits in an auxiliary market with independent private values.

</details>


### [624] [Who Moved the Frontier? Paying Open Frontier Challenges with Free Identities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14974)
*Luca Zanolini,Duc V. Le*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究开放前沿挑战赛中身份免费情况下如何公平付费的问题，分析排名奖与预测市场规则的漏洞，提出按提交收费、信用版税等机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放挑战赛任何人（人或AI）都可提交对共享问题的改动，超过最佳分数即成为公开基线。身份免费时排名奖可被女巫攻击刷取（一人的两个身份可包揽第一二名），需设计抗操纵的支付规则。

Method: 在精确分数下，证明仅看步骤起点与终点的规则中，只有预测市场式"按进步付费"规则能抵抗拆分与合并，额外身份无收益；在带噪分数与独立正态运行下，证明任何不追回款项且为真实改进付费的规则，平均也会为无作为的改动付费；提出每次提交收费（至少等于运气收益）；引入基于"缺少先前改动时后续增益下降多少"的版税机制。

Result: 精确分数下进步付费规则唯一抗拆分合并；噪声下存在不可避免的"运气支付"；按次收费在验证者诚实且噪声不超计划时可消除期望利润，但无机制保证该界限且不封顶总支付；信用规则至多支付等于说谎成本；版税无需声明但需可移除改动；在五个公开挑战上给出所支持的规则。

Conclusion: 开放挑战赛的支付设计需兼顾抗女巫、抗拆分合并与噪声稳健性；单一规则难以完美，需组合按次收费与进步付费/版税机制，并在实际公开挑战中验证其适用性。

Abstract: In an open frontier challenge, anyone, person or AI agent, submits changes to a shared problem, and a change that beats the best measured score becomes the public baseline. How should it pay when identities are free? Rank prizes can be gamed: on a replay of one track of a recent challenge, one solver's steps under two identities would have taken first and second prize. We consider a prediction-market rule, proposed for machine-learning contests, that pays each accepted step for the progress it adds; with exact scores, among rules that see only a step's start and end, only these resist splitting and merging, and extra identities gain nothing. With noisy scores and independent normal runs, we prove that any payment that never takes money back and pays real improvements also pays something, on average, to a change that does nothing. We propose a fee per submission, at least what luck pays per attempt, that removes each attempt's expected profit if verifiers are honest and no submission is noisier than planned; nothing enforces that bound, and under noise the rule does not cap the total paid. If crediting another and faking credit to one's second account look the same, a rule that neither rewards fakes nor punishes honesty pays for credit at most what lying costs. We introduce a royalty on how much a later gain falls without the earlier change, which needs no claims but needs removable changes. For five public challenges, we name the rule our results would support.

</details>


### [625] [The Golden Ratio: EF1 and Ordinal-MMS for Additive Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15582)
*Hadi Hosseini,Shraddha Pathak*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文研究带公平性与份额保证的完整分配问题，证明在可加估值下存在同时满足EF1与1-out-of-⌊φn⌋-MMS的完整分配（φ为黄金比），并在双值估值下得到同时满足EFX与1-out-of-⌈(7n-1)/6⌉-MMS的完整分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知EF1仅能保证每个代理人获得1-out-of-(2n-1)的MMS，该界较弱。作者希望构造同时满足EF1与更强序数型MMS保证的分配，从而改进公平性与份额保证之间的权衡。

Method: 针对可加估值，通过构造性证明展示存在既是EF1又是1-out-of-⌊φn⌋-MMS的完整分配（φ为黄金比）；针对双值估值（每个代理人对物品仅有各自的两种非负取值），给出使分配同时满足EFX与1-out-of-⌈(7n-1)/6⌉-MMS的构造。

Result: 可加估值下：EF1 + 1-out-of-⌊φn⌋-MMS的完整分配恒存在，将分母从2n-1改进到约1.618n。双值估值下：EFX + 1-out-of-⌈(7n-1)/6⌉-MMS的完整分配存在，分母约为1.167n，远优于2n-1。

Conclusion: 更强的序数MMS保证可与EF1（乃至EFX）同时实现，显著优于EF1单独给出的1-out-of-(2n-1)界，揭示了公平性与份额保证之间存在比以往认识更优的权衡。

Abstract: Every complete allocation that is envy-free up to one good (EF1) guarantees each of the $n$ agents her $1$-out-of-$(2n-1)$ maximin share. Can we construct allocations that satisfy EF1 together with stronger ordinal maximin share guarantees? For additive valuations, we prove that there always exists a complete allocation that is simultaneously EF1 and ($1$-out-of-$\lfloor\varphi n\rfloor$)-MMS, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt{5})/2$ is the golden ratio. For bivalued valuations, where each agent may have her own two non-negative values for the goods, we obtain a complete allocation that is simultaneously envy-free up to any good (EFX) and ($1$-out-of-$\lceil(7n-1)/6\rceil$)-MMS.

</details>


### [626] [Core nonemptiness for $2/3$-convex games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16207)
*Keisuke Bando,Toshiyuki Hirai,Kenzo Imamura,Ryuhei Mizutani*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究2/3-凸博弈的核心，证明其总存在边际贡献向量在核中，并给出线性时间构造算法，同时用OSCE"共识减二"程序建模应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凸博弈（convex games）是一类重要的TU博弈，但条件较强。作者希望研究较弱的放松条件——要求任意三个不同联盟中至少两个满足超模不等式（即2/3-凸），来扩展凸博弈理论并刻画核心非空性。

Method: 定义一个联盟博弈为2/3-凸若任意三个不同联盟中至少有两条超模不等式成立；通过构造性证明找出一个边际贡献向量位于核心；并分析其与置换凸性（permutational convexity）的关系，加入单元素对超可加性条件；最后以OSCE共识减二程序构建TU模型作为应用实例。

Result: 证明每个2/3-凸博弈都存在边际贡献向量在核中，因此核心非空，且证明是构造性的，可在线性时间内找到该核心分配；证明2/3-凸一般不蕴含置换凸性，但在单元素对超可加条件下蕴含关系成立；给出的OSCE模型所导出的博弈是2/3-凸但不必为凸。

Conclusion: 2/3-凸是新的一类广义凸博弈，保证核心非空且可线性时间求得核心分配，并具有良好的应用背景（OSCE共识程序），但置换凸性需要额外条件。

Abstract: We study the core of $2/3$-convex games, a class of transferable-utility (TU) games that generalizes convex games, which requires at least two of any three distinct coalitions satisfy the supermodular inequality. We show that every $2/3$-convex game admits a marginal worth vector in the core, and hence has a nonempty core. Our proof is constructive and yields a linear-time algorithm for finding such a core allocation. We also show that $2/3$-convexity does not imply permutational convexity in general, while the implication holds under an additional superadditivity condition on pairs of singletons. As an application, we introduce a TU model motivated by the OSCE's consensus-minus-two procedure and show that the resulting game is $2/3$-convex but need not be convex.

</details>


### [627] [Designing Information in a Forest: Algorithmic Aspects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16327)
*Konstantin Zabarnyi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究"森林层级"多接收者贝叶斯说服的计算复杂度：对称效用可多项式求解、模块效用可多项式求解，但超模效用NP难且无FPTAS，并给出依赖森林深度的近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典贝叶斯说服有私密说服与公开说服两极，而现实中的层级组织（部分接收者获得更精细信号）位于两者之间。作者希望用有向森林刻画这种信息层级，并厘清其计算可解性边界。

Method: 设定二元状态、二元行动、异质接收者，发送者效用是采取目标行动接收者集合的单调函数。借助最优传输理论的思路，将私密说服中对称效用的可解性推广到森林层级；对模块效用给出多项式算法；对超模效用做NP难与不可近似性归约；并构造按森林深度线性比例的近似算法。

Result: 对称效用情形多项式时间可解；模块效用亦有多项式算法；超模效用下问题NP难且不存在FPTAS（除非P=NP），即使每棵树只是3个接收者的链；给出近似比线性依赖于森林深度的近似算法及子模效用对应算法；在森林层级之外，即使对称效用也无法得到FPTAS。

Conclusion: 森林层级严格扩大了可处理的场景但不改变全部易解性；效用函数的单调性与结构（模块/超模/子模）显著决定复杂度，深度成为自然的近似参数。

Abstract: The Bayesian persuasion framework models strategic information revelation by a sender to one or more receivers. We study an intricate version of the multi-receiver persuasion setting in which the communication hierarchy is a forest - i.e., some receivers observe more informative signals than others, and the partial ordering of the receivers according to the information they get is represented by a pre-specified directed forest. This model naturally captures interactions in hierarchical organizations, and it lies in between the two most commonly studied versions of Bayesian persuasion: private persuasion and public persuasion. Inspired by the classic model of private persuasion, we focus on a setting with a binary state of nature and binary-action heterogeneous receivers s.t. the sender's utility is a monotone function of the set of receivers taking a specific desirable action.
  We extend the computational tractability result for symmetric sender's utility from private persuasion to the forest hierarchy framework using methodology inspired by optimal transport theory. We further provide a polynomial-time algorithm when the sender's utility is modular. On the negative side, we show that, unlike in private persuasion, the case of a supermodular sender's utility function leads to an NP-hard optimization problem which further does not admit an FPTAS unless P=NP; this result holds even when each tree component of the forest is a chain of 3 receivers. To complement the hardness result, we provide a simple approximation algorithm with the approximation ratio depending linearly on the depth of the forest hierarchy. We further provide an analogous algorithm for the submodular utility case. Finally, beyond forest communication hierarchies, we rule out an FPTAS for the sender's optimal utility even in the symmetric utility case, unless P=NP.

</details>


### [628] [Accuracy Is Not Welfare: Evaluating AI Buyers under Strategic Price Complexity in a Synthetic Duopoly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16471)
*Ning Jiaqu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 在合成双寡头市场中比较价格比较型 AI 购物代理的不同流程，发现"计算器式"准确率虽高（84.00% vs 68.57%），但"总量核实披露"能带来更高的消费者最差均衡剩余（+20.14）。结论对评估方式高度敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 购买代理不仅影响消费者决策，还会改变卖方的定价激励；因此需要区分"代理准确率"与"消费者福利"这两件不同的事，检验不同价格比较流程在策略性卖方环境下的福利后果。

Method: 构建合成双寡头模型，在固定报价菜单上评估价格比较流程，并在经验相关的均衡博弈中求解；对比两种流程——计算器式辅助选择与"已验证总量披露"；采用冻结策略的留出集比较，并对场景重采样重新求解均衡以检验稳健性。

Result: 计算器辅助在 84.00% 的情况下选出最优报价，已验证总量披露仅 68.57%；但披露在消费者最差均衡中剩余高出 20.14 单位。冻结策略留出比较支持披露方案，而对场景重采样重新求解均衡得到的区间跨越零，说明结论并不稳健。

Conclusion: 基于模型的结果表明：准确率、损失严重程度、卖方激励与福利归属必须分别测量；单一准确率指标不能代表消费者福利，评估方法（固定策略 vs 重新求均衡）本身会改变结论。

Abstract: AI buying agents may alter sellers' incentives as well as consumers' decisions. In a synthetic duopoly, we evaluate price-comparison pipelines on a fixed menu and in empirical correlated-equilibrium games. Calculator assistance selects an optimal offer 84.00% of the time, versus 68.57% under verified-total disclosure, yet disclosure has a 20.14-unit higher consumer-worst equilibrium surplus. A frozen-strategy holdout comparison favors disclosure, while re-solving equilibria under scenario resampling produces a range spanning zero. These model-based results show why accuracy, loss severity, seller incentives, and welfare incidence require separate measurement.

</details>


### [629] [How to Defeat a Mafia (of Size 1)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16496)
*Michael Brand*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文分析带有一名侦探(d=1)的"黑手党"社会推理博弈在 m=d=1 情形下的最优策略，首次在 d=0 之外给出了显式且可证明最优的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有博弈论分析多只考虑无侦探(d=0)变体；一旦引入侦探角色，策略极其复杂，此前只能通过特定策略给出胜负的上界与下界，缺乏可证明最优的显式策略。

Method: 针对 m=d=1（1名黑手党、1名侦探）的特定情形进行博弈论分析，构造并刻画显式最优策略，并给出其最优性证明。

Result: 给出了一个 d>0 情形下显式且可证明最优的获胜策略，是首个超越 d=0 的此类实例。

Conclusion: 在侦探角色引入后复杂策略的背景下，m=d=1 提供了一个可完整求解的基准案例，为理解带侦探博弈的最优性提供了起点。

Abstract: The game "Mafia'' is a social deduction game where $n$ players attempt to uncover a covert coalition of $m$ players among the $n$. Typically, $d=1$ of the non-coalition players are labelled ``Detective'' and have special abilities. Most game-theoretic analysis considers, however, only the variant without a Detective. Once the Detective role is introduced, extremely complex strategies can be employed, for which reason only upper and lower bounds for winning have been established, namely by considering specific strategies. We analyse the case $m=d=1$, providing a first example where an explicit, provably-optimal strategy can be described beyond $d=0$.

</details>


### [630] [Regime-Uncertain Data Transactions: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Self-Adapting and Self-Diagnosing Multi-ML-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16603)
*Chethana Prasad Kabgere*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文将跨组织/跨境ML代理间的数据交换建模为"规则不确定的转移博弈"，代理对适用法规持贝叶斯信念、可付费解锁保障或核验声明，再就剩余合法组合进行Zeuthen式单调让步谈判（LCNB），并在含GDPR、DPDP、CCPA/CPRA的合成环境中验证低违规率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主ML代理在大型组织间交换数据与模型输出，但适用规则随数据主体居住地、代理运行地、所有权、目标对象及法规版本而变化，且数据标签有噪声、交易方可能虚报合规保障，亟需一个能处理规则不确定性的交换机制。

Method: 把单次交换建模为两代理+执法者的三方"规则不确定转移博弈"；规则作为硬约束以"最严格者胜"结构生效；代理持有关于适用规则的贝叶斯信念，可付费解锁保障或核验对方声明，随后对剩余合法组合进行谈判。实现为 Legally-Constrained Nash Bargaining（LCNB），采用基于Zeuthen规则的单调让步协议，并证明该模型的四条性质，在含GDPR、DPDP、CCPA/CPRA及一个更严格样式化规则的合成模拟器中测试。

Result: 在居住地与国籍不一致的三个压力测试案例中，有两个案例下基于国籍的规则在21–37%的共享记录上违规，而LCNB低于1%。但也暴露局限：在默认经济参数下LCNB几乎只共享聚合数据，低违规率部分源于此；违规容忍度、标签噪声与执法强度比谈判解的选择更关键。

Conclusion: LCNB在规则不确定的跨法域交换中显著降低违规率，但其效果依赖于保守的共享策略与外部参数（容忍度、标签质量、执法强度），而非谈判解本身；机制设计与治理参数需协同考量。

Abstract: Autonomous ML agents in large organizations exchange data and model outputs across organizational and legal boundaries. Which rules bind a given exchange is not fixed. It depends on where the data subjects live, where the agents run, who owns them, whom they target, and which version of each rule is in force. Tags that describe the data can be noisy, and a counterparty can overclaim its safeguards. We model one exchange as a \emph{regime-uncertain transfer game} between two ML agents, with an enforcer as a third player. Rules enter as hard constraints with a strictest-wins structure. Agents hold a Bayesian belief over which rules apply, can pay to unlock safeguards or verify claims, and then bargain over the remaining legal bundles.Our method, Legally-Constrained Nash Bargaining (\LCNB), implements this with a Monotonic Concession Protocol using Zeuthen's rule. We prove four properties of the model and test it in a synthetic simulator with GDPR, DPDP, CCPA/CPRA and a stylised stricter regime. In two of three stress cases where residence and citizenship differ, a citizenship-based rule violates in 21--37\% of shared records, and \LCNB{} in under 1\%. The results also show limits. With our default economics, \LCNB{} shares almost only aggregates, and its low violation rate follows partly from that. Violation tolerance, tag noise and enforcement strength matter more than the choice of bargaining solution.

</details>


### [631] [Tight Bounds for Downward-Closed Prophet and Secretary Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16880)
*Hanrui Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究任意向下封闭可行性约束下的在线选择（prophet 与 secretary）问题，在不同到达顺序与分布假设下给出近乎紧的竞争比：对抗序 prophet 为 Θ(log²n/log log n)，随机序 prophet secretary 与 secretary 为 Ω(log n)（结合已有上界即紧），自由序 prophet 为 O(log n/log log n)，从而统一确定了各变体的渐近最优竞争比，并给出随机序与自由序模型间的超常数分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作虽在多种 prophet/secretary 变体上给出上下界，但部分界之间仍存在差距，尤其在下向封闭约束这一统一框架下，各变体（对抗序、随机序、自由序；先验/无先验）的竞争比尚未全部确定。作者希望借助统一分析澄清这些变体的渐近最优竞争比，并刻画到达顺序信息（随机序 vs 自由序）的价值。

Method: 在任意向下封闭约束族下构造统一的下界/上界实例与分析框架，针对四类到达顺序与先验假设分别证明匹配界；技术上细化并强化 Rubinstein 与 Singla [2026] 提出的"大决策优先（big-decisions-first）"原则，将其用于刻画随机序与自由序之间的差异。

Result: (1) 对抗序 prophet：Θ(log²n/log log n)；(2) 贝叶斯随机序 prophet secretary 及无先验随机序 secretary：Ω(log n)，与已有上界结合为 Θ(log n)；(3) 自由序 prophet：O(log n/log log n)。综上，下向封闭约束下所有这些 prophet/secretary 变体的竞争比均达到渐近紧。

Conclusion: 下向封闭约束下 prophet 与 secretary 各变体的竞争比被完全确定，且随机序与自由序模型间存在超常数分离；"大决策优先"原则得到细化与强化，为理解到达顺序信息的价值提供了统一视角。

Abstract: We study online selection problems subject to arbitrary downward-closed feasibility constraints, under different arrival orders, with different distributional assumptions. We establish the following bounds: (1) $Θ(\log^2 n / \log \log n)$ for the standard (adversarial-order) prophet problem, (2) $Ω(\log n)$ for the (Bayesian, random-order) prophet secretary problem, and by extension, for the standard (prior-free, random-order) secretary problem, and (3) $O(\log n / \log \log n)$ for the free-order prophet problem. Together with complementary bounds established in prior work, these results pin down the asymptotically tight competitive ratios for all these variants of prophet and secretary problems subject to downward-closed constraints. Our results refine and reinforce the big-decisions-first principle by Rubinstein and Singla [2026], establishing a superconstant separation between the random-order and free-order models.

</details>


### [632] [Learning Dynamics of the Influencer's Game in Resource Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17148)
*Mark Lovett Feng Fu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出"影响力博弈"空间博弈框架，策略为性状空间中的位置，玩家按相对影响力分得资源份额；在影响核严格对数凹下存在唯一对称纳什均衡，并给出依赖于玩家散布与曲率的稳定性阈值，越界后出现专家聚簇、极限环与自相似子博弈等分岔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生态学、经济学与在线平台等领域中，个体倾向于挤入资源丰厚的策略空间区域，但缺乏统一框架来刻画"竞争压力导致收敛还是碎片化"这一问题。

Method: 构建影响力博弈：玩家策略为性状空间中的位置，依据其在资源点上的相对影响力获得资源份额。证明严格对数凹影响核下唯一对称纳什均衡；基于该均衡做稳定性分析，推导任意维度下依赖散布与曲率的稳定性阈值；用真实资源数据验证；并将动力学扩展到多智能体强化学习，在部分可观测与离散策略空间下检验分岔结构。

Result: 系统稳定性取决于影响核参数、玩家数量与资源分布形状；存在通用稳定性阈值，越界后对称均衡失稳，产生专家聚簇、极限环以及复现大博弈结构的子博弈等多种分岔；真实数据示例支持该框架，且分岔结构在部分可观测与离散策略空间下依然持续。

Conclusion: 影响力博弈为预测竞争压力何时驱动收敛、何时引发碎片化提供了新框架，可跨领域应用（如生态、经济、在线平台）。

Abstract: Across domains as varied as ecology, economics, and online platforms, individuals are incentivized to position themselves within resource-rich strategy spaces. In this work we introduce a new spatial game framework called the influencer's game. Within this new framework players' strategies are represented as positions within a trait space. Players then receive a share of a portion of a resource based on their relative influence at that resource's points traits. For the influencer's game, we show that there is a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium that exists under strict log-concavity of the influence kernel. Using the unique equilibrium we show that the stability of the system depends on the influence kernel's parameters, number of players, and the resource distribution shape. For any dimension we demonstrate a stability threshold that depends on both the scatter and curvature of the players. When this threshold is crossed, the symmetric equilibrium destabilizes and gives way to a variety of bifurcation types; including, specialist clusters, limit cycles, and sub-games that reproduce the larger game's structure. We ground these results using real-world data for resources as a demonstration of the game's application. Finally we extend the game dynamics to use multi-agent reinforcement learning and further show that the predicted bifurcation structure persists under partial observability and discretized strategy spaces. In all, the influencer's game provides a novel framework for predicting when competitive pressure drives convergence versus fragmentation with possible applications across domains.

</details>


### [633] [Fictitious Play When Agents Are Not Expected-Utility Maximizers: A Geometric Analysis in $2$-Action Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17286)
*Hao Liang,Solaleh Mohammadi,Kaiqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究非线性虚拟对弈（NL-FP）：用一般（可能非线性）的支付分布评价泛函替代期望效用，给出2×2博弈收敛的几何刻划，并揭示2×n博弈中即使连续时间也可能不收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典虚拟对弈假设智能体是期望效用最大化者，但实际学习智能体可能采用风险度量等非线性评价泛函来应对对手带来的不确定性，这类非线性虚拟对弈的收敛性质此前缺乏理解。

Method: 提出NL-FP模型：每个纯动作由对手经验信念所诱导支付分布的一般非线性泛函评价。首先识别评价泛函的单交叉性质（SCP），据此保持2×2博弈中FP的经典几何；即使SCP失效，也对2×2博弈收敛行为作新的几何分析。对2×n（n≥3）博弈，构造两动作玩家使用CVaR的2×3反例，并给出保证连续时间动力学与离散迭代收敛的有限交叉条件。

Result: SCP可保持2×2博弈中FP的经典几何结构；2×2博弈在SCP失效时仍可给出收敛的几何分析；2×3博弈中即使在连续时间下，CVaR型NL-FP也可能不收敛；有限交叉条件可保证一般2×n博弈中连续时间动力学和离散迭代的收敛。

Conclusion: 用非线性评价泛函可推广虚拟对弈，其收敛性可由SCP与有限交叉条件刻画；高维（2×n）中收敛可能失败，这一分析也为连续时间经典FP在该类博弈中的全局图景提供了新见解。

Abstract: Fictitious play (FP) is one of the earliest and most fundamental learning procedures in games, where each agent independently chooses a best response to the empirical distribution of opponents' past actions by maximizing the expected payoff with respect to it. However, learning agents may not always be expected-utility maximizers: they may use nonlinear evaluation functionals to account for the uncertainty induced by the opponents, e.g., via risk measures. In this work, we study nonlinear fictitious play (NL-FP), in which each pure action is evaluated by a general, possibly nonlinear functional of the payoff distribution induced by the opponent's empirical belief. To analyze NL-FP, we first identify a single-crossing property (SCP) of evaluation functionals that preserves the classical geometry of FP in $2\times2$ games. Furthermore, we conduct a novel geometric analysis of the convergence behavior of NL-FP in $2\times2$ games, even when the SCP fails. Beyond $2\times2$ games, we show that the convergence of NL-FP in $2\times n$ ($n\ge3$) games may fail even for continuous-time NL-FP, when the two-action player uses conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) in a $2\times3$ game. In addition, we identify a finite-crossing condition that ensures convergence of the selected continuous-time dynamics and the discrete-time iterates in general $2\times n$ games, which also provides new insights into the global landscape of continuous-time classical FP in such games.

</details>


### [634] [The Tournament Equilibrium Set Is PSPACE-Complete, Even under Hereditary Uniqueness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17312)
*Ethan Dickey,Athina Terzoglou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明锦标赛平衡集（TEQ）的成员判定问题是PSPACE完全的，填补了此前NP-hard与PSPACE之间的复杂度间隙，并首次给出锦标赛解的成员问题的PSPACE完全性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TEQ由Schwartz于1990年提出，是基于两两多数比较的经典投票规则，其定义递归依赖于支配者及其TEQ选择。此前已知成员判定是NP-hard且属于PSPACE，二者之间存在间隙，作者希望确定其精确复杂度，并厘清支配者数量约束对复杂度的影响。

Method: 通过构造归约证明PSPACE困难性，即使在每个非空子锦标赛都有唯一最小维持集（Schwartz猜想性质）时仍成立；进一步证明单个至多4个支配者的选项即可保证唯一性并在O(N²)时间找到TEQ胜者；并系统分析支配者上界为1、2、4时的复杂度分层。

Result: 成员问题是PSPACE完全的；困难实例中每个子锦标赛均存在至多3个支配者的选项；若每子锦标赛存在至多1个支配者的选项，TEQ可二次时间计算；允许2个支配者则成员问题NP-hard；在4个支配者条件下，全部t个胜者可在O(2^t N²)时间计算。

Conclusion: TEQ成员判定的精确复杂度为PSPACE完全，且困难性在Schwartz猜想成立的唯一性条件下依然持续；复杂度随支配者上界呈现清晰分层：1为二次可解、2为NP-hard、4为O(2^t N²)，并揭示"找到一个胜者"与"识别指定胜者"之间存在显著的计算不对称。

Abstract: The tournament equilibrium set (TEQ), proposed by Schwartz in 1990, is a classical voting rule based on pairwise majority comparisons. Its definition is recursive: an alternative is judged by the alternatives that beat it, called its dominators, and by which of those dominators TEQ itself selects. Deciding whether a given alternative belongs to TEQ was known to be NP-hard and to lie in PSPACE. We close this gap by proving that the problem is PSPACE-complete. To our knowledge, this is the first PSPACE-completeness result for membership in a tournament solution.
  The hardness persists even when every nonempty subtournament has a unique minimal retentive set, the property conjectured by Schwartz to hold for all tournaments. Moreover, every such subtournament in our hard instances contains an alternative with at most three dominators. We prove that a single alternative with at most four dominators suffices both to guarantee uniqueness and to find a TEQ winner in $O(N^2)$ time. Thus, on our hard instances, finding one winner is efficient even though recognizing a specified winner is PSPACE-complete.
  We also study how the complexity changes with the dominator bound. If every nonempty subtournament has an alternative with at most one dominator, the entire TEQ can be computed in quadratic time; allowing two dominators makes membership NP-hard. Under the same condition with four dominators, all $t$ winners can be computed in $O(2^t N^2)$ time, where $N$ is the number of alternatives.

</details>
